summary: Long-running molecular simulation campaigns require repeated continuation from saved states, provenance-aware progression, adaptive assessment, and occasional interpretation of workflow conditions that cannot be resolved safely by fixed rules. Here, we present Agent-MD, a framework that places large language model (LLM) reasoning selectively at campaign construction and event-triggered review, while routine simulation, analysis, continuation, archiving, and state progression are handled by a persistent rule-based campaign agent using approved policies and explicit state records. Agent-MD was demonstrated in a grand canonical Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics (GCMC-MD) water-vapor desorption campaign comprising five montmorillonite systems and three sequential relative-humidity states (RH = 0.9-0.3-0.1). Across 15 system-RH states, the workflow completed 120 segmented simulation cycles with state-specific sampling lengths and provenance-aware restart inheritance. Routine production required no live reasoning-agent invocation, while one state reached a review boundary; two preserved incidents were subsequently evaluated through blinded reasoning-agent replay, which identified the underlying workflow problems and recommended appropriate follow-up actions. The simulations also revealed distinct composition-dependent low-RH responses, with Ca-bearing montmorillonite retaining more interlayer water and maintaining a larger basal spacing than the Na- and K-bearing systems, while the highest-charge Na system retained more residual water under dry conditions. These results demonstrate that long-running scientific workflows need not place every operation inside an LLM reasoning loop: selective reasoning can instead be combined with deterministic execution, structured evidence, and validated control handoffs to provide reproducible and auditable agent-assisted molecular simulation.

AI.tldr: Agent-MD是一个将大语言模型（LLM）推理选择性嵌入长时程分子模拟工作流的框架：日常模拟、分析、续算和归档由基于规则的持久化campaign agent负责，LLM仅在campaign构建和事件触发的审查环节介入。在GCMC-MD水蒸气脱附模拟中成功运行了5个蒙脱石体系和3个相对湿度状态，完成了120个分段模拟周期，验证了选择性推理与确定性执行结合的可行性与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 长时程分子模拟需要重复续算、溯源感知的进度推进、自适应评估以及对无法由固定规则安全解决的工作流条件进行解释。现有方案要么完全依赖人工干预，要么将所有操作置于LLM推理循环中，导致不可扩展、不可复现且成本高昂。作者希望提出一种架构，仅在必要环节使用LLM推理，而将常规操作交由确定性规则处理。
AI.method: Agent-MD采用双层架构：(1) 持久化的基于规则的campaign agent负责常规模拟执行、分析、续算、归档和状态推进，使用已批准的策略和显式状态记录；(2) LLM推理被选择性部署在campaign构建阶段和事件触发的审查节点。框架在GCMC-MD水蒸气脱附campaign中验证，覆盖5种蒙脱石体系×3个顺序相对湿度状态（RH=0.9→0.3→0.1），共15个体系-湿度状态，120个分段模拟周期，采用状态特定采样长度和溯源感知的restart继承机制。
AI.result: 工作流在15个体系-湿度状态下完成120个分段模拟周期；常规生产过程中无需在线LLM推理调用，仅有一个状态触发审查边界；两个保留的事件通过盲法LLM重放审查，成功识别了底层工作流问题并给出后续建议。模拟还揭示了组成依赖的低湿度响应：Ca-蒙脱石保留更多层间水并维持更大基面间距；最高电荷的Na体系在干燥条件下保留更多残余水。
AI.conclusion: 选择性LLM推理与确定性执行、结构化证据和验证过的控制交接相结合，即可为长时程科学工作流提供可复现和可审计的agent辅助分子模拟，无需将每个操作都置于LLM推理循环中。该架构为其他长时程计算密集型科学研究提供了范式参考。

title: Adaptive KappaSharp: Condition-Number Shaping for Preferential Bayesian Optimization
summary: Preferential Bayesian optimization (PBO) optimizes objectives accessible only through pairwise user comparisons. The standard approach fits a Gaussian process surrogate for observed pairwise comparisons (PairwiseGP) using the Laplace approximation and selects queries with the Expected Utility of Best Option (EUBO) acquisition function. EUBO queries new candidates at each step, producing pairs that share no candidates with previous queries. Each such pair forms an isolated component in the comparison graph, removing one degree of freedom from the likelihood Hessian and making it rank-deficient. This deficiency is structural and cannot be resolved by changing the surrogate modeling approach. Existing approaches to remedy this issue either waste query budget by forcing comparisons to stay connected, or apply uniform regularization that also perturbs directions already well-constrained by the observed comparisons. We propose KappaSharp that enables a diagonal correction to the Hessian to reduce its condition number, with larger corrections where the prior uncertainty is higher. The correction is only applied in the model fitting step, not query selection. An adaptive variant of KappaSharp is also presented that activates the correction only when the surrogate is confident about recent comparisons, avoiding unnecessary corrections when the problem is well-conditioned. On 11 benchmarks (5--20 dimensions), including a 16-dimensional controller tuning problem in plasma medicine, Adaptive KappaSharp outperforms the standard PBO baseline, with up to +10.9% ($p{=}0.003$).

AI.tldr: 本文提出KappaSharp方法，通过对角Hessian修正来解决偏好贝叶斯优化（PBO）中比较图结构导致的秩亏问题，并提出了自适应变体，在11个基准测试上（5-20维）显著优于标准PBO基线，最高提升10.9%。
AI.motivation: 标准PBO使用PairwiseGP和EUBO采集函数时，每次查询产生的新配对在比较图中形成孤立分量，导致似然Hessian秩亏。现有解决方案要么浪费查询预算（强制比较保持连通），要么使用均匀正则化（也会扰动已被良好约束的方向）。作者希望在不浪费查询预算的情况下解决这一结构性问题。
AI.method: 提出KappaSharp方法，在模型拟合步骤中对Hessian施加对角修正以降低条件数，修正量在先验不确定性更高的方向上更大。修正仅应用于模型拟合，不影响查询选择。同时提出自适应变体（Adaptive KappaSharp），仅在代理模型对近期比较足够自信时才激活修正，避免在问题条件良好时进行不必要的修正。
AI.result: 在11个基准测试（5-20维）上验证，包括一个16维的等离子体医学控制器调参问题。Adaptive KappaSharp优于标准PBO基线，最高提升+10.9%（p=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: KappaSharp通过针对性的Hessian对角修正有效解决了PBO中比较图孤立分量导致的秩亏问题，在不浪费查询预算的前提下提升了优化性能，自适应变体进一步避免了不必要的修正。

title: Second Order Drifting Models
summary: Drifting models are a recent class of one-step generative models that evolve the model distribution during training using a predefined sample-based drift field. Although they avoid iterative inference, their kernel-based drift fields induce frequency-dependent training dynamics: In the linearized regime, each Fourier mode of the density residual decays at a rate determined by the kernel spectrum, leading to slow recovery of fine-scale structure. We propose Second-Order Drifting Models, which lift drifting dynamics into phase space by augmenting generated samples with artificial velocity variables. We show that the resulting density perturbations obey accelerated second-order dynamics in Fourier space, connecting drifting models to the celebrated Nesterov acceleration from optimization theory. This provides a principled mechanism for mitigating the spectral stiffness of first-order drifting while preserving one-step inference. We derive a practical semi-implicit training algorithm and evaluate it on synthetic distribution matching, sequential data generation, and robotic control. Across these settings, the second-order drifting model improves convergence behavior and achieves competitive or superior performance over first-order drifting baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出二阶漂移模型（Second-Order Drifting Models），将漂移模型从一阶动态提升到相位空间中的二阶加速动态，通过在采样样本上引入人工速度变量，缓解了核函数类漂移场引发的频谱刚度问题（细尺度结构恢复慢），同时保持一步推理特性。
AI.motivation: 漂移模型虽避免了迭代推理，但其基于核函数的漂移场导致频率依赖的训练动态：在线性化机制下，密度残差的每个傅里叶模态以由核频谱决定的速率衰减，导致细尺度结构的恢复缓慢，即存在"频谱刚度"问题，需要从原理层面加以缓解。
AI.method: 将生成的样本提升到相位空间，引入人工速度变量，使密度扰动在傅里叶空间中服从加速的二阶动态，从而在理论上与优化理论中的Nesterov加速方法建立联系。在此基础上推导出实用的半隐式训练算法。
AI.result: 在合成分布匹配、序列数据生成和机器人控制三个场景中，二阶漂移模型相比一阶漂移基线改善了收敛行为，达到具有竞争力或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过二阶加速机制可有效缓解一阶漂移模型的频谱刚度，在保持一步生成推理优势的同时获得更快的收敛速度，且该方法在多种任务上具有普适性。

title: VDGR-RAG: Vectors, Directories, Graphs, and Reflection Are All You Need for Unified Reasoning over Hierarchical Enterprise Knowledge
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is essential for enterprise knowledge question answering (QA), particularly in domains with complex product documentation like telecommunications. However, existing RAG approaches largely overlook the holistic integration of diverse retrieval strengths, leading to inaccurate domain routing, poor utilization of hierarchical document structures, and consequently limited reasoning capabilities over enterprise knowledge. To address these limitations, we present VDGR-RAG, which integrates vector retrieval, directory-driven reasoning, graph traversal, and iterative reflection in a unified framework for accurate enterprise knowledge QA. Specifically, VDGR-RAG is an agentic GraphRAG system that first constructs a Hierarchical Heterogeneous Knowledge Graph ($\text{H}^2$KG) from document chunks to preserve both hierarchical directory structures and semantic relationships, and then employs a set of atomic tools for knowledge retrieval that can be freely composed to navigate the $\text{H}^2$KG: (1) a directory-enhanced routing tool that uses table-of-contents (TOC) structures to route user queries to appropriate domain-specific $\text{H}^2$KGs; (2) a multi-route retrieval tool that combines vector search, TOC-based agentic search, and graph search for comprehensive knowledge retrieval; (3) a directory backtracking tool that corrects knowledge localization biases; and (4) a dynamic reflection tool that iteratively plans the next retrieval phase. We conduct extensive experiments on our enterprise product documents across four wireless domains (e.g., energy saving and fault management). Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms a variety of RAG baselines in terms of both knowledge retrieval recall and QA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出VDGR-RAG，一个统一的Agentic GraphRAG框架，通过构建层次异质知识图谱（H²KG）并集成向量检索、目录驱动推理、图遍历和迭代反思四种策略，解决电信领域企业知识问答中RAG系统的领域路由不准、文档层次结构利用不足和推理能力受限等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法未能整体集成多种检索优势，导致领域路由不准确、层次文档结构利用不足，限制了在企业知识（尤其电信领域复杂产品文档）上的推理能力。
AI.method: VDGR-RAG首先从文档块构建层次异质知识图谱（H²KG），保留层次目录结构和语义关系；然后使用一组可自由组合的原子工具进行知识检索：目录增强路由工具（利用TOC结构路由到领域特定H²KG）、多路检索工具（结合向量搜索、TOC智能体搜索和图搜索）、目录回溯工具（纠正知识定位偏差）、动态反思工具（迭代规划下一检索阶段）。
AI.result: 在四个无线领域（如节能和故障管理）的企业产品文档上的大量实验表明，VDGR-RAG在知识检索召回率和QA准确性方面均显著优于多种RAG基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VDGR-RAG通过统一集成多种检索策略并利用层次异质知识图谱，有效提升了企业知识问答的检索召回率和答案准确性，验证了多路检索与迭代反思相结合在复杂领域RAG中的有效性。

title: Software Engineering for and with GUI Agent
summary: GUI agents have advanced rapidly, producing a growing body of frameworks, benchmarks, and applications. However, this growth has outpaced the maturity of the field. GUI agents remain technically brittle, incompletely engineered, and insufficiently validated for sustained real-world use. They are evolving into closed-loop software systems. Within these systems, model reasoning is coupled with interface perception, execution feedback, recovery, and human oversight. This evolution calls for a software engineering perspective that remains largely absent from existing research. We address this gap by reviewing 336 GUI-agent papers from January 2018 to April 2026. Five research questions examine the research landscape, architectures, evaluation, software lifecycle concerns, and future opportunities. Our findings show that the field has expanded sharply since 2024, while mobile and web settings remain dominant. Architectures increasingly adopt modular perceive-reason-act loops, but recovery, human escalation, safety enforcement, and auditability remain underdeveloped. This architectural imbalance extends to evaluation. Evaluations are becoming more interactive, but they remain centered on task success and are difficult to compare across protocols. More broadly, existing studies provide limited support for testing beyond benchmarks and for maintaining agents after release. Observability, privacy engineering, and systematic human oversight are also underdeveloped. Together, these findings show that capability improvements alone cannot ensure deployment readiness. Future research should connect dependable execution with lifecycle-centered testing and reproducible evaluation. It should also integrate permission and privacy controls with cost-aware, human-centered governance. This integration is necessary to build dependable, maintainable, secure, and deployable GUI-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对2018年1月至2026年4月间336篇GUI智能体论文进行了系统性综述，从软件工程视角评估了该领域的研究现状，发现其虽自2024年起快速扩张，但在架构上存在恢复机制、人工升级、安全强制与可审计性不足的问题，在评估上过度聚焦任务成功率且缺乏跨协议可比性，在生命周期上缺乏测试与维护支持，以及可观测性、隐私工程和系统化人工监督方面的欠缺。研究结论指出能力提升不足以确保部署就绪，未来需将可靠执行与生命周期导向的测试、可复现评估，以及与成本感知的人工治理相结合。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体的发展速度已远超其领域成熟度，其已演变为闭环软件系统，但现有研究缺乏软件工程视角。作者识别到这一空白，旨在通过系统性文献综述揭示该领域在架构、评估、生命周期管理等方面的系统性问题，为构建可靠、可维护、安全且可部署的GUI智能体系统提供方向性指导。
AI.method: 作者对2018年1月至2026年4月间发表的336篇GUI智能体论文进行了系统性文献综述，围绕五个研究问题展开：研究景观、系统架构、评估方法、软件生命周期关注点以及未来机遇。通过交叉分析架构设计与评估实践，识别研究失衡与空白领域。
AI.result: 研究发现：GUI智能体领域自2024年起急剧扩张，移动端和网页端仍是主导场景；架构上越来越多采用模块化的感知-推理-行动循环，但恢复机制、人工升级、安全强制和可审计性仍不成熟；评估虽趋向交互式，但仍以任务成功为核心且难以跨协议比较；现有研究对基准之外的测试和发布后的维护支持有限；可观测性、隐私工程和系统化人工监督亦发展不足。
AI.conclusion: 能力提升本身不足以确保GUI智能体的部署就绪。未来研究应连接可靠执行与生命周期导向的测试及可复现评估，并将权限与隐私控制整合到成本感知、以人为中心的管理框架中，以构建可靠、可维护、安全和可部署的GUI智能体系统。

title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
summary:
Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values remains a major challenge, especially for trustworthy AI. While existing approaches such as RLHF, CAI, and their variants have achieved promising results, they often rely on a single-agent framework and a unified reward system. This limits their ability to capture ethical pluralism, adapt to diverse moral contexts, and reflect the dynamics of multi-agent moral reasoning.
  In this work, we propose a framework that utilizes multilayer combinatorial fusion for contextual value alignment (MCF-CVA). At the first layer of the framework, it instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinctive value. Their outputs are then expanded combinatorially using both score- and rank-combinations as well as average and weighted aggregations. These combined models are then reduced to the same number of initial moral agents. This expansion and reduction (EAR) process continues for multi-layers until a stopping criterion is reached.
  The MCF-CVA framework leverages cognitive diversity between agents to mitigate conflicts and redundancies across multiple agents, producing responses that better reflect contextual human values. The framework using the EAR algorithm is performed on the dual architecture of Euclidean score space and Kemeny rank space. Empirical evaluations demonstrated that the proposed framework outperforms single-agent baselines, multi-agent single-layer results, and previous aggregation approaches on standard metrics, showing that the MCF-CVA framework provides a robust and effective mechanism for advancing contextual value alignment in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出MCF-CVA框架，利用多层组合融合实现大语言模型的上下文价值对齐，通过多个道德智能体的扩展-约简（EAR）过程，在分数空间和排名空间中组合输出，优于单智能体基线和现有聚合方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法（如RLHF、CAI）依赖单智能体框架和统一奖励系统，无法捕捉伦理多元性、适应多样道德情境，也无法反映多智能体道德推理的动态性。
AI.method: 框架第一层实例化多个道德智能体，每个智能体微调以代表特定价值；通过得分组合和排名组合（平均值与加权聚合）对输出进行组合扩展，然后将组合模型约简回原始智能体数量；该扩展-约简（EAR）过程循环多层直至达到停止条件。算法在欧几里得得分空间和Kemeny排名空间的双架构上执行。
AI.result: 在标准指标上优于单智能体基线、多智能体单层结果及先前聚合方法，证明框架在推进LLM上下文价值对齐方面的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: MCF-CVA通过利用智能体间的认知多样性来缓解多智能体间的冲突和冗余，生成更贴合上下文人类价值观的响应，为LLM的上下文价值对齐提供了稳健有效的机制。

title: CONFER: Conflict-Aware Evidence Negotiation for Regime-Calibrated Weak Supervision in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition often treats self-reported labels as reliable supervision while overlooking self-report unreliability and cross-modal conflict. We propose \textbf{CONFER}, a graph-based conflict-aware evidence negotiation framework for weakly supervised multimodal emotion recognition. CONFER represents each modality expert as a node with a predictive belief, boundary-based uncertainty, and runtime reliability estimated from historical out-of-fold performance and current-sample uncertainty. Uncertainty-aware compatibility and reliability-directed asymmetric edge weights govern iterative message-passing negotiation, followed by peer-supported prediction readout. Conflict reduction, residual disagreement, and mean modality uncertainty further characterize three regimes---Consensus, Dissent, and Ambiguity---for sample-specific weak-label calibration. We evaluate CONFER on AMIGOS, MAHNOB-HCI, and DEAP under subject-dependent 10-fold and strict leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocols. CONFER achieves competitive performance, reaching \textbf{0.873} accuracy on AMIGOS-V and \textbf{0.854} accuracy on MAHNOB-V under strict LOSO evaluation. Further analyses show larger negotiation gains on high-conflict samples and improved robustness to weak-label corruption, indicating that cross-modal conflict provides useful information for both directional modality coordination and supervision-reliability estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出CONFER框架，一种基于图的冲突感知证据协商方法，用于弱监督多模态情感识别，通过不确定性分析和可靠性估计来应对自我报告标签不可靠及跨模态冲突问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别通常将自我报告标签视为可靠监督，但忽略了自我报告不可靠性和跨模态冲突问题，这两者会对模型性能产生负面影响。
AI.method: 将每个模态专家表示为图中的节点，包含预测信念、基于边界的不确定性和运行时可靠性估计（由历史折外性能和当前样本不确定性计算）。通过不确定性感知兼容性和可靠性导向的非对称边权重指导迭代消息传递协商，随后进行同伴支持的预测读出。基于冲突减少量、残余分歧和平均模态不确定性划分三种模式（Consensus、Dissent、Ambiguity），用于样本特定的弱标签校准。
AI.result: 在AMIGOS、MAHNOB-HCI和DEAP数据集上，在subject-dependent 10折和严格LOSO协议下进行评估。AMIGOS-V上达到0.873准确率，MAHNOB-V上达到0.854准确率（LOSO）。高冲突样本上的协商增益更大，对弱标签污染有更好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态冲突不仅不是有害信息，反而为模态协调方向和监督可靠性估计提供了有价值的信息，能有效提升弱监督多模态情感识别性能。

title: Hierarchical rank-evolving representation for physics-informed neural networks
summary: Recently, tensor-based physics-informed neural networks (T-PINNs) have received increasing attention. However, existing T-PINNs still face a fundamental challenge: they mainly rely on pre-specified low-rank tensor decompositions with manually tuned ranks, which limits their ability to capture the underlying structures of multivariate solution functions and hinders their practical deployment. To address this challenge, we propose a hierarchical rank-evolving (abbreviated as HRE) representation for multivariate functions, which endows us to faithfully capture the underlying structure of the targeted multivariate function accompanying with automatic rank determination. Concretely, in the hierarchical design of HRE representation, the target multivariate function is decomposed as a small-scale inner tensor with a set of univariate functions along each mode, where a customized tensor network decomposition can be readily deployed to capture the underlying structure of the small-scale inner tensor. In HRE representation, the crucial hyperparameters, ranks, can be adaptively revealed during the decomposition, freeing us from manual rank tuning and making HRE practically applicable to real-world problems. Besides, we build the HRE-PINNs correspondingly. Extensive numerical experiments, including high-dimensional static problems (Helmholtz equation and Poisson equation), nonlinear time-dependent problems (Klein-Gordon equation), and complex fluid-dynamics problems (flow mixing equation and Navier-Stokes equation), demonstrate that HRE-PINNs consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches in terms of accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种层级秩演化（HRE）表示方法用于多元函数，通过自动秩确定替代手动调秩，并构建了相应的HRE-PINNs，在多个高维、非线性和复杂流体动力学问题上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有张量基物理信息神经网络（T-PINNs）依赖预指定的低秩张量分解和手动调优的秩，难以捕捉多元解函数的底层结构，限制了其实际部署。
AI.method: HRE表示采用层级设计，将目标多元函数分解为一个小规模内部张量加上沿各模态的一组单变量函数，通过定制化张量网络分解捕捉内部张量的底层结构；在分解过程中自适应地揭示关键超参数（秩），实现自动秩确定。
AI.result: 在包括高维静态问题（Helmholtz方程、Poisson方程）、非线性时间依赖问题（Klein-Gordon方程）以及复杂流体动力学问题（流动混合方程和Navier-Stokes方程）在内的广泛数值实验中，HRE-PINNs在精度上持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: HRE表示及其对应的HRE-PINNs通过层级化和自动秩确定机制，有效解决了现有T-PINNs面临的手动秩调优瓶颈，提升了模型的精度和实际适用性。

title: SAGE: SLO-Aware Adaptive Retrieval for Production RAG Systems
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Authors' accepted version of a paper published in Proc. IEEE CoDIT 2026. The version of record is available at the DOI below
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in production operate under strict service level objectives (SLOs) on tail latency and infrastructure cost. However, standard retrieval pipelines rely on fixed retrieval budgets that ignore query difficulty, over-retrieving for easy queries and under-serving hard ones, forcing operators to trade answer quality against SLO compliance. This paper proposes SAGE, a learned SLO-aware adaptive retrieval policy that dynamically selects the number of passages k per query. SAGE uses lightweight features derived from initial retrieval (e.g., score distributions, rank gaps, lexical signals) and is trained offline via imitation learning from an oracle that approximates optimal latency-quality trade-offs. At inference, it adds no LLM calls and minimal overhead. On Natural Questions, under a 5s P95 latency SLO, SAGE achieves 95% SLO compliance versus 30% for the best static baseline (k=20), reduces P95 latency by 36% and retrieval cost by 51% with only 2 percentage points Exact Match (EM) loss. A single policy trained on Natural Questions generalizes across HotpotQA, UnSeenTimeQA, and four LLM families (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma), consistently yielding +45-52 point SLO improvements without quality degradation.

AI.tldr: SAGE是一个基于学习的SLO感知自适应检索策略，根据查询难度动态选择检索的passage数量k，在不牺牲答案质量的前提下显著提升尾延迟SLO合规率和降低检索成本。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的RAG系统受严格的尾延迟和基础设施成本SLO约束，但标准检索管线使用固定的检索预算，忽略了查询难度差异：对简单查询过度检索、对困难查询检索不足，迫使运维人员在答案质量和SLO合规之间做出取舍。
AI.method: SAGE通过模仿学习离线训练自适应检索策略，利用初始检索产生的轻量级特征（如得分分布、排名间隙、词汇信号）动态决定每个查询的passage数量k。推理时无需额外LLM调用，开销极小。
AI.result: 在Natural Questions上，在5秒P95延迟SLO下，SAGE达到95%的SLO合规率（最佳静态基线k=20仅为30%），P95延迟降低36%，检索成本降低51%，仅损失2个百分点的EM分数。在HotpotQA、UnSeenTimeQA及四个LLM家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma）上零成本泛化，均获得+45-52个百分点的SLO改进且无质量退化。
AI.conclusion: SAGE证明了通过轻量级特征和离线模仿学习，可以在不牺牲答案质量的前提下同时实现SLO合规率提升、延迟降低和检索成本节约，且单策略具有良好的跨数据集和跨模型泛化能力。

title: OpenCodeReview: Determinism over Non-Determinism for Cost-Effective Agent-Based Code Review
summary: LLM-based code review agents promise scalable, always-on review, yet current systems suffer from two intertwined weaknesses: (1) non-determinism--unbounded tool use makes review outcomes unstable, and (2) context locality--the reviewer's access remains bounded to the diff, capping discoverable issue depth. Both give rise to three challenges: misaligned context retrieval, a coherence-efficiency trade-off in multi-file pull requests, and hallucinated comments that erode trust. To address these, we introduce OpenCodeReview, built on deterministic engineering for uncertain agents: rather than granting maximal freedom, we inject determinism at three deliberate pipeline points. Rule-Guided Dispatch uses a multi-layer rule system to deterministically select files and review criteria, eliminating variability of agent-driven triage. Grounded File Review replaces free-form exploration with a curated tool set exposed through a ReAct loop, while file-level parallel SubAgents balance context coherence against efficiency and recover cross-file dependencies on demand. Independent Reflection introduces a falsification-first filter under an asymmetric information boundary--the reflector sees only the diff, not the agent's tool-augmented exploration--removing hallucinated comments without self-reinforcing bias, improving precision while preserving recall. On AACR-Bench (200 real-world PRs, 10 languages, 1,505 expert-verified comments), OpenCodeReview outperforms mainstream coding agents (e.g., Claude Code and Codex) across six LLM backends, achieving up to 2.17x higher SEM-F1 (25.10% vs. 11.57%) while consuming 5-15x fewer tokens. We open-source OpenCodeReview at https://github.com/alibaba/open-code-review.

AI.tldr: OpenCodeReview 是一个基于LLM的代码审查系统，通过在三个关键环节（规则引导分发、有界文件审查、独立反思）注入确定性来应对不确定性，在AACR-Bench基准上以5-15倍更少的token消耗实现了比主流编码智能体最高2.17倍更高的SEM-F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的代码审查智能体存在两个相互交织的弱点：（1）非确定性——无限制的工具使用导致审查结果不稳定；（2）上下文局部性——审查者的访问范围局限于diff，限制了可发现问题的深度。这两个弱点引发出三个挑战：上下文检索失配、多文件PR中的连贯性与效率权衡、以及削弱信任的幻觉评论。
AI.method: OpenCodeReview在三个有意的流水线节点注入确定性：1) Rule-Guided Dispatch使用多层规则系统确定性选择文件和审查标准，消除智能体驱动分诊的变异性；2) Grounded File Review通过ReAct循环暴露精选工具集替代自由探索，使用文件级并行SubAgents在上下文连贯性与效率间取得平衡，并按需恢复跨文件依赖；3) Independent Reflection在非对称信息边界下引入先证伪的过滤器——反思者只见diff而非智能体的工具增强探索，从而消除幻觉评论而不会自我强化偏见。
AI.result: 在AACR-Bench基准（200个真实PR、10种语言、1,505条专家验证评论）上，OpenCodeReview在六个LLM后端上优于主流编码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex），实现最高2.17倍更高的SEM-F1（25.10% vs 11.57%），同时消耗5-15倍更少的token。
AI.conclusion: 通过"为不确定的智能体做确定性工程"的理念——在关键流水线节点有策略地约束而非最大化智能体自由度，可以在提升代码审查质量的同时大幅降低资源消耗，这为构建可靠、可信的LLM代码审查系统提供了新范式。

title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
comment: Project Page at https://reallcz.github.io/MGM; Code at https://github.com/RealLcz/MGM
summary: Self-improving coding agents that iteratively rewrite their own source code have demonstrated impressive performance on coding tasks. However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. According to Mendelian principles of controlled inheritance, we introduce Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM). In addition to the general single-trajectory clonal mutation, MGM includes two new types of self-modification that better utilizes evidences accumulated: the reaction-norm mutation edits an agent based on its trajectories on multiple tasks simultaneously, and the cross-lineage hybridization edits an agent using the trajectory of a reference agent from another lineage on the same task. Under an additive fitness landscape model, we prove theoretically and demonstrate via controlled surrogate simulation that the new strategies facilitate a faster and better convergence over single-trajectory baselines. Experiments on SWE-bench and Polyglot confirm MGM's consistent improvement in performance, efficiency, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM)，一种基于孟德尔遗传原理的自改进编码智能体框架，通过三种自我修改策略（单轨迹克隆突变、反应规范突变和跨谱系杂交）利用历史尝试中的丰富比较信号，在理论和实验上证明比单一轨迹基线更快更好地收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有的自改进编码智能体通常从单一失败轨迹中推导自我修改，忽视了智能体扩展的历史尝试存档中可用的丰富比较信号，导致学习效率和收敛效果受限。
AI.method: 参考孟德尔可控遗传原理，提出MGM框架，包含三类自我修改机制：(1) 通用的单轨迹克隆突变（clonal mutation）；(2) 反应规范突变（reaction-norm mutation），基于智能体在多个任务上的轨迹同时进行编辑；(3) 跨谱系杂交（cross-lineage hybridization），使用另一谱系参考智能体在同一任务上的轨迹进行编辑。并在可加性适应度景观模型下进行理论证明和受控替代模拟验证。
AI.result: 理论分析表明新的策略在可加性适应度景观下比单轨迹基线更快更好地收敛；在SWE-bench和Polyglot基准上的实验证实MGM在性能、效率和泛化能力上有一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: MGM通过利用多种轨迹信号（跨任务与跨谱系）实现更优的自我改进，展示了将遗传学原理应用于智能体自我演化设计的潜力。

title: V-Simba: Unleashing the Architectural Potential of RL in Visual Continuous Control
summary: Improving sample efficiency remains a core challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), especially in real-world settings like robotics, where data collection is costly. This challenge is pronounced in visual RL, where high-dimensional inputs often obscure learning signals. While prior work in visual RL has focused on algorithmic solutions, such as better dynamics models or exploration strategies, recent advances in state-based RL show that architectural design alone can lead to significant gains in sample efficiency. This raises an important question: Can these architectural principles transfer to visual RL? In response, we introduce V-Simba, a simple yet effective visual RL architecture inspired by the Simba architecture from state-based RL. Built on top of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with data augmentation, V-Simba modifies the architecture by adding normalization layers to stabilize training and using pointwise convolutions to reduce computation. Despite its simplicity, V-Simba matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art methods across the DMC, Adroit, and Meta-World benchmarks, while being more computationally efficient than DrQ-v2. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/DAVIAN-Robotics/V-Simba.

AI.tldr: 本文提出V-Simba，一种受状态空间RL中Simba架构启发的视觉RL架构，通过在SAC中加入归一化层和逐点卷积，在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World基准上达到或超越SOTA性能，同时比DrQ-v2更高效。
AI.motivation: 视觉RL中的样本效率问题仍然严峻，而先前工作主要集中在算法层面（如更好的动力学模型或探索策略）。近期状态空间RL研究表明，仅靠架构设计就能显著提升样本效率。作者希望探索这些架构原则能否迁移到视觉RL中。
AI.method: V-Simba基于SAC与数据增强构建，从状态空间RL的Simba架构中借鉴设计原则：通过添加归一化层来稳定训练，使用逐点卷积（pointwise convolutions）来降低计算开销。整体架构保持简洁，不做复杂的算法改动。
AI.result: V-Simba在DMC、Adroit和Meta-World三个基准上匹配或超越了现有SOTA方法，并且在计算效率上优于DrQ-v2，体现了简单架构设计带来的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 架构设计原则可以从状态空间RL迁移到视觉RL，仅靠合理的架构选择（归一化层+逐点卷积）就能在视觉RL中取得显著的样本效率和计算效率提升，代码已开源。

title: Training-Free Universal Approximation by Prompting Random Transformers
summary: How expressive is prompting a transformer? Answering this question is important for separating the roles of prompting, architecture, and pretraining in transformer models, and for determining whether task-specific behavior must be stored in model weights or can instead be induced at inference time through the prompt. We show, in an approximation-theoretic sense, that pretraining is optional: a single-layer softmax attention network with random, untrained weights can approximate any Hölder function on a compact manifold when steered by an appropriate soft prompt. Guided by the connection between softmax attention and kernel methods, we construct explicit soft prompts (a prompt per target function, independent of the query) as solutions to linear systems matching attention logits to Gaussian kernel exponents, under which the frozen transformer emulates the classical Nadaraya-Watson kernel estimator. The construction requires only a mild rank condition on the weights, which we show holds almost surely under Gaussian initialization. The prompted network inherits the theoretical guarantees of kernel regression, leading to universal approximation theorems with minimax-optimal rates that depend on the intrinsic dimension. We further quantify the cost of prompting, exposing a tradeoff between the norm of the constructed soft prompt tokens, prompt length, and hidden dimension. Numerical experiments corroborate the constructions and predicted rates.

AI.tldr: 本文从逼近论角度证明：通过构造合适的软提示（soft prompt），一个具有随机未训练权重的单层softmax注意力网络可以逼近紧流形上的任意Hölder函数。研究构建了显式软提示作为线性系统的解，使冻结的Transformer模拟Nadaraya-Watson核估计器，并获得最小最大最优的通用逼近率。
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer的提示（prompting）表达能力对于区分提示、架构和预训练在Transformer模型中的各自作用至关重要，同时有助于回答任务特定行为是必须存储在模型权重中，还是可以通过推理时的提示来诱导。
AI.method: 利用softmax注意力与核方法之间的理论联系，构造显式软提示作为线性系统解，使注意力对数匹配高斯核指数，从而使冻结的Transformer模拟Nadaraya-Watson核估计器。该构造仅需权重满足温和的秩条件（在高斯初始化下几乎必然成立），并分析了提示代价（提示令牌范数、提示长度与隐藏维度之间的权衡）。
AI.result: 证明了在逼近论意义上预训练是可选的：随机未训练权重的单层softmax注意力网络在适当软提示下可逼近任意Hölder函数。提示后的网络继承了核回归的理论保证，得到依赖内在维度的最小最大最优通用逼近率。数值实验验证了构造和预测的收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: 提示本身具有强大的表达能力，可以弥补未经预训练的随机权重网络；这强调提示在决定Transformer任务行为中的核心作用，并揭示了提示的代价与收益之间的内在权衡。

title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0: The Governed Memory Operating System for AI Agents
comment: 35 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21853302. Code: https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory/releases/tag/v4.0.0
summary:
AI agents are becoming shared infrastructure, yet durable memory is commonly assembled from separate retrieval, governance, and operational components. We present SuperLocalMemory 4.0, a governed, local-first memory operating system for AI agents. The system combines dense semantic, BM25 lexical, temporal, Hopfield-associative, and spreading-activation retrieval through reciprocal-rank fusion; a governed learning and behaviour layer; bi-temporal recall; multi-scope personal, shared, and global memory; role-based access control; GDPR-oriented export and verified erasure; audit trails; and a deployment-context EU AI Act checklist.
  V4 introduces a reliability spine for its primary write path: generation-fenced admission, a policy registry, verifiable memory transactions with per-projection apply, verify, compensate, and erase owners, and hash-checkable completion manifests. The runtime is available through CLI, MCP, an HTTP daemon, a dashboard, editor integration, and framework adapters, and supports fully local, local-with-on-device-model, and provider-assisted modes.
  We evaluate eleven fault-injection and mechanism scenarios, each repeated 200 times. The released evidence bundle reports 2,200 of 2,200 deterministic repetitions upholding their scoped component properties. The governed write envelope measured 3.522 ms at p50 and 5.297 ms at p99, versus 1.835 ms and 2.569 ms for the ungoverned baseline, corresponding to in-process control-plane overheads of 1.687 ms at p50 and 2.728 ms at p99. These are scoped component and mechanism measurements, not an end-to-end multi-process or external retrieval-accuracy benchmark. The paper consolidates prior SuperLocalMemory work on privacy-preserving multi-agent memory, information-geometric retrieval, and the V3.3 Living Brain lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SuperLocalMemory 4.0，一个面向AI代理的受治理、本地优先的记忆操作系统。该系统整合了多种检索机制（语义、词法、时间、Hopfield联想、扩散激活）并通过倒数秩融合；引入了治理学习与行为层、双时间召回、多范围记忆、RBAC、GDPR导向的导出与擦除、审计追踪以及EU AI法案合规清单。V4版本增加了主写入路径的可靠性骨架（生成围栏准入、策略注册表、可验证记忆事务）并完成了2,200次确定性故障注入测试，治理写入开销在p99约为2.7ms。
AI.motivation: AI代理正成为共享基础设施，但持久记忆通常由分离的检索、治理和操作组件拼装而成，缺乏系统化的统一架构。该论文旨在构建一个将检索、治理、合规与可靠性集成于一体的本地优先记忆操作系统，以应对多代理场景下的隐私、可验证性和合规挑战。
AI.method: 系统结合了五类检索机制（dense语义、BM25词法、时间、Hopfield联想、扩散激活）并通过倒数秩融合（RRF）进行集成；设计了治理学习与行为层、bi-temporal召回、多范围记忆、RBAC访问控制、GDPR合规导出与已验证擦除、审计追踪以及EU AI法案部署清单。V4在写入路径上引入可靠性骨架：生成围栏准入、策略注册表、带每投影apply/verify/compensate/erase操作的可验证记忆事务，以及哈希可检查的完成清单。运行时支持CLI、MCP、HTTP守护进程、仪表板、编辑器集成和框架适配器，并支持三种部署模式（完全本地、本地+设备内模型、提供商辅助）。
AI.result: 对11个故障注入和机制场景各重复200次，共2,200次确定性重复均满足其组件属性。受治理写入包络在p50为3.522ms、p99为5.297ms，无治理基线的p50为1.835ms、p99为2.569ms，对应的进程内控制平面开销为p50约1.687ms、p99约2.728ms。作者明确指出这是组件与机制层面的测量，而非端到端多进程或外部检索精度基准。
AI.conclusion: SuperLocalMemory 4.0展示了在本地优先架构中实现受治理、可验证、合规的多代理记忆系统的可行性，其可靠性骨架在极低的开销下保证了确定性属性。该工作整合了此前关于隐私保护多代理记忆、信息几何检索和V3.3 Living Brain生命周期的研究。

title: Search-Based Generation of Undetected Quantum Circuit Mutants
summary: Quantum mutation analysis is emerging as an essential technique for evaluating test suites due to the limited availability of real faulty quantum programs. However, existing quantum mutation analysis tools use fixed gate-based mutations, resulting in easy-to-detect mutants, which reduces their effectiveness in assessing the quality of test suites. We propose QUMUG, a search-based approach for generating challenging mutants by utilising parameterisable quantum gates. QUMUG employs search algorithms to optimise mutation parameters and find non-equivalent mutants passing a given test suite. In our evaluation over 30 quantum programs, QUMUG produced mutants that are three times more challenging than the mutants generated by existing tools. Among the four evaluated search algorithms, the genetic algorithm was the most effective, generating an average of 494 undetected mutants per program with a 99.67% success rate and 94.3% non-equivalent ratio. The generated mutants demonstrated their effectiveness by requiring the addition of five times more test cases to the test suite than the mutants generated by existing tools. We also analysed the behaviour of higher order mutants in quantum circuits, and showed that while first order mutations are more effective for enhancing the test suite, higher order mutants highlight the need for new unique test cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QUMUG，一种基于搜索的量子变异测试方法，利用可参数化量子门生成难以检测的变异体。相比现有工具，QUMUG生成的变异体难度高出3倍，需要新增5倍的测试用例才能检测，在30个量子程序上验证有效，其中遗传算法表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 由于真实故障量子程序稀缺，量子变异分析成为评估测试套件质量的关键技术。然而现有量子变异分析工具使用固定的门级变异，生成的变异体容易被检测，导致其评估测试套件质量的有效性不足。
AI.method: QUMUG采用基于搜索的方法，利用可参数化量子门生成挑战性变异体。具体地，使用搜索算法（包括遗传算法等四种）优化变异参数，寻找能通过给定测试套件的非等价变异体。同时分析了一阶和高阶变异体的行为差异。
AI.result: 在30个量子程序上的评估中，QUMUG生成的变异体比现有工具生成的难3倍。遗传算法最为有效，平均每个程序生成494个未被检测的变异体，成功率99.67%，非等价率94.3%。生成的变异体需要比现有工具多5倍的测试用例来覆盖。一阶变异对增强测试套件更有效，而高阶变异突显了对新独特测试用例的需求。
AI.conclusion: QUMUG通过参数化量子门和搜索算法显著提升了量子变异测试的有效性，生成了更具挑战性的变异体。一阶变异更适合增强测试套件，高阶变异则有助于发现需要新增的独特测试用例。

title: An Agentic AI Framework Overcomes Fundamental Limitations of Large Language Models for Glaucoma Detection from Fundus Photography
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in medical image interpretation but suffer from hallucination, limited accuracy, and run-to-run inconsistency. We developed and validated an agentic AI framework integrating LLMs with specialized deep learning tools for glaucoma detection from fundus photography. The workflow had three steps: (1) LLM initial assessment; (2) function calling to invoke specialized tools for image quality (QAModel, FundaQ-8), glaucoma classification (SwinV2-Tiny), and optic disc/cup segmentation (SegFormer-B0); and (3) LLM reflection integrating the initial impression with tool outputs. Two LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5.4 mini) were evaluated on two public datasets (ORIGA, n=100; RIM-ONE-v3, n=100) under uncropped and cropped fields of view; all images were independently graded by a masked fellowship-trained glaucoma specialist. The agentic workflow improved classification accuracy by 16 to 47 percentage points across all conditions, reaching within 6 points of the specialist; on RIM-ONE-v3 the best configurations matched the specialist accuracy of 88%. LLM-alone approaches failed in two ways: GPT-5.4 mini showed positive bias (sensitivity 95-100%, specificity 0-5%), while Gemini 2.5 Flash varied stochastically between runs; the agentic workflow corrected both. Cup-to-disc ratio error fell 15-50% (MAE 0.156-0.228 to 0.104-0.132), and correlation with specialist grading rose from weak (r=0.12-0.39) to moderate-strong (r=0.59-0.84). Run-to-run consistency rose from near-random (kappa as low as -0.01) to near-perfect (kappa up to 0.96). Integrating LLMs with specialized tools addressed key limitations of LLM-alone approaches, including over-diagnosis and run-to-run variability. Gains held for both LLMs, suggesting generalizability across backbones, and may signal a shift from monolithic models toward orchestrated multi-agent systems in medical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个智能体AI框架，将大语言模型（LLM）与专门的深度学习工具相结合用于青光眼眼底照相检测。该框架采用三步工作流（LLM初始评估→函数调用调用专门工具→LLM反思整合），在两个公开数据集上显著提升了分类准确率（16-47个百分点）、杯盘比误差和运行一致性，纠正了纯LLM方法的过度诊断和随机波动问题。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医学图像解读中显示出潜力，但存在幻觉、准确性有限和运行间不一致三大缺陷。纯LLM方法在青光眼检测中要么表现出阳性偏差（高灵敏度、零特异度），要么出现随机变化，无法可靠地用于临床场景，因此需要将LLM与专门化的医学影像工具相结合以克服这些限制。
AI.method: 开发了一个代理式AI框架，包含三个步骤：（1）LLM对眼底照片进行初始评估；（2）通过函数调用调用专门工具，包括图像质量评估模型（QAModel, FundaQ-8）、青光眼分类模型（SwinV2-Tiny）以及视盘/视杯分割模型（SegFormer-B0）；（3）LLM反思阶段整合初始印象与工具输出。评估了两种LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash和GPT-5.4 mini）在两个公开数据集（ORIGA和RIM-ONE-v3）上、裁剪与未裁剪视野条件下，并与遮盲的专科医生分级进行比较。
AI.result: 代理式工作流在所有条件下将分类准确率提升了16至47个百分点，在RIM-ONE-v3上最佳配置达到与专科医生相同的88%准确率。杯盘比误差降低15-50%（MAE从0.156-0.228降至0.104-0.132），与专科医生的相关性从弱（r=0.12-0.39）提升至中-强（r=0.59-0.84）。运行间一致性从接近随机（kappa低至-0.01）提升至接近完美（kappa高达0.96）。两种LLM均获得一致提升，表明框架具有跨骨干网络的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与专门化工具整合的代理式框架有效解决了纯LLM方法的过度诊断和运行间变异等关键局限，准确率接近专科医生水平，且在不同LLM骨干网络上均表现稳定。这暗示医学AI可能从单体模型向编排式多智能体系统转变。

title: Router Sensitivity Under Lightweight Fine-Tuning Identifies Prunable Experts in Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models decouple total parameters from per-token compute, but deployment still requires storing every expert. Recent theory shows that pruning experts with the smallest router-norm changes during fine-tuning can preserve accuracy, but assumes full fine-tuning. We test whether lightweight adaptation can recover this signal. We briefly fine-tune with a parameter-efficient adapter, rank experts by the induced $\ell_2$ router change, and prune the least-changed experts in one shot. On Mixtral-8$\times$7B-Instruct (44.83% MMLU-Pro), router-only LoRA trains 0.002% of parameters and outperforms all-module LoRA at matched rank with half the experts removed (27.54% vs. 24.42%); signal quality declines as adaptation spreads to attention and expert weights. Accuracy improves monotonically with LoRA rank, reaching 28.76%. IA3, which leaves router weights frozen, matches direct router adaptation, whereas unconstrained additive adapters degrade the signal. Router-guided MMLU-Pro accuracy decays quasi-linearly rather than collapsing, remains nearly 1.8 times that of magnitude-based or random pruning at maximal compression, and reduces memory by 49% and per-token latency by 37%. At 25% compression, retention is competitive with methods using full activation statistics. The criterion also transfers to Qwen1.5-MoE fine-tuned for mathematics, retaining 49.7% mean accuracy over eleven benchmarks with half the experts removed while random pruning falls to single digits. Router sensitivity under lightweight fine-tuning therefore makes provably motivated expert pruning practical at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何在轻量级微调（参数高效适配）下恢复专家剪枝所需的路由信号。通过仅用路由器LoRA微调，仅训练0.002%的参数，在去掉一半专家的情况下性能优于全模块LoRA（27.54% vs 24.42%），并且在最大压缩下保持约1.8倍于基于幅度或随机剪枝的MMLU-Pro准确率，同时减少49%内存和37%延迟。
AI.motivation: MoE模型的总参数量与每token计算量解耦，但部署时仍需存储所有专家。先前理论证明在完全微调下，根据路由器范数变化最小的专家进行剪枝可保持精度，但该假设在实际中成本过高。作者希望验证能否通过轻量级适配来恢复这一信号，使理论上有保证的专家剪枝在大规模部署中变得实用。
AI.method: 使用参数高效适配器（router-only LoRA）进行短暂微调，仅训练0.002%的参数（只更新路由器相关权重），根据诱导的ℓ2路由器变化对专家进行排序，然后一次性剪枝变化最小的专家。实验对比了router-only LoRA、全模块LoRA、IA3（冻结路由器权重）、无约束加性适配器等不同适配方式对剪枝信号质量的影响，并在Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct和Qwen1.5-MoE上进行验证。
AI.result: 在Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct上，router-only LoRA在移除一半专家时达到27.54% MMLU-Pro（优于全模块LoRA的24.42%）；准确率随LoRA秩单调提升至28.76%。IA3与直接路由器适配效果相当，而无约束加性适配器会降低信号质量。路由引导的MMLU-Pro准确率准线性衰减而非崩溃，最大压缩下仍约为幅度/随机剪枝的1.8倍，减少49%内存和37%延迟。在Qwen1.5-MoE数学任务上，移除一半专家后保留49.7%平均准确率（随机剪枝降至个位数）。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级微调下的路由器敏感性信号能够有效指导专家剪枝，使得具有理论动机的专家剪枝方法在实际大规模部署中变得可行且高效。信号质量取决于适配方式——仅路由器参数更新（如router-only LoRA或IA3）能保持最高质量的剪枝信号。

title: Not Worth Another Token: Marginal Value Estimation for Efficient Deep Research Agents
summary: Long-horizon research agents solve open-ended tasks through iterative retrieval, aggregation, and synthesis, but context grows rapidly while the marginal value of additional evidence often declines. This leads to unnecessary token cost, higher latency, and noisier inputs for final report generation. We study marginal value estimation for context management in deep research agents and present the first systematic stage-aware comparison of pruning strategies across the pipeline. We evaluate lightweight heuristic criteria and a learned value model at pre-retrieval, post-retrieval, and pre-synthesis stages. Our results show that pruning effectiveness depends more on where pruning is applied than on the specific scoring rule: early pruning yields the largest end-to-end savings, while later pruning mainly refines the final synthesis context. Lightweight heuristics reduce token usage by up to 73% with little quality degradation, learned pruning remains competitive on selected trade-offs, and no single method dominates across quality, efficiency, and faithfulness. These findings provide practical guidance for designing efficient long-horizon agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文对深度研究智能体中的边际价值估计与上下文管理进行了系统研究，首次提出跨流水线的阶段感知式剪枝策略比较，涵盖预检索、后检索和预合成三个阶段。结果表明剪枝效果更多取决于应用阶段而非具体评分规则：早期剪枝带来最大的端到端token节省（启发式方法最多减少73%的token使用量），后期剪枝主要优化最终合成上下文；启发式方法与学习的价值模型在不同权衡维度上各有优势，不存在可支配所有质量、效率和忠实性指标的单一方法。
AI.motivation: 长时程研究智能体通过迭代式检索、聚合和合成来解决开放式任务，但上下文随着迭代快速增长，而额外证据的边际价值往往递减。这导致不必要的token开销、更高的延迟以及最终报告生成时更嘈杂的输入。因此，需要对深度研究智能体中的上下文进行有效的边际价值估计和剪枝管理。
AI.method: 在预检索、后检索和预合成三个流水线阶段，系统比较了轻量级启发式评分标准和学习的价值模型这两种剪枝策略。通过端到端评估来衡量剪枝在不同阶段的效果、token节省和对最终报告质量与忠实性的影响。
AI.result: 剪枝效果主要取决于应用阶段而非评分规则；早期剪枝产生最大的端到端节省，后期剪枝主要优化合成上下文；轻量级启发式方法最多可减少73%的token使用且质量损失极小；学习的剪枝模型在特定权衡上具有竞争力；不存在在所有质量、效率和忠实性指标上全面占优的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为设计高效的长时程智能体系统提供了实用性指导，强调了剪枝阶段选择的重要性，并指出需要根据具体应用场景在质量、效率与忠实性之间做出明确的权衡决策。

title: White paper: A perspective on civilian-to-defence research transfer to SDD
summary:
Military capability is increasingly determined by software. Yet defence platforms are procured on decade-long timescales, while the software and AI models they carry must evolve in days or hours. This paper calls this mismatch the lifecycle paradox, and argues it is the central problem Software-Defined Defence (SDD) must solve.
  SDD rests on three dimensions: software and systems engineering (design, procurement, certification), AI engineering (sovereignty and trust of learned components), and connectivity and infrastructure engineering (timely exchange of information among sensors, AI, and operators). The proposed path to resilient SDD starts from civilian technologies, addressed through a continuous, DevOps-style loop: model-based systems engineering and simulation-based testing front-load design and verification; tactical connectivity and low-power edge execution carry that design into contested operation; continuous compliance, assurance, and variability management run as cross-cutting concerns. This loop is sustainable given capabilities already proven in automotive, manufacturing, space, and energy. The next step is validating them under adversarial or defence-certified conditions, with short-, medium-, and long-term paths to closing gaps.
  Closing the SDD gap while preserving civic benefits is a distributed responsibility: researchers must redirect methods toward adversarial conditions; industry must expose tooling to operational needs; policymakers must shape regulatory instruments; and defence agencies must validate results with operators. Recommendations span three horizons: a short-term baseline of adversarial testing and connectivity pilots; a medium-term pipeline of incremental certification; and a long-term validation closing the loop under operational conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"生命周期悖论"——国防平台采购周期长达数十年，而其所承载的软件与AI模型需在数天或数小时内演化——并论证这是软件定义国防（SDD）必须解决的核心问题。文章提出基于民用技术、通过DevOps式持续循环构建韧性SDD的路径，并给出短、中、长期三阶段建议。
AI.motivation: 军事能力日益由软件决定，但国防平台按数十年周期采购，软件与AI模型却要求数天或数小时内快速演进，二者之间存在根本性时间尺度错配（即"生命周期悖论"），被视为软件定义国防必须解决的核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出SDD三大维度：软件与系统工程（设计、采购、认证）、AI工程（学习组件的自主性与可信度）、连接与基础设施工程（传感器、AI与操作员间信息及时交换）。路径以民用技术为起点，通过持续DevOps式循环推进：基于模型的系统工程与仿真测试前置设计与验证；战术连接与低功耗边缘执行将设计带入对抗性作战环境；持续合规、保证与可变性管理作为横切关注点运行。
AI.result: 论证该循环在汽车、制造、航天与能源领域已有成熟能力支撑，具有可持续性。下一步是在对抗性或国防认证条件下验证这些能力，并通过短、中、长期路径弥合差距。
AI.conclusion: 弥合SDD差距同时保留民用利益需分布式责任：研究人员须将方法转向对抗性条件，行业须让工具面向作战需求，政策制定者须塑造监管工具，国防机构须与操作员共同验证结果。建议分三个地平线：短期建立对抗性测试与连接试点基线；中期建立增量认证管线；长期在作战条件下闭环验证。

title: IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls
summary: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.

AI.tldr: IntelliAudit 是一个基于检索增强的多智能体系统，用于IT审计证据评估。它在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化，通过专家审计师评审和用户反馈评估，能支持控制解读、证据推理和审计准备工作流，但研究同时揭示人工监督对校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松建议的重要性。
AI.motivation: IT审计要求审计师判断异构组织证据是否满足语义安全和合规控制，但相关证据分散在政策、记录、电子表格和运营工件中，且审计结论依赖证据充分性而非关键词匹配，导致这一判断难以自动化。
AI.method: IntelliAudit是一个检索接地（retrieval-grounded）的多智能体系统，给定控制项和证据语料库后，执行以下流程：检索相关工件、生成基于证据的评估、对不利发现提出质疑、仲裁分歧，最终生成面向审计师的建议（含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和补救指导）。在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化，并在多个模拟组织中结合专家审计师评审和审计就绪度用户反馈进行评估。
AI.result: 评估显示IntelliAudit能够支持控制解读、证据接地推理和审计准备工作流，同时揭示了人工监督在校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松建议方面的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 检索接地多智能体系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统使用。

title: LLM-Based Embeddings for Program Analysis and Optimization
summary: Recent advances have highlighted the potential of machine learning, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs), for analyzing and optimizing programs. We present the first application of program embeddings from LLMCompiler---an LLM massively pretrained on intermediate representation (IR) code---to representative program analysis and optimization tasks. We generate program embeddings directly from source and IR code using a simple approach: split programs into chunks, independently embed each chunk with pretrained LLMs, and then aggregate the chunk embeddings into a single program embedding. Our experiments show that combining source and IR code embeddings achieves an error rate of 1.54\% in algorithm classification, a 12\% improvement over the current state-of-the-art, and a competitive accuracy on heterogeneous device mapping. These findings suggest that training a performance-aware LLM for embedding IR code might yield state-of-the-art results in code optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次将LLMCompiler（大规模预训练于中间表示IR代码的LLM）生成的程序嵌入应用于程序分析与优化任务。通过将源代码和IR代码切分成块、独立嵌入并聚合的方法，在算法分类任务中达到了1.54%的错误率，较当前最优方法提升了12%，并在异构设备映射任务中取得了有竞争力的准确率。
AI.motivation: 机器学习（特别是大型语言模型）在程序分析和优化方面展现出巨大潜力，但此前领域内缺乏对大规模预训练于IR代码的LLM所生成程序嵌入的系统性应用研究。作者希望探索利用LLMCompiler生成的程序嵌入能否提升程序分析和优化的下游任务性能。
AI.method: 该方法采用简单直接的嵌入生成策略：将程序分割为多个块，使用预训练的LLM（LLMCompiler，预训练于LLVM IR代码）对每个块独立生成嵌入，然后将所有块的嵌入聚合成单一的程序级嵌入。在实验中同时使用源代码和IR代码生成的嵌入，并将两者结合起来进行下游任务。
AI.result: 结合源代码和IR代码的嵌入在算法分类任务中实现了1.54%的错误率，相比当前最优方法有12%的相对提升；在异构设备映射任务中取得了有竞争力的准确率，验证了该方法在多个程序分析任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，使用针对性能感知目标训练的LLM来嵌入IR代码，有可能在代码优化任务中获得最先进的结果。这也为未来训练专门面向代码性能优化的嵌入模型指明了方向。

title: LLM within MCP Matters: Measuring Inefficient Resource Utilization Driven by LLMs
comment: 4 pages, 1 table. Accepted at the AgentSearch Workshop at SIGIR 2026, Melbourne, Australia (non-archival). Code and data: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-in-mcp-matters
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes how servers expose data and tools to Large Language Models (LLMs). A common server design embeds frequently used reference data, such as identifier lookup tables, directly in the server instructions: the system-prompt text a server hands to the host application. When a query concerns an entry of the embedded table, the model can act on it immediately instead of re-discovering the same information through a search tool. We test whether client LLMs actually consume such instruction-embedded data, reporting a 54,000-trial study across 24 LLMs (9 Claude, 6 Gemini, 9 GPT) on a production legal-information MCP server. A diagnostic condition that removes the competing search tool shows that failures are dominated by behavioral preference rather than missing capability. With search unavailable, 23 of 24 models read the embedded data reliably (hit ratio at least 98%); with a search tool merely present, 9 models drop below 15%. A 2^3 factorial analysis of three instruction-level interventions reveals strong interaction effects: combining all three restores at least 86% for 20 of 24 models, but individual interventions can backfire for specific model families. Per-server prompt engineering is therefore a workaround rather than a fix; we argue that MCP host applications should provide an explicit mechanism that places server instructions ahead of tool selection in the client LLM's deliberation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过54,000次试验、覆盖24种LLM，研究了MCP服务器指令中嵌入的参考数据是否被客户端LLM实际消费。研究发现，当搜索工具可用时，许多模型会忽略指令中的嵌入数据（行为偏好问题而非能力缺失），而三项指令级干预的组合可以恢复多数模型的性能，但单个干预可能适得其反。
AI.motivation: MCP服务器常将参考数据嵌入系统提示词中，但客户端LLM是否真正利用这些指令内的数据尚不清楚。由于存在可选的搜索工具时模型可能选择"搜索"而非"直接读取"，这种行为的失败究竟是能力不足还是偏好问题需要系统验证。
AI.method: 在真实的生产法律信息MCP服务器上进行54,000次试验，覆盖24个LLM（9个Claude、6个Gemini、9个GPT）。设计诊断性条件移除搜索工具以区分能力与偏好；采用2^3因子设计分析三种指令级干预及其交互效应。
AI.result: 移除搜索工具后，23/24模型可靠读取嵌入数据（命中率≥98%），说明能力普遍存在；但搜索工具存在时，9个模型命中率跌破15%。2^3因子分析显示三种干预存在强交互效应，三者组合可使20/24模型恢复至少86%的命中率，但单个干预对特定模型家族可能产生反效果。
AI.conclusion: 逐服务器提示工程仅是权宜之计而非根本解决方案。作者主张MCP宿主应用应提供显式机制，将服务器指令置于客户端LLM的工具选择之前，以确保指令中嵌入的数据被优先消费。

title: SmellCC: A Tool for Automated Code Smells Remediation
summary: Code smells significantly threaten software maintainability by accumulating technical debt, yet developers often lack the resources to manually address these flaws under tight release schedules. While static analysis tools like SonarQube provide precise detection, they function largely as passive alert systems, leaving the burden of refactoring on developers. To bridge this gap, we present a novel cleaning tool, namely SmellCC, a Visual Studio Code extension that augments SonarQube with an LLM-based pipeline to automatically detect and refactor Python code smells. By employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and few-shot learning, SmellCC provides in-place, one-click remediation for the top-10 most frequent smells, effectively preventing the accumulation of technical debt during development. Our quantitative evaluation demonstrates that our SmellCC is promising in helping developers effectively eliminate code smells (96.8\% cleaning rate) with high accuracy (i.e., 91.3\%), ensuring that the refactored code remains syntactically correct and behavior-preserving, thereby significantly improving long-term software maintainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SmellCC，一个基于VS Code的扩展工具，将SonarQube的静态检测能力与LLM驱动的自动化重构管道相结合，通过Chain-of-Thought和few-shot学习自动检测并修复Python代码中最常见的10种坏味道，实现96.8%的清理率和91.3%的准确率，同时保证重构后代码的语法正确性和行为保持性。
AI.motivation: 代码坏味道严重威胁软件可维护性并积累技术债务，但开发者在紧张的发布排期下缺乏手动处理这些缺陷的资源。现有的静态分析工具如SonarQube虽然能提供精确检测，但本质上是被动的告警系统，将重构负担完全留给开发者，缺乏自动化的重构支持。
AI.method: SmellCC是一个Visual Studio Code扩展，它通过LLM-based流水线增强SonarQube的能力。具体地，采用Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理和few-shot学习技术，实现针对top-10最频繁代码坏味道的原位一键式自动重构，从而在开发过程中主动防止技术债务积累。
AI.result: 定量评估表明SmellCC在帮助开发者有效消除代码坏味道方面表现优异，达到96.8%的清理率，且精度高达91.3%，确保重构后的代码保持语法正确且行为不变。
AI.conclusion: SmellCC证明了将静态分析工具与LLM重构管道相结合能够有效弥合检测与修复之间的鸿沟，显著提高长期软件可维护性，为自动化代码质量保障提供了可行路径。

title: Towards Researcher Agents for Knowledge-Graph Question Answering
comment: Second International TEXT2SPARQL Challenge, co-located with Text2KG at ESWC 2026
summary: Translating a natural-language question into a SPARQL query that can be executed against a large knowledge graph requires resolving lexical ambiguity, grounding surface terms in the target ontology, and producing graph patterns that are both syntactically valid and semantically faithful. We present an agentic text-to-SPARQL system that goes one step beyond static tool-using agents: a researcher agent that, after each round of inference on a validation set, proposes and tests changes to its own prompts, rules, and tool-orchestration code. We instantiate the loop on DBpedia, evolve nine successive versions of the agent driven by a low-cost reasoning model, and deploy the best-performing configuration with two stronger backbone models. The study yields three observations: (i) self-improvement converges quickly and then achieves 0.22 overall accuracy on the 2025 DBpedia validation set; (ii) the bottleneck is consistently in basic-graph-pattern predicate selection, not in SPARQL syntax or modifiers; and (iii) several benchmark items appear to penalise correct queries due to property ambiguity in DBpedia, suggesting that future Text-to-SPARQL benchmarks should be scored using a combination of machine translation and information retrieval metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种智能体式text-to-SPARQL系统，该系统通过自我改进循环（在验证集上推理后自动提出并测试对其提示、规则和工具编排代码的修改）来逐步优化自身。在DBpedia上实例化该循环，使用低成本推理模型演化出九个连续版本，最终在2025年DBpedia验证集上达到0.22的整体准确率。
AI.motivation: 自然语言问题转SPARQL查询需要解决词汇歧义、在目标本体中锚定表层词项，并生成语法有效且语义忠实的图模式。现有静态工具使用智能体缺乏自适应能力，无法根据验证集反馈自主改进，因此需要一个能够自我演进的agent系统。
AI.method: 构建一个"研究型智能体"（researcher agent），在每一轮对验证集进行推理后，自动提出并测试对自身提示（prompts）、规则（rules）和工具编排代码（tool-orchestration code）的修改。在DBpedia上实例化该循环，使用低成本的推理模型驱动演化出九个版本，选择最优配置后部署到两个更强的骨干模型上进行评测。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：(i)自我改进快速收敛，最终在2025年DBpedia验证集上取得0.22的整体准确率；(ii)性能瓶颈始终在于基本图模式（basic-graph-pattern）的谓词选择，而非SPARQL语法或修饰符；(iii)部分基准条目因DBpedia的属性歧义而错误惩罚了正确查询，暗示未来测评应结合机器翻译和信息检索指标进行评分。
AI.conclusion: 智能体自我改进机制在text-to-SPARQL任务上能够有效驱动系统进化，但当前瓶颈集中在谓词选择的语义消歧上。此外，现有基准的评分方式存在局限，建议采用多维度指标综合评估查询质量，以更公平地反映系统真实性能。

title: When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes
comment: 38 pages, 4 figures, 21 tables. Measurement and scoped negative-results study. Artifacts, frozen manifests and SHA-256 records archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21788821
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile.
  With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. Workload contamination: probe sets using one instruction template per category produce verbatim-identical generation prefixes; a matched-pair rendering intervention moves the measured early-window effect by 19.4-31.9 points and reverses which workloads look most cache-friendly. Operating regimes: normalized miss fractions do not transfer across models, so the per-step expert union relative to per-layer capacity must be reported -- yet permuting only the temporal order of an identical event stream moves the offline-optimal gap from 44.9% to 30.8%, so it is not sufficient.
  Corrected, a stable gap to the offline optimum remains (44.2-45.9% over 13 frozen workload compositions). A forced-admission oracle attributes 84.3-96.6% of it to knowing which resident expert is used furthest in the future. A causal next-use predictor, used as an eviction rule, recovers -11.4% of the gap; it picks an optimal victim 3.4% of the time, against 2.4% for a random resident block and 20.6-22.1% for LRU and LFRU. Our position is narrow: in our evaluated settings a large offline-optimal gap substantially overstates the gains recovered by representative lightweight causal mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MoE模型专家缓存管理的评测方法论问题，发现评测结果高度脆弱。通过trace驱动的事件原子模拟器，作者识别出三个改变结论（而非仅数字）的评测轴：重放语义、工作负载污染和运行机制。修正评测方法后，仍存在44.2-45.9%的离線最优差距，但通过因果预测器仅能恢复-11.4%的差距，表明离线最优的大幅差距高估了轻量级因果机制的实际收益。
AI.motivation: MoE模型已超出加速器内存，将专家权重卸载到主机内存成为标准做法，因此专家缓存管理策略（如提高命中率以减少token级专家流量）成为重要优化杠杆。然而评估此类策略是一个测量问题，作者发现这种测量非常脆弱，不同评估设置会彻底颠倒结论。
AI.method: 使用trace-driven的事件原子模拟器，对三个MoE模型（40、64、128个专家）进行实验。从三个维度隔离分析评测脆弱性：(1) 重放语义——比较融合事件流量契约下不一致的逐访问重放与一致的重放；(2) 工作负载污染——用匹配对渲染干预检验指令模板对生成前缀的影响；(3) 运行机制——检验归一化未命中率是否跨模型迁移，以及事件时间排列对离线最优差距的影响。此外引入强制准入oracle和因果下次使用预测器作为驱逐规则进行对比实验。
AI.result: 三个评测轴均会颠倒结论：不一致的逐访问重放使基于最近性的策略膨胀27-29%而频率/静态策略仅偏差4%；匹配对渲染干预使早期窗口效应移动19.4-31.9点并逆转工作负载友好性排序；仅对相同事件流的时间顺序进行排列就能使离线最优差距从44.9%变为30.8%。修正后稳定差距为44.2-45.9%。强制准入oracle归因84.3-96.6%的差距来源于知道哪个常驻专家在未来最远被使用。因果预测器仅恢复-11.4%差距，选中最优受害者的概率为3.4%，而LRU和LFRU为20.6-22.1%。
AI.conclusion: 在作者评估的设置下，离线最优的大幅差距在很大程度上高估了代表性轻量级因果机制可恢复的收益。作者立场明确但范围窄：评测修正后的大离线最优差距不应被解读为简单因果机制能获得巨大收益。评测方法论的严谨性（重放语义一致性、工作负载控制、运行机制报告）对MoE缓存策略的可靠评估至关重要。

title: Can Open-Weight Models Compete on Financial Text Comprehension?
comment: To be presented at the workshop International Symposium on Large Language Models for Financial Services (FinLLM@IJCAI2026)
summary: Open-weight language models from Chinese AI labs caught up on benchmarks relative to proprietary frontier models in recent months. Yet their reliability on real-world financial tasks remains largely untested. We updated the Financial Touchstone benchmark, which now has 2,967 question context-answer triplets across 495 international annual reports. We also apply a new set of models on the benchmark, expanding coverage from eleven to twenty models across ten providers, including recent open-weight models such as GLM 4.7, GLM 5, Kimi K2.6, and DeepSeek V3.2, as well as Alibaba's proprietary flagship Qwen3-Max. Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 achieves the highest accuracy (88.4%), while Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro maintains the lowest hallucination rate (0.08%). Notably, the open-weight Kimi K2.6 ranks third in accuracy, and the non-reasoning models GLM 5 and Mistral 3 rank fourth and fifth, challenging the assumption that reasoning architectures or proprietary weights are a prerequisite for strong financial comprehension. Information retrieval remains the primary bottleneck, accounting for 48.9% of all failures. We also document a new finding: geopolitical content filters in Chinese models refuse legitimate financial questions (0.08% of attempts), sometimes without clear reason, and the refusal behavior depends on the access route as much as on the model. The complete dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文更新了Financial Touchstone基准，涵盖495份国际年报中的2,967个问答三元组，并将模型覆盖面从11个扩展到20个（来自10家提供商）。Claude Opus 4.6以88.4%准确率居首，Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%）。开源权重模型Kimi K2.6位列准确率第三，非推理模型GLM 5和Mistral 3位列第四、五名，挑战了推理架构或专有权重是强金融理解的先决条件这一假设。信息检索仍是主要瓶颈（占48.9%故障），并发现中国模型的过滤器会拒绝0.08%的合法金融问题，且拒绝行为取决于访问路径而非仅模型本身。
AI.motivation: 中国AI实验室的开源权重模型在基准测试上已接近专有前沿模型，但其在真实世界金融任务上的可靠性尚未得到充分验证。本文旨在通过扩展金融基准测试来系统评估这些模型在现实金融场景中的表现。
AI.method: 更新Financial Touchstone基准测试，构建包含2,967个问题-上下文-答案三元组的测试集（来自495份国际年报）；将评估模型从11个扩展到20个（覆盖10家提供商），包括GLM 4.7、GLM 5、Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V3.2等开源权重模型以及阿里专有的Qwen3-Max；同时记录失败类型和内容过滤行为。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6准确率最高（88.4%），Gemini 2.5 Pro幻觉率最低（0.08%）。Kimi K2.6准确率第三，GLM 5和Mistral 3分别第四、第五。信息检索失败占48.9%，是主要瓶颈。中国模型中有0.08%的合法金融问题被内容过滤器拒绝，且拒绝行为与访问路由方式有关。
AI.conclusion: 开源权重模型在金融任务上已具备与专有模型竞争的实力，推理架构并非金融理解能力的必需条件。信息检索是当前最需要改进的环节。此外，模型的对齐过滤机制可能影响其在金融等专业领域的可用性，且这种影响受部署渠道影响，值得关注。

title: The Unseen Delta: Characterizing the Compiler Optimization Landscape via Top-Down Differential Analysis
summary:
Compiler optimizations are essential for achieving high performance in modern software. However, recent studies highlight the persistence of performance bugs, i.e., subtle defects where the compiler generates functionally correct but computationally inefficient code, leading to significant performance degradation. Existing detection and testing methods typically employ a bottom-up approach, focusing on specific low-level code properties and remaining confined to known optimization rules. Consequently, they struggle to quantify the holistic impact of identified issues and often overlook critical microarchitectural inefficiencies.
  We observe a key indicator of untapped potential: different compilers often produce binaries with significant performance differences for identical source code. However, the root causes of these discrepancies remain largely unexplored and difficult to pinpoint using current techniques. To bridge this gap, we introduce a top-down differential analysis methodology. This approach calibrates compiler optimization differences with fine-grained, hierarchical microarchitectural metrics, offering a comprehensive view of runtime behavior. Using a sampling-based approach, this method efficiently pinpoints the critical code snippets responsible for performance differences, enabling targeted root cause analysis.
  Our empirical evaluation uncovers substantial and often surprising performance differences between binaries generated by GCC and Clang. A categorization of root causes reveals systemic challenges in compiler optimizations. To quantitatively validate our findings and demonstrate practical impact, we developed a binary patching framework that fixes identified performance issues by transplanting superior code sequences from competing compilers. This work provides a novel lens for understanding and analyzing optimization defects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自顶向下的差分分析方法，利用细粒度、分层的微架构指标来校准编译器的优化差异，从而精准定位导致性能差异的关键代码片段并进行根因分析。通过二进制补丁框架移植竞争编译器的优质代码，实证验证了GCC与Clang之间显著的性能差异及其系统性根因。
AI.motivation: 现有编译器性能缺陷检测方法采用自底向上策略，仅聚焦于特定的底层代码属性和已知优化规则，难以量化问题的整体影响，且容易忽略关键的微架构级低效问题。不同编译器对相同源码生成二进制文件的性能差异显著，但其根因尚未被深入探索，现有技术难以精准定位。
AI.method: 提出一种自顶向下的差分分析方法：以分层微架构指标对编译器优化差异进行校准，提供运行时行为的全面视图；结合基于采样的方法高效锁定造成性能差异的关键代码片段，从而支持精准的根因分析；并开发一个二进制补丁框架，通过移植竞争编译器中的优质代码序列来修复已识别的性能问题。
AI.result: 实证评估揭示了GCC与Clang生成的二进制文件之间存在显著且往往出乎意料的性能差异；对根因的分类揭示了编译器优化中的系统性挑战；通过二进制补丁框架定量验证了发现并展示了实际影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解和分析编译器优化缺陷提供了全新的视角，自顶向下的差分分析方法能够有效发现传统方法遗漏的微架构级低效问题，并具备实际修复的可行性。

title: Protecting patient privacy in clinical foundation models: Technical and legal perspectives
summary: Clinical foundation models trained on large-scale patient data are increasingly used for decision support, screening, and public health. As deployment expands, privacy risk increasingly arises from model-mediated leakage, yet its prevalence and severity remain poorly quantified. Models can disclose sensitive training artifacts, enabling patient re-identification in ways not captured by data-handling controls alone. Existing frameworks, including HIPAA and GDPR, offer limited guidance for such indirect threats. We propose a practical framework for assessing privacy risk in clinical foundation models and illustrate realistic leakage scenarios across deployment settings, map them to legal regimes, and outline complementary technical and legal mitigations. Our analysis provides a context-aware risk assessment grounded in realistic usage to preserve the value of medical foundation models while rigorously safeguarding patient privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个实用的框架来评估临床基础模型中的隐私风险，通过模拟跨部署场景的真实泄露情境，将其映射到法律体系（如HIPAA和GDPR），并概述技术与法律的双重缓解措施，以在保护患者隐私的同时维持模型价值。
AI.motivation: 临床基础模型在大规模患者数据上训练后已广泛用于决策支持、筛查和公共卫生领域，但模型介导的隐私泄露风险（model-mediated leakage）普遍存在且严重程度未被充分量化。现有的数据处理控制措施无法完全捕捉此类间接威胁，而HIPAA和GDPR等现有法律框架对此类间接隐私威胁的指导也十分有限，亟需一个系统化的隐私风险评估框架。
AI.method: 作者提出了一个用于评估临床基础模型隐私风险的实用框架，具体包括：1）模拟不同部署环境中真实的泄露场景；2）将泄露场景映射到相应的法律监管体系（HIPAA、GDPR等）；3）制定结合技术与法律维度的互补性缓解策略，实现基于实际使用情境的上下文感知风险评估。
AI.result: 该框架能够系统性地识别和分类跨越不同部署场景的模型介导隐私泄露路径，并将各类泄露情境与相应的法律框架进行对应关联，同时提供了技术与法律协同的缓解措施方案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种基于实际使用情境的上下文感知风险评估方法，能够在保护患者隐私的同时保留医学基础模型的核心价值，弥补了现有框架对模型介导间接隐私威胁指导不足的空白。

title: SPECTRA: Pushing the KV Cache Beyond the 2-Bit Cliff via Spectral Transform Coding
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly read long inputs in the agentic era, from whole documents and codebases to conversations across many turns. Their inference memory is then dominated by the key-value (KV) cache, the stored attention keys and values of every token the model has read and generated. Because the cache grows with context length and is re-read in full at every generated token, a longer context means more GPU memory.
  To reduce this cost, most existing methods compress the KV cache by lowering every stored value to the same low precision, a technique known as quantization. They can push this to nearly two bits per value, but rarely further, because quality drops sharply at this 2-bit cliff: four levels are too few for the cache's outlier-heavy values, where a few large entries consume the levels and collapse the rest into noise. A natural remedy is to spend more bits on the channels (feature dimensions) that matter and fewer on the rest, but the raw cache offers no handle: its channels are strongly correlated, so none stands out as more important.
  Our analysis shows that this handle appears once the cache is rotated into a coordinate system computed from its own statistics, removing these correlations. There, a small fraction of channels carries almost all the information, and spending the budget on those few is far more accurate than spreading it evenly.
  Guided by this analysis, we develop SPECTRA, a training-free, drop-in codec that re-encodes the cache into this coordinate system and concentrates the bit budget on the channels that carry the signal. On Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B over long-context benchmarks, SPECTRA is near-lossless at 4x compression, competitive at 8x where uniform quantization has collapsed, and reaches up to 12x, pushing usable compression past the 2-bit cliff so the same GPU holds longer contexts and larger batches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPECTRA，一种无需训练的KV缓存压缩方法。通过将KV缓存旋转到从自身统计量计算出的坐标系中，消除通道间相关性，使少量通道承载几乎全部信息，从而将比特预算集中到关键通道上。在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B的长上下文基准测试中，SPECTRA在4倍压缩下近乎无损，8倍压缩下仍具竞争力，最高可达12倍压缩，突破了2比特量化悬崖。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在智能体场景中需要读取长输入，推理内存被KV缓存主导。现有量化方法将每个值降到相同低精度，但在接近每值2比特时质量急剧下降（2比特悬崖），因为4个量化级别太少，无法容纳KV缓存中少数异常大值，导致其余值坍缩为噪声。简单地对重要通道分配更多比特行不通，因为原始缓存通道高度相关，没有哪个维度更突出。
AI.method: SPECTRA的核心思想是将KV缓存旋转到由自身统计量计算出的坐标系中（去除通道间相关性），旋转后少量通道承载几乎全部信息。然后SPECTRA将比特预算集中分配给信号所在的关键通道，而非均匀分配。该方法无需训练，作为drop-in编解码器直接使用。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B模型上，针对长上下文基准测试：4倍压缩下近乎无损；8倍压缩下仍具竞争力（此时均匀量化已崩溃）；最高可达12倍压缩，将可用的压缩率推到2比特悬崖以上，使相同GPU能容纳更长上下文和更大批次。
AI.conclusion: SPECTRA通过坐标旋转揭示KV缓存中的信息稀疏结构，并据此进行非均匀比特分配，成功突破了均匀量化面临的2比特质量悬崖，将KV缓存的可用压缩率从约2比特/值大幅提升至12倍，为长上下文大模型的推理内存优化提供了有效方案。

title: Representative Dataset Generation Framework for AI-based Failure Analysis during real-time Validation of Automotive Software Systems
summary: Recently, thanks to its ability to extract knowledge from historical datasets, the data-driven approach has been widely used in various phases of the system development life cycle. During real-time system validation, remarkable achievements have been accomplished in developing an intelligent failure analysis based on historical data. However, despite its superiority over other conventional approaches, e.g., model-based and signal-based, the availability of representative datasets persists as a major challenge. Thus, for different engineering applications, new solutions to generate representative faulty data in different forms should be explored. Therefore, in this study, a novel approach based on Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation and real-time Fault Injection (FI) method is proposed to generate and collect data samples under single and simultaneous faults for Machine Learning (ML) applications during system validation phases. The developed framework can generate not only sequential data, but also textual data including fault logs. The results show the applicability of the proposed framework in simulating and capturing the system behaviour under faults within the system components.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于硬件在环（HIL）仿真和实时故障注入（FI）的新方法，用于在系统验证阶段生成单故障和并发故障下的代表性数据集（包括序列数据和故障日志文本数据），以供机器学习应用使用。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动方法在系统开发生命周期的实时系统验证中已被广泛应用并取得显著成果，但代表性数据集的可用性仍是主要挑战。传统方法（如基于模型和基于信号的方法）在生成代表性故障数据方面存在局限，因此需要为不同工程应用探索生成不同形式代表性故障数据的新方案。
AI.method: 提出一种基于硬件在环（HIL）仿真与实时故障注入（FI）相结合的新框架，能够在系统验证阶段生成和采集单故障及并发（同时）故障下的数据样本。该框架不仅能生成序列数据，还能生成包含故障日志在内的文本数据。
AI.result: 结果表明，所提出的框架在模拟和捕获系统组件在故障状态下的行为方面具有适用性，能够有效仿真系统在故障条件下的响应并采集相应数据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为机器学习应用提供了在系统验证阶段生成代表性故障数据集的新途径，特别是通过HIL仿真与实时FI方法的结合，能够同时覆盖序列数据和文本日志数据，克服了历史数据可用性不足的挑战。

title: QuantumMind: Constraint-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Speedup Analysis in Quantum Computing
summary: Identifying a meaningful quantum speedup requires more than matching a classical problem to a familiar quantum primitive: the claim must preserve the task, respect access and output models, expose required promises, and remain within a defensible complexity scope. We present QuantumMind, an auditable agentic workflow for generating and conservatively screening quantum-acceleration hypotheses. A fixed sequence of typed, role-specialized actions formalizes the public task, analyzes structure and classical bottlenecks, matches a source-linked registry of quantum primitives and barriers, and constructs a scoped candidate scheme. A deterministic ten-check validator assigns the authoritative verdict; completed states are compiled into a Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph and passed through a downward-only research screen that cannot strengthen the decision. We evaluate QuantumMind against seven task-adapted prompting and agentic controls on 582 identical open-discovery tasks. Under the frozen Open-Discovery Score (ODS), QuantumMind obtains 53.1 mean ODS, exceeding the strongest baseline by 17.3 points (48.2% relative), and wins 355 of 582 paired tasks against that baseline. It passes the graph audit on 99.8% of tasks, compared with 43.6% for the strongest baseline, and ranks first in all seven task families. The results indicate that typed state transitions and deterministic evidence control contribute beyond fluent generation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantumMind，一个可审计的智能体工作流，用于生成并保守筛选量子加速假设。相比最强的基线方法，其在582个开放发现任务上平均得分提升17.3分（53.1 vs 35.8），相对提升48.2%，并在355个配对任务中获胜，图审计通过率达99.8%（基线的两倍以上），在全部七个任务族中排名第一。
AI.motivation: 识别有意义的量子加速不能仅将经典问题匹配到已知的量子原语，还必须保持任务不变、尊重访问与输出模型、暴露所需前提，并保持在合理的复杂度范围内。现有方法缺乏系统性、可审计的流程来生成和筛选量子加速假设。
AI.method: QuantumMind是一个可审计的智能体工作流，包含固定序列的类型化、角色专精动作：形式化公开任务、分析结构与经典瓶颈、匹配来源链接的量子原语与障碍注册表，并构建有范围的候选方案。采用确定性十项检查验证器给出权威裁决，完成的中间状态编译为量子加速证据图，并通过只能向下（不能加强决策）的研究筛选。基于冻结的开放发现评分（ODS）进行评估，并与七种任务自适应提示与智能体控制方法对比。
AI.result: 在582个相同的开放发现任务上，QuantumMind取得53.1的平均ODS，超过最强基线17.3分（相对提升48.2%），在355个配对任务中胜出；图审计通过率99.8%，远高于最强基线的43.6%；在全部七个任务族中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，类型化状态转换和确定性证据控制对流利生成本身之外有显著贡献，即结构化的可审计工作流比仅依赖流畅的生成能力更能产生可靠且可验证的量子加速假设。

title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026); to appear in IEEE proceedings
summary: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we identify five recurring patterns: spectral outliers encode a dominant component of the learned structure; Q projections carry the most outliers; V projections under grouped-query attention lack a clean signal/noise separation; entry-level outliers form structured row-bands in Q and column-bands in O; and specific residual-stream dimensions persist as band outliers across layers in K and O. We close by outlining how these observations could inform parameter-efficient fine-tuning and structured pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文应用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论将预训练注意力权重分解为"随机团"与"谱异常值"两部分，并因果验证了该分解的有效性：将MP识别出的异常值（信号）置零后，Mistral-7B在HellaSwag、MMLU和PIQA上性能退化到接近随机水平；而清零等量团奇异值仅造成较小但不可忽略的退化。在11个预训练Transformer中识别出五个重复模式，并据此提出对参数高效微调和结构化剪枝的启示。
AI.motivation: 理解预训练Transformer中注意力权重矩阵的结构，特别是区分随机噪声成分与真正的学习信号，为可解释性和模型压缩提供理论依据。
AI.method: 应用Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论分解注意力投影矩阵为随机团（bulk）与谱异常值（outliers）；通过因果实验（清零操作）验证分解的有效性；在11个预训练Transformer上进行系统性跨模型分析，归纳异常值的分布规律。
AI.result: MP识别出的异常值承载了主导性的学习结构；Q投影包含最多异常值；GQA下的V投影缺乏清晰的信噪分离；entry-level异常值在Q中形成行带、在O中形成列带；特定残差流维度在K和O中跨层持续作为带异常值存在。
AI.conclusion: 该分解可用于指导参数高效微调（针对信号部分）和结构化剪枝（移除随机团部分），为模型压缩和微调提供谱域层面的新视角。

title: Security Tests as Executable Specifications for LLM Code Generation: Benefits, Trade-offs, and Coverage Limits
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate functionally useful code that remains vulnerable, while security-focused interventions may break intended behavior. We investigate security tests as executable specifications both before generation and during iterative repair. We develop SecTDD, a controlled test-feedback scaffold that separates three factors: whether tests are shown upfront, whether failed executions trigger revision, and how failures are selected and represented. The evaluation uses behavior-partitioned visible and hidden tests and byte-identical initial candidates for repair comparisons. Across 2,705 trajectories, 31 task instances, three secure-code benchmarks, 16 CWE categories, and two model families, showing all visible tests upfront increases hidden functional-and-security joint success by 19.3 percentage points on average, but improves only seven of nine benchmark-model conditions and harms two. In shared-candidate comparisons, structured feedback repairs 80 initially unsuccessful candidates with no joint regressions; fixed raw feedback repairs 83 but causes three regressions. Structured and raw feedback are otherwise nearly indistinguishable head-to-head (six wins, six losses, and 453 ties). Candidates that pass all visible tests still fail hidden behavior families under every common regime. These results show that executable feedback can repair secure-code generation, but its benefits depend on the model, task, feedback entry point, and especially test coverage.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨将安全测试作为可执行规范用于大语言模型安全代码生成的测试反馈脚手架（SecTDD），通过分离测试前瞻展示、失败执行触发修订及失败选择表示三个因素，在31个任务实例、2705条轨迹上发现展示全部可见测试平均提升19.3个百分点的联合成功率但并非对所有模型-基准组合有效，结构化反馈修复80个候选且无联合回退，但所有常见机制下测试覆盖不足仍导致隐藏行为失败。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能生成功能可用但存在漏洞的代码，而安全导向的干预可能破坏代码的预期功能。现有研究缺乏对测试反馈机制在安全代码生成中作用的系统分解，需要理解测试作为可执行规范在生成前后如何影响安全性与功能性的平衡。
AI.method: 提出SecTDD（Security Test-Driven Development）受控测试反馈脚手架，分离三个因素：（1）测试是否预先展示；（2）失败执行是否触发修订；（3）失败的选择与表示方式（结构化vs原始）。采用行为分区可见/隐藏测试和字节完全相同的初始候选进行修复比较，在31个任务实例、16个CWE类别、两个模型家族上评估。
AI.result: 展示所有可见测试使隐藏功能与安全联合成功率平均提升19.3个百分点，但仅改善九个基准-模型条件中的七个并损害两个；结构化反馈修复80个初始失败候选且无联合回退，原始反馈修复83个但引起三个回退；两者头对头比较几乎无差别（6胜6负453平）；通过所有可见测试的候选在每种常见机制下仍会失败于隐藏行为族。
AI.conclusion: 可执行测试反馈能够修复安全代码生成，但其收益高度依赖模型、任务、反馈入口点以及尤为关键的测试覆盖率。测试覆盖不足是限制安全代码生成可靠性的核心瓶颈。

title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes
summary: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两级容量分配算法，在多个地点和两个服务类别间共享单一守恒容量预算。第一级按比例赤字和盈余在类别内跨地点再分配，第二级在类别间弹性借贷容量。该算法严格守恒预算、保持非负性，并在平稳需求下单次迭代即达稳定分配，计算复杂度为O(KN)。在CDN防容量攻击场景中，该算法在多数竞争场景下优于最大化总吞吐量的两类别线性规划，66-93%的高优先级需求得到服务；类别间借贷在突发负载下可提升1.5个百分点的高优先级服务水平；5地点真实HTTP流量的原型验证了该流水线。
AI.motivation: 许多真实场景面临单一守恒容量预算在多个地点与两个服务类别间的共享问题（如请求率上限、许可吞吐上限、出口预算），且需求不均匀、时变、可能超过供给。现有方法在竞争（contention）场景下目标函数设定不当，无法区分合法流量与攻击流量，导致高优先级需求服务水平不足。
AI.method: 作者提出一个两级容量分配算法。第一级在类别内部跨地点进行比例赤字与盈余再分配；第二级在类别间进行弹性容量借贷（当一类有盈余而另一类有赤字时）。算法不携带任何跨周期状态，因此在平稳需求下一次迭代即可达到稳定分配，每周期复杂度为O(KN)，K为类别数、N为地点数。通过消除法（ablation）隔离验证借贷机制的效果。
AI.result: 在22地点拓扑、8种竞争场景的CDN每域预算防攻击评估中，该算法服务66-93%的高优先级需求，与单类别线性规划最优解相当，且当总需求达到或超过预算时从不闲置容量或过度承诺。两类别LP最大化总吞吐量在多数场景下服务的高优先级负载反而更少。类别间借贷在突发负载下提升高优先级服务1.5个百分点，在平稳需求下中性。5地点真实HTTP流量原型验证了流水线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究有两个超出应用的结论：第一，在竞争场景下以吞吐量最大化为目标函数是错误的——最大化总服务负载的两类别LP服务的高优先级负载反而更少，因为它无法识别所服务的某些负载正是竞争来源；第二，类别间借贷在突发负载下值得其实现复杂度，值得更加复杂的实现。算法理论保证（预算守恒、非负性、单迭代稳定性）和实际验证共同表明该方法在需求不均、时变且超供的条件下有效。

title: Information Routing across Batch Boundaries: Memory--Batch Tradeoffs in Lipschitz Bandits

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机Lipschitz老虎机中"宽度-深度"权衡：学习者在每次拉臂后最多保留W比特的奖励相关状态，并最多组织B个承诺批次。当W≳d·log(eT)时，论文刻画了极小极大期望伪遗憾（精确到对数因子），并证明状态宽度与更新深度不可互换，揭示了信息路由约束。
AI.motivation: 自适应学习既需要保存观测含义的状态（宽度），也需要在该状态上行动的机会（深度）。此前工作分别研究了无记忆约束下的全序策略和有记忆但无批次限制的策略，但两者之间的基本权衡——状态宽度与批次深度如何相互制约——尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 论文在随机Lipschitz老虎机框架下引入双参数模型(W,B)：每轮后保留至多W比特奖励依赖状态，拉臂组织为至多B个承诺批次。核心技术是通过区域尺度分析信息路由约束：在区域尺度s下，低遗憾要求承诺动作实录编码Θ_d(s^{-d})个区域决策，而收集的边界状态至多携带(B-1)W比特熵。配对的策略通过流式擦除验证统计量，同时保留安全活动集掩码（内存中或逐片段）。
