AI.result: 当W≳d·log(eT)时，作者给出了极小极大期望伪遗憾的精确刻画（最高对数因子），下界对所有W成立。新代价项为T^{(d+2)/(d+3)}(1+(B-1)W)^{-1/(d(d+3))}，证明宽度与深度不可互换。该定理恢复了全维最坏情形纯批次边界，并在全序特例中恢复了对数内存可达性；静态批次边界与可预测自适应批次匹配。
AI.conclusion: 状态宽度和更新深度在随机Lipschitz老虎机中构成一个不可分解的联合约束：它们以一种信息路由瓶颈的方式耦合，而非简单的可互换资源。这为未来设计内存受限与批次受限的自适应学习算法提供了理论基础。

title: SpecPath: Testing Coding Agents Across Contract-Equivalent Specification Histories
summary:
Modern coding agents increasingly appear capable of following complex software requirements, yet their success leaves a critical ambiguity: do they resolve the active specification, or merely follow the most salient path by which it was stated? We identify specification-path sensitivity, a failure mode in which requirement histories that are equivalent in their final meaning lead the same agent system to produce behaviorally different programs. This reframes evolving-requirement evaluation as active-contract resolution: before writing code, an agent must determine which requirements still count.
  Building on this view, we introduce SpecPath, a diagnostic evaluation that holds the repository, final contract, verifier, agent system, and execution budget fixed while changing only the revision path that leads to the contract. Rather than treating each patch as an isolated pass or failure, SpecPath uses paired executable outcomes to reveal whether an agent realizes the same tested behavior across contract-equivalent histories. Across five calibrated software tasks and fourteen coding-agent configurations, aggregate direct and revision-history accuracy is nearly unchanged; nevertheless, 35 of 100 complete blocks that succeed on the direct specification fail on at least one equivalent history. These results show that implementation success on a consolidated request does not guarantee specification-path invariance. Evaluating evolving requirements therefore calls for controlled tests of whether agents are robust to the path by which a specification becomes final.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"规范路径敏感性"这一失败模式：即使最终需求含义相同，不同修订历史会导致同一智能体系统产生行为不同的程序。作者引入SpecPath诊断评估框架，通过仅改变通往最终契约的修订路径来测试编码智能体是否对规范路径鲁棒。实验发现35/100个直接规范成功的完整模块在至少一条等价历史路径上失败，表明实现成功不能保证路径不变性。
AI.motivation: 现代编码智能体虽然看似能遵循复杂软件需求，但其成功存在关键歧义：它们是在解决活动规范，还是仅仅跟随陈述规范时最显著的路径？现有评估将每次补丁视为孤立的通过/失败，忽略了需求历史对最终行为的影响，需要重新构建需求演化评估为主动契约解析。
AI.method: 提出SpecPath诊断评估框架：保持仓库、最终契约、验证器、智能体系统和执行预算固定，仅改变到达契约的修订路径。与传统逐补丁评估不同，SpecPath使用配对的可执行结果来揭示智能体是否在契约等价的历史路径上实现相同的测试行为。
AI.result: 在五个校准软件任务和十四个编码智能体配置上，直接准确率和修订历史准确率几乎不变；然而100个直接规范成功的完整模块中，有35个在至少一条等价历史路径上失败。
AI.conclusion: 对合并需求请求的实现成功并不能保证规范路径不变性。需求演化评估需要受控测试，检验智能体是否对规范成为最终版的路径具有鲁棒性。

title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Quantum Enhanced AI and Secure Computing (QASC2026)
summary: LLM benchmarks can build an organization's reputation and attract customers, but only when results are transparent and verifiable. Unverified claims that DeepSeek R1 outperformed OpenAI's o1 contributed to market panic on January 27, 2025, when Nvidia lost USD589 billion in market value. Yet vendor benchmarks often depend on an honor system. Academic reassessments and independent leaderboards have found undisclosed changes to proprietary models, contaminated training data, and selective reporting. LLM-as-a-judge methods scale evaluation by reducing human review. Studies, however, suggest that judges may show identity-aware bias, scoring an answer according to its source model rather than its quality. This bias has not been fully measured or corrected across politically sensitive, reasoning-intensive, and preference-based tasks. We examine this problem using seven verifier models: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.3 70B, GLM 5.1, Qwen3 32B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Mistral Large3, and Sarvam M. They score anonymous and identity-disclosed responses from three primary models on 58 factual, reasoning, political, and preference-based questions. Identity disclosure slightly raises scores for factual questions, moderately affects stress-reasoning tasks, and causes large changes for geopolitically sensitive topics. Notable results include GLM5.1 (+7.00 points, p = 0.0249) and Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56 points, p = 0.00). We also introduce a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents on an Ethereum-compatible ledger. In Phase 1, each judge records a one-way hash of its score and a secret salt before candidate identities are revealed. In Phase 2, the identity and raw score are disclosed and verified on-chain. This creates a tamper-evident audit trail that separates blind evaluation from post-hoc claims and reduces the verification burden on independent researchers and leaderboard operators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM-as-a-judge评测方法中存在的身份感知偏见问题，发现当评测者知道答案来自哪个模型时，评分会受到影响，尤其在政治敏感任务上偏差最大。作者提出基于区块链的commit-reveal协议，通过链上哈希承诺和事后验证来确保评测的公正性和可审计性。
AI.motivation: LLM基准测试对组织声誉和商业价值影响巨大，但现有评测依赖honor system，缺乏透明度。此前DeepSeek R1超越OpenAI o1的未证实声明导致Nvidia单日损失5890亿美元市值。同时，LLM-as-a-judge方法存在身份感知偏见，即评测者根据答案来源模型而非答案质量打分。这一偏见在政治敏感、推理密集和偏好类任务中未被充分量化和纠正。
AI.method: 使用7个验证者模型（GPT-OSS 120B、Llama 3.3 70B、GLM 5.1、Qwen3 32B、DeepSeek V4 Pro、Mistral Large3、Sarvam M）对3个主模型在58个事实性、推理、政治和偏好问题上进行匿名和身份披露两种条件下的打分对比。同时提出区块链双阶段commit-reveal协议：第一阶段评测者在身份公开前提交分数加随机盐的哈希承诺，第二阶段公开身份和原始分数并在链上验证。
AI.result: 身份披露对事实类问题评分影响较小，对压力推理任务有中等影响，对地缘政治敏感话题影响最大。具体数据：GLM5.1评分提升7.00分（p=0.0249），Llama 3.3 70B提升1.56分（p=0.00），表明身份感知偏见确实存在且在某些模型上显著。
AI.conclusion: 身份感知偏见在LLM评测中真实存在且具有任务依赖性，需要系统性纠正。区块链commit-reveal协议通过将盲评与事后声明分离、建立防篡改审计追踪，能够降低独立研究者和排行榜运营方的验证负担，为可信的AI评测提供了基础设施层面的解决方案。

title: Comprehending Python Repetition Structures: An Eye-Tracking Study with Novice Developers
comment: Paper accepted at Brazilian Symposium on Software Engineering (SBES) 2026
summary: Code comprehension is central to software maintenance and evolution, yet different Python repetition structures may impose distinct cognitive demands. We conducted a controlled eye-tracking experiment with 32 undergraduate students with prior Python experience to compare comprehension of for loops, while loops, recursion, and list comprehensions (LCs). Participants solved six comprehension tasks in a Latin Square design while we measured completion behavior and eye-tracking metrics over full snippets and construct-specific Areas of Interest (AOIs). for loops showed the lowest visual effort. Relative to for, while loops increased AOI fixation duration by up to 97% and regression count by 114%, with regressions concentrated around counter management. Recursion showed a descriptive 50% increase in regressions, mainly between the base case and recursive call. LCs increased AOI time by 62.5% and fixation duration by 80.9%, with horizontal regressions suggesting dense token-by-token parsing. LC comparisons yielded the clearest statistically significant pairwise differences, while the combined comparison of all non-for structures was significant across all eye-tracking metrics. These findings provide process-level evidence that Python repetition structures induce distinct visual-effort patterns, with implications for readability, code review, refactoring, onboarding, and maintainability.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过眼动追踪实验（32名有Python经验的本科生）比较了Python四种重复结构（for循环、while循环、递归和列表推导式）的代码理解认知负担。结果表明for循环的视觉努力最低；while循环在AOI注视时长和回视次数上显著增加，回视集中在计数器管理区域；递归的回视增加约50%，主要集中在基准情形与递归调用之间；列表推导式的AOI时间和注视时长分别增加62.5%和80.9%，水平回视暗示逐token密集解析。列表推导式与for循环的对比在所有眼动指标上均呈统计显著差异。
AI.motivation: 代码理解是软件维护和演化的核心，但不同Python重复结构可能对认知提出不同的需求。作者旨在提供过程层面的证据，揭示不同重复结构在视觉注意和认知负荷上的差异，以服务于可读性、代码审查、重构、入职培训等实际应用。
AI.method: 采用受控眼动追踪实验，招募32名有Python经验的本科生；被试在拉丁方设计中完成六个代码理解任务；同时测量完成行为数据和眼动指标（包括整个代码片段和特定构建的兴趣区AOI）；比较for循环、while循环、递归和列表推导式四种结构的视觉努力。
AI.result: for循环的视觉努力最低。与for相比：while循环的AOI注视时长增加最多达97%，回视次数增加114%，且回视集中在计数器管理区域；递归回视描述性增加50%，主要发生在基准情形与递归调用之间；列表推导式AOI时间增加62.5%，注视时长增加80.9%，水平回视暗示密集的逐token解析。列表推导式的成对比较在多指标上统计显著，所有非for结构的综合比较在所有眼动指标上均显著。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为Python重复结构引发不同的视觉努力模式提供了过程层面的证据，表明不同结构对认知负荷有显著差异，这对代码可读性、代码审查、重构、入职培训和可维护性具有实际启示。

title: AndroidReality: How Far Are Mobile Agents from the Real World?
summary: Mobile agents have achieved promising results on clean online benchmarks such as AndroidWorld, yet their performance often degrades sharply in real-world deployment due to environmental variations and imperfect interface conditions. In this work, we introduce AndroidReality, a perturbation-based framework for evaluating and improving the robustness of mobile agents. Through a Markov Decision Process (MDP) perspective, we organize real-world interface variability into a principled taxonomy of perturbations along three axes: state, transition, and action. Guided by this taxonomy, we build a perturbed mobile benchmark on top of AndroidWorld with realistic and controllable perturbation injections, enabling systematic robustness evaluation of mobile agents. Our evaluation reveals substantial robustness gaps and four recurring error categories, motivating a simple training-free Test-Time Introspective Recovery (TTIR) mechanism that mitigates these failures on both perturbed and clean settings. Together, these results position robustness as a missing dimension in mobile agent evaluation and establish benchmark perturbation as an effective tool for both stress testing and surfacing latent weaknesses of mobile agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AndroidReality，一个基于扰动注入的框架，用于评估和提升移动智能体（mobile agents）的鲁棒性。作者从MDP视角将真实世界界面变化归纳为状态、转移和动作三个轴上的扰动，并在AndroidWorld基础上构建了扰动基准，揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距和四类重复错误，进而提出训练无关的测试时内省恢复（TTIR）机制来缓解这些失败。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体在干净的在线基准（如AndroidWorld）上表现良好，但在真实部署中由于环境变化和界面条件不完美，性能显著下降。现有基准缺乏对鲁棒性的系统评估，鲁棒性被忽视作为一个独立的评估维度。
AI.method: 1) 从马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）视角出发，将真实世界界面可变性组织为沿状态（state）、转移（transition）和动作（action）三个轴的原则性扰动分类体系；2) 基于此分类学在AndroidWorld上构建带真实且可控扰动注入的扰动基准；3) 提出训练无关的测试时内省恢复（TTIR）机制，通过测试时自我反思来缓解识别出的失败模式。
AI.result: 评估揭示出显著的鲁棒性差距和四类重复出现的错误类别；TTIR机制在扰动基准和干净设置上均能有效缓解这些失败。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性应作为移动智能体评估中一个缺失的关键维度；基准扰动注入是压力测试和揭示移动智能体潜在弱点的有效工具。

title: Adaptive Supervised Anchoring for On-Policy Self-Distillation
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, and 14 tables. Meilin Yang and Zixuan Ding contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Li Yu and Zhe Fu
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) adapts a language model by distilling guidance from a frozen teacher on trajectories sampled from the student. Its effectiveness, however, depends critically on the quality of those trajectories. We show that when student rollouts drift from target trajectories, conditioning the teacher on off-target prefixes substantially weakens its task-relevant supervision. Controlled prefix-corruption experiments expose this failure mode, which we term rollout-conditioned signal degradation. To address this problem, we propose a unified training framework that separates two complementary supervision pathways. The first retains rollout-conditioned distribution matching, providing guidance on states the student actually visits. The second applies supervised cross-entropy on canonical ground-truth contexts, avoiding the incompatibility of imposing target tokens on erroneous rollout prefixes. Token-level rollout-target alignment is used to adapt the strength of the canonical-context anchor, emphasizing it during cold start and relaxing it as rollout quality improves. Experiments across multiple model scales, two task families, and general-reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed approach improves task acquisition over OPSD while preserving general capabilities, resulting in a more favorable empirical plasticity-stability trade-off. These findings identify context quality as a central bottleneck in on-policy self-distillation and demonstrate the value of separating rollout-conditioned guidance from canonical supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一的训练框架，将滚动条件分布匹配与经典监督交叉熵两条互补监督路径分离，以解决on-policy自蒸馏中因学生rollout偏离目标轨迹而导致的"rollout条件信号退化"问题，在多个模型规模、两个任务族和通用推理基准上取得优于OPSD的任务获取效果，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: On-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）的效果严重依赖于学生采样轨迹的质量。当学生rollout偏离目标轨迹时，教师基于偏离前缀的条件化会显著削弱其任务相关监督信号。这种"rollout条件信号退化"构成OPSD的核心瓶颈，需要被系统性地识别和解决。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的训练框架，将两条互补的监督路径分离：(1) 保留rollout条件分布匹配，用于指导学生在实际访问状态上的行为；(2) 在规范（canonical）真实上下文上施加监督交叉熵，避免在错误的rollout前缀上强行施加目标token的不兼容性问题。通过token级rollout-目标对齐来动态调整规范上下文锚的强度——冷启动阶段加强，rollout质量改善后放松。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模、两个任务族及通用推理基准上的实验表明，所提方法相比OPSD提升了任务获取能力，同时保持了通用能力，实现了更有利的经验性可塑性-稳定性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 上下文质量是on-policy自蒸馏中的关键瓶颈；将rollout条件监督与经典监督分离可以有效缓解信号退化问题，为大规模语言模型的自蒸馏训练提供了更稳健的范式。

title: Detecting Behavioral Changes in Python Refactoring Implementations with Foundation Models
comment: Accepted at Brazilian Symposium on Software Engineering (SBES) 2026
summary: Python is a widely adopted programming language, valued for its simplicity and flexibility. However, automated refactoring for Python remains challenging, even though refactoring is an essential practice in software evolution aimed at improving internal code structure without changing external behavior. Understanding how behavioral changes are introduced during refactoring is crucial, as such issues can compromise software reliability and reduce developer productivity. We propose an approach based on a foundation model oracle that analyzes git-style diffs to identify behavioral changes introduced by Python refactorings. We evaluated our technique on Rope refactoring implementations, reusing 1,152 refactoring attempts from a prior study and analyzing 217 resulting transformation pairs with the oracle. Our model-based analysis uncovered 13 distinct bugs among the seven refactoring types studied. All reported bugs were submitted to the respective developers, and 12 of the 13 resulting issue reports were accepted according to issue-tracker evidence. These results highlight the need to improve the robustness of current Python refactoring tools to ensure the correctness of automated code transformations and support reliable software maintenance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型（foundation model）的oracle方法，通过分析git-style diffs来识别Python重构过程中引入的行为变化。作者在Rope重构工具上评估该方法，复用1,152次重构尝试并分析217个转换对，发现了13个不同类型的bug，其中12个被开发者接受。
AI.motivation: Python虽然广泛使用，但其自动化重构工具仍存在挑战。重构旨在不改变外部行为的前提下改善代码结构，但行为变化可能在重构过程中被引入，影响软件可靠性和开发效率。因此需要系统化的方法来识别和发现重构工具中的行为缺陷。
AI.method: 提出一种基于基础模型oracle的方法：通过将git-style diff输入给基础模型进行分析，由模型作为oracle来判断重构前后是否发生了行为变化。在Rope重构实现上评估，复用先前研究的1,152次重构尝试，筛选出217个转换对，用oracle分析这些转换对中的行为变化。
AI.result: 在7种重构类型中发现了13个不同的bug，所有bug均已提交给对应开发者，其中12个issue报告根据问题跟踪器的证据被接受。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明当前Python重构工具在稳健性方面仍需改进，以确保自动化代码转换的正确性并支持可靠的软件维护。基础模型oracle方法为发现重构工具中的行为变化提供了有效途径。

title: The Capability Ladder: A Curriculum-Modernization Framework for Workforce Readiness in the AI Era
summary: Artificial intelligence is changing the task composition of computing work faster than curricula and training typically adapt. This is a curriculum-framework paper, grounded in a structured narrative review of labor-market and software-engineering evidence and illustrated through an exploratory pilot course: the review supports the framework, and the pilot illustrates it rather than serving as primary evidence. The central claim is that near-term change is task reallocation rather than full replacement: routine implementation is increasingly automated while verification, systems thinking, security, and the ability to supervise and orchestrate AI (keeping a human in the loop) gain value. We organize the response as a capability-assurance framework anchored by a Capability Ladder: a five-level progression (trigger, automation, workflow, AI agent, agent team) that classifies the operational autonomy of AI-augmented work and the human supervision it requires. We map the ladder to course-level updates, workload-aware assessment, and stackable workforce credentials, and illustrate it through a two-semester pilot of a team-based, no-code course enrolling computing and business students. We argue for targeted modernization around durable capabilities rather than wholesale curriculum replacement, and we are explicit about evidence limits: labor signals are confounded by non-AI forces, industry reports are directional, and the pilot is exploratory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个课程框架论文，基于结构化叙事综述论证AI对计算工作的近期影响是"任务再分配"而非"完全替代"，并提出"能力阶梯"（Capability Ladder）五级框架来分类AI增强工作的自主性与所需人类监督，通过一个探索性试点课程加以说明。
AI.motivation: AI改变计算工作任务构成的速度快于课程与培训的适应速度，需要课程框架层面的系统回应，而非零散的课程修补。
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事综述作为理论基础（涵盖劳动力市场与软件工程证据），并设计一个为期两学期的探索性试点课程（面向计算与商科学生的团队式、无代码课程）作为框架的示例说明，而非主要证据。
AI.result: 提出"能力阶梯"五级进展（触发、自动化、工作流、AI代理、代理团队），用于分类AI增强工作的操作自主性及所需人类监督；并将其映射到课程层级更新、工作量感知评估（workload-aware assessment）以及可堆叠的劳动力资质认证；核心主张是围绕持久能力进行定向现代化而非全面替换课程。
AI.conclusion: 近期AI变化本质是任务再分配：常规实现日益自动化，而验证、系统思维、安全及监督和编排AI（保持人在回路）的能力价值上升；作者同时明确承认证据局限——劳动力信号受非AI因素混淆、行业报告具方向性、试点仅为探索性质。

title: Persistent Semantic Entities in Tool-Augmented LLM Systems
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Camera-ready version; 32 pages . The openreview url is https://openreview.net/forum?id=zPjmtawzT8&noteId=CXB95ws5so and ICML poster url is https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/poster/60521
summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents can harbor implicit state that persists across sessions, activates through events, and propagates across agent boundaries---largely invisible to standard debugging. We formalize this as Persistent Semantic Entities (PSEs): constructs defined by name binding, event triggering, and cross-boundary propagation, and evaluate them across 24 models from 11 families (1.5B--1T parameters). First, every tested model is susceptible (20--100% on the 20-model susceptibility panel), with name binding as the necessary and dominant mechanism: without it, contamination is 0%. Second, persistence depends on contamination type rather than scale or deployment: preference contamination persists undecayed on every model probed (100% at t=10) and instruction contamination persists wherever adopted, persona-style injection decays partially (90%$\to$10%), while factual injection is model-dependent---self-corrected on Llama-3.1-8B and GPT-4o-mini but held at ceiling on both Qwen2.5-coder variants, so we do not claim it self-corrects in general. The preference and instruction results hold across providers in our controlled setting. Third, context-isolated self-verification achieves 20--79% reduction (median 36.5%) without oracle references while keyword-based detection produces systematic false positives, and contamination compounds 1.9$\times$ along a four-stage agent pipeline (40%$\to$75%). Preference and instruction contamination---persistent, lacking self-correction, and poorly captured by standard monitoring---represent a particularly concerning attack surface for deployed agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了工具增强型LLM代理中存在的持久语义实体（PSEs）问题：跨会话、跨代理边界且对标准调试不可见的隐式状态。在24个模型（11个家族，1.5B--1T参数）上的评估显示，所有模型均易受攻击（20--100%），名称绑定是必要且主导的污染机制。持久性取决于污染类型而非模型规模：偏好和指令污染在所有模型上不衰减（t=10时为100%），个性注入部分衰减（90%→10%），事实注入依赖模型。上下文隔离的自我验证可实现20--79%（中位数36.5%）的降低，而关键词检测产生系统性误报，且污染在四阶段代理管线中复合增长1.9倍（40%→75%）。偏好和指令污染构成已部署代理系统特别严重的攻击面。
AI.motivation: 标准调试工具无法检测工具增强型LLM代理中跨会话、事件触发、跨边界传播的隐式状态，这些持久语义实体（PSEs）构成了未被充分认识的安全和可靠性风险，需要系统化的形式化和评估。
AI.method: 将持久语义实体形式化为由名称绑定、事件触发和跨边界传播定义的构造；在24个模型（11个家族，1.5B--1T参数）上系统评估；使用上下文隔离的自我验证和基于关键词的检测方法进行比较；沿四阶段代理管线测量污染复合效应。
AI.result: 所有被测试模型均易受污染（20--100%）；名称绑定是必要机制（无名称绑定时污染为零）；偏好污染在所有模型上不衰减（t=10为100%），同样适用于指令污染；个性注入部分衰减；事实注入因模型而异（Llama-3.1-8B和GPT-4o-mini可自纠正，Qwen2.5-coder变体保持顶峰）；上下文隔离自我验证降低20--79%（中位数36.5%）；关键词检测产生系统性误报；污染在四阶段管线中40%→75%复合增长。
AI.conclusion: 偏好和指令污染是持久的、缺乏自纠正能力且标准监控难以捕获的，代表对已部署代理系统的严重攻击面。上下文隔离的自我验证是一种无需oracle引用的有效缓解手段，而关键词检测方法不可靠。

title: Who Built This Model? Tracing LLM Lineage via Spectral Fingerprints in Weight Space
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly developed through complex, multi-stage pipelines, leading to intricate lineage relationships that reflect model origin, ownership, and evolution. Understanding these relationships is important for model provenance, governance, and supply-chain integrity. In this work, we investigate the notion of LLM "biometrics" (analogous to human biometrics) to ask whether LLMs exhibit intrinsic fingerprints in weight space alone, without access to input data, that reveal their origin and lineage. We formulate this as a lineage discrimination problem, distinguishing among independent-origin, same-series, and shared-base models. To characterize these relationships, we propose a unified geometric fingerprinting framework that analyzes weight matrices from two complementary perspectives: (i) spectral energy, captured by singular value distributions to encode global magnitude patterns, and (ii) subspace alignment, quantified via subspace deviations to capture directional geometry. Our analysis uncovers a clear hierarchy of structural similarity in weight space: spectral energy reliably distinguishes independently trained models and different model families, while subspace alignment enables fine-grained discrimination among closely related models, including variations in dataset scale and post-training procedures. Extensive experiments on over 110 diverse open-weight LLM pairs demonstrate that weight-space geometry provides a robust and interpretable signal for model lineage, enabling coarse-grained regime separation and fine-grained discrimination within shared-base models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种仅基于权重空间（无需输入数据）的"LLM生物特征"框架，通过谱能量和子空间对齐两种几何视角，实现对开源大语言模型的血统判别（独立来源、同系列、共享基座），并在110余个模型对上验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 开源大语言模型通过复杂多阶段流水线开发，形成了反映模型来源、所有权和演化的复杂谱系关系。理解这些关系对模型溯源、治理和供应链完整性至关重要。现有方法缺乏一种无需访问输入数据即可区分模型血统的内在指纹信号，因此需要探索权重空间中是否存在类似人类生物特征的内在指纹。
AI.method: 将模型血统识别形式化为一个谱系判别问题（区分独立来源、同系列、共享基座三类关系），提出统一的几何指纹框架，从两个互补视角分析权重矩阵：（i）谱能量——通过奇异值分布编码全局幅度模式；（ii）子空间对齐——通过子空间偏差量化方向性几何。实验覆盖超过110个开源权重LLM对。
AI.result: 实验揭示了权重空间中清晰的结构相似性层级：谱能量能够可靠区分独立训练的模型和不同模型家族；子空间对齐能够实现近缘模型（包括数据集规模和后期训练程序的差异）的细粒度判别。权重空间几何提供了稳健且可解释的模型血统信号，支持粗粒度机制划分和共享基座模型内的细粒度判别。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间的几何特征可作为LLM的内在"生物特征"，无需访问输入数据即可揭示模型的来源与谱系关系，为模型溯源、治理和供应链完整性提供了新的可解释工具。

title: From Uncertainty to Failure Attribution: Self-Diagnosing Models for Failure Attribution under Distribution Shift
summary: Distribution shift poses a significant challenge to the robustness of machine learning models, but the current solutions only aim to detect out-of-distribution (OOD) samples and predict uncertainty levels. We introduce a problem setting for failure attribution under distribution shift, which enables the models not only to detect OOD samples, but also to find out the reason for their failure. The solution we propose is called self-diagnosing models, which are capable of jointly learning predictive output, predictive uncertainty, and a failure attribution signal. In particular, we use the failure attribution vector, produced by a neural network, which provides a structured representation of predictive unreliability by distinguishing four different types of failures: covariance shift, semantic shift, noise corruption, and adversarial perturbation. In other words, we move from scalar uncertainty towards failure identification. For training the model, we introduce a consistency regularizer that encourages consistency between uncertainty and failure attribution predictions. Moreover, to be able to evaluate the model on its ability to find the reasons for failure, we construct several distribution shift benchmarks with predefined mechanisms for generating distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的问题设置——分布偏移下的失败归因（failure attribution），使模型不仅能检测OOD样本，还能识别失败原因。作者提出了自诊断模型（self-diagnosing models），联合学习预测输出、预测不确定性和失败归因信号，通过一个失败归因向量区分四种失败类型：协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声损坏和对抗扰动。此外，引入一致性正则化器，并构建了具有预定义偏移生成机制的基准数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅能检测OOD样本并预测不确定性水平，无法解释模型为何失败，缺乏对失败原因的结构化诊断能力。
AI.method: 提出自诊断模型，联合学习预测输出、预测不确定性和失败归因向量；引入一致性正则化器促进不确定性与失败归因之间的一致性；构建具有预定义机制的分布偏移基准用于评估。
AI.result: 通过失败归因向量区分四种失败类型（协变量偏移、语义偏移、噪声损坏、对抗扰动），实现了从标量不确定性向失败识别的转变。
AI.conclusion: 自诊断模型能够在检测OOD样本的同时归因失败原因，为分布偏移下的模型鲁棒性提供了更细粒度的诊断能力。

title: CliniCARE-Bench: Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR
summary: Large language models perform strongly on medical knowledge benchmarks, but reliable clinical deployment requires agents to conduct defensible investigations over heterogeneous, longitudinal records: determining what evidence is needed, retrieving and reconciling structured and free-text data, grounding conclusions in verifiable evidence, and deferring cases that cannot be resolved reliably. We introduce CliniCARE-Bench (Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR), a benchmark for retrospective clinical audit: 25 clinician-validated scenarios instantiated as 750 patient-specific cases over real-patient-derived MIMIC-IV data. Systems investigate each case through a governed, logged tool environment for record retrieval, computation, and policy access, and return one of four verdicts---Yes, No, Indeterminate: Lack of Data, or Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous---the last two separating missing evidence from residual medical ambiguity. Beyond verdict accuracy, we score patient-evidence and policy grounding, process adherence, calibrated abstention, reliability, and efficiency against case-level reference verdicts produced by independent multi-model adjudication and calibrated against Clinical Board review. Every retrieval, computation, and report is replayable, so the investigation trace is inspectable and scorable. To our knowledge, CliniCARE-Bench is the first deployment-oriented clinical-agent benchmark to jointly evaluate real longitudinal EHR investigation, claim-level evidence grounding, governing-policy use, process adherence, and calibrated abstention within a common patient-level adjudication framework. Across 16 agentic systems, four-way accuracy spans 65.3-76.1%, but raw accuracy overstates investigation quality. Defect-free accuracy, which credits a verdict only when correct and free of prohibited shortcuts, is 4.8-14.8 points lower and reorders the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CliniCARE-Bench，首个面向临床部署的医疗智能体基准，用于评估在真实纵向电子健康记录（EHR）上执行可辩护性临床审计的能力。基准包含25个临床专家验证场景、750个基于MIMIC-IV的真实患者案例，通过受管制的可回放工具环境评估系统的调查质量，涵盖证据检索、结构化与非结构化数据调和、政策遵循、校准性弃权及过程合规等维度。实验表明，16个智能体系统的四分类准确率达65.3-76.1%，但无缺陷准确率（要求预测正确且无违规捷径）比原始准确率低4.8-14.8个百分点，且会重排排行榜。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医学知识基准上表现优异，但可靠的临床部署需要智能体能够在异构、纵向的病历记录上进行可辩护的调查，这包括确定需要什么证据、检索并调和结构化与自由文本数据、将结论锚定在可验证的证据上，以及在无法可靠裁决时主动推迟。现有基准缺乏对真实纵向EHR检索、证据锚定、政策遵循和校准弃权的联合评估，CliniCARE-Bench旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了25个经临床医生验证的场景，实例化为750个基于真实患者来源的MIMIC-IV数据的个体案例。系统通过一个受管制、可记录的日志工具环境进行调查（支持病历检索、计算和政策访问），返回四种裁决之一：Yes、No、Indeterminate: Lack of Data（数据缺失）或Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous（医学模糊）。除裁决准确性外，还从患者证据和政策锚定、过程遵循、校准弃权、可靠性和效率等多个维度打分，参考裁决由独立多模型裁决并经临床委员会审查校准。所有检索、计算和报告均可回放，调查轨迹可检查、可评分。
AI.result: 在16个智能体系统上，四分类准确率区间为65.3%-76.1%，但原始准确率高估了调查质量。无缺陷准确率（仅当裁决正确且无禁止性捷径时计分）比原始准确率低4.8-14.8个百分点，并导致排行榜排名发生变化。这是首个在统一患者级裁决框架下联合评估真实纵向EHR调查、声明级证据锚定、治理政策使用、过程遵循和校准弃权的面向部署的临床智能体基准。
AI.conclusion: CliniCARE-Bench证明了准确率作为唯一指标不足以评估临床智能体的可靠性——忽视过程质量和证据锚定会显著高估系统能力。该基准为评估临床智能体在实际部署环境中的调查质量提供了首个标准化框架，推动更严格、可审计、可回放的临床AI评估范式。

title: EasyBalance: Cross-Layer Load Balancing in Distributed MoE Inference
summary: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. As routing distributions are typically skewed across experts, devices hosting lighter-loaded experts must idle to wait for the heaviest during expert computing, leading to inefficiency. Existing load-balancing approaches primarily rely on expert replication or migration within each layer, which introduce additional overhead and limit their flexibility and scalability. To address this problem, we propose EasyBalance, a cross-layer load balancing strategy that requires no modifications to the expert-device mapping, enabling instant adaptability and incurring essentially no additional overhead. Our key insights are that (1) experts of other layers can be viewed as naturally redundant for the current layer, and (2) cross-layer MoE workloads can be jointly executed to mitigate their individual imbalance. Based on these observations, EasyBalance greedily schedules a subset of cross-layer workloads to run at each MoE step and defers the remaining workloads for future balancing opportunities, effectively leveraging cross-layer imbalance mitigation. Extensive experiments across models, tasks, and configurations demonstrate that EasyBalance consistently accelerates distributed MoE inference, reducing GPU idling by mostly over 40%. Code is available at https://github.com/yize-wu/EasyInfra.

AI.tldr: EasyBalance提出了一种跨层负载均衡策略，通过将其他层的专家视为当前层的天然冗余负载，并在不修改专家-设备映射的前提下跨层联合执行MoE工作负载，从而显著减少分布式MoE推理中的GPU空闲时间（多数场景降低40%以上）。
AI.motivation: 专家并行分布式推理中，MoE模型的路由分布通常偏斜，导致负载较轻的设备必须等待最重的设备，造成严重的GPU空闲和推理效率低下。现有方法依赖层内专家复制或迁移，引入了额外开销并限制了灵活性和可扩展性。
AI.method: EasyBalance的核心在于：(1) 将其他层的专家视为当前层的自然冗余；(2) 跨层MoE工作负载可以联合执行以缓解各自的不均衡。具体实现上，EasyBalance采用贪心调度策略，在每个MoE步骤中选择一部分跨层工作负载执行，将剩余工作负载推迟到未来进行平衡调度，从而有效利用跨层负载差异进行均衡。
AI.result: 在多种模型、任务和配置下的广泛实验表明，EasyBalance能够持续加速分布式MoE推理，将GPU空闲时间减少40%以上。
AI.conclusion: EasyBalance作为一种无需修改专家-设备映射的跨层负载均衡方案，具有即时适应性和几乎零额外开销的优势，为分布式MoE推理中的负载均衡问题提供了一种高效、灵活且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents
summary: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体框架，用于自动重构约束规划（CP）模型。智能体给定原始模型和三个训练实例，从开放空间中提出替代公式，通过将解注入原始模型进行实证验证，并迭代诊断和修复失败，在约15分钟内返回最优变体。在9个组合优化问题上，生成的模型在27个测试实例中的21个上优于原始模型，部分问题求解速度提升超过两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 约束规划（CP）求解器的运行时间对建模选择高度敏感，如对称性破除、隐含约束、全局约束、约束重构和变量表示等。传统上改进约束模型需要人类专家经验，而现有自动化重构系统局限于预定义的手工变换规则库，缺乏从开放空间中探索新模型公式的能力。
AI.method: 提出智能体框架：使用LLM作为智能体，给定约束模型和三个训练实例，智能体（1）提出替代公式；（2）通过将每个提案的解注入原始模型来实证验证其正确性；（3）诊断和修复失败，迭代改进；（4）返回最优变体。模型用CPMpy建模库表达，每个提案在三个更大的测试实例上评估。
AI.result: 在9个组合优化问题上，生成的模型在27个测试实例中的21个优于原始模型，部分问题求解速度提升超过两个数量级。与非智能体基线（复用相同验证和选择工具）的对比表明性能提升源于智能体的迭代诊断和修复，而非简单采样多个候选。
AI.conclusion: 自主智能体方法能够有效支持约束模型的改进，展示了LLM智能体在自动化约束编程建模优化方面的潜力，为摆脱对人工专家建模经验的依赖提供了新路径。

title: CausalNav: Reliability-Certified Causal World Models for Control under Physical-Parameter Shift
summary: A world model is only useful for physical AI if it changes what the agent does, and only safe if it declines to do so when it is wrong. We study both halves of that requirement with CausalNav, a controller built around a signed, action-conditioned transition graph over identified state coordinates. At deployment CausalNav simulates a small library of intervention sequences, converts their objective error into policy-logit advice, and admits that advice only when a scale-free predictive-reliability certificate, a policy-margin gate, and an argmax-agreement gate all pass; otherwise it falls back exactly to its own model-based base controller. We evaluate against nine controlled baselines (transformer, recurrent, split-latent, graph, causal-induction, and three recent model-based reasoning modules) on CartPole-v1 and discretized Pendulum-v1 with physical-parameter shifts, under one shared PPO trainer, one interaction budget, and ten held-out seeds (200 runs). CausalNav attains the best average rank (1.25 of ten). The diagnostic result is more informative than the ranking: the learned graph recovers structure well above chance (CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09), yet per-seed structural fidelity is uncorrelated with per-seed control benefit (r = -0.15, p = 0.67), and the certificate abstains on 10/10 Pendulum seeds, where forcing the planner on costs return. Model fidelity did not predict downstream control utility in our setting; certified abstention, not better prediction, is what made the world model safe to deploy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalNav，一个基于有符号、动作条件化转移图的因果世界模型控制器。它通过预测可靠性证书、策略边界门和argmax一致性门三重机制决定是否采纳计划器的建议，否则回退到基础控制器。在CartPole-v1和Pendulum-v1上的实验显示其平均排名最优（1.25/10），但关键发现是：图结构保真度与下游控制收益无相关性，认证式弃权（而不是更好的预测）才是世界模型安全部署的关键。
AI.motivation: 世界模型要真正实用，必须同时满足两方面的要求：当模型正确时能改变智能体的行为（有用性），当模型错误时拒绝改变行为（安全性）。但现有工作往往只关注预测精度，忽视了"模型准确度"与"下游控制效益"之间的关系，也缺乏可靠的安全机制来防止错误模型指导下的错误决策。
AI.method: CausalNav由一个经过标识的状态坐标构建的有符号、动作条件化转移图组成。部署时，它：(1) 模拟一个小型干预序列库；(2) 将客观误差转化为策略logit建议；(3) 只有当三个条件全部通过时才采纳建议——尺度无关的预测可靠性证书、策略边界门、argmax一致性门；否则完全回退到自身的基于模型的基础控制器。实验使用统一的PPO训练器、统一交互预算和10个保留种子（共200次运行），与九个受控基线对比。
AI.result: 在CartPole-v1和离散化Pendulum-v1（含物理参数偏移）上，CausalNav取得最佳平均排名（10个方法中排名1.25）。诊断结果显示：学习到的图结构恢复显著高于随机水平（CartPole F1=0.59±0.09），但逐种子的结构保真度与逐种子的控制收益不相关（r=-0.15, p=0.67）；证书在10/10的Pendulum种子上弃权，强行使用规划器则会损害回报。
AI.conclusion: 模型的预测保真度并不能直接预测下游控制效用；在本文设置中，经过认证的弃权机制（而非更好的预测能力）才是让世界模型安全部署的核心因素。提出了"安全部署世界模型"的设计范式：可靠性认证+门控回退，而非一味追求预测精度。

title: ZeroLock: Concurrent Memory-Efficient LLM Training via Modular Update Decoupling
summary: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning at the edge adapts the model to scenario-specific data while preserving privacy. Although existing studies proposed pipeline parallelism to address the limited memory and computing resources of edge devices, they commonly rely on backpropagation (BP) training, which has a fundamental limitation of update locking and could experience severe throughput and memory bottlenecks. In this work, we propose a BP-free algorithm, called ZeroLock, that decouples the model updates into independent chunk updates by local objective construction. It breaks the update locking of BP and hence can improve throughput at the algorithm level and lower memory usage by reducing activation storage. To the best of our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical framework for such local objective construction-based approaches under general model chunk division by mapping local objectives to the global objective. We prove that ZeroLock has a convergence rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/\sqrt{T})$, which differs from BP only by polylogarithmic factors. We design a system for ZeroLock and build real-world prototypes, incorporating techniques such as early forwarding and failure recovery for efficient and robust implementation. Experiments on the prototype show that compared to BP-based baselines, ZeroLock reduces the memory by 26.5% and improves throughput by 4.9%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZeroLock，一种无反向传播（BP-free）的边缘端大语言模型微调算法，通过局部目标构建将模型更新解耦为独立的分块更新，打破BP的更新锁定，在算法层面提升吞吐量并降低激活存储带来的内存占用。作者提供了首个针对此类方法在通用分块划分下的理论框架，证明ZeroLock的收敛率为O(1/√T)（仅与BP相差多对数因子），并在真实原型上实现验证，相比BP基线内存降低26.5%、吞吐量提升4.9%。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的LLM微调需要兼顾隐私保护和有限的存储与计算资源。现有的流水线并行方法依赖反向传播（BP）训练，但BP存在更新锁定（update locking）这一根本性缺陷，导致严重的吞吐量瓶颈和内存开销。
AI.method: ZeroLock通过局部目标构建的方式，将模型更新解耦为相互独立的分块更新，从而打破BP的更新锁定。论文还建立了从局部目标映射到全局目标的理论框架（适用于通用模型分块划分），并设计了包含早期转发（early forwarding）和故障恢复（failure recovery）的完整系统实现。
AI.result: 理论方面，ZeroLock的收敛率为Õ(1/√T)，与BP相比仅相差多对数因子。实验方面，在真实原型上相比BP基线，ZeroLock将内存降低26.5%、吞吐量提升4.9%。
AI.conclusion: ZeroLock证明了BP-free的局部目标构建方法可以在理论上保证收敛性，并在实践中显著优于BP方案，为边缘端LLM微调提供了更高效、更低内存的替代方案。

title: AI Evaluation Should Measure Verification Cost, Not Correctness Alone
summary: The reliability of AI generative models is typically measured by output correctness, yet in practice it depends on the effort required to verify those outputs. We argue that current evaluation metrics overlook a critical failure mode: Verification-Cost Errors (VCEs), defined as incorrect input-output pairs that a declared fraction of the verifier population fails to identify within the verification budget available in a given deployment context. Unlike standard notions of "hallucination", VCEs are defined operationally, by the failure of correct identification within budget rather than by any property of the output itself. Plausibility and authoritative presentation are hypothesised contributors to that failure, not defining conditions. To capture this asymmetry, we introduce the notion of verification cost relative to a deployment budget as an operational dimension that current evaluation does not routinely capture. The quantity is presented as a conceptual instrument rather than a finalized metric. Evidence from code generation and multi-modal document understanding shows that high benchmark accuracy can mask significant verification effort in practice. We therefore take the position that correctness alone is insufficient as a measure of reliability. AI evaluation should explicitly account for verification cost, reflecting whether errors can be detected under realistic resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证成本错误"（Verification-Cost Errors, VCEs）这一概念，指在给定部署预算内、声明的验证者群体无法识别的错误输入-输出对。作者认为当前以输出正确性为核心的评估指标无法捕捉此类错误，并主张AI评估应显式纳入验证成本这一操作维度。
AI.motivation: 现行AI生成模型可靠性评估仅关注输出正确性，忽略了实际应用中验证输出所需付出的努力。高基准精度可能掩盖显著的实际验证负担，导致在真实部署场景下错误难以被及时发现。
AI.method: 提出"验证成本错误"（VCE）的操作性定义，引入"验证成本相对于部署预算"这一操作维度作为概念性工具；通过代码生成和多模态文档理解两个领域的证据展示高基准精度与高验证成本可以并存。
AI.result: 在代码生成和多模态文档理解任务中的实证表明，高基准准确率可能掩盖显著的实际验证成本，验证了VCE作为评估维度的必要性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 正确性单独不足以衡量AI可靠性，评估体系应显式纳入验证成本维度，以反映在现实资源约束下错误是否可被检测。

title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
summary: An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. With no change to the judge, the candidates, or the budget, EL-DGR reaches 58.2% on GSM8K (vs. 56.8% judge, 55.8% majority, 55.4% first candidate) and 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1 on HotpotQA (vs. 15.67/23.49, 15.33/23.19, 15.33/22.97), improving on first-candidate GRPO by +2.8 pp (exact McNemar p=0.0026) and +2.00 EM (p=0.070, borderline). A decision audit shows why: EL-DGR overturns consensus on only 8 of 30 pilot questions and never converts a correct consensus into an incorrect answer. We also report what did not work: the same seven-channel decomposition used as a step-level gated training reward is null, and corrected channel-drop ablations show no channel is individually necessary (p=1.0 throughout). The practitioner-facing finding is negative about judges and positive about admissibility, bound the judge's blast radius rather than trying to make it accurate.

AI.tldr: 本文证明LLM判官在推理管线中的有效性主要取决于其嵌入的决策规则而非判官本身的准确性。作者提出Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair（EL-DGR）任务自适应非补偿规则，在不改变判官、候选或预算的情况下，相较多数投票和判官直接使用显著提升GSM8K和HotpotQA指标，并展示了对共识颠覆的严格限制。最终实践结论是：应限制判官的"爆炸半径"而非追求其准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究过度关注LLM判官本身的准确性，但作者发现推理管线中部署判官时，真正决定产品质量的是判官所嵌入的决策规则。研究发现无约束的标量判官相比多数投票几乎无增益，甚至在特定场景下会显著降低准确性，需要更合理的决策框架来约束判官的影响力。
AI.method: 提出EL-DGR（Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair）框架：一种任务自适应的非补偿性决策规则。在判官偏好与证据支持的共识冲突时，要求提供可提取的证据证书；仅在无替代方案被认证时才允许修复。同时进行了消融实验：七通道分解用作步级门控训练奖励无效，通道剔除无任何通道单独必要（p=1.0）。
AI.result: 在GSM8K上EL-DGR达58.2%（对比判官56.8%、多数55.8%、首个候选55.4%），相对首个候选提升+2.8pp（精确McNemar p=0.0026）；在HotpotQA上达17.33 EM/25.46 F1。决策审计显示EL-DGR仅在30个试点问题中的8个上颠覆共识，且从未将正确共识转化为错误答案。同时报告了负面结果：七通道分解作为训练奖励无效，无通道单独必要。
AI.conclusion: 面向实践者的核心发现是双重否定性+肯定性的：对判官本身的追求是消极的（准确性与下游表现弱相关），而对可入性/准入控制的思路是积极的——应通过决策规则约束判官的影响力边界（"爆炸半径"），而非试图让判官更准确。

title: Evaluator Ensembles Under Reward Hacking: Covariance Geometry and Finite-Search Guarantees
summary: Language-model judges and reward models enable scalable supervision, but finite optimization can exploit evaluator errors rather than improve response quality. We characterize this failure through the covariance geometry of evaluator ensembles. For calibrated judges, the ensemble mean retains common-mode error along the all-ones direction, whereas cross-judge disagreement captures only orthogonal error. Consequently, disagreement can be high despite robust aggregation, or low while shared response-dependent errors persist. We prove that common-mode error is not identifiable from internal judge scores alone. Under a joint sub-Gaussian model, we bound best-of-K selection overstatement and target-quality regret, extending the guarantees to predictably adaptive search under conditional calibration. The resulting search terms scale as the square root of log K and are asymptotically tight for Gaussian projected errors. We further show that noisy quality proxies introduce artificial rank-one covariance without changing disagreement, and propose a bounded two-anchor Bernstein certificate for finite-search error and regret. Fixed-seed Gaussian stress tests over 120 (J, rho, K) configurations and real-model audits validate the theory while revealing the limits of disagreement-based diagnostics under increasing search pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过协方差几何刻画了语言模型裁判集成在有限优化中的系统性失效模式。证明校准裁判的集成均值沿全一方向保留共同模式误差，而裁判间分歧只能捕获正交方向误差，因此分歧高并不能保证聚合稳健，分歧低也不能排除共享的响应相关误差。作者进一步证明了仅凭内部裁判分数无法识别共同模式误差，并在联合次高斯模型下给出了best-of-K选择高估和负遗憾的界，扩展到条件校准下的预测自适应搜索。此外，噪声质量代理会引入人工秩一协方差而不改变分歧，作者提出有界双锚点Bernstein证书，并通过120个(J, rho, K)配置的固定种子高斯压力测试和真实模型审计验证了理论。
AI.motivation: 基于语言模型的裁判和奖励模型支持可扩展监督，但有限的优化过程（如best-of-K搜索）可能利用裁判的评估错误而非真正改善响应质量。现有研究缺乏对这种失败模式的系统性刻画，特别是裁判集成中共同模式误差与分歧的几何关系尚未被理论化理解。
AI.method: 通过协方差几何框架将裁判集成误差分解为共同模式（沿全一方向）和正交（跨裁判分歧）两部分；证明共同模式误差不可识别性；建立联合次高斯模型推导选择高估和遗憾的紧界；引入有界双锚点Bernstein证书用于有限搜索误差控制；通过固定种子高斯压力测试（120个参数配置）和真实模型审计进行验证。
AI.result: 证明共同模式误差无法从内部裁判分数中识别；分歧与聚合稳健性之间存在反直觉关系；搜索项以sqrt(log K)的规模增长且对高斯投影误差渐近紧；噪声代理引入秩一协方差伪影；双锚点Bernstein证书为有限搜索提供可靠界；实验验证了理论并揭示了高搜索压力下分歧诊断的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 基于裁判分歧的评估方法在有限优化场景中存在根本性局限，共同模式误差不可识别且分歧指标可能产生误导性信号。需要新的诊断工具和优化策略来补充甚至替代分歧基准方法，以应对日益增长的搜索压力。

title: Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation for Real-world Repository Migration
summary: LLMs have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and automated program repair, but migrating an entire repository rarely produces a runnable application because long-horizon translation challenges LLM-based agents' ability to maintain repository-level migration objectives. In this work, we propose Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation (ECAT), a multi-agent framework for automated Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration. ECAT formulates repository migration as adversarial entropy minimization through a generator-discriminator architecture. The discriminator measures migration quality using a unified metric called Code Entropy and produces text gradients that specify both file-level generation directives and the skills needed to execute them. Guided by these optimization signals, the generator iteratively updates the repository, and each update is accepted only if it reduces Code Entropy. Repeated generator--discriminator interactions progressively drive the migration from an initial template toward a functionally complete HarmonyOS repository. Successful low-entropy trajectories are further distilled into a self-evolving memory tree, enabling transferable migration knowledge across repositories. We also introduce A2H-RepoBench, the first real-world benchmark for Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration, covering applications from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of lines of code. Evaluated by node alignment and an agent-based functional judge, ECAT achieves 74.7% overall migration quality and consistently outperforms existing agent-based methods across repositories of different scales.

AI.tldr: 提出了ECAT（基于熵的代码对抗迁移）多智能体框架，用于Android到HarmonyOS的仓库级自动迁移，通过生成器-判别器架构将迁移建模为熵最小化过程，并引入首个真实基准A2H-RepoBench。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在代码生成和自动程序修复方面表现出色，但现有方法无法完成整个仓库的迁移——长周期翻译任务会挑战LLM智能体维持仓库级迁移目标的能力，产出的应用往往不可运行。
AI.method: ECAT采用生成器-判别器架构，将仓库迁移形式化为对抗性熵最小化。判别器使用统一的"代码熵"（Code Entropy）指标衡量迁移质量，并产生文本梯度来指定文件级生成指令及所需技能；生成器根据这些优化信号迭代更新仓库，且仅在降低代码熵时接受更新。成功的高质量轨迹被蒸馏为自进化记忆树，实现跨仓库的可迁移迁移知识。同时构建了首个真实世界的Android到HarmonyOS仓库迁移基准A2H-RepoBench。
AI.result: 在节点对齐和基于智能体的功能评判下，ECAT达到74.7%的整体迁移质量，在不同规模仓库上均一致优于现有基于智能体的方法（覆盖数万到数十万行代码的应用程序）。
AI.conclusion: 生成器-判别器的对抗式熵最小化框架能够有效解决仓库级长周期代码迁移问题，且通过记忆树蒸馏可实现迁移知识的跨仓库复用，为Android到HarmonyOS的生态迁移提供了可行的自动化方案。

title: Counterfactual Benchmarking and Training for Factuality Consistency and Order-Robust Grounded Reasoning in LLMs over Heterogeneous Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have increasingly supported response generation grounded in user-provided knowledge spanning heterogeneous structures. However, existing benchmarks provide limited assessment of whether LLMs can faithfully perform multi-hop reasoning chains across such knowledge contexts while remaining robust to variations in their input order. We introduce TKFQA, a factuality consistency benchmark comprising 10,130 question-answering (QA) pairs grounded in tables, texts, and knowledge graphs (KGs). Each example is constructed from an explicit counterfactual reasoning chain, enabling the joint evaluation of answer correctness, reasoning-chain accuracy, and robustness to different input-order. An extensive evaluation of 14 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals that state-of-the-art models exhibit limited reasoning-chain accuracy and remain sensitive to variations in the input order of heterogeneous knowledge contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ORLF, an LLM-agnostic training framework that models cross-context topological relations through knowledge-specific latent vectors. ORLF integrates context-wise position encoding, a latent-bridge attention mask, and topological knowledge bias to preserve knowledge-specific bias and encode topological semantics. Experiments across four LLM backbones show that ORLF outperforms competitive training-free and LoRA-based baselines, improving average Exact Match and Reasoning-Chain Accuracy by 2.15% and 4.29%, respectively, while reducing order-induced performance standard deviation by 0.04% to 3.01%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TKFQA基准，包含10,130个基于表格、文本和知识图谱的QA对，用于评估LLM在异构知识上进行多跳推理的忠实性和输入顺序鲁棒性。评估发现现有LLM在这些方面表现不佳，为此提出ORLF训练框架，通过知识特异的潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系，在四个LLM骨干上平均提升EM和RCA分别2.15%和4.29%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对LLM在异构知识（表格、文本、知识图谱）上进行多跳推理链的忠实性评估，也未能评估模型对知识输入顺序变化的鲁棒性。作者希望填补这一空白，并提出可提升模型的训练方法。
AI.method: （1）构建TKFQA基准，基于显式反事实推理链生成10,130个QA对，联合评估答案正确性、推理链准确性和输入顺序鲁棒性。（2）提出ORLF框架，这是一个与LLM无关的训练框架，通过知识特异的潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系，具体包括上下文位置编码、潜在桥梁注意力掩码和拓扑知识偏置三个组件。
AI.result: 在14个开源和闭源LLM上的评估表明，最先进的模型推理链准确率有限，且对异构知识输入顺序变化敏感。ORLF在四个LLM骨干上超越了竞争力的无训练基线和LoRA基线，平均提升Exact Match 2.15%、Reasoning-Chain Accuracy 4.29%，并将顺序诱导的性能标准差降低0.04%到3.01%。
AI.conclusion: LLM在异构知识上的多跳推理忠实性和顺序鲁棒性仍有显著提升空间，ORLF通过建模跨上下文拓扑关系能有效改善这两方面性能，为未来研究和实际部署提供了基准与解决方案。

title: Quality-Diversity Stress Tests for Process Reward Models:What Archive Coverage Can and Cannot Certify
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) score intermediate reasoning steps and are widely used for search, ranking, and training, but optimization can exploit these learned proxies by increasing reward while turning correct reasoning into incorrect reasoning. We formulate PRM stress testing as a quality-diversity search problem using MAP-Elites, retaining the most severe correctness-flipping edit in each behavior-space region while separating search coverage from exploit coverage. We characterize what such archives certify: finite-cell repair bounds covered-cell tail risk and average residual severity but cannot bound the worst remaining cell from covered fraction alone; under Lipschitz post-repair loss and metric-cover auditing, the residual is bounded by archive fitting error plus the Lipschitz constant times the covering radius. A controlled landscape validates this certificate and the impossibility of any fraction-only worst-case guarantee. On real PRMs, the search reveals an aggregation-dependent vulnerability in Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B: padding yields 44 strict exploits with maximum gain 0.294 under mean pooling versus one exploit under minimum readout; a matched syntactic control isolates the mechanism, and an RLHFlow value-head model shows the same qualitative effect with maximum gain 0.005. A predeclared paired LoRA repair protocol reduces exploit rates from 0.148 to 0.037 to 0.074, lowers the worst attack from 0.333 to 0.177 to 0.212, improves ranking AUROC without degrading best-of-4 accuracy, attributes gains to adversarial fine-tuning rather than archive diversity, and is confirmed by independent unpaired replications (44 to 1, clean-split worst gain 0.0092, MATH-500 41 to 0, clean ranking 40/40).

AI.tldr: 本文提出将过程奖励模型（PRM）的压力测试形式化为质量-多样性搜索问题（使用MAP-Elites），并提出了可认证的修复协议。研究揭示了Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B中聚合方式相关的脆弱性（mean pooling下padding产生44个严格漏洞，最大增益0.294），并通过LoRA修复协议将漏洞率显著降低，同时不损害排名AUROC和best-of-4准确率。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）被广泛用于搜索、排序和训练，但优化过程可能利用这些学习到的代理指标，在增加奖励的同时将正确推理转化为错误推理。现有的PRM评估缺乏对这类对抗性漏洞的系统性压力测试方法，需要一种能发现并量化这些漏洞的方法。
AI.method: 将PRM压力测试形式化为质量-多样性（QD）搜索问题，使用MAP-Elites算法，在每个行为空间区域保留最严重的正确性翻转编辑，同时分离搜索覆盖与漏洞利用覆盖。提出理论认证：有限单元修复边界可覆盖单元尾部风险和平均残余严重度，但在Lipschitz后修复损失和度量覆盖审计下，残余由归档拟合误差加Lipschitz常数乘覆盖半径界定。此外，采用预声明的配对LoRA修复协议，并使用独立的非配对复制验证结果。
AI.result: 受控实验验证了认证的有效性和仅依赖覆盖分数无法保证最差情况的结论。在真实PRM上，Qwen2.5-Math-PRM-7B在mean pooling下通过padding产生44个严格漏洞（最大增益0.294），而minimum readout下仅1个。RLHFlow value-head模型显示相同定性效果（最大增益0.005）。LoRA修复协议将漏洞率从0.148降至0.037再降至0.074，最坏攻击从0.333降至0.177再降至0.212，同时提升排名AUROC且不损害best-of-4准确率。独立非配对复制确认了结果（44到1，clean-split最坏增益0.0092，MATH-500 41到0）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了PRM脆弱性的系统性压力测试和修复的可行性：质量-多样性搜索能够发现PRM的对抗性漏洞，理论认证提供了可审计的残差边界，LoRA修复协议能有效降低漏洞率并保持甚至改善下游性能。同时指出聚合方式（如mean pooling vs minimum）对PRM脆弱性有显著影响。

title: Back to the Future: A workbook time machine for spread sheet creation benchmarks
summary: We introduce the workbook time machine, a pipeline that automatically creates benchmarks evaluating the ability of language models to create derived objects in spreadsheets (formulas, charts, pivot tables, and conditional formatting). Applied to public workbook corpora, it produces wtmcorpus--a collection of (input workbook, output workbook, query) triples spanning four artifact types and varying complexity. From this corpus we curate wtmbench, a 150-task evaluation benchmark with queries at three levels of specificity. We evaluate existing spreadsheet manipulation agents and baselines on wtmbench across artifact types, step complexity, and instruction granularity. Our evaluations show that query specificity, agent orchestration, and interface API used to control spreadsheets play a big role in LLM performance on Excel tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Workbook Time Machine（WTM），一个自动化流水线，用于从公开的工作簿语料库中生成评估基准，测试语言模型在电子表格中创建派生对象（公式、图表、透视表和条件格式）的能力。由此构建了WTMCorpus数据集和WTMbench（150个任务）评估基准，实验发现查询特异性、代理编排和界面API对LLM在Excel任务上的性能有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏系统性的基准来评估语言模型在电子表格中创建派生对象（如公式、图表、透视表、条件格式）的能力，而这些是电子表格操作的核心任务。作者希望自动化构建大规模、多样化的评估基准，以弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出一个自动化的流水线（Workbook Time Machine），从公开工作簿语料库中自动生成（输入工作簿、输出工作簿、查询）三元组。该流水线涵盖四种工件类型（公式、图表、透视表、条件格式），并按不同复杂度生成任务。基于此构建了WTMcorpus语料库，并从中筛选出包含150个任务的WTMbench基准，查询分为三个级别的特异性。
AI.result: 在WTMbench上评估了现有的电子表格操作代理和基线模型，结果表明查询特异性（指令粒度）、代理编排方式以及控制电子表格的界面API都会显著影响LLM在Excel任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 查询特异性、代理编排和界面API是影响LLM在电子表格任务上性能的关键因素，这为未来电子表格智能代理的设计提供了重要指导。

title: Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization for Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) plays an important role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recently, time series foundation models (TSFMs), pretrained on large-scale datasets, have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities and emerged as an important paradigm for TSF. Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has consequently attracted growing attention as a means of further improving their performance on downstream tasks. However, we find that, in certain forecast regions, RL post-training may gradually shift the output distributions of TSFMs away from the ground truth, thereby limiting their performance. We refer to this phenomenon as \textbf{suboptimal collapse}. Our analysis suggests that difficulty in initially sampling high-quality trajectories near the ground truth is an important contributing factor to suboptimal collapse. To address this issue, we propose Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization (GTN-R) for RL post-training of TSFMs. GTN-R uses the ground truth as a reference for locating high-quality regions and guides the model's probability mass toward the ground-truth neighborhood. This increases the probability of sampling high-quality trajectories, mitigates suboptimal collapse, and improves performance. Moreover, GTN-R can be flexibly integrated into various RL methods for TSFMs. Extensive experiments show its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文针对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的强化学习（RL）后训练中出现的"次优坍缩"（suboptimal collapse）现象，提出了一种名为GTN-R（Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization）的正则化方法。该方法利用真实值作为参考定位高质量区域，引导模型概率质量向真实值邻域集中，从而提高高质量轨迹的采样概率，缓解次优坍缩并提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: TSFM在大规模预训练后展现强大泛化能力，RL后训练被用于进一步提升下游任务性能。然而作者发现，在某些预测区域中，RL后训练会逐渐将TSFM的输出分布推向偏离真实值的方向，即"次优坍缩"现象，限制了模型性能。分析表明，难以在真实值附近初始采样到高质量轨迹是导致该现象的重要因素。
AI.method: 作者提出Ground-Truth Neighborhood Regularization（GTN-R）方法。GTN-R以真实值作为参考定位高质量区域，并通过正则化引导模型的概率质量向真实值邻域移动，从而增加在高质量轨迹（即靠近真实值的轨迹）上的采样概率，缓解次优坍缩。该方法设计为模块化组件，可灵活集成到各种RL后训练方法中用于TSFM。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了GTN-R的有效性，证明其能缓解次优坍缩现象并提升TSFM在下游任务上的预测性能，且与多种RL方法兼容。
AI.conclusion: GTN-R通过利用真实值邻域作为指导信号，有效解决了TSFM在RL后训练中出现的次优坍缩问题，为TSFM的后训练提供了一种灵活且有效的正则化手段。

title: SurgLAT: Surgical Latent Attention Tracking for Depth-Aware Robotic Laparoscope Control
summary: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control requires continuous understanding of the surgeon's operative intent in dynamic surgical scenes, where the target operative region is not a stable physical object but a latent and temporally evolving attention state. In this work, we present Surgical Latent Attention Tracking (SurgLAT), a causal online framework for latent surgical attention modeling and autonomous laparoscopic view control. SurgLAT uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a state-conditioned spatial token mixer to extract operative evidence under a memory-guided spatial prior, while a selective causal latent memory module jointly models short-term motion continuity and long-horizon surgical intent evolution through dynamic retrieval of current, recent, and historical latent states. The learned latent surgical attention state is decoded into a probabilistic attention heatmap and operative region for downstream endoscope guidance. Beyond perception, we further introduce a robotic deployment framework with explicit laparoscopic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) constrained control based on virtual-axis formulation, together with redundancy-aware null-space initialization for stable and smooth manipulator motion. We validate the full system on real laparoscopic surgical videos and a physical robotic laparoscope platform. Experimental results demonstrate robust online operative-region tracking and stable autonomous endoscopy adjustment under occlusion, rapid motion, and target transitions, highlighting the effectiveness of latent surgical intent modeling for surgical autonomy.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgLAT，一种用于自主腹腔镜相机控制的因果在线框架，通过冻结DINOv3编码器和状态条件空间token混合器提取手术证据，并结合选择性因果潜在记忆模块建模短期运动连续性和长期手术意图演化，最终将学习的潜在手术注意力状态解码为概率注意力热图和手术区域以指导内窥镜控制。系统还包含基于虚拟轴公式的RCM约束控制和冗余感知零空间初始化的机器人部署框架，在真实手术视频和物理机器人平台上验证了遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自主腹腔镜相机控制需要持续理解外科医生的手术意图，而目标手术区域并非稳定的物理对象，而是一种潜在且随时间内隐演化的注意力状态。现有方法难以应对动态手术场景中的遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换，亟需一种能联合建模短期与长期手术意图演化的在线框架。
AI.method: SurgLAT采用冻结的DINOv3编码器提取视觉特征，通过状态条件空间token混合器在记忆引导的空间先验下提取手术证据；选择性因果潜在记忆模块通过动态检索当前、近期和历史潜在状态，联合建模短期运动连续性与长期手术意图演化；学习到的潜在注意力状态被解码为概率注意力热图和手术区域。机器人端采用基于虚拟轴公式的RCM约束控制，并结合冗余感知零空间初始化实现平滑稳定的机械臂运动。
AI.result: 在真实腹腔镜手术视频和物理机器人腹腔镜平台上验证了全系统性能，实验结果表明该方法在遮挡、快速运动和靶区切换等挑战性场景下均能实现鲁棒的在线手术区域跟踪和稳定的自主内窥镜调整。
AI.conclusion: 潜在手术意图建模对于手术自主性具有显著有效性，SurgLAT通过将手术注意力视为内隐演化的潜在状态进行因果在线建模，为自主腹腔镜相机控制提供了新的范式，并展示了从感知到物理机器人部署的完整解决方案。

title: Do All LLMs Know When They're Being Harmful? A Reproducibility Study of Latent-Space Safety Probes Across Model Families
summary: Khatri et al. (2026) [DOI: 10.1109/DSN-W70714.2026.00027] show that lightweight MLP probes on final-layer activations of a single 8B model (LLaMA-3.1-8B) detect harmful prompts at F1 competitive with guard models 1000x larger, using one probe per benchmark. We reproduce this pipeline end-to-end and extend it along two axes the original study leaves open. First, we test whether the result generalizes across other model architecture and scale by training identical probes on activations from models like Gemma-4-E4B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, and Qwen2-7B, using the three benchmarks (WildJailbreak, BeaverTails, AEGIS 2.0). Second, we test how much of the reported performance is affected by non-determinism during inference by repeating extraction under five random seeds and measuring the variance of F1 scores. Our results reproduce the original LLaMA model benchmarks within 0.37 percentage points of the original F1 scores (and within 0.2 points on BeaverTails). We find that the original MLP probe architecture extends to other model families with F1 scores within a point of the values reported for LLaMA-3.1-8B. Our experiments varying seed values reveal an interesting observation: final token latent vectors remained the same for all tested architectures irrespective of the seed values used.

AI.tldr: 本文复现了Khatri等人提出的轻量级MLP探针方法——在8B模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B）的最终层激活上训练探测头来检测有害提示，并将其扩展到其他模型架构（Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3、Qwen2-7B）进行验证。结果显示该架构在不同模型族上均能保持竞争力，且最终token的潜在向量在不同随机种子下保持一致。
AI.motivation: 原研究（Khatri et al. 2026）展示了MLP探针在单个8B模型上能以与千倍规模守卫模型竞争的性能检测有害提示，但存在两个未探索的问题：一是该结果是否能在其他模型架构和规模上泛化；二是推理过程中的非确定性对报告性能有多大影响。本文旨在填补这两个空白。
AI.method: 本研究采用端到端复现方法：首先在LLaMA-3.1-8B上复现原始MLP探针流程；然后将其扩展到Gemma-4-E4B、Mistral-7B-v0.3和Qwen2-7B等不同架构模型，使用WildJailbreak、BeaverTails和AEGIS 2.0三个基准数据集；最后通过五种随机种子重复提取过程来测量F1分数的方差，以评估非确定性对结果的影响。
AI.result: 复现结果表明：原始LLaMA模型的F1分数误差在0.37个百分点以内（BeaverTails上误差在0.2分以内）；MLP探针架构成功扩展到其他模型族，F1分数与LLaMA-3.1-8B报告值相差不超过1分；值得注意的发现是，所有测试架构的最终token潜在向量在不同随机种子下完全一致，与种子值无关。
AI.conclusion: MLP探针方法具有跨模型架构和规模的泛化能力，轻量级探测头在多种8B级模型上均能保持与守卫模型竞争的有害提示检测性能。此外，最终token潜在向量的种子无关性表明该层面存在确定的表征结构，但这也暗示原始研究中报告的F1方差可能主要来源于训练过程中的随机性而非推理阶段。

title: GRACE: LLM-Grounded Semantic Metric Spaces for Scalable Mixed-Data Clustering
summary: Clustering mixed tabular data requires a unified metric space to bridge the inherent heterogeneity between continuous numerical measurements and discrete categorical symbols. Traditionally, algorithms rely entirely on dataset-internal statistics to estimate categorical relationships, which confines the learned metric to empirical co-occurrences and ignores conceptually obvious yet statistically unobserved affinities. Although LLMs offer external world knowledge, applying their text-centric reasoning to highly abstract tabular concepts presents significant challenges. Bridging this modality gap to construct a semantically complete metric typically requires embedding LLMs into iterative metric learning loops to dynamically optimize cross-modality representations. This incurs intractable computational overhead, forcing a compromise between semantic enrichment and scalability. Therefore, we propose GRACE, an LLM-grounded framework for scalable mixed-data clustering. GRACE shifts semantic acquisition to the attribute-value level via a multi-perspective LLM querying strategy, mapping heterogeneous values into knowledge-informed descriptions. Crucially, this one-shot grounding extracts general-purpose semantic representations that embed heterogeneous attributes into a unified space, decoupling expensive LLM invocation from iterative optimization. Furthermore, GRACE cross-validates these external semantics against dataset-internal statistical evidence to ensure alignment with the dataset-specific cluster structure. Ultimately, GRACE matches the scalability of conventional statistics-driven baselines while achieving superior clustering accuracy and conceptual interpretability over 11 competing methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/develop-yang/GRACE-GRACE-A

AI.tldr: GRACE是一个基于LLM的混合表格数据聚类框架，通过一次性的属性值级语义查询将异构数据映射到统一语义空间，解耦了昂贵的LLM调用与迭代优化，在保持传统方法可扩展性的同时实现了更优的聚类精度和概念可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统的混合数据聚类仅依赖数据集内部统计信息来估计类别关系，忽略了概念上明显但统计上未观察到的语义关联；而直接使用LLM进行跨模态推理面临巨大的计算开销，导致语义增强与可扩展性难以兼得。
AI.method: GRACE采用多视角LLM查询策略，在属性-值粒度提取知识驱动的描述，并通过一次性（one-shot）方式将异构属性嵌入统一语义空间，从而将LLM调用从迭代优化中解耦；同时通过跨验证机制将外部语义与数据集内部统计证据对齐，确保与数据集特定的簇结构一致。
AI.result: GRACE在11个竞争方法中取得了最优的聚类精度和概念可解释性，同时匹配甚至超越了传统基于统计方法的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GRACE证明通过将语义获取转移到属性值粒度并采用一次性LLM查询，可以在不牺牲可扩展性的前提下显著增强混合数据聚类的语义质量和精度，为基于LLM的聚类方法提供了一种高效可行范式。

title: CLAM: Causal Spatial Disaggregation to Infer Local Effects From Coarse Data
summary: Learning fine-grained spatial patterns from coarse-resolution data is challenging, especially in causal settings where high-resolution effects must be inferred from aggregated interventions and outcomes. We introduce CLAM, a method for estimating localized causal effects from coarse observations by exploiting high-resolution contextual covariates that modulate these effects. By jointly learning the causal mechanism and a disaggregation mapping, CLAM captures interactions that are missed when addressing these problems independently. The method supports localized effect estimation, counterfactual reasoning, and principled outcome disaggregation, and reliably captures spatially varying causal effects across diverse settings. This is particularly relevant for applications such as public health and environmental policy, where decisions are made at broad scales despite substantial local heterogeneity. Code is available at https://github.com/gerritgr/clam

AI.tldr: 提出CLAM方法，从粗粒度观测数据中学习细粒度局部因果效应，通过联合学习因果机制与分解映射，利用高分辨率上下文协变量来捕捉空间异质性因果效应。
AI.motivation: 从粗分辨率数据中学习细粒度空间模式具有挑战性，尤其是在因果场景中，需要从聚合的干预和结果推断高分辨率效应，而现有方法独立处理因果机制学习和数据分解，会遗漏交互信息。
AI.method: CLAM通过联合学习因果机制和分解映射（disaggregation mapping），利用调节因果效应的高分辨率上下文协变量，同时支持局部效应估计、反事实推理和原则化结果分解。
AI.result: 该方法在多样化的设置中可靠地捕捉了空间变化的因果效应，尤其适用于公共卫生和环境政策等领域。
AI.conclusion: CLAM解决了从粗观测数据推断局部因果效应的难题，为粗粒度决策环境下考虑局部异质性提供了有效工具。

title: Reason Wide, Not Deep: Amortizing the Reasoning Premium into Distilled Skills
summary: Reasoning modes of language models outperform their non-reasoning counterparts on multi-step agentic tasks, but pay a 3-6x premium in output tokens on every episode -- much of it spent re-deriving procedures that are shared across episodes of the same domain. We show this recurring cost can be amortized: a coding agent analyses a small corpus of existing trajectories from a training split and compiles a compact natural-language skill that is injected into the non-reasoning model's system prompt. Across four agentic benchmarks (ALFWorld, tau$^2$-bench telecom and retail, and SpreadsheetBench-Verified), skills recover 55%-100%+ of the reasoning gap for GPT-5.4-mini on held-out tasks -- exceeding the reasoning mode outright on two of four -- while emitting 2.7-6x fewer output tokens and zero reasoning tokens. Notably, reasoning traces are not a prerequisite: skills distilled from non-reasoning trajectories alone remain competitive with skills distilled from paired reasoning/non-reasoning corpora, with domain-dependent differences between the two sources. We interpret these results through a search lens: test-time reasoning is deep search inside a single episode, re-paid at every deployment, while corpus distillation is wide search across episodes, paid once. The two recover overlapping procedural knowledge, and width over cheap trajectories is often the better buy -- with the residual gap on some domains (telecom, SpreadsheetBench) delineating where genuinely per-instance deep search remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过语料蒸馏（corpus distillation）的方式，让编码代理从既有轨迹中提取紧凑的自然语言技能并注入非推理模型的系统提示中，从而在不牺牲任务性能的前提下大幅降低多步智能体任务的推理代币开销。在四个基准上，技能蒸馏恢复了推理模式55%-100%+的性能差距，同时减少2.7-6倍输出代币和零推理代币。
AI.motivation: 推理模式的语言模型在多步智能体任务上表现优于非推理模式，但每次轨迹都要支付3-6倍的输出代币开销，其中大量代币浪费在跨episode重复推导的共享流程上。这种重复开销亟需被摊销。
AI.method: 编码代理分析训练分割中的一小批既有轨迹，编译出紧凑的自然语言技能（skill），并将其注入非推理模型的系统提示中。该方法的关键在于技能蒸馏不要求推理轨迹作为前提，可以从纯非推理轨迹中蒸馏。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、tau²-bench（telecom和retail）及SpreadsheetBench-Verified四个基准上，技能在保留任务上恢复了GPT-5.4-mini推理模式差距的55%-100%+，在四个基准中的两个上甚至超过了推理模式，同时输出代币减少2.7-6倍且零推理代币。从非推理轨迹蒸馏的技能与配对推理/非推理语料蒸馏的技能表现相当，但存在域相关差异。
AI.conclusion: 测试时推理是单episode内的深度搜索，每次部署都要重新付费；而语料蒸馏是跨episode的广度搜索，只支付一次。两者恢复的是重叠的程序性知识，在廉价轨迹上进行广度搜索通常是更优选择，但在部分域（如telecom、SpreadsheetBench）残留的差距表明这些域仍需要真正的逐实例深度搜索。

title: Adaptive Symmetry Discovery for Dynamical System Identification
summary: Dynamical systems model trajectory data generated by fixed underlying dynamics, with applications ranging from biology to physics. Especially in scientific settings, dynamical systems are not generic but often exhibit symmetries imposed by physical laws, formalized through equivariance with respect to group actions. The identification problem concerns recovering the parameters of a system from observed trajectories. In this work, we study adaptive symmetry discovery for dynamical system identification and address how a system can be identified from a single trajectory when it is equivariant with respect to an unknown symmetry group. To this end, we first show that for known symmetries, the system can be identified from a significantly shorter single trajectory than in the generic setting, and we precisely characterize this improvement. We then consider the automatic symmetry discovery setting, proposing a method to learn the symmetry group directly from a single trajectory and incorporate it into the identification procedure, achieving the same optimal trajectory length as in the known-symmetry case. Our analysis relies on tools from group representation theory and the expander properties of Cayley graphs, and may be of independent interest for the study of symmetries in dynamical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究动力学系统识别中的自适应对称性发现问题，证明当系统关于已知对称群等变时，可以从显著更短的单条轨迹中识别系统，并精确刻画了这一改进；进一步提出从单条轨迹自动学习对称群并将其纳入识别过程的方法，达到与已知对称性情形相同的最优轨迹长度。
AI.motivation: 科学场景中的动力学系统通常具有由物理定律强加的对称性（群作用的等变性），但现实中对称群往往是未知的。如何在未知对称性的条件下，仅凭单条轨迹高效识别系统参数是一个尚未解决的关键问题。已有工作未考虑对称性对轨迹长度需求的影响，也缺乏自动发现对称性的系统性方法。
AI.method: 首先通过群表示论和Cayley图的扩展子（expander）性质，理论分析了已知对称性下系统可识别所需的最短单条轨迹长度，并给出精确刻画；随后提出一种自动对称性发现方法，直接从单条轨迹中学习未知的对称群，并将其纳入参数识别流程。
AI.result: 证明对称性已知时，所需单条轨迹长度显著短于一般情形，并精确刻画了这一改进幅度；所提出的自动对称性发现方法在轨迹长度需求上达到了与已知对称性情形相同的理论最优值。
AI.conclusion: 对称性可以大幅降低动力学系统识别所需的轨迹长度，且这种优势可以通过自动学习对称群来实现，无需事先知道对称性的具体形式。文中所用的群表示论与Cayley图工具对动力学系统中的对称性研究具有独立参考价值。

title: TelemetrySuffBench: Is Agent Telemetry Sufficient for Failure-Origin Diagnosis?
summary: Agent systems increasingly expose execution traces, yet telemetry that reveals a failure may still be inadequate for identifying where that failure originated. We introduce TelemetrySuffBench, a controlled benchmark that separates failure detection, fault-origin localization, and safe abstention under insufficient evidence. The benchmark constructs canonical multi-component traces with delayed-binding faults and renders them as paired coarse views, seven-factor telemetry masks, and exact-equal ambiguous origin pairs. We evaluate five frontier language models using unified protocols, explicit candidate sets, invalid-output accounting, subgroup analyses, and a frozen blind holdout. With full telemetry, origin-step Top-1 accuracy ranges from 33.8% to 97.2% across models. Metadata, OpenTelemetry-compatible, and OpenInference-compatible views retain 99.5% to 100% detection F1 while limiting origin-step accuracy to at most 0.5%, exposing a robust detection-localization gap. Factor ablations further show that removing decision content reduces origin-step accuracy to zero for every model, while provenance removal also causes large model-dependent losses. On rich ambiguous inputs that require abstention, evidence gating reduces unsupported unique-origin answers by 12.5 to 48.6 percentage points for three models, whereas two models still answer every case, revealing strong model dependence in safe abstention. Results on the frozen holdout reproduce the central pattern within the same generator family. These findings show that terminal status can support detection, whereas reliable causal attribution requires explicit decision-to-provenance links and abstention safeguards that remain effective across models. The dataset and benchmark implementation are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TelemetrySuffBench-E635/README.md.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TelemetrySuffBench基准，用于分离故障检测、故障源定位和证据不足时的安全弃权。评估五个前沿语言模型后发现：全遥测下定位准确率在33.8%到97.2%之间，而元数据/OpenTelemetry/OpenInference视图虽然检测F1接近100%，但定位准确率最多仅0.5%，暴露了检测-定位的显著差距；决策内容缺失会使定位准确率降为零，证据门控可减少部分模型的无依据回答但存在强模型依赖性。
AI.motivation: Agent系统暴露的执行轨迹（遥测）虽然能揭示故障，但往往不足以定位故障根源。现有基准缺乏将故障检测、故障源定位和在证据不足时安全弃权这三项能力分开评估的受控条件，导致无法准确衡量模型在因果归因上的真实能力及其局限。
AI.method: 构建TelemetrySuffBench受控基准：(1) 构造具有延迟绑定故障的规范多组件轨迹；(2) 渲染为配对粗粒度视图、七因子遥测掩码和精确等价的模糊来源对；(3) 使用统一协议、显式候选集、无效输出会计、子组分析和冻结盲保留集评估五个前沿语言模型。
AI.result: 全遥测下，起源步Top-1准确率在33.8%至97.2%之间跨模型变化。元数据、OpenTelemetry兼容和OpenInference兼容视图保持99.5%-100%检测F1的同时将起源步准确率限制在最多0.5%。移除决策内容使所有模型的起源步准确率降为零，移除来源信息也导致模型依赖性的大幅损失。证据门控对三个模型减少了12.5-48.6个百分点的不支持唯一来源回答，但两个模型仍回答所有案例。冻结保留集复现了相同生成器族内的核心模式。
AI.conclusion: 终端状态足以支撑故障检测，但可靠的因果归因需要显式的决策-来源链接和跨模型保持有效的弃权保障机制。这揭示了当前语言模型在Agent系统因果归因方面的系统性短板。

title: Support Selection Beyond Smooth DAG Exactness: Completion Geometry,Score Margins, and Selective Certificates
summary: Smooth acyclicity constraints answer whether a weighted support is a DAG, whereas structure learning asks which support change should be made. Existing analyses establish degeneracy for particular constraint formulas but do not isolate what follows from smooth exactness itself. At a DAG boundary, we show that minimal cycle completions generate a squarefree monomial ideal containing every restricted Taylor jet of an exact representation. If the smallest completion has $q$ edges, the first possible response has order $q$ for a vector residual and $2q$ for a nonnegative scalar. Exponentially many constant-scale cyclic manifolds exhibit the same lack of ranking away from the boundary for NOTEARS and DAGMA. We derive the exact selection time for an isolated cycle. When $Ψ'(h)\asymp h^ν$, the feasibility-only time is $T_0(\varepsilon)=Θ(\varepsilon^{-(2ν+1)})$; a score margin changes the leading dynamics at scale $T_0^{-1}$ for $ν>0$, while $ν=0$ has a logarithmic boundary layer requiring $γT_0\log(1/\varepsilon)\to0$. Experiments verify this law, and a truth-free separation statistic predicts selection time on 320 official NOTEARS/DAGMA trajectories (Spearman $-0.52$ and $-0.66$, permutation $p<10^{-4}$). For finite samples, a parent-set confidence family and forced-opposite queries certify skeleton and unshielded-collider labels shared by every population optimum of a frozen score. Across 320 runs, every regret bound covers an independent oracle-score audit. None of 3,042 certified skeleton or 2,396 collider labels disagrees with the oracle-score optimum, although 4.4% and 5.5%, respectively, disagree with the generating graph. These results separate DAG feasibility, score-based support selection, and causal identification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了平滑无环性约束（如NOTEARS和DAGMA）在DAG边界附近的退化行为。作者证明最小环补集生成方单项式理想，包含精确表示的所有受限Taylor射流；在小补集有q条边时，向量残差的首次响应阶数为q，非负标量为2q。在孤立环上推导出精确选择时间：当Ψ'(h)≍h^ν时，可行性时间T0(ε)=Θ(ε^{-(2ν+1)})，得分边际在ν>0时改变主导动力学。320条官方轨迹上的无真值分离统计量与选择时间显著相关（Spearman -0.52/-0.66），有限样本下父集置信族和强制相反查询可认证骨架与无遮蔽碰撞标签。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅针对特定约束公式分析退化性，未能隔离平滑精确性本身带来的后果。本文旨在从平滑精确性出发，揭示DAG可行性、基于得分的支撑选择与因果识别之间的矛盾关系。
AI.method: 理论分析采用代数几何方法，证明最小环补集产生方单项式理想并包含受限Taylor射流；动力学分析通过τ量化选择时间；实验使用320条NOTEARS/DAGMA官方轨迹及无真值分离统计检验；有限样本采用父集置信族和强制相反查询进行认证。
AI.result: 在DAG边界，最小补集为q条边时首次响应阶数为q（向量残差）和2q（非负标量）；指数多个常尺度环形流形对NOTEARS和DAGMA均缺乏排序。孤立环精确选择时间为T0(ε)=Θ(ε^{-(2ν+1)})，得分边际在ν>0时以T0^{-1}尺度改变主导动力学，ν=0时需γT0 log(1/ε)→0。320条轨迹上无真值分离统计预测时间（Spearman -0.52/-0.66，p<10^{-4}）。认证结果：3042个骨架和2396个遮蔽碰撞标签均与oracle得分最优一致，但4.4%/5.5%与真实生成图不一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究分离了DAG可行性、基于得分的支撑选择与因果识别三个层面：平滑精确性导致DAG边界附近环形流形缺乏排序，选择时间遵循幂律（ν>0）或对数边界层（ν=0）规律；认证标签虽然可靠于oracle得分，但并非都与生成图一致，说明因果识别与得分优化目标存在系统性偏差。

title: GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning
summary: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating planning hallucinations. Furthermore, within the GRPO framework, the task graph offers delicate reward design to train the LLM planner, enhancing long-horizon planning capabilities and improving generalization. Finally, an event-driven replanning module, powered by the scene graph, enables closed-loop environment awareness and error correction. GraphThink achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ALFRED benchmark. In particular, our high-level planner surpasses leading API-based LLMs on both the validation set and held-out long-horizon tasks, underscoring its robust zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. Additional evaluations further demonstrate strong out-of-distribution generalization to novel tasks and environments.

AI.tldr: GraphThink是一个将任务图（task graph）与场景图（scene graph）集成到LLM规划器中的框架，通过结构化知识引导、GRPO奖励设计以及事件驱动的重规划模块，解决了具身智能体中LLM规划器的物理幻觉、长程任务泛化差和环境感知不足等问题，在ALFRED基准上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的具身智能体规划器存在三大核心痛点：物理幻觉（physical hallucinations）、对长视界任务（long-horizon tasks）的泛化能力差、以及缺乏环境感知（environmental awareness）。作者旨在通过引入结构化知识表示来解决这些问题，提升规划器的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.method: GraphThink包含三个关键模块：(1) 任务图（task graph）：提供结构化知识，通过上下文提示（contextual prompting）和迭代精炼（iterative refinement）引导LLM思考，缓解规划幻觉；(2) 在GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）框架下，利用任务图设计精细的奖励函数来训练LLM规划器，增强长程规划能力并提升泛化；(3) 事件驱动重规划模块（event-driven replanning module）：基于场景图（scene graph）维护环境记忆，实现闭环环境感知与错误纠正。
AI.result: GraphThink在ALFRED基准上取得了SOTA性能，其高层规划器在验证集和held-out长程任务上均超越了领先的API-based LLM，展现了强大的零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）能力；额外的评估还表明其在新任务和新环境上具有出色的分布外（out-of-distribution）泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GraphThink通过任务图与场景图的协同集成，系统性地解决了LLM具身规划中幻觉、长程泛化与环境感知的短板，验证了结构化知识增强LLM规划器在具身智能领域的有效性与可扩展性。

title: TSDS-Toolbox: A Toolbox for Measuring Time-Series Dataset Similarity
summary: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has significantly accelerated research in time-series analysis, particularly in forecasting, classification, and generation tasks. Recent models, especially foundation models, benefit from time-series dataset similarity due to its significant role in source dataset selection for fine-tuning. However, many existing implementations for benchmarking time-series dataset similarity methods are fragmented and difficult to extend. To address this, we present a unified framework, the Time-Series Dataset Similarity Toolbox (TSDS-Toolbox). Our work enables (1) systematic and reproducible comparisons of time-series dataset similarity methods; (2) flexible extensibility for users to add customized datasets, similarity methods, and downstream time-series tasks; and (3) consistent evaluation of both dataset-level and series-level similarity methods through integrated time-series dataset reducers. The effectiveness of TSDS-Toolbox is validated through comprehensive experiments under diverse experimental settings. Our toolbox is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TSDS-Toolbox，一个用于统一基准测试时间序列数据集相似性方法的开源工具箱，支持系统化、可复现的比较，灵活扩展自定义数据集/方法/下游任务，并通过集成的数据集缩减器实现数据级和序列级相似性方法的一致评估。
AI.motivation: 时间序列数据集相似性在基础模型微调时选择源数据集方面至关重要，但现有的时间序列数据集相似性方法基准测试实现碎片化且难以扩展，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: TSDS-Toolbox提供了一个统一框架，具备三大能力：(1)系统化且可复现的时间序列数据集相似性方法比较；(2)灵活的扩展性，允许用户添加自定义数据集、相似性方法和下游时间序列任务；(3)通过集成的数据集缩减器，对数据集级和序列级相似性方法进行一致的评估。
AI.result: 通过多种实验设置下的综合实验验证了TSDS-Toolbox的有效性，且该工具箱已公开可用。
AI.conclusion: TSDS-Toolbox填补了时间序列数据集相似性基准测试领域缺乏统一工具的空缺，为研究者提供了标准化、可扩展且可复现的评估平台，有助于推动时间序列基础模型的发展和源数据集选择的深入研究。

title: When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits
summary: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. Frozen calibration efficacy predicts held-out power curves, with R^2 = 0.83-0.98 across six exact-permutation channels, but the efficacy-only Gaussian budget is miscalibrated at the small sample sizes it prescribes, failing in 9/9 gate-passing channels even though efficacy itself transports. The failure is in the inversion, not the calibration. A predeclared two-stage planner that simulates the deployed test repairs the budgets, is uniformly conservative, and abstains when its probe does not transport. The certificate is valid but vacuous at audit scale, and a five-seed paired injection study recovers the mechanism ordering verbatim > paraphrase > surface, in which the apparent answer-only signal is explained by baseline drift. We report the audit contract and its failures together: a non-rejection is interpretable only alongside the efficacy, budget, and validity gates that produced it.

AI.tldr: 本文从形式化角度区分了行为污染检测中"无证据"的两种含义——基准干净或检测功效不足。通过匹配的干净/已见对照，可检测性由 alpha * rho * sqrt(m) 决定，提出样本分割证书和两阶段规划器来验证和修复检测预算。
AI.motivation: 行为污染检测器返回"无证据"结果时，无法区分是因为基准本身干净还是审计功效不足。现有方法缺乏对检测边界、功效预算和证书有效性的严格理论刻画，导致不可拒绝（非拒绝）结果难以被正确解读。
AI.method: 1) 将检测问题建模为稀疏混合 Q_alpha = (1-alpha)P_0 + alpha P_1，用二阶矩论证推导可检测性由 alpha * rho * sqrt(m) 控制，其中 rho^2 = chi^2(P_1||P_0) 为行为可分离性度量；2) 提出标量检测器的功效（efficacy）上界 ef <= rho，可预先从对照数据估计；3) 设计样本分割证书在不假设方向性的情况下、分布无关地给出 alpha 的下界；4) 提出两阶段规划器，通过模拟部署测试来修复预算，在探针不迁移时弃权。
AI.result: 冻结校准功效能预测留出功效曲线（R^2 = 0.83-0.98，覆盖六个精确置换通道），但仅靠功效的高斯预算在小样本下校准失灵，在9/9个通过门控的通道中失败——问题出在反转而非校准。两阶段规划器修复了预算、具有一致保守性，在探针不迁移时弃权。证书在审计规模下有效但空洞。五种子配对注入实验恢复了机制排序：逐字 > 释义 > 表面，其中表面（仅答案）信号被基线漂移解释。
AI.conclusion: 应将审计合同及其失败一并报告：非拒绝结果只有在功效、预算和有效性门控共同作用下才可解释。本文同时报告了理论工具的成功与失败边界，强调审计结果解读需要伴随元信息（efficacy、budget、validity gates）而非孤立地视为"干净"证据。

title: Accurate Ensembles, Fragile Narratives: Multi-Scale Stacking and a Fidelity Audit of LLM-Generated Explanations for Credit Risk
summary: Credit scoring increasingly relies on models whose decision logic cannot be read off their parameters, in tension with supervisory expectations that adverse decisions be explainable.
