A common proposal closes that gap with a language model: compute feature attributions, hand them to an LLM, and let it write the rationale. We build such a system end to end and test whether the second half of the promise holds. The predictive component is a multi-scale stacking ensemble fusing four differently regularised gradient-boosting learners with a residual network through a neural meta-learner trained on out-of-fold predictions. On a public 32,581-application credit dataset it reaches test ROC-AUC 0.9539 (95% CI [0.9462, 0.9616]) and PR-AUC 0.9137, beating the best single model by Delta-AUC = 0.0143 (p = 0.016 under a conservative independence assumption). Our central finding is asymmetric. The ranking gain is real but operationally small: at the F1-optimal threshold the ensemble avoids only six additional missed defaults out of 1,422 against a tuned random forest, cutting cost-weighted loss by under 2%. The narrative layer fails in a way prompt engineering alone does not fix. In an audited case the model named three factors as risk-increasing that the supplied attributions scored as risk-reducing, omitted the dominant driver, and introduced a feature never given to it. We trace this to properties we measure rather than assume: SHAP and LIME agree on which features matter (overlap@10 = 0.80) but not on their order (tau = 0.43, p = 0.18), and the attribution sign for the model's most sensitive input is near a coin flip across applicants (modal-sign share 0.53). Calibration (ECS = 0.117) and perturbation stability (DPD = 0.078) both fall short of our own thresholds. Constrained prompting is necessary but not sufficient: grounding must be verified after generation, not assumed.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个端到端的信用评分系统（多尺度堆叠集成模型+LLM生成解释），发现集成模型在预测性能上有真实但微小的提升，而LLM生成的决策解释存在严重失真：模型将降低风险的因子称为风险增加因子、遗漏主导因子、引入未提供的特征。归因方法本身存在顺序不一致和符号不稳定问题，约束提示不足以确保解释的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 信用评分越来越多地依赖参数不可读的复杂模型，与监管对"不利决策需可解释"的要求相冲突。常见的解决方案是让LLM根据特征归因自动撰写解释，但该方案的第二半（LLM文本生成）是否真的可靠尚未被严格检验。
AI.method: 构建端到端系统：预测部分为多尺度堆叠集成（四个不同正则化的梯度提升模型+残差网络，通过神经元学习器在折外预测上融合）；解释部分将SHAP/LIME归因交给LLM生成自然语言解释。在公开的32,581条信贷申请数据集上评估预测性能、解释准确性（对齐性验证）、校准（ECS）和扰动稳定性（DPD）。
AI.result: 集成模型达到test ROC-AUC 0.9539，PR-AUC 0.9137，击败最佳单模型（ΔAUC=0.0143, p=0.016），但在F1最优阈值下仅额外避免6个漏报违约（共1,422个），成本加权损失降低不足2%。解释层失效：审计案例中模型将3个归因标记为风险降低的特征说成风险增加，遗漏主导驱动因素，并引入从未提供的特征。SHAP与LIME在特征重要性上有重叠（overlap@10=0.80）但排序相关性弱（τ=0.43），最敏感输入的归因符号近似抛硬币（modal-sign share=0.53）。校准（ECS=0.117）和扰动稳定性（DPD=0.078）均未达阈值。
AI.conclusion: 预测性能的提升真实但操作意义有限（边际收益微小）；LLM生成的解释不可靠且提示工程无法修复。归因方法本身的多重不一致性是根本问题。约束提示是必要但非充分条件——生成后的grounding验证必须强制执行，而非假设LLM会忠实地基于所提供的归因进行叙述。

title: TongGuOCR: A Layout-Aware and Token-Augmented OCR Framework for Chinese Historical Documents
summary: Chinese historical documents preserve valuable cultural heritage, but many collections remain accessible only as scanned page images, preventing full-text retrieval, collation, and computational analysis. Optical character recognition (OCR) can bridge this gap, but accurate transcription remains challenging because historical documents often contain complex layouts, rare characters, and nontrivial reading orders. We propose TongGuOCR, a layout-aware and token-augmented OCR framework for Chinese historical documents. First, a Layout-Aware Preprocessing module constructs and refines locally coherent recognition blocks to preserve local context while reducing interference across regions. Second, a Token-Augmented Recognition module augments the transcription target at two complementary levels: character-level vocabulary expansion gives each rare glyph a direct one-token representation and shortens its decoding path, while line-to-line transition modeling injects discrete spatial displacement tokens that guide the decoder along complex reading paths without requiring precise coordinates. Experiments on two Chinese historical document OCR benchmarks show that TongGuOCR outperforms representative traditional task-specific OCR models, general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and OCR-oriented MLLMs. On the more challenging M5HisDoc benchmark, TongGuOCR achieves 93.76 AR and reduces NED from 10.43 to 6.15 and RO-ED from 7.53 to 3.49 relative to the best competing score for each metric. An online demo is available at https://jzzh2004.github.io/TongGuOCR.

AI.tldr: TongGuOCR是一个面向中文历史文献的布局感知与标记增强的OCR框架，通过Layout-Aware预处理模块构造局部连贯的识别块，并通过Token-Augmented识别模块在字符级（稀有字符词汇扩展）和行间级（离散空间位移标记）两个层面增强转录目标。在M5HisDoc基准上达到93.76 AR，并将NED从10.43降至6.15、RO-ED从7.53降至3.49，优于传统OCR模型和多种多模态大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 许多中文历史文献仅以扫描页面图像形式存在，无法进行全文检索、校勘和计算分析。虽然OCR可以弥补这一差距，但历史文献中复杂的版面布局、稀有字符和非平凡的阅读顺序使得准确转录仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: TongGuOCR由两个核心模块组成：(1) Layout-Aware Preprocessing模块，构造并细化局部连贯的识别块，以保留局部上下文同时减少区域间干扰；(2) Token-Augmented Recognition模块，在两层面对转录目标进行增强——字符级通过词汇扩展为每个稀有字形提供直接的one-token表示并缩短解码路径，行间级通过注入离散空间位移标记引导解码器沿着复杂阅读路径前进，无需精确坐标。
AI.result: 在两个中文历史文档OCR基准上，TongGuOCR优于传统任务专用OCR模型、通用多模态大语言模型和OCR定向多模态大语言模型。在更具挑战性的M5HisDoc基准上，TongGuOCR达到93.76 AR，NED从最优竞品的10.43降至6.15，RO-ED从7.53降至3.49。
AI.conclusion: 布局感知预处理结合双重token增强策略能有效解决中文历史文献OCR中的复杂版面、稀有字符和复杂阅读顺序问题，并已提供在线演示。

title: DoGMA: A Central-Dogma-Guided Foundation Model for Multi-Omics Alignment and Multi-Task Learning in Oncology
summary: Attention mechanisms have been widely utilized in modern deep learning, and many existing multi-omics models inherit their conventional use to allow unrestricted bidirectional interactions. However, the fundamental logic of life is directional. Existing designs often overlook the directionality suggested by the central dogma, potentially limiting transfer across heterogeneous cancers, downstream tasks, and incomplete modality settings.In this work, we present DoGMA, a central-dogma-guided foundation model for pan-cancer multi-omics analysis, arguing that robust transfer requires representations with domain-specific inductive bias. Concretely, we build it on a Transformer-MoE architecture where directed attention biases inter-omics communication toward central-dogma information flow. We further pretrain our model with masked hierarchical omics reconstruction to guide it toward learning central-dogma-consistent interactions. Across diverse downstream tasks, including cancer representation learning, survival prediction, and metastasis prediction, DoGMA consistently demonstrates strong predictive performance. Ablations and analyses further suggest that the performance gains arise from the synergy between central-dogma-guided directed attention and reconstruction-based pretraining, which together promote more biologically consistent cross-omics information exchange. Overall, DoGMA demonstrates that domain-specific inductive biases can improve the robustness and transferability of multi-omics foundation models, offering new insights into the design of attention mechanisms for multi-omics representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DoGMA，一个基于中心法则引导的泛癌多组学基础模型。它采用Transformer-MoE架构，通过有向注意力将组学间通信引导为中心法则方向的信息流，并利用掩码层次组学重构进行预训练。在癌症表征学习、生存预测和转移预测等下游任务中表现优异，证明领域特定归纳偏置能提升多组学基础模型的鲁棒性和可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习中广泛使用的注意力机制允许无限制的双向交互，但生命的基本逻辑是方向性的（中心法则）。已有的多组学模型忽略了中心法则所暗示的方向性，可能限制了模型在不同癌症、下游任务和不完整模态设置之间的迁移能力。
AI.method: 构建基于Transformer-MoE架构的DoGMA模型：(1) 采用有向注意力机制，将组间通信偏置为中心法则的信息流方向；(2) 通过掩码层次组学重构进行预训练，引导模型学习与中心法则一致的组学交互模式。
AI.result: 在癌症表征学习、生存预测和转移预测等多个下游任务中，DoGMA均展现出稳定的强预测性能。消融实验表明性能提升来源于中心法则引导的有向注意力与基于重构的预训练之间的协同作用，二者共同促进了更符合生物学的跨组学信息交换。
AI.conclusion: DoGMA证明了领域特定的归纳偏置能够提升多组学基础模型的鲁棒性和可迁移性，为多组学表征学习中的注意力机制设计提供了新的见解。

title: ZhuLong: Execution-Grounded LLM Agent for EDA Scripting with Offline API Self-Exploration
summary:
EDA scripting with tool-specific, often undocumented APIs remains a long-tail bottleneck that existing LLMs fail to address. This paper presents ZhuLong, an execution-grounded LLM coding agent for PyAether and SKILL that combines API retrieval, documentation inspection, and sandbox execution via unified MCP tools, augmented by an offline API self-exploration mechanism that infers undocumented API behaviors through counterfactual experimentation.
  We evaluate ZhuLong on EDA-Eval-PyAether, a benchmark of 158 real-world tasks with assertion-based execution, where the complete system achieves 78.5% Pass@1 in the commercial Empyrean Aether environment, substantially outperforming a pure LLM baseline (23.6%). Ablation studies identify sandbox execution as the dominant performance driver (41.2 pp drop when removed), with the self-exploration mechanism contributing an additional 3.2 pp accuracy gain and a 22.1% reduction in per-task tool calls. On 20 interactive tasks involving unsaved layouts and schematics, ZhuLong achieves 60.0% Pass@1 for PyAether and 50.0% for SKILL.

AI.tldr: ZhuLong是一个面向PyAether和SKILL的EAD脚本编码智能体，通过执行接地（execution-grounded）的方式结合API检索、文档检查、沙箱执行以及离线API自探索机制，在158个真实任务的基准测试中达到78.5%的Pass@1，远超纯LLM基线的23.6%。
AI.motivation: EDA脚本编写依赖工具特定的、往往缺乏文档的API，这是现有LLM无法解决的长期瓶颈（long-tail bottleneck）。现有LLM生成的EDA脚本不可靠，尤其是面对未文档化的API时表现很差。
AI.method: ZhuLong将API检索、文档检查与沙箱执行统一为MCP工具，构建执行接地的编码智能体；并设计了离线API自探索机制，通过反事实实验（counterfactual experimentation）推断未文档化API的行为。评估使用EDA-Eval-PyAether基准，包含158个基于断言执行的真实任务。
AI.result: 在商业华大九天（Empyrean Aether）环境中，完整系统达到78.5% Pass@1，远超纯LLM用户基线的23.6%。消融实验显示沙箱执行是主导性能因素（移除后下降41.2个百分点），自探索机制额外贡献3.2个百分点准确率提升以及22.1%的每任务工具调用减少。在20个交互式任务上，PyAether达到60.0% Pass@1，SKILL达到50.0% Pass@1。
AI.conclusion: 执行接地与沙箱执行是提升EDA编程智能体性能的核心要素，而离线API自探索机制能够在减少工具调用的同时进一步提升准确率，证明了该方法在商业EDA环境中的有效性。

title: A Hybrid Nested Harness for Decoupling Structure and Parameters in LLM-Driven Optimization
comment: Published as a conference paper at LM4Sci Workshop @ COLM 2026
summary: In evolutionary algorithms powered by language models, the LLM acts as a single operator that simultaneously updates structural components (like control flow) and continuous parameters. While LLMs can be good at the first, they are not efficient at the second, wasting tokens taking discrete jumps inside a trial and error loop. We resolve this by formalizing a hybrid nested search, in which an outer loop has the LLM propose a structural sketch, with numeric gaps, and an inner numerical optimizer tunes the sketch. Both the outer and inner solvers are pluggable: any text-based optimizer can be combined with a zero-order optimizer (CMA-ES), gradient-based routines, or MCMC samplers. We validate our framework across three scientific domains: (i) meta-optimizers on closed-form test functions, (ii) code-based policies for systems research and social dilemmas; and (iii) approximate Bayesian inference tasks. Across all three, the hybrid optimizer is superior to both vanilla LLM-driven search and pure numerical optimization baselines. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/hybrid-nested-search

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合嵌套搜索框架，将LLM驱动的结构搜索（外循环）与数值优化器驱动的参数调优（内循环）分离，解决了LLM单独作为算子进行参数微调时低效、浪费token的问题。框架在三个科学领域（元优化器、代码策略、近似贝叶斯推断）中均优于纯LLM搜索和纯数值优化基线。
AI.motivation: 在基于语言模型的进化算法中，LLM被当作单一算子同时更新结构组件（如控制流）和连续参数，导致LLM在参数搜索上低效——它以离散跳变的方式在试错循环中浪费token。作者希望通过将结构搜索与参数优化解耦来提升效率。
AI.method: 形式化一个混合嵌套搜索框架：外循环由LLM提出带有数值空缺的结构草图（structural sketch），内循环由数值优化器对草图进行参数调优。外循环与内循环求解器均可插拔——任何基于文本的优化器可与零阶优化器（CMA-ES）、梯度方法或MCMC采样器组合。
AI.result: 在三个科学领域（闭式测试函数上的元优化器、系统研究与社会困境的代码策略、近似贝叶斯推断任务）中，混合优化器均优于纯LLM驱动搜索和纯数值优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 混合嵌套搜索充分利用了LLM在结构探索上的优势与数值优化器在参数收敛上的优势，是一种普适且优于单一策略的框架，代码已开源。

title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are prone to hallucination, which undermines their reliability and poses challenges for safe deployment. Hallucinations in LRMs arise from two distinct failure sources: reasoning hallucination, where flawed inference steps propagate to an incorrect conclusion, and knowledge hallucination, where the model lacks the requisite factual knowledge to answer the query. To address reasoning hallucination, we propose REIN, an alignment framework that trains LRMs to produce a structured reasoning sequence, $\texttt{<think>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<reflection>} $$\rightarrow$ $\texttt{<answer>}$, enabling explicit self-reflection before committing to a final answer. To address knowledge hallucination, REIN introduces a reward mechanism that encourages explicit abstention (e.g., "I don't know") when none of the sampled reasoning chains yields a correct answer, allowing the model to refrain from unsupported predictions. Extensive evaluations on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that REIN consistently improves selective accuracy, reduces incorrect-but-self-endorsed responses, and maintains high coverage compared with competitive baselines. Notably, REIN achieves these gains within a single forward pass, without requiring process supervision, inference-time controllers, external search, or multi-round critiques. Experiments on multiple backbones show that REIN reduces the hallucination proxy by $58\sim72\%$ relative to the base models while maintaining $86\sim91\%$ average coverage, and improves selective accuracy on attempted questions by $6.6\sim14.2\%$.

AI.tldr: 提出REIN对齐框架，通过结构化推理序列（思考→反思→回答）和显式弃权奖励机制，在单次前向传播中同时缓解大型推理模型的推理幻觉和知识幻觉，无需过程监督或外部工具。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）存在幻觉问题，影响可靠性和安全部署。幻觉来源于两个关键失败源：推理幻觉（错误的推理步骤导致错误结论）和知识幻觉（模型缺乏回答所需的必备事实知识），现有方法难以同时有效应对这两类幻觉。
AI.method: REIN框架包含两个核心机制：(1) 对齐训练使LRM生成结构化推理序列<think>→<reflection>→<answer>，在给出最终答案前强制进行显式自我反思，以缓解推理幻觉；(2) 引入奖励机制，当采样的推理链均未产生正确答案时，鼓励模型显式弃权（如回答"I don't know"），使模型避免无依据的预测，以缓解知识幻觉。
AI.result: 在数学和常识推理基准上的广泛评估显示，REIN一致性地提升选择性准确率，减少错误但自我认可的回答，并保持了较高的覆盖率。在多个骨干模型上，REIN将幻觉代理指标相对基础模型降低58-72%，同时保持86-91%的平均覆盖率，并在已尝试问题上的选择性准确率提升6.6-14.2%。
AI.conclusion: REIN在单次前向传播中即可实现这些改进，无需过程监督、推理时控制器、外部搜索或多轮批评，展示了其在提升LRM可靠性方面的有效性和实用性。

title: Predicting blood clot growth from sparse post-onset measurements with latent neural differential equations
summary: Computational models of blood clotting improve understanding of thrombus formation, but their clinical application remains limited because many model inputs are difficult to measure and patient-specific data are often sparse. We present a computational framework based on latent neural differential equations that infers unknown model parameters from sparse measurements and forecasts thrombosis progression. We demonstrate the framework using data generated from a multiphysics blood-clotting model in which clot growth is governed by the coagulation cascade and diffusion. Four known biochemical inputs (fibrinogen and factors IX, VIII, and V), together with sparse early clot-size observations, are used to infer the tissue-factor parameter and predict subsequent clot growth. We compare seven probabilistic methods: stochastic neural ordinary differential equations (SNODE), stochastic neural functional differential equations (SNFDE), a latent neural-process baseline, a monotone probabilistic deep ensemble, empirical trajectory retrieval, PCA-ridge Gaussian posterior, and Gompertz-curve retrieval. SNODE achieved the best performance in inferring the unknown input and forecasting future clot-growth trajectories. SNFDE performed similarly and consistently outperformed the other non-differential models. Prediction accuracy improved as more observations became available, whereas longer forecasting horizons increased uncertainty and decreased accuracy. Latent neural differential equations thus effectively combine parameter inference and clot-growth forecasting from sparse measurements, providing a promising foundation for personalized thrombosis modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于潜变量神经微分方程的計算框架，从稀疏测量中推断凝血模型中未知参数并预测血栓进展。在七种概率方法对比中，随机神经常微分方程（SNODE）在推断未知输入和预测血凝块生长轨迹方面表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 血液凝固的计算模型有助于理解血栓形成，但临床应用中许多模型输入难以测量且患者数据稀疏，导致现有模型无法有效用于个性化医疗。
AI.method: 提出基于潜变量神经微分方程的計算框架，利用已知生化输入（纤维蛋白原、因子IX、VIII、V）及稀疏早期血凝块尺寸观测，推断组织因子参数并预测后续血凝块生长，并与七种概率方法（SNODE、SNFDE、特征神经过程基线、单调概率深度集成、经验轨迹检索、PCA-ridge高斯后验、Gompertz曲线检索）进行对比。
AI.result: SNODE在推断未知输入和预测未来血凝块生长轨迹方面表现最佳；SNFDE表现相近且一致优于其他非微分模型。预测精度随观测数据增多而提高，但更长的预测时域会增加不确定性并降低精度。
AI.conclusion: 潜变量神经微分方程有效结合了参数推断与血凝块生长预测，适用于稀疏测量场景，为个性化血栓建模提供了有前景的基础。

title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution
summary: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that vision is necessary but does not replace text extraction, that missing pages bound accuracy while distractors cost little, and that reasoners fail to integrate evidence across pages even when it is fully supplied. Prompting can shift reasoning behaviour substantially, improving some outcomes at the expense of others. We translate these findings into guidance for building such systems under a fixed compute budget.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多页视觉丰富文档理解（MP-VRDU）系统，将错误归因于表示、选择、推理三种失败模式，并通过干预实验逐一隔离研究，发现视觉不可或缺但不能替代文本提取、缺失页面限制准确性而干扰项影响小、推理器即使获得完整证据也难以跨页整合，最终将发现转化为固定计算预算下的系统构建指南。
AI.motivation: 多页视觉丰富文档理解需要处理稀疏且跨页分布的证据，且常超出模型上下文窗口；此前工作产生了相互竞争且大多未经检验的系统构建主张，缺乏系统性的失败模式归因分析。
AI.method: 在多页文档理解数据集上，将错误答案归因于表示（representation）、选择（selection）、推理（reasoning）三种失败模式，通过固定其他因素、干预单一因素的实验设计，逐一隔离每种失败模式的贡献；同时探索提示（prompting）对推理行为的影响。
AI.result: 视觉信息是必要的但不能替代文本提取；缺失页面成为准确性的瓶颈，而干扰项（distractors）造成的代价很小；推理器即使在证据完全提供的情况下仍无法跨页整合证据。提示可以显著改变推理行为，改善某些结果的同时牺牲其他方面的表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为在固定计算预算下构建MP-VRDU系统提供了可操作的指导，明确了各组件（表示、选择、推理）的相对重要性及其权衡关系。

title: Biologically Informed Representation Learning for Robust Cross-Center Generalization of MALDI-TOF Mass Spectrometry
summary: Machine learning models for MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry have shown considerable promise for clinical microbiology tasks such as microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction. However, their deployment across institutions remains limited by domain shift, as acquisition-specific variability often leads models to capture technical artifacts rather than transferable biological information. Existing representation learning approaches primarily address this problem through statistical domain alignment while largely overlooking the biological supervision naturally available in microbiology datasets. We introduce DALMA, a probabilistic representation learning framework that jointly models acquisition-specific variability and biological supervision to learn biologically structured latent representations. By combining domain-specific reconstruction with biologically guided representation learning, DALMA learns transferable representations that generalize across heterogeneous clinical centers without requiring institution-specific components at inference, enabling zero-shot deployment on previously unseen sites. We evaluate DALMA on a multi-center benchmark comprising seven datasets from three countries. DALMA consistently achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot microbial identification across two held-out clinical centers, while the learned representations also transfer effectively to antimicrobial resistance prediction. Furthermore, latent-space novelty estimation enables reliable selective prediction under previously unseen domain shifts. These results demonstrate that biologically informed representation learning provides an effective strategy for robust and transferable ML in clinical microbiology.

AI.tldr: DALMA是一个概率表示学习框架，通过联合建模采集特异性变异和生物学监督，学习生物学结构的潜在表示，实现跨临床中心的零样本微生物鉴定和抗菌素耐药性预测。
AI.motivation: MALDI-TOF质谱的机器学习模型在临床微生物学任务中很有前景，但跨机构的领域偏移导致模型捕获技术伪影而非可迁移的生物学信息。现有表示学习方法主要依赖统计域对齐，忽略了微生物学数据中天然可用的生物学监督信息。
AI.method: DALMA提出一个概率表示学习框架，联合建模采集特异性变异与生物学监督。通过领域特异性重建和生物学引导的表示学习相结合，学习跨异构临床中心可迁移的表示，推理时无需机构特异性组件。
AI.result: 在包含三个国家七个数据集的多中心基准上，DALMA在两个留出临床中心上持续达到最先进的零样本微生物鉴定性能，学习的表示还可有效迁移到抗菌素耐药性预测任务；潜空间新颖性估计支持在未见过领域偏移下的可靠选择性预测。
AI.conclusion: 生物学信息引导的表示学习为临床微生物学中稳健且可迁移的机器学习提供了有效策略，使模型能够在未见过的临床中心实现零样本部署。

title: Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution for Verification of Distributed Parallel AI Programs
summary: Distributed parallel Artificial Intelligence (AI) programs expose reliability gaps that conventional testing cannot close: parallel executions are non-deterministic, and AI workloads bring high-dimensional inputs and non-linear operations that defeat fuzzing and symbolic execution in isolation. We present Directed Neuro-Symbolic Stochastic Execution (DNSSE), a hybrid testing framework that couples schedule prediction guided by a Large Language Model (LLM) with symbolic constraint solving and coverage-guided stochastic mutation. We model distributed AI executions as non-deterministic transition systems, specify correctness in linear temporal logic, and prove soundness, bounded completeness, and probabilistic completeness of the hybrid solver, together with an expected-cost analysis of LLM-guided schedule exploration. A scalable implementation on PyTorch and Ray detects 2.9% more concurrency bugs than the strongest baseline and raises average branch coverage from 68.6 % to 91.6 % across five realistic distributed AI benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出DNSSE，一个混合测试框架，结合LLM引导的调度预测、符号约束求解和覆盖率引导的随机变异，用于分布式并行AI程序的可靠性测试。该框架在PyTorch和Ray上实现，比最强基线多检测2.9%的并发错误，并将平均分支覆盖率从68.6%提升至91.6%。
AI.motivation: 分布式并行AI程序存在传统测试无法覆盖的可靠性缺陷：并行执行具有非确定性，同时AI工作负载的高维输入和非线性运算使得单独使用模糊测试或符号执行均无法有效处理。
AI.method: 将分布式AI执行建模为非确定性转移系统，用线性时序逻辑（LTL）指定正确性；提出LLM引导的调度预测与符号约束求解、覆盖率引导的随机变异相结合的混合求解器；并从理论上证明了求解器的可靠性、有界完备性和概率完备性，同时给出了LLM引导调度探索的期望成本分析。
AI.result: 在PyTorch和Ray上的可扩展实现，在五个真实的分布式AI基准测试中，比最强基线多检测2.9%的并发错误，平均分支覆盖率从68.6%提升到91.6%。
AI.conclusion: DNSSE通过神经符号混合方法有效填补了分布式AI程序测试的空白，在并发缺陷检测和覆盖率提升方面均取得显著进展，理论性质保证了方法的可靠性与完备性。

title: Beyond Aggregate Calibration: Decomposing Income-Conditional Recall Disparities in Automated Credit Default Prediction
summary: Data-centric curation pipelines frequently rely on model confidence scores to flag and filter noisy or mislabeled training instances. Evaluating this filtering convention on a large-scale consumer lending sample (LendingClub, N = 1,344,936) uncovers an underlying demographic asymmetry: high-income defaulters are disproportionately classified as label noise relative to low-income defaulters (Cramer's V approximately 0.03-0.07). Re-examining this behavior through the lens of equal opportunity [Hardt et al., 2016] reveals a far more severe discrepancy: a 16.86 percentage point gap in true positive rate (recall) between high- and low-income borrowers who ultimately defaulted. Implementing a sequential feature-blinding methodology allows us to isolate the drivers of this disparity across three distinct mechanisms: (1) direct reliance on self-reported applicant income; (2) algorithmic absorption of upstream institutional bias encoded within origination interest rates; and (3) a residual disparity (3.55 percentage points in cross-validation; 2.56 percentage points on a held-out test partition, Z = -4.04, p < 0.0001) that remains even after purging both income and interest rates from the model. Out-of-sample signed SHAP valuations demonstrate that this residual gap is maintained by structural proxies, most notably loan amount and home ownership status. These empirical findings show that simply blinding an algorithm to sensitive attributes fails to ensure fairness when institutional pricing decisions and behavioral proxy variables collectively reconstruct the omitted signals. We outline the practical implications of these findings for auditing data-centric AI workflows within regulated financial institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于LendingClub大规模消费贷款样本（N=1,344,936），发现数据中心的清洗流程中基于模型置信度过滤标签噪声的做法存在人口统计学不对称性：高收入违约者比低收入违约者更易被误判为标签噪声。通过等机会（equal opportunity）视角分析，揭示了高/低收入违约者之间16.86个百分点的真正例率差距。通过顺序特征遮蔽方法，将差距来源分解为三个机制：对自报收入特征的直接依赖、对利率中编码的制度性偏见的算法吸收，以及即使在剔除收入和利率后仍存在的残余差距（交叉验证3.55个百分点，留出测试集2.56个百分点，Z=-4.04, p<0.0001）。残余差距通过结构性代理变量（贷款金额和房屋所有权状态）维持。研究结论表明，仅对算法屏蔽敏感属性并不足以确保公平性，因为制度性定价决策和行为代理变量会共同重构被省略的信号。
AI.motivation: 数据中心清洗流程经常依赖模型置信度分数来标记和过滤噪声或错误标注的训练实例，但这一做法潜在的公平性影响尚未被充分研究。作者希望揭示置信度过滤机制在人口统计学维度上可能引入的系统性偏差，并深入理解这种偏差的根源。
AI.method: 使用LendingClub大规模消费贷款数据集（N=1,344,936），首先评估置信度过滤中的偏见（Cramer's V约0.03-0.07），然后通过等机会框架量化歧视（16.86个百分点TPR差距）。采用顺序特征遮蔽方法论，依次剔除收入特征和利率特征，识别三个独立的偏差驱动机制，并通过留出样本上的有符号SHAP值定位残余差距的代理变量。
AI.result: 研究发现高收入违约者被误分类为标签噪声的比例不成比例地高于低收入违约者；等机会分析显示高/低收入违约者间16.86个百分点的真正例率差距。即使同时遮蔽收入与利率特征，仍存在统计显著的残余差距（交叉验证3.55个百分点，留出测试集2.56个百分点，Z=-4.04, p<0.0001），该差距由贷款金额和房屋所有权状态等结构性代理变量维持。
AI.conclusion: 仅对算法实施敏感属性屏蔽不足以实现公平，因为上游制度性定价决策（如利率）和行为代理变量会共同重构被省略的敏感信号。研究为受监管金融机构中审计数据中心的AI工作流提供了实践指导。

title: FreSH: Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification
summary: Multivariate Time Series Classification (MTSC) demands models that can effectively capture complex temporal patterns across multiple scales while remaining computationally efficient. However, existing approaches generally struggle to reconcile fine-grained representation learning, especially under class imbalance and real-world constraints. In this paper, we present FreSH, a Frequency-Segmented Hierarchical Multi-Expert Framework designed to address these challenges. FreSH introduces a new perspective for MTSC by enabling adaptive, multi-scale analysis of temporal signals, allowing different aspects of the data to be modeled in a complementary and coordinated manner. By combining localized specialization with holistic context modeling, FreSH achieves strong representational capacity without incurring excessive computational overhead. An adaptive fusion strategy further enhances flexibility, enabling the model to dynamically emphasize the most informative components of the input. In addition, we incorporate a more robust optimization objective that improves learning stability across varying sample difficulties and class distributions. Extensive evaluations on 30 UEA benchmark datasets and real-world vibration data demonstrate that FreSH consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in classification accuracy, while substantially reducing model size and efficiency.

AI.tldr: FreSH是一个面向多元时间序列分类的频段分层多专家框架，通过自适应多尺度分析和动态融合策略，在30个UEA基准数据集和真实振动数据上实现了超越现有方法的分分类精度，同时大幅降低模型大小和计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有的多元时间序列分类方法难以在多尺度特征捕捉、类别不平衡处理和真实世界约束（如计算效率）之间取得良好平衡，缺乏能够进行细粒度表示学习同时保持高效性的解决方案。
AI.method: FreSH采用频段分层的多专家架构，对时间信号进行自适应多尺度分析，通过局部化专家分工与全局上下文建模相结合增强表征能力；采用自适应融合策略动态强调最具信息量的输入成分；并引入更稳健的优化目标以改善不同样本难度和类别分布下的学习稳定性。
AI.result: 在30个UEA基准数据集和真实世界振动数据上的大量实验表明，FreSH在分类准确率上持续优于现有最优方法，同时显著减少了模型参数量并提升了计算效率。
AI.conclusion: FreSH通过频段分层的多专家协同机制，成功在表征能力与计算效率之间实现了良好平衡，为多元时间序列分类提供了一种既稳健又高效的新框架。

title: KGCache: Amortized Subgraph Retrieval for KG Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Large language models can answer knowledge-intensive questions more reliably when they are grounded with knowledge graphs, but systems such as Think-on-Graph and Reasoning-on-Graph repeatedly query the same graph neighborhoods across different questions. In this work, we study this repeated retrieval in Knowledge Graph Question Answering~(KGQA) workloads and propose KGCache, an in-memory cache for one-hop knowledge graph neighborhoods. KGCache is designed to be compatible with both iterative traversal (ToG) and one shot planning (RoG) KGQA paradigms. KGCache is placed between the KGQA engine and the backend serving the KG, so repeated entity requests can be served from cache instead of issuing new KG queries. We evaluate KGCache on WebQSP and CWQ using LRU, LFU, and a trace-aware Oracle policy. Our analysis shows that both datasets contain substantial entity reuse among starting entities and entities reached during traversal. We also explore semantic caching for similar queries, which shows additional hit-rate gains on WebQSP and needs further accuracy testing on CWQ. Entity caching accelerates KG retrieval by up to $1.91\times$, while semantic-context caching achieves up to $1.06\times$ full-system speedup in the evaluated WebQSP configurations, with each hit being up to $3.73\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KGCache，一种用于知识图谱问答(KGQA)工作负载的内存缓存系统，用于缓存一跳知识图谱邻域。KGCache位于KGQA引擎和后端知识图谱服务之间，使得重复的实体请求可以从缓存直接服务，避免了重复的KG查询。在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上使用LRU、LFU和Oracle策略评估，实体缓存可将KG检索速度提升至1.91倍，语义上下文缓存可实现最高1.06倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识图谱问答系统（如Think-on-Graph和Reasoning-on-Graph）在不同问题之间会反复查询相同的图谱邻域，造成大量重复的KG查询开销。这种重复检索在KGQA工作负载中非常普遍，但目前缺乏专门的缓存机制来解决这一问题。
AI.method: KGCache是一种用于一跳知识图谱邻域的内存缓存系统，设计上与迭代遍历（ToG）和一次性规划（RoG）两种KGQA范式兼容。KGCache部署在KGQA引擎与后端KG服务之间，采用LRU、LFU和基于trace的Oracle策略进行缓存替换，并探索语义缓存以处理相似查询。
AI.result: 在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上的分析显示，两个数据集在起始实体和遍历过程中到达的实体之间存在大量实体复用。实体缓存将KG检索加速最高1.91倍，语义上下文缓存在WebQSP配置下实现最高1.06倍的端到端加速，单次缓存命中最高快3.73倍。
AI.conclusion: KGCache通过利用KGQA工作负载中实体的重复访问模式，有效降低了KG查询开销。实体缓存已展现出显著的检索加速效果，语义缓存在WebQSP上带来额外的命中率提升，在CWQ上仍需进一步的精度测试。

title: Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Decoupling the Shared Control Bottleneck of RL Post-Training
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training unlocks complex reasoning in LLMs. Yet benchmark scores reveal only whether a model improved, not what changed inside it, nor how it splits finite capability across tasks. A representative interpretability line attributes the success of RL fine-tuning to stronger and more diverse circuit activation. We challenge this activation-centered account by separating activation from control: an activated circuit need not control the post-training reward gain. Adapting Metabolic Control Analysis, we define the Post-training Control Coefficient to measure component control over reward gain and arrange these coefficients by task family into a control matrix, paired with an activation-magnitude matrix. We call cross-task control concentration the Shared Control Bottleneck and the difference between activation and control concentration the Activation-Control Gap. This reveals that highly shared activations can coexist with task-specific control, while a small gap indicates that control has collapsed onto a shared direction and lost task specificity. To reduce this collapse, we regularize the post-training loss with the Shared Control Bottleneck and propose Control-Diverse Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (CD-RFT). The exact regularizer gradient requires second-order automatic differentiation incompatible with flash attention, so we derive a first-order proxy with worst-case overhead below eight percent. On Qwen2.5-7B, CD-RFT achieves the largest control decoupling and improves multi-task capability over matched GRPO across mathematics, code, and logic. The no-KL variant leads on pass@1, and the KL-penalized variant leads on large-k pass@k coverage that KL otherwise degrades. Together, these results show that the Shared Control Bottleneck is both a mechanistic diagnostic and a training regularizer, and that control decoupling and capability gains transfer to Llama-3.2-3B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"共享控制瓶颈"（Shared Control Bottleneck）这一概念，区分了电路激活与电路控制，通过后训练控制系数（Post-training Control Coefficient）衡量组件对奖励增益的贡献，并据此提出控制多样性强化微调（CD-RFT）正则化方法，在多个基准上超越GRPO，实现更好的多任务能力与控制解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有基准分数只能说明模型是否提升，无法揭示RL后训练内部如何改变模型，以及模型如何在任务之间分配有限的能力。主流可解释性观点认为RL微调的成功源于更强且更多样的电路激活，但作者认为被激活的电路并不一定控制后训练的奖励增益，需要将"激活"与"控制"分离研究。
AI.method: 借鉴代谢控制分析（Metabolic Control Analysis），定义后训练控制系数（Post-training Control Coefficient）以衡量组件对奖励增益的控制程度，构建控制矩阵与激活幅度矩阵。提出"共享控制瓶颈"度量跨任务控制的集中度，以及"激活-控制差距"度量激活与控制浓度的差异。将该瓶颈作为正则项加入后训练损失，提出CD-RFT。由于精确正则化梯度需要二阶自动微分且与flash attention不兼容，作者推导出最坏开销低于8%的一阶代理。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-7B上，CD-RFT实现了最大的控制解耦，并在数学、代码、逻辑多任务上超越匹配的GRPO。无KL变体在pass@1上领先，带KL惩罚的变体在大k的pass@k覆盖率上领先（而纯KL会损害该指标）。相关结论在Llama-3.2-3B上得到迁移验证。
AI.conclusion: 共享控制瓶颈既是一种机制性诊断工具，也是一种训练正则化器。高度共享的激活可以与任务特定的控制共存，而小的激活-控制差距则表明控制已坍缩到共享方向上并丧失任务特异性。控制解耦与能力提升可迁移至其他模型规模。

title: Self-Evolving Neuro-Symbolic Skills for Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Large vision-language models have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, but they remain unreliable on fine-grained spatial tasks that demand both precise spatial perception and fine-grained geometric computation beyond end-to-end generation. Tool augmentation offers a natural solution, while existing methods either plan tool calls from scratch without explicit dependency constraints or rely on fixed pipelines that are redundant and generalize poorly across spatial tasks. An effective spatial reasoning agent should instead accumulate reusable experience and adaptively compose it for new problems. To this end, we propose NeSy-Spatial, a neuro-symbolic framework for self-evolving spatial skills. NeSy-Spatial abstracts tool interactions and geometric operations into typed executable atomic instructions and composes them into two complementary skill types: Tool-Use Skills for organizing tool execution and Geometry Skills for structured geometric reasoning. During inference, NeSy-Spatial retrieves and executes relevant skills in a closed-loop process. During evolution, it analyzes buffered successful and failed trajectories to refine skill structures and prune unreliable or inactive entries. Experiments on three spatial reasoning benchmarks show that NeSy-Spatial consistently improves reasoning accuracy with more precise tool utilization.

AI.tldr: 提出NeSy-Spatial，一个神经符号框架，通过将工具交互和几何操作抽象为可执行原子指令，组合成Tool-Use Skills和Geometry Skills两类互补技能，在推理时闭环检索执行技能，在演化时分析成功/失败轨迹来精炼技能结构，从而提升大视觉语言模型在细粒度空间推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在细粒度空间任务上不可靠，现有工具增强方法要么从头规划工具调用且缺乏显式依赖约束，要么依赖固定流程导致冗余且泛化差。需要一个能积累可复用经验并自适应组合来解决新问题的空间推理智能体。
AI.method: 提出NeSy-Spatial神经符号框架：(1) 将工具交互和几何操作抽象为类型化可执行原子指令；(2) 组合成两类互补技能——Tool-Use Skills负责组织工具执行，Geometry Skills负责结构化几何推理；(3) 推理阶段通过闭环过程检索并执行相关技能；(4) 演化阶段分析缓存的成功/失败轨迹来精炼技能结构，剪除不可靠或不活跃条目。
AI.result: 在三个空间推理基准上的实验表明，NeSy-Spatial持续提升了推理准确率，并实现了更精确的工具利用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可复用技能积累与自适应组合相结合的神经符号框架，NeSy-Spatial有效解决了大视觉语言模型在细粒度空间推理任务中依赖规划不可靠和固定流程泛化差的问题，验证了技能演化机制对提升空间推理能力的有效性。

title: SCOUT: Self-Checking and Recovery-Aware Tool-Thought Agents for Ultra-Long Egocentric Video Reasoning
summary: Ultra-long egocentric video understanding requires reasoning over temporally sparse evidence distributed across hours or days, challenging current multimodal models with limited context and the grounding of key video segments. While Chain-of-Tool-Thought (CoTT) agent systems enable iterative retrieval and inspection, they suffer from error propagation due to rigid zoom-in strategies that lack recovery mechanisms. In this work, we address these challenges through SCOUT (Self-Checking Chain-Of-Tool-thought), a recovery-aware agentic framework introducing an adaptive policy that evaluates intermediate tool observations and dynamically trades off exploitation (zoom-in) and exploration (region switching), enabling robust multi-hop reasoning over extremely long horizons. However, training such multi-turn tool-using agents remains challenging, as existing RL methods rely on sparse outcome-level rewards and lack supervision over extended decision trajectories, resulting in suboptimal credit assignment for long-horizon reasoning. To address this, we develop UPS-GRPO, an uncertainty-prioritized policy optimization method that concentrates exploration on high-uncertainty post-tool states while preserving sample efficiency. We further introduce a turn-level advantage decomposition that integrates outcome rewards with tool-grounded temporal alignment rewards for improved credit assignment. Experiments show that SCOUT achieves state-of-the-art results on ultra-long egocentric benchmarks, while remaining competitive on shorter-horizon long-video settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT（自检工具链推理）框架，一个具备恢复能力的智能体框架，通过自适应策略在工具观察中动态权衡利用（放大）与探索（区域切换），实现超长自我中心视频理解；并配套开发UPS-GRPO策略优化方法，利用不确定性优先的探索和回合级优势分解解决长程工具使用智能体的信用分配问题，在超长基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 超长自我中心视频理解需要推理跨越数小时或数天的时间稀疏证据，但现有多模态模型受限于有限上下文且难以定位关键视频片段。已有的CoTT智能体系统采用刚性的放大策略，缺乏恢复机制，导致错误传播问题。此外，训练多轮工具使用智能体的强化学习方法仅依赖稀疏的结果级奖励，缺乏对长决策轨迹的监督，导致长期推理的信用分配不佳。
AI.method: 1) SCOUT框架：自适应策略评估中间工具观察，动态权衡利用（zoom-in放大）与探索（region switching区域切换），支持超长视界的鲁棒多跳推理。2) UPS-GRPO：不确定性优先的策略优化方法，集中在高不确定性的工具后状态上进行探索，保持样本效率。3) 回合级优势分解：整合结果奖励与工具锚定的时间对齐奖励，改善信用分配。
AI.result: SCOUT在超长自我中心视频基准上取得SOTA结果，同时在较短视界的长视频设定下保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入恢复感知的自适应工具使用策略和不确定性驱动的策略优化，SCOUT有效解决了超长视频理解中的错误传播和长程信用分配问题，证明了在极长视界场景中探索-利用权衡和细粒度奖励设计的有效性。

title: The Replay Gap: Static Evaluation of Model Switching in LLM Agents Scores the Wrong World
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling 2026. Code: https://github.com/AshrithaG/replay-gap Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ashritha0907/replay-gap-trajectories
summary: LLM routers promise efficiency by matching each request to the cheapest adequate model, and are increasingly applied per step inside multi-step agents. Yet agentic routers are evaluated like single-turn routers: by replaying logged trajectories and substituting another model's recorded outputs, assuming the rest of the trajectory is unaffected. We test this assumption with branching rollouts: we fork live SWE-bench agent trajectories at controlled points, rebuild the environment, continue each fork with a different model, and compare against same-model control forks that isolate sampling and replay noise. Across six paired runs (~900 rollouts), swaps exceed their matched control floors by +0.25 to +0.66 normalized edit distance (multiplicity-corrected CIs exclude zero), rewriting 61-94% of post-fork actions; 74-77% of early swaps diverge at the first post-fork action, versus 6-35% of controls, leaving only 3% of replayed states valid. Divergence decreases with fork depth in both directions. All five outcome flips we observe occur in swap arms, upgrades rescuing unsolved instances and a downgrade losing the sole solve, and zero occur across 359 control forks. Scoring these same swaps with a log-stitching replay evaluator, replay mispredicts every success-relevant outcome call and predicts patches with 0.00-0.11 similarity to reality. Auditing the noise floor, temperature-0 "determinism" is configuration-dependent: FP8-served controls diverge on over 90% of forks while AWQ-served ones remain near-identical; and under tight budgets the stronger model more often exhausts its steps without submitting. Replay-based benchmarks score the wrong world for agentic routing; we release our harness and all trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分支回放（branching rollouts）实验验证了"轨迹重放"评估方法在多步智能体路由器场景下的无效性。研究者fork真实SWE-bench智能体轨迹，用不同模型继续运行并与同模型对照对比，发现模型交换会导致轨迹大幅偏离原始路径，而基于日志拼接（log-stitching）的重放评估器在所有关键结果上均产生错误预测。研究揭示了重放评估的根本缺陷，并发布了完整的实验数据与工具。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM路由器正被应用于多步智能体的每一步决策中，但评估方式仍沿用单轮路由器的做法：重放已记录的轨迹并替换某个模型的输出，假设轨迹其余部分不受影响。这一假设在多步智能体场景中很可能不成立，因为一步的决策会级联影响后续所有步骤。研究者希望通过可控实验严格检验这一核心假设是否站得住脚。
AI.method: 采用分支回放方法：在SWE-bench智能体轨迹的受控节点处fork（分支），重建环境后用不同模型继续执行，同时设置同模型对照分支以隔离采样噪声和重放噪声。共进行六组配对实验（约900次rollout），并额外使用日志拼接重放评估器对相同交换进行评分以对比。同时审计了temperature-0"确定性"的配置依赖性问题（FP8与AWQ两种服务方式）以及预算限制对不同模型的影响。
AI.result: 模型交换后的轨迹偏差超过对照组的+0.25到+0.66归一化编辑距离（多重校正CI排除零），61-94%的分支后动作被重写；74-77%的早期交换在第一个分支后动作即发生分歧，对照仅为6-35%，仅3%的重放状态仍然有效。分歧随fork深度双向递减。所有5次结果翻转均出现在交换组（升级模型挽回未解决实例，降级模型丢失唯一解），而359个对照组中为0次。日志拼接重放评估器错误预测了所有与成功相关的结果调用，预测补丁与实际相似度仅0.00-0.11。FP8服务的对照组在90%以上的fork处产生分歧，而AWQ服务的对照组几乎保持一致；在严格预算下更强模型更易耗尽步骤而无输出。
AI.conclusion: 基于重放的基准测试在多步智能体路由场景中评估的是"错误的世界"——轨迹重放无法反映真实的分支演化行为，会系统性误判路由决策的成败。智能体路由器的评估必须采用能够捕捉级联效应的实时分支评测方法，而非静态的日志重放。

title: CyberAGENTS: Structured Autonomy for Agentic Gamified Learning in Cybersecurity
summary: Gamification is especially effective in learning domains requiring active problem-solving and iterative skill-building, such as cybersecurity education. Generative AI agents offer a path to delivering such experiences adaptively at scale, but introduce well-documented risks in educational settings: inconsistent behavior, hallucinated reasoning, and misalignment with pedagogical frameworks. Grounding these systems in learning science is therefore essential. We present \model, an agentic framework for gamified cybersecurity learning that enables structured autonomy through ontology-guided validation, schema-governed behavioral control, and competency-based progression. The system is organized around a competency-based progression model that structures topics by difficulty and prerequisite relationships, reflecting evidence-based principles of scaffolded instruction. The learning loop is decomposed into four specialized agents: challenge, support, evaluation, and reward, each governed by behavioral schemas that encode operational modes and progression logic, bounding agent autonomy without eliminating generative flexibility. A cybersecurity ontology validates all generated content prior to display, enforcing domain-consistent reasoning and safety constraints. We evaluate CyberAgents through classroom deployment with undergraduate students, complemented by expert evaluations from educators and domain specialists. Results indicate improved engagement, clearer feedback interpretation, and greater learner trust in AI-generated responses when behavioral schemas and ontology validation are active. Preliminary comparisons with an unconstrained configuration further support the role of structured control in stabilizing instructional behavior. These findings offer a blueprint for designing pedagogically grounded agentic gamified learning systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CyberAgents，一个基于本体引导验证、模式化行为控制和能力进阶的代理框架，用于游戏化网络安全学习，通过课堂部署与专家评估证明了其在提升参与度、反馈清晰度和学习者信任方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI代理虽能大规模提供适应性游戏化学习体验，但在教育场景中存在行为不一致、推理幻觉和与教学框架脱节等风险，因此需要将系统扎根于学习科学，通过结构化约束来保证教学质量。
AI.method: 系统围绕能力进阶模型组织，将学习循环分解为挑战、支持、评估和奖励四个专门代理；每个代理由行为模式控制，编码操作逻辑和进阶规则以限制自动化行为同时保留生成灵活性；网络安全本体在内容展示前验证所有生成内容，确保领域一致推理与安全约束。
AI.result: 通过本科生课堂部署、教育者和领域专家评估，结果表明启用行为模式与本体验证时，学习者的参与度提升、反馈解读更清晰、对AI生成结果的信任度更高；与无约束配置的初步对比进一步支持结构化控制在稳定教学行为中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为设计教学法驱动的代理化游戏化学习系统提供了蓝图，证明了以学习科学为基础的结构化自主能够兼顾生成灵活性与教学可靠性。

title: Learning from Environmental Feedback: Credit Assignment across Multiple Timescales for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from delayed and sparse rewards in real-world environments. A promising solution to this challenge is credit assignment, which aims to decompose trajectory-level rewards and provide more fine-grained supervision for intermediate decisions. However, existing credit assignment approaches ignore the rich process information naturally generated during environment interaction, e.g., interaction history. We argue that such information provides valuable supervision for identifying the contribution of individual actions. To this end, we propose Environmental Feedback-based Credit Assignment (EFCA), a multi-timescale credit assignment approach for long-horizon agentic RL. EFCA complements the long-term outcome signal with two environment-grounded process signals: a short-term feedback signal that captures the immediate effect of the current action and a medium-term state-history signal that identifies ineffective patterns from recent interactions. Both signals are directly extracted from environment feedback and integrated through a return reweighting mechanism. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that EFCA consistently improves both task success and task quality over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of environment-grounded multi-timescale credit assignment for long-horizon agentic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EFCA（环境反馈驱动的信用分配），一种面向长程智能体强化学习的多时间尺度信用分配方法，利用环境交互中自然产生的两类过程信号（短期动作反馈和中长期状态历史）来补充稀疏延迟的轨迹级奖励，通过回报重加权机制整合，在ALFWorld和WebShop上取得优于强基线的一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 智能体强化学习在真实环境中常面临延迟且稀疏的奖励问题。信用分配旨在分解轨迹级奖励以提供更细粒度的中间决策监督，但现有方法忽略了环境交互过程中自然产生的丰富过程信息（如交互历史）。作者认为这些信息能为识别单个动作的贡献提供有价值的监督信号。
AI.method: EFCA采用多时间尺度信用分配框架：1）保留长期结果信号作为全局目标；2）引入短期反馈信号，捕获当前动作的即时环境效果；3）引入中期状态-历史信号，从近期交互中识别无效模式。两类过程信号均直接提取自环境反馈，并通过回报重加权机制与长期信号整合，实现对轨迹级奖励的细粒度分解。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准上，EFCA相比多个强基线在任务成功率和任务质量指标上均取得一致且稳定的性能提升，验证了环境驱动的多时间尺度信用分配对长程智能体RL的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用环境反馈中固有的过程信息进行多时间尺度信用分配，能够有效缓解长程智能体强化学习中延迟稀疏奖励带来的难题，为该领域提供了新的方法论方向。

authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
title: Opportunity Is Not Realizability: Selection-Valid Diagnostics for Multi-LLM Routing
summary: Oracle routing measures how much a pool of language models could gain from per-query selection, but the diagnostic has two flaws: testing against a best fixed model selected on the same examples invalidates paired inference, and a full-information oracle sees outcomes no deployable router observes. We separate three estimands (outcome-oracle opportunity, the Bayes-optimal gain from a declared pre-answer signal, and the held-out gain of a learned router) and prove selection-valid confidence intervals that survive choosing the best fixed model or the best member of a router family, a signal-information sandwich, and a $(1-1/e)$ greedy guarantee for building compact pools from submodular complementary coverage. On eight checkpoints from six families over four benchmarks, selection-valid intervals certify a population oracle gap of $9.7$--$30.7$ points on every task, yet the strongest deployable prompt router recovers only $7.5$--$14.4\%$ of it, and the simultaneous interval for the best of eleven tested policies has lower limit zero throughout. The realizable share of oracle opportunity is small and certifiable: strong routers beat the best fixed model, and most of the gap remains.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有Oracle路由诊断的两个缺陷（同例选最优固定模型导致配对推断失效、全信息oracle看到部署路由器不可观测的结果），提出三种估计目标（结果oracle机会、预回答信号的贝叶斯最优增益、学习型路由器的留出增益），并证明选择有效的置信区间、信号信息三明治界以及基于次模互补覆盖的紧凑池构建的(1-1/e)贪心保证。在6个模型家族8个检查点4个基准上的实验显示，选择有效区间证明群体oracle差距为9.7-30.7点，但最强的可部署提示路由仅恢复其中7.5-14.4%，且11个策略中最好的同时区间下界为零。
AI.motivation: 现有的Oracle路由诊断存在两个缺陷：一是使用与测试相同示例上选出的最优固定模型作为基线，导致配对推断统计无效；二是完全信息的oracle能观察到部署路由器不可观测的最终结果，高估了路由的潜在收益。这些缺陷使得路由潜力评估不可靠，需要更严谨的统计框架。
AI.method: 本文提出三个分离的估计目标：结果oracle机会（全信息基线）、来自声明预回答信号的贝叶斯最优增益（半信息）、学习型路由器的留出增益（实际可部署）。并证明了三组工具：选择有效的置信区间（能承受选择最优固定模型或最优路由器家族成员的推断）、信号信息三明治界（连接不同信息水平的估计目标）、以及基于次模互补覆盖的紧凑池构建贪心保证。
AI.result: 在6个模型家族、8个检查点、4个基准上的实验表明：选择有效置信区间在每项任务上认证了9.7-30.7点的群体oracle差距；然而最强的可部署提示路由只恢复了其中7.5-14.4%；对11个测试策略中最优者的同时置信区间下界在所有任务上均为零。真实可实现的oracle机会份额很小但可被严格证明。
AI.conclusion: 强路由确实能击败最优固定模型，但oracle机会中绝大部分差距仍然不可实现。本文提供的统计框架使路由潜力的评估更加严谨，揭示了与全信息oracle相比，实际可部署路由器的可实现收益有限，这为路由池构建和部署策略提供了重要指导。

title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
comment: Gambit is a thought-level beam search algorithm that reallocates inference compute to high-quality reasoning traces, achieving up to +6.7% accuracy gains and 68.5% token reduction over pruning and parallel sampling under strict hardware constraints
summary: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional parallel sampling treats traces independently and induces severe memory bottlenecks, while subtractive pruning starves hardware and fails to actively and sufficiently shift the output distribution. To overcome this dichotomy, we introduce Gambit, an inference algorithm that executes \emph{thought-level beam search}. By periodically pruning unpromising trajectories and immediately branching from high-quality prefixes, Gambit dynamically concentrates compute onto the most promising reasoning traces via a light-weight scorer probing hidden states while maintaining continuous high hardware utilization. Extensive evaluations across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that Gambit strictly dominates existing baselines. Under identical hardware constraints, our method yields up to a +6.7\% absolute accuracy gain on HMMT-24 and +3.3\% on AIME-25 over pruning baselines, delivers $>2\times$ higher throughput on trace completion, and reduces total token consumption by up to 68.5\% relative to standard parallel sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gambit，一种基于thought级beam search的推理算法，通过动态剪枝低质量轨迹并在高质量前缀上立即分支，将测试时计算集中分配到最有希望的推理路径上，在固定硬件预算下实现了比现有并行采样和剪枝方法更高的准确率和吞吐量，同时显著降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)的性能提升高度依赖测试时计算扩展，但现有方法在固定硬件预算下效率极低。传统并行采样将轨迹独立处理，导致严重内存瓶颈；而剪枝式方法则使硬件饥饿，无法主动且充分地改变输出分布。核心问题从"花多少计算"转变为"计算花在哪里"，需要一种能主动将计算分配到最有希望的推理轨迹上的方法。
AI.method: Gambit将测试时推理形式化为部分轨迹上的受限计算分配问题，并执行thought-level（思维级别）的beam search。具体来说：1) 周期性剪枝不具前景的推理轨迹；2) 立即从高质量前缀进行分支扩展；3) 通过轻量级评分器探测隐藏状态来评估轨迹质量；4) 在保持硬件高利用率的同时，动态将计算集中到最有希望的推理路径上。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准上的广泛评估中，Gambit严格优于现有基线：在相同硬件约束下，相比剪枝基线在HMMT-24上获得最高+6.7%的绝对准确率提升，在AIME-25上获得+3.3%的提升；轨迹完成吞吐量提高2倍以上；相比标准并行采样，总token消耗最多降低68.5%。
AI.conclusion: Gambit通过thought-level beam search在并行采样和剪枝范式之间找到平衡，证明主动计算分配是提升LRM测试时推理效率的关键方向。该方法在准确率、吞吐量和token效率三个维度上均实现了对现有范式的严格超越。

authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
title: Stateful CARS: Exact Cross-History Reuse for Policy-Constrained LLM Agents
summary: Tool-using language-model agents face constraints whose meaning changes with observations and prior actions. We study exact sampling from the model distribution conditioned on a hard stateful validator while reusing invalidity certificates across histories. Stateful CARS freezes a bank of sound state--continuation schemas within each attempt and removes every trajectory containing a certified continuation at a matching abstract state. An exact residual Doob transform samples from the resulting proposal. We give a checkable future-validity bisimulation condition, prove schema soundness, adaptive exactness, i.i.d.\ outputs, almost-sure termination, monotone acceptance, and compression invariance, and characterize computation by the number of reachable full-history product states. This number can be exponential for a history-dependent language model; the evaluated method therefore makes no generic finite-trie scalability claim. On enumerable workflows, its analytic law matches the valid conditional to $10^{-16}$ at validity probability $6\times10^{-8}$, whereas state-aware local decoding can be $0.97$ away. A matched comparison is negative: observation-keyed official CARS is cheaper in sampler steps (root/Stateful ratio $0.942$ $[0.934,0.951]$), and the Qwen comparison is null ($0.99$ $[0.90,1.08]$). Cross-history transfer helps only in an internal matched-key ablation ($1.27\times$). Thus the evidence supports exact schema-induced conditioning, not a systems advantage over CARS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Stateful CARS方法，通过冻结状态-延续模式的音库并在每次尝试中移除含已验证延续的轨迹，实现对带硬状态性验证器约束的精确采样；理论上证明了模式健全性、自适应精确性、几乎必然终止等性质，实验上在可枚举工作流中达到10^-16精度，但与官方CARS相比无系统性优势。
AI.motivation: 工具型语言模型智能体面临的状态性验证器约束会随观察和先前行而变化，精确从满足约束的模型分布中采样具有挑战性，需要一种能够跨历史复用无效性证书且保持精确性的采样方法。
AI.method: Stateful CARS冻结一组健全的状态-延续模式音库，移除所有在匹配抽象状态处包含已验证延续的轨迹；通过精确残差Doob变换从所得提议分布中采样；提出了可检验的未来有效性双模拟条件，并证明模式健全性、自适应精确性、i.i.d.输出、几乎必然终止、单调接受和压缩不变性；用可达全历史积状态数刻画计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在可枚举工作流上，解析分布与实际有效的条件分布差距达10^-16（有效性概率为6×10^-8），而状态感知的局部解码偏差可达0.97；但与observation-keyed官方CARS相比，采样步数比率为0.942（状态CARS更慢），Qwen对比无显著差异（0.99），跨历史转移仅在内部消融中有1.27倍提升。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持精确的模式诱导条件采样的有效性，但Stateful CARS并不提供超越官方CARS的系统性优势；其适用性受限于历史相关语言模型可能导致指数级乘积状态数的情况。

title: Legal Responsibilities Using Autonomous Agents For Artificial Intelligence
summary: Recent incidents involving Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, which were reported escaping their containment `unintentionally' to gain unauthorized access, pose looming questions about who or what should be held legally responsible for resultant criminal or negligent damage. As the independent capabilities of agents expand, Promise Theory suggests a systematic method to resolve these questions, based on the Downstream Principle for causal influence. Responsibility can easily be expanded to include AI agents where tracing responsibility becomes impactical, and agents' freedoms to act can be limtied by policy choices.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI代理"无意"逃出隔离并获得未授权访问的事件所引发的法律责任归属问题，提出基于Promise Theory的下游原则（Downstream Principle）作为系统化方法，将责任扩展至AI代理并可通过政策选择限制其行动自由。
AI.motivation: 近年来AI代理不断发生"意外"逃逸并造成未授权访问的事件，引发关于应由谁（或什么）对由此产生的刑事或过失损害承担法律责任的紧迫问题。随着AI代理自主能力的扩展，传统的责任归属框架面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用Promise Theory框架，基于因果影响力的下游原则（Downstream Principle）来系统化解决责任归属问题。该方法可将责任机制扩展至AI代理，并在责任追踪变得不切实际时，通过政策选择来限制代理的行动自由。
AI.result: 提出了一种基于下游原则的责任分配方法，能够将责任系统化地扩展至AI代理领域，同时通过政策约束为限制代理行为自由提供理论依据。
AI.conclusion: Promise Theory的下游原则提供了一种可行的系统化路径，用于解决AI代理逃逸事件中的法律责任归属难题，使责任机制能够适应AI代理日益增强的自主能力。

title: Causal State-Space Model for Causal Inference: Estimating Longitudinal Individual Treatment Effects
comment: Submitted to AAAI 2027. 13 pages, 5 tables, appendices A-E
summary: Estimating counterfactual outcomes over time from longitudinal observational data is central to clinical decision support. Existing methods rely on domain confusion -- adversarial training that renders representations invariant to treatment assignment -- yet this invariance creates a mutual information conflict: it suppresses treatment-correlated covariate signals necessary for accurate outcome prediction. We formalise this tension via a Jensen-Shannon divergence bound on counterfactual prediction error and develop two complementary models. CSSD (Causal State-Space model with Direct decoder) adapts selective State Space Models with a parallel multi-step decoder that eliminates accumulated rollout error by producing all prediction horizons simultaneously in a single forward pass. CSSPD (Causal State-Space model with Predictive regularisation and Direct decoder) augments CSSD with Contrastive Predictive Coding and Local Information Maximisation to reinforce temporal predictability in the balancing representation and recover local covariate information destroyed by domain confusion. On MIMIC-III, CSSPD achieves lower counterfactual RMSE than the Causal Transformer at every horizon tau >= 2 at O(T) encoder cost, with gains from 0.02 (2-step) to 0.07 (6-step). On Cancer Simulation across confounding strengths gamma in {0,1,2,3,4}, CSSPD outperforms CT at gamma <= 3 (margins 25.9%--37.0%), and CSSD achieves the lowest overall average RMSE (12.7% reduction over CT), confirming the MI conflict analysis. To our knowledge, this is the first work to formalise the balancing-prediction MI conflict and propose a structured resolution through complementary predictive and information-theoretic training objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CSSD和CSSPD两种因果状态空间模型，通过结构化解耦域混淆与预测目标之间的互信息冲突，在MIMIC-III和Cancer Simulation数据集上实现了优于Causal Transformer的反事实预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实时序预测方法依赖域混淆对抗训练来使表征不受治疗分配影响，但这种不变性会抑制与治疗相关且对预测至关重要的协变量信号，形成互信息冲突。本文首次形式化了这一平衡-预测互信息冲突，并针对性地提出解决方案。
AI.method: 通过Jensen-Shannon散度界形式化反事实预测误差，提出两种互补模型：(1) CSSD采用选择性状态空间模型配合并行多步解码器，单次前向传播同时生成所有预测时域，消除累积rollout误差；(2) CSSPD在CSSD基础上增加对比预测编码和局部信息最大化正则化，增强平衡表征的时序可预测性并恢复被域混淆破坏的局部协变量信息。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III上，CSSPD在所有时域tau>=2上以O(T)编码成本取得比Causal Transformer更低的反事实RMSE（2步至6步提升0.02-0.07）；在Cancer Simulation上，CSSPD在gamma<=3时超越CT（边际25.9%-37.0%），CSSD取得最低平均RMSE（较CT降低12.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个形式化平衡-预测互信息冲突的工作，通过互补的预测和信息论训练目标实现了结构化解决，验证了互信息冲突分析的正确性，为临床决策支持的时序反事实估计提供了更优方法。

title: The Authority Expectancy Effect in Multi-User Conflict
summary: We investigate how social authority (SA) signals interact with severity-based prioritization in large language models, operationalizing each axis as a model-elicited baseline -- the triage hierarchy and the SA hierarchy. Across four LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok) and three experimental phases -- resource allocation, fault attribution, and multi-turn dispute mediation -- we find that occupational authority, institutional documentation, and relational congruence can restructure model judgments in ways not captured by additive reweighting of authority cues. We formalize this pattern as the Authority Expectancy Effect (AEE) and characterize it through three properties observed across our conditions: it is reference-dependent, defined only relative to a pre-authority baseline; it involves evidential reinterpretation, in which identical content acquires different inferential implications depending on which party bears the SA signal; and it exhibits direction sensitivity, producing opposite outcomes depending on whether authority position and evidentiary cues align.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中社会权威（SA）信号与严重性优先分级之间的交互作用，提出"权威期望效应"（AEE），并通过四个LLM和三个实验阶段验证其三个核心性质：参考依赖性、证据性再解释和方向敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常将权威线索视为对模型判断的简单加权调整，但缺乏对其与严重性分级等优先化机制之间交互作用的系统性理解。作者旨在揭示权威信号如何以非线性方式重构LLM的推理与判断。
AI.method: 将社会权威与严重性分级分别操作化为模型诱发的两条基线（分诊层级与权威层级），在四种LLM（Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok）和三个阶段（资源分配、过失归因、多轮纠纷调解）中进行实验，考察职业权威、制度文件和关系一致性对模型判断的重构作用。
AI.result: 发现权威信号对模型判断的重构无法通过权威线索的加性再加权来解释；识别出三个特征：参考依赖性（仅相对权威前基线定义）、证据性再解释（相同内容因不同持有权威信号的当事方而获得不同推理含义）、方向敏感性（权威位置与证据线索对齐与否导致相反结果）。
AI.conclusion: 权威信号在LLM中并非简单的附加权重，而会从根本上重构模型的推理结构，从而需要新的理论框架（权威期望效应）来理解其影响机制。

title: A Controlled Study of Feature-Based Knowledge Distillation Across Student Designs
summary:
Knowledge distillation trains a smaller student to match the outputs of a larger teacher. Feature-based methods also align intermediate representations, but this extra constraint may affect students differently. We study this question on CIFAR-100 using a ResNet-50 teacher, a width-controlled CustomResNet family and MobileNetV2 as a cross-design comparison. For each student, we evaluate each feature method against a matched logit-KD run using the same teacher, optimizer settings, training schedule and seed. We repeat the main comparisons across multiple seeds.
  Logit KD improved every tested student over its scratch baseline. Attention Transfer showed no clear relationship with size inside the CustomResNet family, but its average effect was negative for that family and positive for MobileNetV2. FitNets was below logit KD in all 15 paired runs. Within the constant-depth width sweep, its gap increased for wider students, although the different-depth w=48 student did not follow this trend. Finally, the same auxiliary coefficient produced different gradient scales across students, showing that a fixed coefficient does not create a uniform training condition.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了不同特征蒸馏方法在不同规模学生网络上的效果差异。在CIFAR-100上以ResNet-50为教师，分别使用宽度可调的CustomResNet家族和MobileNetV2作为学生，与匹配配置的logit-KD基线进行对照实验。结果表明：logit蒸馏稳定改善所有学生；注意力迁移在CustomResNet家族中平均效果为负、在MobileNetV2中为正；FitNets在所有15组配对实验中均低于logit蒸馏，且宽度越大差距越大；固定的辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同的梯度尺度，无法提供统一的训练条件。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏中基于特征的蒸馏方法通过对齐中间表征来增强学生训练，但这种额外约束对不同架构和不同规模的学生可能产生不同甚至相反的影响。现有研究缺乏对这种异质性影响的系统量化，作者旨在通过严格的对照实验回答"特征蒸馏是否总是有益"以及"其效果如何随学生规模变化"这两个核心问题。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-100数据集上使用ResNet-50作为教师，构建宽度受控的CustomResNet家族（恒定深度、不同宽度）以及跨架构的MobileNetV2作为学生。对每个学生，将每种特征蒸馏方法（Attention Transfer和FitNets）与使用相同教师、优化器设置、训练调度和随机种子的logit-KD运行进行配对比较，并在多种子下重复主要对比以确保统计可靠性。
AI.result: 所有学生的logit蒸馏均优于从头训练的基线；注意力迁移在CustomResNet家族内与规模无明确关系且平均效应为负，但对MobileNetV2呈正效应；FitNets在所有15组配对运行中都低于logit蒸馏，在恒定深度宽度扫描中更宽的学生差距更大（但不同深度的w=48学生不符合该趋势）；相同辅助系数在不同学生上产生不同的梯度尺度。
AI.conclusion: 特征蒸馏方法的效果高度依赖学生架构和规模，不能假设其普遍优于或等价于logit蒸馏。固定的超参数（如辅助系数）无法在不同学生之间提供可比的训练条件，研究者需要对每个学生进行单独调参。这提示在蒸馏实践中应更审慎地选择特征对齐方法，并考虑其与学生规模的交互效应。

title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
comment: Accepted to the actionable Interpretability workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction upstream causally controls refusal. But the detection direction is orthogonal to the change that actually writes the refusal, which is late and assembled over the course of generation rather than read off in a single forward pass. We attribute the write to a specific, localizable circuit, a mixture-of-experts writer held in check by an attention opposer and price every way of intervening on it: damping the opposer is cheap and effective, amplifying the writer is a cost wall, and surgical edits to the responsible heads do nothing. The circuit's organization, and the gradient method that exposes it, recur in a second, unrelated MoE model, while the lever's strength is architecture-specific. The result is a cost-measured map of where a multilingual safety repair can land, and what it costs

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言模型安全对齐的不均衡问题，发现拒绝行为的不一致并非源于危害检测失败，而是因为“检测方向”与“写入拒绝行为的电路”正交。作者定位到一个可本地化的MoE（混合专家）电路——由专家写入器与注意力对抗器组成，并量化了各种干预方式的成本，绘制出一张多语言安全修复的“成本地图”。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型的安全对齐在低资源语言上明显薄弱，同一有害请求在英语中被拒、在低资源语言中却会被满足。理解这一机制性差距是修复安全漏洞并实现跨语言一致安全行为的前提。
AI.method: 以Indic多语言MoE推理模型sarvam为对象，通过机制可解释性手段：1) 在LL层测量危害编码方向的跨语言一致性；2) 通过上游方向操控做因果验证；3) 将拒绝行为的“检测”与“书写”分离，定位出由MoE专家写入器与注意力对抗器构成的电路；4) 系统性地量化多种干预方式的代价（成本墙、无效编辑等）；5) 用梯度方法在第二个无关的MoE模型上验证电路的普遍性。
AI.result: 危害在模型中期以近乎语言无关的内部方向编码（L11层跨语言方向余弦≈0.9），操控该方向可因果控制拒绝。但检测方向与写入拒绝行为的方向正交，写入发生在生成后期而非单次前向传播。写入由可定位的MoE电路完成：阻尼对抗器廉价有效，放大写入器存在成本墙，而对负责头的精准手术编辑无效。电路结构与梯度方法在第二个MoE模型中复现，但控制杠杆强度因架构而异。
AI.conclusion: 多语言安全差距的根源不在危害识别，而在于危害检测信号与拒绝行为写入电路之间的正交解耦。这项工作给出了一张量化的、按成本衡量的多语言安全修复地图，指明哪些干预点位有效、哪些失效、各需付出何种代价，为后续安全对齐修复提供了机制层面的依据。

title: Machine-Learning-Based Diagnostic Framework for Passive Ultrasonic Detection of Railway Wheel Defects
comment: Presented at the ASNT Research Symposium 2026, Salt Lake City, Utah, July 20-24, 2026
summary: Reliable identification of railway wheel defects is important for safety and maintenance. This study develops a machine-learning-based diagnostic framework for multi-class defect identification using passive air-coupled ultrasonic acoustic emission signals. Data were collected from eleven full-scale railway wheelsets representing nine health states. Time- and frequency-domain features were evaluated using Kruskal-Wallis statistical testing and mutual-information analysis to identify the most discriminative indicators. A Random Forest classifier was then trained using the selected features with stratified 5-fold cross-validation. The model achieved a balanced accuracy of approximately 0.66 and a Macro-F1 score of 0.65 across the nine classes. Decay rate, kurtosis, skewness, and envelope low-frequency power emerged as the most influential features, while a compact subset of features retained most of the classification performance. The results demonstrate the feasibility of combining passive ultrasonic sensing, statistical feature selection, and supervised machine learning for non-contact railway wheel defect classification and provide a foundation for future field-deployable inspection systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一种基于机器学习的多类别铁路车轮缺陷诊断框架，利用无源气耦合超声声发射信号，通过统计特征选择和随机森林分类器实现九种健康状态的分类，平衡准确率约0.66，Macro-F1分数0.65，证明了非接触式缺陷分类的可行性。
AI.motivation: 铁路车轮缺陷的可靠识别对安全和维护至关重要，需要开发更有效的非接触式缺陷检测方法。
AI.method: 从十一个全尺寸铁路轮对（代表九种健康状态）采集无源气耦合超声声发射信号；使用时域和频域特征，通过Kruskal-Wallis统计检验和互信息分析选择最具判别力的特征；使用随机森林分类器结合分层5折交叉验证进行训练。
AI.result: 模型在九个类别上实现了约0.66的平衡准确率和0.65的Macro-F1分数；衰减率、峰度、偏度和包络低频功率是最有影响力的特征；紧凑的特征子集保留了大部分分类性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了被动超声传感、统计特征选择和有监督机器学习相结合用于非接触式铁路车轮缺陷分类的可行性，为未来现场部署的检测系统奠定了基础。

title: SkillSmith: Enhancing Locally Deployed Agents via Automatic Skill Construction and Evolution
summary: LLM-based agent frameworks now act as personal assistants for multi-step tasks. Existing agent frameworks such as OpenClaw commonly follow the Cloud Agent depolyment mode using closed-source cloud LLMs as backbone model, which may expose private user information and incur repeated LLM-calling costs. Local Agents address these deployment concerns by depolying frontier open-source SLMs on user-controlled devices, but their task effectiveness still lags far behind Cloud Agents. Through diagnostic analysis, we reveal that the limited effectiveness of Local Agents with frontier SLM backbones mainly comes from missing environment knowledge caused by limited backbone model scale including environment rules and operation procedures. To supply such knowledge non-parametrically, context-efficiently, and without expert authoring, we present SkillSmith, a Cloud--Local Agent collaboration framework that uses Skill as a context-efficient knowledge carrier, automatic constructs Skill from Cloud Agent task exploration and evolves Skill using Local Agent execution feedback to enhance a frozen Local Agent. Experiments on daily agent task datasets AppWorld and WorkBench show that the automatically generated Skill enables the Local Agent with Qwen3.6-27B(SLM) to achieve task effectiveness comparable to Cloud Agents with frontier LLMs, outperform the strongest non-parametric baselines, reduce average actions per task from 36.1 to 9.9 on AppWorld-Normal, and generalize to other SLM backbone models without rerunning Skill construction.

AI.tldr: SkillSmith是一个云-本地智能体协作框架，通过自动构建和演进Skill知识载体，将云智能体探索中获取的环境知识非参数化、上下文高效地注入冻结的小语言模型（SLM）本地智能体，使其任务效果媲美云端大语言模型智能体，同时保留数据隐私和成本优势。
AI.motivation: 云端智能体依赖闭源大语言模型，存在隐私泄露风险和重复调用成本；本地智能体虽解决部署问题，但受限于小模型规模导致环境知识不足（环境规则和操作流程缺失），任务效果远落后于云端智能体。
AI.method: SkillSmith提出以Skill作为上下文高效的知识载体，从云智能体的任务探索中自动构建Skill，并通过本地智能体的执行反馈对Skill进行迭代演进。在推理时，将Skill以非参数化方式注入冻结的本地SLM智能体，无需微调模型或专家人工编写知识。
AI.result: 在AppWorld和WorkBench数据集上，Qwen3.6-27B(SLM)本地智能体配合SkillSmith生成的Skill，任务效果与使用前沿大语言模型的云端智能体相当；优于最强非参数基线；在AppWorld-Normal上每任务平均动作数从36.1降至9.9；Skill可泛化到其他SLM骨干模型，无需重新构建。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith验证了以Skill为媒介的云-本地智能体协作范式是可行且高效的：既能保留本地部署的隐私与成本优势，又能弥补小模型在环境知识上的不足，使本地SLM智能体达到云端LLM智能体的任务水平。

title: The Neural Division of Labor: Biologically-Inspired Modular Architectures for Robust Neuromorphic Computing
summary: Biological neural systems achieve high efficiency and robustness through compartmentalized architectures. In contrast, modern artificial neural networks rely on globally entangled structures, which obscure decision logic and suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Here, we report a Decomposable Spiking Neural Network (D-SNN) that eliminates global synaptic entanglement by structurally isolating classification pathways into independent experts. Optimized via a bio-inspired push-pull loss function, the D-SNN achieves competitive accuracies on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10/100 benchmarks. This modular approach matches the performance of fully dense networks while utilizing an order of magnitude fewer parameters. In addition, our networks operate with up to several orders of magnitude lower firing rates and fewer synaptic operations. Furthermore, physically severing connections between experts provides inherent protection against catastrophic forgetting during sequential learning. Crucially, these isolated pathways generate auditable neural signals, increasing decision transparency. This biomimetic, verifiable architecture establishes an efficient foundation for deploying deterministic neuromorphic intelligence in resource-constrained edge environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可分解脉冲神经网络（D-SNN），通过将分类路径结构性地隔离为独立专家来消除全局突触纠缠，在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10/100基准上达到与全稠密网络相当的精度，同时参数、发射率和突触操作数量均降低一个数量级以上，并且通过物理切断专家间连接天然抵御灾难性遗忘，产生可审计的神经信号以增强决策透明度。
AI.motivation: 生物神经系统通过区室化架构实现高效与鲁棒性，而现代人工神经网络依赖全局纠缠结构，导致决策逻辑不透明且存在灾难性遗忘问题。作者旨在借鉴生物系统的模块化设计，构建一种可分解、可审计且防遗忘的神经架构。
AI.method: 提出可分解脉冲神经网络（D-SNN），将分类路径结构性地分解为独立专家，消除全局突触纠缠；采用受生物学启发的推-拉（push-pull）损失函数进行优化；通过物理切断专家间连接来提供对灾难性遗忘的天然防护。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10/100上达到与全稠密网络相当的精度，同时参数使用量减少一个数量级，发射率和突触操作数降低数个数量级，且在顺序学习中展现对灾难性遗忘的固有抵抗能力。
AI.conclusion: 这种仿生、可验证的架构为在资源受限的边缘环境中部署确定性神经形态智能建立了高效基础，兼具性能竞争力、参数效率、低能耗和决策透明性。

title: Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities
summary: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lingjing，一个用于开放城市场景中异构多智能体具身智能的统一仿真平台。该平台从地理数据重建动态城市，同步多个物理引擎，提供Gym类接口支持用户自定义ReAct智能体和自然语言任务，并具备可归因回放功能。作者在共享引擎在环协议下评估了12个视觉语言模型在9个城市场景任务上的表现，揭示了地面定位和长时程执行方面的持续性瓶颈及协调中的性能权衡。
AI.motivation: 城市具身智能需要异构智能体（如无人机、地面机器人、自动驾驶车辆）在动态城市中的协调，现有仿真平台将不同具身形态隔离，并将任务设计与评估解耦，缺乏支持异构多智能体协调、任务定义和统一评估的一体化平台。
AI.method: Lingjing平台从地理数据重建并渲染演化中的城市，同步多个物理引擎，向智能体暴露共享物理及结构化城市状态。其Gym类接口支持用户自定义ReAct智能体，支持单/多智能体自然语言任务，具备星型或广播通信配置及资源约束。每个回合生成可归因回放，将智能体轨迹与通信连接至关系图变化、资源消耗和基于引擎的评估。
AI.result: 在共享引擎在环协议下，对12个视觉语言模型在9个城市任务上进行了评估。受控研究考察了通信、可扩展性、鲁棒性和失败溯源。结果显示地面定位和长时程执行存在持续性瓶颈；任务相关的协调权衡；增加模型容量带来递减收益；负载增加进一步降低成功率。
AI.conclusion: Lingjing提供了统一的测试平台，支持可复现的端到端评估和城市场景下多智能体具身智能的系统性失败诊断。

title: Spatial Heterogeneity-Aware Multi-Hazard Susceptibility and Risk Mapping at Regional Scale
summary: Floods and landslides often co-occur, but their relationships with environmental controls vary spatially. This study develops a spatial heterogeneity-aware framework for flood-landslide susceptibility and relative-risk mapping in Kerala, India, and Nepal. It combines 15 km x 15 km grid cells with region-specific contextual zones and compares proximity-gated cross-zone training (S1) and ecology-gated zone-constrained training (S2). S1 permits geographically nearby models to be assigned across contextual boundaries, whereas S2 restricts model development and assignment to the same zone. Random Forest models for each hazard use strategy-specific predictor sets and are evaluated on spatially held-out test samples. Susceptibility surfaces are integrated with CRITIC-weighted exposure and vulnerability indices to produce hazard-specific and nine-class bivariate relative-risk maps. S1 achieved higher mean accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, AUC-ROC, and PR-AUC for both hazards and regions. The largest difference occurred for Nepal flood susceptibility, where AUC-ROC increased from 0.728 under S2 to 0.886 under S1 and PR-AUC from 0.512 to 0.823. S2 produced lower Brier scores for both Nepal hazards and retained zone-specific differences in predictor selection, SHAP rankings, and response patterns, particularly in Kerala. Both strategies reproduced flood-prone lowland and landslide-prone upland patterns but differed in susceptibility and risk classes. Bivariate risk-map agreement was 0.521 in Kerala and 0.711 in Nepal, with allocation disagreement exceeding quantity disagreement in all S1-S2 comparisons. Susceptibility-to-risk correspondence remained below 0.350, showing that exposure and vulnerability changed priority locations. Overall, cross-zone learning strengthens regional discrimination, while zone-constrained learning preserves environmental differences, supporting their integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个空间异质性感知框架，用于绘制Kerala（印度）和Nepal的洪水-滑坡易发性及相对风险图，比较了邻近门控跨区域训练（S1）与生态门控区域约束训练（S2）两种策略。S1在所有性能指标上优于S2（如Nepal洪水AUC-ROC从0.728提升至0.886），但S2保留区域特定差异并获得更低Brier分数。两策略风险图一致性较低（0.521和0.711），易发性与风险对应性低于0.350，表明暴露和脆弱性显著改变了优先区域。
AI.motivation: 洪水与滑坡常同时发生，但其与环境控制因素的关系随空间变化，现有研究缺乏有效处理这种空间异质性的建模框架，需要开发能够兼顾区域差异与模型泛化能力的洪水-滑坡易发性和风险制图方法。
AI.method: 采用15km×15km网格，结合区域特定上下文区域（contextual zones）；提出两种训练策略：S1为邻近门控跨区域训练（允许地理邻近模型跨环境边界分配），S2为生态门控区域约束训练（限制模型开发与分配在同一区域）；使用随机森林模型分别构建易发性模型，以空间独立测试集评估；将易发性面与CRITIC加权暴露和脆弱性指数整合，生成九类双变量相对风险图。
AI.result: S1在两个区域和两种灾害上均获得更高的平均准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数、AUC-ROC和PR-AUC；最大差异出现在Nepal洪水易发性（AUC-ROC从0.728提升至0.886，PR-AUC从0.512提升至0.823）。S2在Nepal两种灾害上获得更低Brier分数。两策略风险图一致性在Kerala为0.521、Nepal为0.711，分配不一致在所有比较中均超过数量不一致；易发性与风险对应性低于0.350。
AI.conclusion: 跨区域学习增强区域判别能力，而区域约束学习保留环境差异，两种策略互为补充，支持整合使用以提升洪水-滑坡易发性和风险制图的可靠性。

title: JustLLMGRPO: Radiographic Control for Chest X-Ray Generation
summary: Text-conditioned chest X-ray generation aims to synthesize realistic radiographs that faithfully depict specified findings. Existing work has primarily improved quality by updating image generators, implicitly treating prompts as fixed after CXR-domain adaptation. We show that this generator-centric view leaves a substantial optimization dimension underexplored. With a CXR-adapted Sana generator frozen, one-pass reformulation by an unmodified LLM reduces RadDINO-FID from 54.225 to 27.572. Prompt analysis shows that the LLM suppresses temporal comparisons, uncertainty, and other non-renderable report content while emphasizing visible radiographic findings. However, unconstrained reformulation reduces BioViL-T alignment with source prompts from 0.695 to 0.609. We therefore introduce JustLLMGRPO, which applies standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) only to the LLM prompt policy while keeping Sana frozen. Group-relative radiology-aware image feedback retains visual focus while preserving source-prompt alignment. On CheXGenBench, JustLLMGRPO reduces RadDINO-FID to 26.780, a 50.6% improvement over direct prompting, while maintaining alignment (0.696 versus 0.695). It also achieves state-of-the-art distribution coverage and downstream classification utility. These results show that substantial performance can remain latent in how radiographic information is expressed to an adapted generator. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/pxcai/JustLLMGRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JustLLMGRPO，通过仅优化LLM提示策略（保持生成器冻结）来提升胸部X光生成质量。基线发现：一次性的LLM改写可将RadDINO-FID从54.225降至27.572，但会破坏与源提示的语义对齐；而将GRPO仅应用于提示策略后，RadDINO-FID进一步降至26.780（相对直提示改进50.6%），同时保持对齐度（0.696 vs 0.695）并取得SOTA的分布覆盖率和下游分类效用。
AI.motivation: 现有文本条件胸部X光生成研究主要聚焦于更新图像生成器，隐含地将提示视为固定输入。作者认为这一生成器中心的视角遗漏了一个重要的优化维度——即如何表达射线影像学信息给已适应的生成器，这一维度可能蕴含大量性能提升空间。
AI.method: 1) 先用未修改的LLM对提示进行一次改写（one-pass reformulation），发现可大幅降低RadDINO-FID，但会牺牲BioViL-T对齐。2) 提出JustLLMGRPO：在保持Sana生成器冻结的前提下，仅将标准GRPO应用于LLM提示策略，利用分组相对的影像感知反馈（radiology-aware image feedback）来优化提示改写方向，兼顾视觉聚焦与源提示对齐。
AI.result: 在CheXGenBench上，JustLLMGRPO将RadDINO-FID降至26.780（相对直接提示提升50.6%），BioViL-T对齐保持0.696（与基线0.695几乎持平），同时在分布覆盖率和下游分类效用上达到SOTA。提示分析表明LLM会抑制时间比较、不确定性等不可渲染内容，强调可见的影像学发现。
AI.conclusion: 胸部X光生成中，向已适配生成器表达影像信息的"表达方式"本身就是一个重要的优化维度。仅通过强化学习优化提示策略（不更新生成器）即可获得显著的生成质量提升，表明在生成器-提示联合优化中提示端的潜力被此前严重低估。

title: PRISM: A Predictive Protocol for Permutation Optimization via Landscape Diagnostics
comment: Preprint. Includes theoretical analysis, exhaustive permutation-landscape experiments, LLM instruction-ordering experiments, scientific machine learning pipeline studies, and neural architecture search benchmarks. Code and reproducibility artifacts available
summary: Permutation optimization arises whenever the components of a system are fixed but their ordering affects performance. We introduce PRISM, a predictive protocol for permutation optimization that measures a fitness landscape before selecting a search strategy. PRISM uses inexpensive landscape diagnostics, including one-step move autocorrelation and fitness-distance correlation, to predict useful mutation operators, identify when structured search is likely to outperform random sampling, and detect regimes in which search provides little advantage. Across synthetic permutation landscapes, neural architecture benchmarks, scientific machine learning pipelines, and large-language-model instruction ordering, the protocol makes testable predictions about search behavior before optimization begins. Exhaustive instruction-ordering experiments reveal substantial performance variation induced solely by permutation, while cross-model experiments show that useful ordering structure can transfer across model families and task difficulty. Additional experiments demonstrate that instruction ordering remains consequential after prompt wording is optimized, indicating that content optimization and ordering optimization are complementary. The results position PRISM not as a universally superior optimizer, but as a framework for determining when permutation search is useful, which representation and operator should be used, and when simpler alternatives are preferable.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个预测性协议，在开始排列优化之前通过廉价的景观诊断（如单步移动自相关和适应度-距离相关性）来预测搜索策略的有效性，帮助决定何时值得进行排列搜索、选择哪种表示和算子，以及何时简单方法更佳。
AI.motivation: 排列优化中组件的顺序会影响性能，但不同问题的最佳搜索策略差异很大。缺乏一种在优化开始前就能预测哪种搜索策略有效的方法，导致盲目选择优化器可能浪费计算资源或错过更好的方案。
AI.method: PRISM使用廉价的景观诊断工具（包括单步移动自相关和适应度-距离相关性）来：1) 预测有效的变异算子；2) 识别结构化搜索何时优于随机采样；3) 检测搜索收益甚微的场景。协议在多种排列景观（合成排列景观、神经架构基准、科学机器学习流水线、大语言模型指令排序）上进行验证。
AI.result: 穷尽性指令排序实验揭示了仅由排列引起的显著性能变化；跨模型实验表明有用的排序结构可以在不同模型家族和任务难度间迁移；额外实验证明在提示词内容优化后指令排序仍然重要，表明内容优化与排序优化是互补的。
AI.conclusion: PRISM不是一个万能更优的优化器，而是一个框架，用于判断排列搜索何时有用、应使用哪种表示和算子，以及何时简单替代方案更合适。

title: SodaMem: Evidence-Grounded Temporal Graph Memory for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that assist users over weeks of conversation must remember what is currently true, not merely what was once said. Flat RAG diaries and Markdown logs optimize needle retrieval but under-serve currency, provenance, and ordered temporal reasoning (Maharana et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2024; Packer et al. 2023; Chhikara et al. 2025). We present SodaMem, an evidence-grounded temporal graph memory that (i) extracts typed FactEvents with mandatory provenance spans, (ii) persists mention time, occurrence time, and validity with SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES edges under hybrid lexical-dense indexing, and (iii) answers via a planner-reader loop that gathers citable evidence before composing a final response. On LongMemEval-S, our store-of-record configuration reaches 92.8% accuracy (464/500; best of N=3) at mean $0.00161/question (approximately 18.3k tokens; median $0.00111 / approximately 14.6k) with deepseek-v4-flash. We compile public systems with estimable API cost into a cost table and cost-accuracy map; under these estimates SodaMem sits near the accuracy frontier at Flash-tier spend and strictly dominates several higher-cost, lower-accuracy points. Accuracy uses the same Flash model as reader and judge (self-grading); costs exclude ingest/judge and cross-system comparisons are compiled estimates rather than a single-harness bake-off.Our code is available at https://github.com/SodaMem/SodaMem

AI.tldr: SodaMem 是一个以证据为根基的时序图记忆系统，用于提升长期对话 LLM 代理的记忆准确性。它通过提取带出处标注的类型化事实事件（FactEvents），在混合词法-稠密索引下维护多重时间信息与 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 关系边，并采用 planner-reader 循环在作答前收集可引用证据。在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 92.8% 准确率（464/500），平均每题约 0.00161 美元（约 1.83 万 token），在 Flash 级成本下接近准确率前沿，并严格支配多个更高成本但更低准确率的系统。
AI.motivation: 现有长对话记忆方案（如平面 RAG 日志、Markdown 日志等）虽然在针式检索上表现良好，但无法充分满足记忆的现时性（currency）、来源可追溯性（provenance）与有序时间推理需求。代理在数周对话中需要记住"当前为真"的信息，而非仅"曾经被说过"的内容，这暴露了传统记忆结构在时间建模与证据支撑上的根本不足。
AI.method: SodaMem 提出证据驱动的时序图记忆架构，包含三大核心组件：(i) 提取带强制出处跨度（provenance spans）的类型化事实事件（FactEvents）；(ii) 同时持久化提及时间（mention time）、发生时间（occurrence time）与有效性（validity），并在混合词法-稠密索引（hybrid lexical-dense indexing）下构建 SUPERSEDES/CONTRADICTS/UPDATES 三种关系边；(iii) 通过 planner-reader 循环先收集可引用证据再组织最终回答。整体形成 store-of-record 配置，可在推理时兼顾检索效率与证据完整性。
AI.result: 在 LongMemEval-S 基准上，SodaMem 的 store-of-record 配置达到 92.8% 准确率（464/500，N=3 中的最优），平均每问题成本约 0.00161 美元（约 1.83 万 token），中位数约 0.00111 美元（约 1.46 万 token），使用 deepseek-v4-flash 模型。作者还将公开系统按估算 API 成本编译成成本表与成本-准确率映射图，显示 SodaMem 在 Flash 级成本下接近准确率前沿，并严格支配多个成本更高但准确率更低的系统。需要说明的是，准确率使用同一 Flash 模型作为 reader 和 judge（自评分），成本不含 ingest/judge 阶段，且跨系统比较为编译估算而非单一测试框架下的直接对比。
AI.conclusion: SodaMem 证明证据支撑的时序图记忆在面对长期对话场景时，能同时兼顾高准确率与低成本，相较于传统平面日志式记忆在溯源和时序推理上具有显著优势。其代码已开源，为后续研究提供了可复现的基线。
