summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routers commonly use the same scores both to select experts and to weight their already-computed outputs. We study whether these two roles, dispatch and aggregation, should be coupled. On pretrained OLMoE-1B-7B, we keep selected Top-8 expert IDs, expert computation, and total selected router mass fixed and change only within-set aggregation. A structured oracle improves full-horizon cross-entropy by 0.0160 +/- 0.0039 across three seeds; the router's top-scored expert is the counterfactual-best vertex only 17.2% of the time, with router-utility Spearman 0.030. We therefore train Fixed-Dispatch Adaptive Aggregation (FDAA), a 301K-parameter post-compute head optimized directly with the language-modeling objective while freezing the backbone, router, and experts. On OLMoE, FDAA improves fresh WikiText-103 test by Delta CE = -0.1523 +/- 0.0031 across three seeds, and mixed-domain training gives robust gains on WikiText-103, C4, and held-out Penn Treebank under frozen confirmatory evaluation. We also replicate the fixed-dispatch audit on DeepSeek-V2-Lite, which uses Top-6 routed experts plus shared experts. Best-vertex headroom remains significant on WikiText and C4, while router Top1 identifies the best selected expert in only 12.5% and 16.7% of audited examples. In a one-seed mixed-domain replication, FDAA improves locked WikiText and PTB, while C4 is statistically neutral. These results support a cross-architecture distinction between expert selection and expert commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稀疏MoE路由器中"调度"（dispatch）与"聚合"（aggregation）两种角色是否需要耦合。作者发现路由器最高分专家与反事实最优专家仅有17.2%重叠，因此提出仅301K参数的FDAA后计算头（post-compute head），在冻结主干、路由器和专家的前提下直接优化语言建模目标，在OLMoE上实现ΔCE=-0.1523的显著改善，并在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上验证了跨架构的通用性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE路由器通常用同一套分数既选择专家又加权专家输出，但这两项功能（调度与聚合）在数学上未必是最优耦合的。作者质疑这种耦合假设，希望通过实证检验两者是否应当解耦，从而获得更好的语言建模性能。
AI.method: 1) 在预训练OLMoE-1B-7B上固定Top-8专家ID、专家计算和总路由质量，仅改变集合内聚合权重，通过结构化oracle量化聚合改进的上限空间；2) 提出FDAA（Fixed-Dispatch Adaptive Aggregation），一个301K参数的轻量后计算头，在冻结主干、路由器和专家的情况下直接用LM目标优化聚合权重；3) 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite（Top-6路由+共享专家）上复现固定调度审计，进行跨架构验证。
AI.result: 在OLMoE上，结构化oracle将全序列交叉熵提升0.0160±0.0039；路由器最高分专家仅为反事实最优顶点的17.2%时间，Spearman相关系数仅0.030。FDAA在全新WikiText-103测试集上实现ΔCE=-0.1523±0.0039，混合域训练在WikiText-103、C4和保留的PTB上均有稳健提升。DeepSeek-V2-Lite上保留了显著的最佳顶点headroom，路由器Top1仅分别识别12.5%和16.7%的最佳选中专家；FDAA对WikiText和PTB有改进，C4在统计上中性。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明MoE中专家选择与专家承诺应被区分对待——调度权重的排序质量较差（与最优聚合相关性极低），而通过专门训练的轻量聚合头可以在不改变任何上游组件的情况下显著提升性能。这一发现跨OLMoE和DeepSeek-V2-Lite两种架构成立，支持调度与聚合解耦的通用设计原则。

title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification
summary: Astronomers classify galaxy morphology to investigate cosmic evolution. While deep foundation models are increasingly utilized in Galaxy Morphology Classification (GMC), little work has been done on evaluating the uncertainty of GMC results. Uncertainty evaluation is important because astronomical data are inherently noisy due to instrumental and environmental limitations. Also, the continuous evolution of galaxies creates intrinsic morphological ambiguity. However, current foundation models operate as deterministic point estimators, failing to quantify the uncertainty. To overcome this limitation, we propose UEGMC, a post-hoc framework of Uncertainty Estimation for Galaxy Morphology Classification. It categorizes uncertainty in GMC into distinct types by model parameters, astronomical data, reference standards, or intrinsic physical ambiguities, thereby facilitating better classification. Our framework can directly predict uncertainties from representations extracted from the frozen backbones of foundation models, without computationally expensive sampling, therefore enabling fine-grained uncertainty evaluations. Our experimental results demonstrate that UEGMC provides competitive uncertainty quantification performance compared with previous methods.

AI.tldr: UEGMC是一个用于星系形态分类（GMC）不确定性估计的事后（post-hoc）框架，能够从冻结的预训练基础模型骨干网络中提取表征直接预测不确定性，无需昂贵的采样过程，实现了细粒度不确定性评估。
AI.motivation: 天文数据因仪器和环境限制天然带有噪声，且星系连续演化导致形态存在内在模糊性，因此不确定性评估对星系形态分类至关重要。然而，现有基础模型作为确定性点估计器运行，无法量化不确定性，目前也缺乏对GMC结果不确定性的系统性评估工作。
AI.method: UEGMC将GMC中的不确定性按来源划分为四类：模型参数、天文数据、参考标准、内在物理模糊性。该框架直接从冻结的基础模型骨干网络提取的表征中预测不确定性，无需计算昂贵的采样过程，从而实现细粒度的不确定性评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，UEGMC相比以往方法在不确定性量化性能上具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UEGMC提供了一种高效且有效的事后不确定性估计方案，使基础模型在星系形态分类中不仅能给出分类结果，还能量化与之相关的不确定性，为天文学家在噪声和模糊条件下的分类决策提供了更可靠的支持。

title: Agentic Anomaly Detection with ORCA-Style Dynamic Inductive Bias Adaptation in Multimodal Wearable Time Series Data
summary: Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) generate multivariate physiological time series that are highly nonstationary and must often be processed under strict computational and memory constraints. A critical yet underexplored challenge in this setting is selecting an appropriate temporal receptive field, which serves as a strong inductive bias for anomaly detection models. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed temporal contexts, which can perform inconsistently across heterogeneous signal regimes and require dataset-specific tuning. We propose ORCA, an agentically controlled anomaly detection framework that dynamically adapts the temporal receptive field at inference time based on lightweight signal statistics. Rather than introducing additional trainable parameters or learned policies, ORCA employs a supervisory controller that autonomously selects among discrete temporal contexts, enabling state-dependent inductive bias adaptation without retraining. Across a custom WBAN dataset, ORCA achieves performance comparable to the strongest fixed-context baselines (AUROC = 0.99) while eliminating the need to tune temporal horizons in advance. We further evaluate ORCA on MIMIC-IV as a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark, observing conservative generalization behavior without performance collapse under heterogeneous clinical conditions. These results highlight adaptive temporal inductive bias control as a practical and robust design principle for anomaly detection in resource-constrained, nonstationary physiological time series.

AI.tldr: ORCA是一个基于智能体控制的自适应异常检测框架，在推理时根据轻量级信号统计动态调整时间感受野，无需额外可训练参数或预先调整时间窗口，在WBAN数据集上达到与最强固定上下文基线相当的AUROC=0.99，并在MIMIC-IV上展示了保守的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 无线体域网络（WBAN）生成的多变量生理时间序列具有高度非平稳性且需在严格计算和内存约束下处理，而选择合适的时间感受野（temporal receptive field）作为异常检测的强归纳偏置是尚未充分探索的关键挑战。现有方法依赖固定时间上下文，在不同信号状态下表现不一致且需针对数据集逐一调参。
AI.method: ORCA采用智能体控制的异常检测框架，通过监督控制器（supervisory controller）在推理时依据轻量级信号统计自动在离散时间上下文中选择，实现状态依赖的归纳偏置自适应。该方法不引入额外可训练参数或学习策略，也无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在自定义WBAN数据集上，ORCA达到AUROC=0.99，与最强固定上下文基线性能相当，但免除预先调整时间窗口的需求。在MIMIC-IV这一挑战性分布外基准上，ORCA表现出保守的泛化行为，在异质临床条件下未出现性能崩塌。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时间归纳偏置控制是资源受限、非平稳生理时间序列异常检测中实用且稳健的设计原则。

title: Forgotten History or Test-of-Time? Retrospect and Prospect on RAG from an IR Perspective
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely regarded as a novel paradigm born from the limitations of large language models (LLMs)--a mechanism to ground their outputs in external knowledge. This view, however, is incomplete when considered within a broader historical context. In this paper, we argue that the core ideas underlying RAG are not new: foundational concepts such as integrating retrieval and language generation, knowledge augmentation, answer verification, and iterative query (or prompt) refinement had already been studied and instantiated in information retrieval (IR) and question answering (QA) research dating back to the early 2000s, well before the emergence of LLMs.
  We make this case by systematically tracing the intellectual lineage of modern RAG and Agentic RAG back to their classical IR and QA antecedents, and examining why this continuity has gone under-recognized -- a consequence of community fragmentation, shifting terminology, and the recency bias endemic to fast-moving fields. Rather than treating LLMs as the origin point of retrieval-augmented intelligence, we propose viewing them as a new interface layer atop a decades-old QA architecture. This reframing is not merely historical: by situating RAG within the longer trajectory of IR research, we surface underutilized prior work -- on user modeling, answer validation, and query refinement -- that can directly inform next-generation RAG design, reducing unintentional rediscovery and fostering genuine cross-community integration.

AI.tldr: 本文论证RAG（检索增强生成）的核心思想并非LLM时代的新创，而是早在2000年代初的经典信息检索和问答研究中就已提出并实现。作者将现代RAG和Agentic RAG的思想谱系系统性地回溯至传统IR和QA的前身，并认为LLM只是这一数十年历史问答架构之上的新接口层，而非检索增强智能的起点。
AI.motivation: RAG被普遍视为源于LLM局限性的全新范式，但作者认为这一观点在更广阔的历史背景下是不完整的。这种"知识盲区"导致研究者忽视已有的经典IR/QA研究成果，造成重复发明（unintentional rediscovery），阻碍跨社区整合和下一代RAG系统设计。作者旨在纠正这一历史认知偏差。
AI.method: 作者采用系统性的思想谱系追溯方法，将现代RAG和Agentic RAG的核心组件（检索与生成整合、知识增强、答案验证、迭代式查询/提示词精化）逐一映射回2000年代早期的IR和QA研究，并分析这些连续性未被充分认识的原因——包括社区碎片化、术语演变以及快速进展领域的近因偏差（recency bias）。
AI.result: 作者确认RAG的核心概念（检索与生成整合、知识增强、答案验证、迭代查询精化）在LLM出现之前就已在经典IR和QA研究中得到研究和实例化；识别出连续性未被认识的根本原因（社区碎片化、术语漂移、近因偏差）；并提出将LLM视为数十年QA架构之上新接口层的重构视角。
AI.conclusion: 将RAG置于更长的IR研究轨迹中不仅具有历史意义，还能发掘出被忽视的既有工作——如用户建模、答案验证和查询精化——这些可直接为下一代RAG设计提供借鉴，减少重复发明，促进跨社区的真正整合。

title: Approximation Rates for Metaplectic Neural Networks
summary: In this paper we develop quantitative approximation results for shallow neural networks constructed using a dictionary based on metaplectic operators. First, we extend the concept of Barron spaces by considering a symplectically motivated extension of the Fourier transform, known as the metaplectic transform. Then, after establishing embedding between metaplectic Barron spaces and Sobolev spaces we consider a neural metaplectic dictionary and we prove Monte-Carlo approximation bounds for metaplectic Barron functions using finite linear combinations of atoms of the dictionary. Finally, we validate the introduction of the neural metaplectic dictionary by devising a deep neural network architecture that uses as building blocks the atoms of the dictionary. We test it to approximate solutions of time-dependent Schrödinger equations, demonstrating better performance compared to classical phyisics informed neural networks architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文基于metaplectic算子构建了浅层神经网络的定量逼近理论，扩展了Barron空间的概念，证明了metaplectic Barron空间与Sobolev空间的嵌入关系，并给出了Monte-Carlo逼近界，最后通过一种使用metaplectic字典原子的深度神经网络架构在时变薛定谔方程逼近中取得了优于经典物理信息神经网络的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有浅层神经网络的逼近理论主要基于Fourier变换及其对应的Barron空间，但面对量子力学等领域的非平稳信号或含有特定振荡结构的函数时，经典Fourier工具缺乏足够的灵活性。作者希望利用辛几何动机下的metaplectic变换这一更广泛的积分变换框架，来扩展Barron空间的概念并建立更通用的神经网络逼近理论，从而更好地处理量子力学中的薛定谔方程等具有特殊结构的问题。
AI.method: 本文首先将Barron空间的概念推广到基于metaplectic变换的metaplectic Barron空间；随后建立该空间与Sobolev空间之间的嵌入关系；接着构造基于metaplectic算子的神经网络字典（neural metaplectic dictionary），并利用Monte-Carlo方法证明有限原子线性组合对这些空间中函数的逼近误差上界；最后设计一种以该字典原子为基本构建块的深度神经网络架构，将其应用于求解时变薛定谔方程。
AI.result: 作者证明了metaplectic Barron空间与Sobolev空间之间的嵌入关系，获得了metaplectic Barron函数用有限字典原子线性组合近似的Monte-Carlo逼近界。数值实验表明，所提出的基于metaplectic字典的深度神经网络在逼近时变薛定谔方程的解时，性能优于经典的物理信息神经网络架构。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入metaplectic变换将Barron空间理论推广到更一般的情形，为浅层和深度神经网络的定量逼近分析提供了新的理论框架，并在量子动力学问题中验证了其实际优势，表明基于辛几何结构的字典构造能更有效地捕获量子系统中固有的振荡结构。

title: TRACE-Memory: Public-Conditioned Retrieval and Utility-Aware Evidence Admission for Personalized Generation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
summary: Personalized generation systems retrieve user history by request--memory relevance and inject it into the model context. Yet relevant history may concern the wrong preference aspect, duplicate public information, or provide insufficient support. We argue that personal memory should be used only when it adds utility beyond a public-only response. We propose TRACE-Memory, a two-stage framework for selective personalization. Stage 1 queries for user-specific information missing from the request and public context, then retrieves a coverage-oriented candidate pool. Stage 2 admits a compact subset of source-traceable evidence units, or the empty set, according to response-level incremental utility. We progressively train the query-generation and evidence-admission policies through structured SFT initialization, reduced-space stage-wise GRPO warm-up, and nested multi-sample Joint GRPO. Across 4,500 Controlled and Natural tasks from Goodreads, Amazon Reviews, and Reddit, TRACE-Memory consistently outperforms random and lexical memory use, improves over semantic retrieval, remains competitive with frontier-LLM memory pipelines as local generator capacity increases, and conditions evidence admission on public-context sufficiency, supporting selective rather than default personalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE-Memory，一个两阶段选择性个性化框架：第一阶段生成查询以检索覆盖用户特定信息缺失的候选池，第二阶段根据响应级增量效用选择少量可溯源证据单元（或空集）。通过结构化SFT初始化、降维逐步GRPO热身及嵌套多样本Joint GRPO渐进训练策略，在Goodreads、Amazon Reviews和Reddit的4,500个任务上优于随机和词法检索，接近甚至超越前沿LLM记忆管线。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化生成系统仅依据请求-记忆相关性检索用户历史并注入上下文，但相关历史可能涉及错误的偏好方面、重复公共信息或提供不足支持。因此记忆不应对用户产生效用性收益时应被摒弃，需要建立一种仅当记忆超越纯公共响应效用时才使用的选择性个性化机制。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) Stage 1：查询生成——识别请求与公共上下文中缺失的用户特定信息，检索覆盖导向的候选记忆池；(2) Stage 2：证据准入——根据响应级增量效用，选择紧凑的可溯源证据单元子集或空集。训练采用结构化SFT初始化、降维空间逐步GRPO热身、嵌套多样本联合GRPO的渐进式策略。
AI.result: 在Goodreads、Amazon Reviews、Reddit的4,500个Controlled和Natural任务上，TRACE-Memory一致优于随机和词法记忆使用；相对于语义检索有提升；随本地生成器容量增加可与前沿LLM记忆管线竞争；并能在公共上下文充足时学习有条件地拒绝记忆注入，支持选择性而非默认个性化的行为。
AI.conclusion: 个性化记忆应基于其增量效用被选择性使用而非默认注入；TRACE-Memory通过覆盖导向检索与效用驱动证据准入，实现更精准、可溯源的个性化，同时避免了公共信息冗余和无关偏好干扰。

title: DistillCache: KL-Guided Adaptive KV-Cache Eviction for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many tasks, but their Key-Value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length, creating a severe memory bottleneck for long-context inference. Existing heuristic eviction methods (e.g., H$_2$O and SnapKV) rely on static attention or positional signals that often fail to capture a token's future predictive influence. We propose DistillCache, a reinforcement learning framework that formulates KV-cache eviction as a sequential decision problem. DistillCache learns a lightweight policy network using rich internal model signals (attention statistics, value norms, entropy, and position) and trains it with REINFORCE via a per-step KL-divergence reward to preserve the full-cache output distribution. On a 7B-parameter instruction-tuned Transformer (Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3), DistillCache retains 94.2% of full-cache accuracy on LongBench at a 25% cache budget, outperforming both strong heuristic baselines (H$_2$O, SnapKV) by up to 2.7 absolute points and, under our re-implementations, concurrent RL-based methods (ForesightKV, RLKV) by up to 1.4 points on long-context tasks. On reasoning benchmarks, DistillCache is competitive with the best concurrent method and surpasses it under aggressive compression. It also delivers up to 2.1x full-cache throughput while maintaining competitive practical efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of learned, distribution-aware policies for memory-efficient long-context LLM inference.

AI.tldr: DistillCache是一个基于强化学习的KV缓存淘汰框架，将缓存驱逐建模为序列决策问题，通过轻量策略网络学习，在25%缓存预算下于LongBench上保留94.2%的全缓存准确率，比启发式基线高2.7个绝对点，比同类RL方法高1.4个点，并实现最高2.1倍吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: Transformer大语言模型的长上下文推理面临KV缓存随序列长度线性增长的严重内存瓶颈。现有启发式驱逐方法（如H₂O和SnapKV）依赖静态注意力或位置信号，难以捕捉token对未来预测的影响，缺乏对token预测影响力的动态认知，亟需更智能的缓存管理策略。
AI.method: 将KV缓存驱逐建模为顺序决策问题，使用REINFORCE强化学习算法训练一个轻量策略网络。策略网络的输入特征包括注意力统计量、值范数、熵和位置等丰富的模型内部信号。奖励函数采用逐步骤的KL散度奖励，以保持全缓存输出分布为目标来优化驱逐决策。
AI.result: 在Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3上，DistillCache在25%缓存预算下于LongBench保留94.2%的全缓存准确率，比H₂O和SnapKV高最多2.7个绝对点，比同类RL方法（ForesightKV、RLKV）高最多1.4个点。在推理基准上竞争力强，激进压缩下超越最佳同类方法。吞吐量最高提升2.1倍，同时保持竞争力的实际效率。
AI.conclusion: DistillCache验证了学习型的、分布感知的KV淘汰策略在内存高效长上下文LLM推理中的有效性，展示了强化学习结合模型内部信号进行缓存管理的优越性。

title: What Keeps Agent Skills from Being Reusable? Evidence from 138K SKILL.md Files
summary: Under the current standard, Agent Skills are SKILL.md files that combine instructions with supporting resources, enabling Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures beyond a single conversation. Yet many public skills appear to originate from a single task, repository, or conversation, even when they are shared as reusable components. We analyze this gap across 138,133 public SKILL.md files from 20,556 repositories using a two-tier defect taxonomy grounded in the official specification and best-practice guidance. We find that 91.8% of skills contain at least one detected defect, with stable estimates across lenient and strict thresholds (88.8-94.6%). The dominant failures are ordinary packaging problems rather than exotic attacks: weak routing metadata, bloated or non-actionable bodies, and poor resource organization. A deterministic routing stress test over 20,000 skills shows the functional impact: skills with valid routing metadata are retrieved more reliably from startup descriptions than skills with routing defects. Defect rates vary by platform and provenance: specification-aware skills contain fewer defects, while AI-marked skills show more safety and portability problems. Lightweight enforcement and repair experiments support a quality-assured generation workflow combining spec-aware prompting, lightweight linting, automated repair, and safety gating.

AI.tldr: 本文对138,133个公开SKILL.md文件（来自20,556个仓库）进行了系统性缺陷分析，发现91.8%的Agent技能文件至少存在一个缺陷。缺陷主要类型为弱路由元数据、臃肿或不可行动的主体、资源组织不善等普通打包问题，而非恶意攻击。路由压力测试表明元数据有效的技能检索更可靠，且缺陷率因平台和来源而异。作者提出了一种结合规范感知提示、轻量级linting、自动修复和安全门控的质量保障生成工作流。
AI.motivation: 尽管Agent Skills被设计为可复用的组件，但许多公开发布的技能文件实际上源自单一任务、仓库或对话，缺乏真正的可复用性。这种"声称可复用"与"实际可复用"之间的差距阻碍了LLM代理生态系统的健康发展，需要通过系统性分析来量化和理解这一问题。
AI.method: 基于官方规范和最佳实践指南，构建了一个两层缺陷分类体系（two-tier defect taxonomy），对138,133个来自20,556个仓库的公共SKILL.md文件进行分析。使用宽松和严格两种阈值进行评估以获得稳定估计，并进行确定性的路由压力测试（20,000个技能）来验证路由元数据缺陷的功能影响，同时按平台和来源（如AI标记的技能）对比缺陷率差异。
AI.result: 91.8%的技能至少包含一个检测到的缺陷（宽松阈值88.8%至严格阈值94.6%）。主要缺陷为普通打包问题：弱路由元数据、内容臃肿/不可操作、资源组织不佳。路由压力测试表明元数据有效的技能从启动描述中检索更可靠。平台和来源差异显著：规范感知的技能缺陷更少，AI标记技能在安全性和可移植性方面问题更多。
AI.conclusion: 当前Agent Skills生态存在普遍的质量缺陷，需要通过轻量级执行（lightweight enforcement）和修复实验来改善。作者提出了一个质量保障的生成工作流，结合规范感知提示、轻量级linting、自动修复和安全门控，以提升技能文件的质量和可复用性。

title: Federated Attention Autoencoders with a Stochastic Aggregation Scheme for Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted and presented at the 3rd International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2025)
summary: Outlier detection in decentralized data environments is a challenging task for many machine learning implementations, particularly in settings where data cannot be shared. Recently, there have been advances in federated outlier detection, some of which are based on the use of autoencoder networks. The introduction of attention mechanisms to autoencoders boosts their efficiency. However, the application of attention-based models in federated learning remains underdeveloped due to the absence of proper aggregation functions for these types of networks. In our work, we propose two novel aggregation functions tailored for attention-based autoencoders, which better preserve the learned information stored within the memory modules of these networks. We evaluated our approach on the KDDCUP10 dataset, and we showed that the proposed methods achieve up to 2.9\% and 5.1\% better results for F1 score and AUC ROC respectively when compared to traditional autoencoders.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出两种针对基于注意力机制的自动编码器的新型聚合函数，用于联邦学习环境下的异常检测。在KDDCUP10数据集上，相比传统自动编码器，F1分数提升2.9%，AUC ROC提升5.1%。
AI.motivation: 联邦异常检测中，基于自动编码器的方法已有进展，而注意力机制的引入能提升自动编码器效率。然而，由于缺乏适当的聚合函数，注意力模型在联邦学习中的应用尚未成熟，这成为该领域发展的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出两种专门针对基于注意力的自动编码器设计的新型聚合函数，旨在更好地保留这些网络中记忆模块内存储的已学习信息。
AI.result: 在KDDCUP10数据集上，所提出的方法相比传统自动编码器，F1分数提升最高达2.9%，AUC ROC提升最高达5.1%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的两种针对注意力自动编码器的聚合函数能够有效提升联邦异常检测性能，解决注意力模型在联邦学习中因缺乏合适聚合函数而受限的问题。

title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
summary: Modern LLM agents are often improved by modifying prompts, tools, or workflows manually, while the executable scaffold surrounding the model---the \emph{harness}---is typically treated as a fixed artifact after deployment. This work studies an alternative where the harness is \emph{task-specific and continuously evolvable}: each task family maintains its own harness, which is hot-swapped across iterations through a fixed task-injection seam and rewritten using environment feedback. We introduce \textbf{Hierarchical Self-Improvement (HSI)}, a framework in which a single frozen LLM $M$ operates across three hierarchical scopes: a task harness $H$ that executes tasks, an evolver that rewrites $H$, and a meta-evolver that rewrites the evolver's strategy code under a frozen outer anchor. A thinking-on/off design isolates the contribution of harness evolution by disabling reasoning during task execution while enabling it during self-modification. HSI is bounded by two factors: a \emph{feedback-fidelity bound}, since evolution requires informative reward signals to guide selection, and a \emph{backbone capability bound}, since harness redesign cannot overcome limitations of the frozen model. On BALROG with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview as the frozen backbone, HSI achieves consistent gains over the initial harness on moderate-difficulty tasks ($+39.3$ on BabyAI, $+33.0$ on Crafter, $+25.0$ on TextWorld, and $+15.0$ on MiniHack, all in raw \% Progress), while obtaining strong held-out generalization on BabaIsAI sub-suites ($0.98$ best-test on BreakStop and $1.00$ on GoTo from a $20\%$ unseen split). On tasks beyond the backbone's capability (NLE), harness evolution provides no improvement. These results demonstrate task-specific harness evolution as a viable axis for improving frozen LLM agents under clear empirical limits. Code is available at https://github.com/TailinZhou/hsi.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层自改进（HSI）框架，让冻结的LLM在三层作用域中自修改执行任务的"harness"（脚手架）：任务harness执行任务、evolver重写harness、meta-evolver重写evolver策略。采用thinking-on/off设计隔离harness演化的贡献，证明任务特定harness演化是提升冻结LLM智能体的可行方向，并明确了反馈保真度与骨干能力两个边界。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的改进通常通过手动修改提示词、工具或工作流，而围绕模型的可执行脚手架（harness）在部署后被视为固定不变。本文质疑这一假设，提出harness应当是任务特定且可持续演化的，从而探索一个被忽视的改进维度。
AI.method: HSI框架采用三层层级：1）任务harness H执行任务；2）evolver重写H；3）meta-evolver在冻结的外层锚下重写evolver的策略代码。通过thinking-on/off设计，在任务执行时禁用推理以隔离harness演化的独立贡献，在自修改时启用推理。系统受两个界约束：反馈保真度界（演化依赖信息丰富的奖励信号）和骨干能力界（harness重设计无法超越冻结模型的能力上限）。
AI.result: 以DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Preview为冻结骨干，在BALROG基准上中等难度任务较初始harness获得一致提升：BabyAI +39.3、Crafter +33.0、TextWorld +25.0、MiniHack +15.0（均以raw % Progress计）；在BabaIsAI子套件上展现强泛化能力（20%未见分割下BreakStop最佳测试0.98、GoTo达1.00）。对超出骨干能力的NLE任务，harness演化无提升。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的harness演化是在清晰经验边界内提升冻结LLM智能体的一条有效途径。该发现证实了"脚手架可演化"这一设计范式，但同时也指出其受制于反馈信号的质量和冻结骨干的固有能力的双重限制。

title: A Domain-Structured Ensemble Framework for Perioperative Outcome Prediction Using Electronic Health Record Data
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2026)
summary: Perioperative risk prediction models are often limited by narrow surgical populations, incomplete intraoperative data, poor calibration, and limited interpretability. We present a domain-structured ensemble framework for perioperative outcome prediction using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data. Predictors are organized into patient-related, surgery-related, and anesthetics-related domains. Domain-specific gradient boosting models generate independent risk estimates that are integrated through a logistic regression meta-learner. We demonstrate the framework using postoperative delirium (POD) in a case-control sample of 5,386 surgical encounters (2,693 cases, 2,693 controls) from a statewide health information exchange. POD required both delirium-related ICD codes and a positive Confusion Assessment Method screening within seven postoperative days; patients with preexisting dementia were excluded. The stacked meta-learner achieved AUROC 0.899 (95% CI: 0.891-0.906), precision-recall AUC 0.881, and Brier score 0.126, compared with AUROC 0.849 for the best single-stage model. Domain ablation showed improved discrimination and calibration over a surgery-only model (AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140). Temporal validation on held-out post-2017 data yielded AUROC 0.915. Calibration was excellent, with intercept -0.006 (95% CI: -0.083 to 0.070) and slope 1.035 (95% CI: 0.982 to 1.088). Decision curve analysis, corrected for case-control sampling, showed positive net benefit across clinically plausible thresholds. The modular framework supports alternative outcomes, extension of predictor domains, and dynamic risk updating, providing a scalable foundation for interpretable, calibration-aware perioperative clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于领域结构化集成框架的围术期风险预测模型，利用电子健康记录（EHR）数据，将预测因子分为患者、手术和麻醉三个领域，通过梯度提升模型分别生成独立风险评估，再由逻辑回归元学习器进行集成。在5,386例手术病例（2,693例病例，2,693例对照）的术后谵妄（POD）预测中，该框架达到AUROC 0.899，优于最佳单阶段模型的0.849，在时间验证（AUROC 0.915）、校准性能和决策曲线分析中均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有围术期风险预测模型受限于狭窄的手术人群、不完整的术中数据、较差的校准性能以及有限的可解释性，亟需一种能够整合多领域信息、具有良好校准性和可解释性的预测框架。
AI.method: 提出一种领域结构化集成框架：预测因子按患者相关、手术相关和麻醉相关三个领域分组，各领域分别训练梯度提升模型生成独立风险估计，再通过逻辑回归元学习器（stacking）整合为最终预测。研究使用全州健康信息交换平台的5,386例手术记录（1:1病例对照设计）验证，POD定义需同时满足谵妄相关ICD编码和术后7天内Confusion Assessment Method阳性筛查，排除术前痴呆患者。
AI.result: 集成元学习器AUROC达0.899（95% CI: 0.891-0.906），精确率-召回率AUC为0.881，Brier分数为0.126，优于最佳单阶段模型的AUROC 0.849。领域消融实验显示优于仅手术模型（AUROC 0.879, Brier 0.140）。在2017年后时间验证数据上AUROC达0.915。校准极佳（截距-0.006，斜率为1.035），决策曲线分析在临床合理阈值区间内呈正净获益。
AI.conclusion: 该模块化框架支持替代结局、扩展预测领域及动态风险更新，为可解释、校准感知的围术期临床决策支持提供了可扩展的基础设施。

title: Idea Search: Guiding Tree Search with Ideas to Explore Diverse Scientific Methods
summary: Tree Search-based test-time scaling of LLMs is a powerful tool for automated scientific coding. However, pure Tree Search sometimes struggles with systematic exploration, becoming trapped in local optima, or unproductive loops, especially in the vast search space of scientific methods. To address this limitation, we propose Idea Search, a framework that systematically integrates a dynamic "Idea Bank" into Tree Search. Idea Search involves three steps: (1) decomposing existing methods into atomic ideas, (2) sampling from this bank of ideas to guide branches of code mutations, and (3) dynamically updating the bank with new ideas discovered through execution. On single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) batch integration, Idea Search reliably breaks the plateau of a strong pure Tree Search baseline, improving the mean score from 0.678 to 0.697 and reaching a best score of 0.728. We then characterize which design choices drive these gains: bank augmentation helps bandit sampling but not random sampling, "Exploratory" prompting that prioritizes new ideas surfaces the rare best-performing solutions, while increasing sampling-level exploration is counterproductive.

AI.tldr: 思想库（Idea Search）框架，通过将树搜索与动态"思想库"相结合，将科学编码中LLM测试时扩展的均值分数从0.678提升到0.697，最佳分数达0.728。
AI.motivation: 纯树搜索在科学方法的巨大搜索空间中容易陷入局部最优或无效循环，缺乏系统性探索能力，难以有效突破性能瓶颈。
AI.method: Idea Search三步流程：(1)将现有方法分解为原子思想；(2)从思想库中采样以引导代码突变分支；(3)基于执行结果动态更新思想库，不断纳入新发现的思路。
AI.result: 在scRNA-seq批次整合任务上，Idea Search显著突破纯树搜索基线的性能瓶颈，平均分数从0.678提升至0.697，最佳分数达0.728。消融研究显示：库增强对bandit采样有效但对随机采样无效；优先探索新思想的"Exploratory"提示能发现罕见的高性能解；而增加采样级探索反而有害。
AI.conclusion: Idea Search通过动态思想库为树搜索提供结构化的先验知识，有效克服了纯树搜索的系统性探索不足问题，并揭示了设计选择（如采样策略与提示方式）对性能的关键影响。

title: Aero Realtime: Fully Aligned Input-Output Streams for Low-Latency Streaming Multimodal Generation
summary: Existing streaming multimodal models process observations incrementally but still follow a turn-based prefill-then-decode pattern, making them non-duplex: new observations cannot naturally enter an active generation stream. Proactive alternatives use micro-turn polling or external response gates, which fragment continuous interaction, decouple response timing from language generation, and complicate KV-cache-friendly serving. We introduce Aero Realtime, a 4B streaming multimodal model with a duplex architecture for realtime generation. Aero Realtime aligns video, audio, and textual output on a shared temporal grid, where each approximately 80-ms audio slot predicts either a lexical token or a silence token. This allows input and output to advance together, enabling one autoregressive objective to learn both when to respond and what to generate. During inference, Aero Realtime appends only the newest multimodal slot, carries forward the previous output state, and reuses the KV cache for efficient incremental execution. We further provide a complete training and serving recipe, including realtime QA construction, slot-aligned supervision, hardware-aware distributed training, and resumable inference. On four NVIDIA A6000 workstation GPUs, Aero Realtime maintains 84-ms median and 173-ms P95 processing lag over 20 minutes of a continuously streamed video, remaining within 200~ms of the source timeline. These results demonstrate the feasibility of fully aligned input-output modeling for duplex, proactive, and hardware-aligned multimodal interaction.

AI.tldr: Aero Realtime 是一个4B参数的流式多模态模型，通过将视频、音频和文本输出对齐到共享时间网格（每约80ms的音频槽预测词元或静默词元），实现输入输出同时推进的双工架构，在推理时仅追加最新多模态槽并复用KV缓存实现高效增量执行。在四块A6000 GPU上实现了84ms中位数和173ms P95的处理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有流式多模态模型仍遵循基于回合的"预填充-解码"模式，新观测无法自然进入活跃生成流，导致非双工交互。主动式替代方案（微轮询或外部响应门控）会碎片化连续交互，使响应时序与语言生成脱钩，并增加KV缓存友好的服务复杂度。
AI.method: 1) 架构：4B流式多模态模型，将视频、音频、文本输出对齐到共享时间网格，每个约80ms的音频槽预测词元或静默词元；2) 训练：单一自回归目标同时学习何时响应和生成什么；3) 推理：仅追加最新多模态槽，保留前一输出状态，复用KV缓存实现增量执行；4) 提供完整训练与服务方案，包括实时QA构建、槽对齐监督、硬件感知分布式训练和可恢复推理。
AI.result: 在四块NVIDIA A6000工作站GPU上，Aero Realtime在连续20分钟流式视频中保持84ms中位数和173ms P95处理延迟，保持在源时间线200ms以内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了完全对齐的输入-输出建模在双工、主动式和硬件对齐的多模态交互中的可行性，为流式多模态系统提供了高效的架构方案。

title: Gradient Under Microscope: Benchmarking Resource Utilization of Memory-Efficient Gradient Computation Methods
summary: AI training's rising resource intensity is straining electricity supplies and carbon budgets, motivating systematic study of memory-efficient training on constrained hardware. We benchmark five gradient optimizers (SGD, Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta, and Conjugate Gradient Descent) under three memory strategies (standard training, gradient checkpointing, and gradient accumulation) across four transformer architectures (ViT, ModernBERT, Llama 3.1 1B, and NanoVLM), measuring training loss, GPU utilization, training time, and memory usage. Gradient accumulation emerges as the most reliable strategy, cutting training loss by roughly an order of magnitude on the vision-language model and about four-fold on the language model without additional GPU memory. Contrary to common practice, Adam is not universally superior: Adadelta and SGD outperform it on the encoder and autoregressive architectures. Gradient checkpointing's effect is strongly architecture-dependent, improving vision transformer loss while severely degrading the encoder model, and it increases training time by up to 60% on memory-bound models. GPU utilization is governed primarily by architecture, ranging from 8-15% for the memory-bound language model to 96-99% for compute-bound vision models. These findings provide practical guidelines for optimizer and gradient-strategy selection in resource-efficient model training and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文在受限硬件条件下系统基准测试了五种梯度优化器（SGD、Adam、Adagrad、Adadelta和共轭梯度下降）与三种内存策略（标准训练、梯度检查点和梯度累积）在四种Transformer架构上的表现。研究发现梯度累积是最可靠的内存策略，Adadelta和SGD在特定架构上优于Adam，GPU利用率主要由架构决定（8%-99%不等）。
AI.motivation: AI训练的算力和资源消耗日益加剧，对电力供应和碳预算造成压力，亟需在受限硬件上进行内存高效训练的系统研究，以指导和优化资源受限场景下的模型训练策略。
AI.method: 设计了一个综合基准实验：在ViT、ModernBERT、Llama 3.1 1B和NanoVLM四种Transformer架构上，交叉测试五种优化器（SGD、Adam、Adagrad、Adadelta、共轭梯度下降）与三种内存策略（标准训练、梯度检查点、梯度累积），并测量训练损失、GPU利用率、训练时间和内存占用五个指标。
AI.result: 梯度累积被证明是最可靠的策略，在视觉语言模型上降低训练损失约一个数量级，在语言模型上约四倍，且不增加额外GPU内存。Adam并非普遍最优：Adadelta和SGD在编码器和自回归架构上表现更优。梯度检查点效果高度依赖架构：改善ViT损失但严重损害编码器模型，且对内存受限模型增加多达60%的训练时间。GPU利用率主要受架构支配，内存受限的语言模型仅为8-15%，计算受限的视觉模型达96-99%。
AI.conclusion: 研究为资源高效模型训练与部署中的优化器和梯度策略选择提供了实用指南，强调了策略选择需结合具体架构特性，而非一味遵循常用惯例（如默认选择Adam）。

title: Yesterday's Shield, Today's Spear: A Self-Evolving Safety Guardrail in Production
summary: Deployed LLM safety guardrails are predominantly static: trained once and frozen at release, while new jailbreak techniques and previously un-addressed harmful categories emerge within days, leaving the defense perpetually a step behind. We present SESG (Self-Evolving Safety Guardrails), a multi-agent system running in production. SESG monitors the live traffic behind a deployed guardrail and surfaces two classes of failure: jailbreaks novel in form and harmful categories novel in content. Once a failure is confirmed, a generation agent synthesizes paired training data targeted at it; a validation agent rebalances the batch toward the direction in which the deployed model errs, so that the model's own mistakes steer its training set; and a routing agent matches the training action to the diagnosed gap and returns the next version to production. Over six rounds of live evolution (V0 to V6), a 1.7B guardrail adapts to a new threat in 16-24 hours, with about 2 hours of human effort, versus the 40-90 hours of the manual process it replaces. On six emerging threats, it outperforms static guardrails from 0.6B to 9B and an adaptive baseline while preserving its general screening competence. Since April 2026, SESG has been the primary update pipeline of Sangfor's guardrail, autonomously closing 14 of 15 new threat scenarios in two months. We release 9 test sets for the 6 new threats at https://github.com/Trams1017/SESG. Warning: This paper contains examples that may be harmful or offensive.

AI.tldr: SESG是一个生产环境中的自进化LLM安全护栏系统，通过多智能体架构（生成、验证、路由）监控实时流量、自动识别新型越狱攻击和有害内容类别，并自动生成训练数据、平衡训练批次、重新部署更新版本。在六轮迭代中，1.7B模型可在16-24小时内适应新威胁（约2小时人工投入），显著优于传统40-90小时的人工流程和静态护栏。
AI.motivation: 部署的LLM安全护栏本质上是静态的——训练一次后在发布时冻结，而新的越狱技术和未解决的有害类别在几天内就会出现，导致防御系统始终滞后于攻击。
AI.method: SESG采用多智能体架构：监控代理实时监测已部署护栏后的流量并识别两类失败（形式上新颖的越狱和内容上新颖的有害类别）；生成代理合成针对性的成对训练数据；验证代理将批次重平衡到部署模型出错的方向，让模型自身错误引导训练集；路由代理将训练动作与诊断出的差距匹配并发布下一版本到生产环境。
AI.result: 经六轮在线进化（V0到V6），1.7B护栏在16-24小时内适应新威胁（约2小时人工），对比替代的40-90小时手动流程。在6个新兴威胁上优于0.6B到9B的静态护栏和自适应基线，同时保持通用筛查能力。自2026年4月起作为Sangfor护栏的主要更新管道，两个月内自主关闭15个新威胁场景中的14个。发布了9个测试集。
AI.conclusion: SESG证明安全护栏可以在生产环境中实现自主进化闭环，通过让模型的错误引导训练方向，大幅缩短从新威胁出现到防御更新的时间窗口，同时保持通用筛查能力不退化，是现有静态护栏架构的有效替代方案。

title: Math-Vision Diagrams: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Mathematical Diagram Generation Capabilities
summary: The generation of mathematically precise diagrams from tex- tual prompts has emerged as a critical yet underexplored capability of Large Language Models (LLMs). This has been of interest to researchers in the areas of curriculum preparation, automated ranking of problem sets, and scientific publishing. For LLMs to achieve this, it requires per- fect coordination between Spatial Reasoning, Mathematical Reasoning, and Rendering systems. While existing benchmarks such as MathVision, MathVista are built for Math Reasoning or DiagramGenBenchmark, Mer- maidSeqBench on general purpose diagram generation, no prior work provides a standardized set of prompt, image pairs that can be used to evaluate the LLMs specifically on math diagram generation. This includes fields that span both both text-to-code and text-to-image paradigms. We introduce Math-Vision Diagrams, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs on mathematical diagram generation, and the first to assess text-to-code and text-to-image generation paradigms together in a single unified setting, agnostic of the underlying coding lan- guage or model type. Building on the Math-Vision benchmark, we select a subset of 2920 images out of 3040 from high-quality competition problems with essential visual context. A novel pipeline combining an ensemble of LLMs with Subject Matter Expert (SME) curation is presented, together with a suite of evaluation metrics. Testing several leading models against this benchmark, we demonstrate that LLMs struggle with math diagram generation. All code, data, curation pipeline, and evaluation scripts will be fully open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Math-Vision Diagrams，首个专门用于评估LLM数学图表生成能力的基准，统一了文本到代码和文本到图像两种范式，包含2920个来自高质量竞赛问题的高质量图像-文本对。
AI.motivation: 虽然已有MathVision、MathVista等数学推理基准和DiagramGenBenchmark、MermaidSeqBench等通用图表生成基准，但缺乏专门评估LLM数学图表生成能力的标准化基准。数学图表生成需要空间推理、数学推理和渲染系统的完美协调，具有独特挑战性。
AI.method: 基于Math-Vision基准筛选3040个图像中的2920个高质量竞赛问题，构建一个统一评估框架，同时覆盖文本到代码和文本到图像两种生成范式，与底层编程语言或模型类型无关。提出了一种结合LLM集成与领域专家（SME）人工审核的新型标注pipeline，并配套一套评估指标。
AI.result: 通过在该基准上测试多个领先模型，实验表明LLMs在数学图表生成任务上表现欠佳，能力仍然不足。
AI.conclusion: Math-Vision Diagrams填补了数学图表生成评估的空白，且所有代码、数据、标注pipeline和评估脚本将完全开源，为后续研究提供基础设施。

title: HoloAegis: Frozen Representation, Topological Inference: Minimally Parametric Safety Manifolds for Zero-Shot LLM Guardrails
summary: Current LLM safety guardrails face a fundamental tension: fine-tuning distorts pre-trained representations while generative judges incur prohibitive inference costs. We challenge the prevailing paradigm by asking: can safety be achieved through pure geometric reasoning over frozen semantic representations? We present HoloAegis, a minimally parametric topological inference framework that decouples representation from reasoning. We term our approach minimally parametric because the only free parameters are the anchor count K and the temperature tau, both fixed after construction and requiring no gradient-based training. An un-fine-tuned encoder maps text to a unit sphere, after which all decisions are purely geometric. We formalize safety evaluation as a Gibbs-Boltzmann Free Energy computation over a pre-computed System Topology Anchor Bank, and we introduce Dual Time-Scale Exponential Moving Averages to detect progressive multi-turn semantic drift. Our key theoretical insight is a Topological Boundary Stability Conjecture: we provide theoretical motivation and strong empirical evidence that sparse anchor centroids stabilize the decision boundary against high-frequency lexical perturbations far better than full vector space methods. Evaluated across 8 benchmarks, HoloAegis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy (1.0000 AUC on AuthenHallu, 0.9802 on HarmBench) with sub-millisecond latency, zero cold-start data, and cross-lingual transfer (0.9758 AUC on Chinese CHIFRAUD).

AI.tldr: HoloAegis 提出了一种极简参数化的拓扑推理框架，通过在冻结语义表示上进行纯几何推理来实现LLM安全对齐，不依赖任何梯度训练，在8个基准上达到SOTA精度且延迟低于毫秒级。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM安全护栏面临根本性矛盾：微调会扭曲预训练表示，而生成式评判器推理成本过高。作者挑战主流范式，提出纯几何推理是否足以实现安全的疑问。
AI.method: 将表示与推理解耦：使用未微调的编码器将文本映射到单位球面，所有决策纯几何化。将安全评估形式化为在预计算的系统拓扑锚库上的Gibbs-Boltzmann自由能计算，引入双时间尺度指数移动平均检测多轮语义漂移。核心是拓扑边界稳定性猜想：稀疏锚质心能比全向量空间方法更好地稳定决策边界。
AI.result: 在8个基准上达到SOTA精度：AuthenHallu上AUC为1.0000，HarmBench上为0.9802，亚毫秒延迟，零冷启动数据，跨语言迁移（中文CHIFRAUD上AUC 0.9758）。
AI.conclusion: 证明纯几何推理可以在无需微调的情况下实现强鲁棒的安全对齐，稀疏锚点质心在扰动下具有更好的决策边界稳定性，同时具备极低延迟和跨语言能力。

title: Label-Free Parkinson's Disease Screening from Face and Voice through Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) is the second most common neurodegenerative disorder. Typical machine learning screening methods require PD labels, but the available data is limited by privacy concerns and the need for expert annotation. We propose a label-free face-plus-voice PD screen built entirely on frozen pretrained encoders--a face-expression Vision Transformer and HuBERT--in which no PD label touches any fit; the reference is training controls only. The voice modality uses a synthetic-dysarthria contrastive activation addition (CAA) direction built from time-stretch and breathy degradation of healthy speech; the face modality uses a k-nearest-neighbor anomaly score to the control embedding cluster. We introduce the alignment principle, a post-hoc analysis showing that a synthetic-degradation CAA detector works when the cosine similarity between the synthetic and real disease directions exceeds zero. Measured on the YouTubePD benchmark, this cosine is +0.37 for voice (CAA works, AUROC 0.765) and -0.48 for face (CAA fails; anomaly succeeds, AUROC 0.751). Equal-weight late fusion reaches AUROC 0.802 (95% CI [0.70,0.89]) with NPV 0.95, supporting a rule-out triage interpretation. An overfitting audit shows the voice detector transfers cleanly, while the face-side--and thus fused--AUROC is potentially optimistic pending external validation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种完全无需帕金森病(PD)标注的无标签筛查方法，仅使用冻结的预训练编码器（面表情Vision Transformer + HuBERT语音编码器），通过合成构音障碍对比激活加性（CAA）方向和K近邻异常检测实现面+语音双模态PD筛查。在YouTubePD基准上，语音模态AUROC 0.765，面部模态AUROC 0.751，晚期等权重融合达到AUROC 0.802（NPV 0.95），支持排除性分诊解释。同时引入"对齐原则"作为事后分析工具，并完成过拟合审计。
AI.motivation: 帕金森病是第二大常见神经退行性疾病，传统机器学习筛查需要PD标签，但数据因隐私问题和专家标注需求而受限。作者旨在构建一个完全不依赖任何PD标签的筛查系统，仅利用健康对照作为参考，以规避数据标注和隐私瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用冻结的预训练编码器（面部使用面表情Vision Transformer，语音使用HuBERT），语音模态基于对健康语音进行时间拉伸和气息音退化处理来合成构音障碍，并构建对比激活加性（CAA）方向；面部模态使用对控制嵌入簇的K近邻异常评分。引入"对齐原则"：当合成退化方向与真实疾病方向的余弦相似度大于零时，CAA检测器有效。最终进行等权重晚期融合。
AI.result: 在YouTubePD基准上，语音方向的合成与真实疾病余弦相似度为+0.37（CAA有效，AUROC 0.765），面部为-0.48（CAA失败，异常检测成功，AUROC 0.751）。等权重晚期融合达到AUROC 0.802（95% CI [0.70,0.89]），NPV 0.95。过拟合审计显示语音检测器干净迁移，面部及融合AUROC可能偏乐观，需外部验证。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的PD筛查是可行的，语音模态通过合成退化CAA方向有效工作，面部模态依赖异常检测而非CAA。系统整体表现支持排除性分诊（rule-out triage）使用场景，但面部模态的AUROC可能过于乐观，有待外部验证确认。

title: TrustRoboReward: Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing for Multi-Paradigm Robot Reward Models
summary: Reward models are a bottleneck for reinforcement learning in embodied AI. Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires scalable vision feedback beyond handcrafted rewards or task-specific annotations. Existing open-source VLM reward judges like RoboReward adopt simple 1--5 trajectory progress scoring, lacking pairwise preferences for RLHF, DPO and Bradley-Terry frameworks, while failing to optimize video scene understanding. Augmenting RoboReward with pairwise comparison and video-QA supervision causes inconsistency between pairwise preferences and pointwise scores, introducing training noise and hurting downstream performance---an issue aggregation methods such as TrustJudge cannot resolve. To address this, we propose TrustRoboReward, a multi-paradigm reward modeling framework equipped with Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE). We construct a unified four-paradigm dataset with trajectory progress scoring (Score-A), video-QA answer quality scoring (Score-B), and their pairwise counterparts (Pair-A, Pair-B). Pairwise labels align better with human judgment than pointwise scores, inspiring us to calibrate pointwise scores to avoid score-pair reversals against pairwise preferences. POISE rectifies pointwise scores and eliminates cross-paradigm reversal conflicts unresolved by TrustJudge. Theoretically, POISE reduces score-pair reversal conflicts from 20.15% to 0%, whereas TrustJudge retains 20.46% conflicts on the same corpus. Evaluated on our benchmark, Qwen3-VL-4B trained with POISE achieves an overall reward score of 77.96%, nearly matching GPT-5-mini (78.09%, gap 0.13%) and outperforming the strongest RoboReward-4B baseline by 10.13%. It also lifts test-time score-pair consistency to 71.90%, exceeding RoboReward-4B (57.26%) and GPT-5-mini (68.09%). Integrating TrustJudge aggregation during inference boosts the overall score to 78.57%, surpassing the GPT-5-mini teacher model.

AI.tldr: 提出TrustRoboReward，一种多范式奖励建模框架，通过Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE)校准点得分，消除与成对偏好之间的冲突，在长程机器人操作奖励建模中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的开源VLM奖励判断模型（如RoboReward）仅采用简单的1-5轨迹进度打分，缺乏成对偏好支持，无法适用于RLHF、DPO和Bradley-Terry等框架，同时未能优化视频场景理解。简单地用成对比较和视频QA监督增强RoboReward会导致成对偏好与点得分之间的不一致，引入训练噪声并损害下游性能，现有聚合方法（如TrustJudge）无法解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出TrustRoboReward多范式奖励建模框架，并设计了POISE（Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing）方法。构建了统一四范式数据集：轨迹进度打分（Score-A）、视频QA答案质量打分（Score-B），以及对应的成对比较（Pair-A、Pair-B）。利用成对标签与人类判断更一致的特性，通过等距回归校准点得分，消除点得分与成对偏好之间的反向冲突。
AI.result: 理论上POISE将得分对反向冲突从20.15%降至0%（TrustJudge保留20.46%）。在基准测试中，Qwen3-VL-4B结合POISE训练达到77.96%的总体奖励得分，几乎匹配GPT-5-mini（78.09%），超出最强RoboReward-4B基线10.13%；测试时得分对一致性提升至71.90%，超过RoboReward-4B（57.26%）和GPT-5-mini（68.09%）。推理时集成TrustJudge聚合后，总体得分提升至78.57%，超过GPT-5-mini教师模型。
AI.conclusion: TrustRoboReward通过POISE有效解决了多范式奖励建模中点得分与成对偏好之间的冲突问题，在长程机器人操作视频奖励建模中取得了接近甚至超过强教师模型的性能，验证了多范式融合与偏好校准在具身AI奖励建模中的有效性。

title: Twin Rollouts: Noise-Coupled Counterfactual Branching in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Interactive video world models generate rollouts autoregressively under an action stream, yet they are trained and evaluated almost exclusively on factual prediction. We study counterfactual generation inside the rollout: given a trajectory the model has itself generated, what would have happened had the actions differed from step t* onward? We formalize noise-coupled twin rollouts --- a factual and a counterfactual branch sharing the generated prefix and the future exogenous noise sequence, diverging only in the action stream at an intervention point. Because the factual branch is self-generated, its exogenous noise is known exactly: the abduction step of Pearl's counterfactual procedure is exact by construction, sidestepping the approximate-inversion problem faced by editing-based pipelines. Noise coupling further turns the minimal-change principle into a per-sample verifiable property: we define a spatiotemporal locality metric that penalizes divergence outside the causal descendants of the intervention, computable against simulator ground truth without a learned judge. Forking the simulator state at t* yields ground-truth counterfactual re-renders, which we use as verifiable rewards for post-training. This note establishes the formal framework, metric definitions, and positioning; experiments are forthcoming.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在交互式视频世界模型中进行反事实生成的形式化框架，通过噪声耦合孪生 rollout 精确实现 Pearl 反事实程序中的外推（abduction）步骤，并定义了可验证的时空局部性度量来评估最小变化原则。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频世界模型仅针对事实预测进行训练和评估，忽略了反事实生成这一重要能力。传统基于编辑的反事实管线面临近似逆问题，难以精确恢复外生噪声。
AI.method: 提出噪声耦合孪生 rollout 框架：事实分支和反事实分支共享生成前缀及未来外生噪声序列，仅干预点之后的动作流不同。由于事实分支是自生成的，其外生噪声精确已知，使 Pearl 反事实程序的 abduction 步骤精确成立。同时定义时空局部性度量，惩罚干预因果后代之外的发散，并通过在干预点分叉模拟器状态获得真实反事实重渲染作为可验证奖励用于后训练。
AI.result: 本文为概念性工作，尚未提供实验结果，仅建立了形式化框架、度量定义和定位。实验工作待后续开展。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为视频世界模型的反事实生成提供了严谨的理论基础，将最小变化原则转变为逐样本可验证的性质，避免了学习的评判器需求，未来可为世界模型的因果推理能力评估与训练提供新范式。

title: MathShikkha: A Controlled Study of Answer-Only and Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Bangla Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: Mathematical reasoning remains challenging in low-resource languages such as Bangla. We study whether teacher-generated Bangla Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision provides benefits beyond ordinary supervised fine-tuning. We construct \textsc{MathShikkha}, a Bangla mathematical reasoning dataset with GPT-5.4-generated rationales, and fine-tune four 4B--7B student models under a matched protocol in which answer-only and CoT conditions share data splits, response-only loss masking, decoding, and scoring, differing only in the training target. In-domain, CoT provides no significant improvement over answer-only fine-tuning for three stronger backbones (paired bootstrap 95\% CIs include zero; exact McNemar $p \geq 0.17$), despite generating 15--52$\times$ more tokens, but significantly improves the weaker 4B model by 18.56 points ($p < 0.0001$). On the larger, contamination-audited BanglaMATH benchmark, this pattern reverses: CoT significantly outperforms answer-only supervision for all four models by 20.1--28.1 points (all $p < 0.0001$). Answer-only fine-tuning also reduces out-of-domain accuracy below the base model for three models, whereas CoT preserves or improves it for all four. A human study with two co-author annotators, external-expert adjudication, and Cohen's $κ= 0.76$--$1.00$ finds no significant CoT improvement over the base model on reasoning-content criteria; instead, its measurable effect is target-language adherence and producing inspectable reasoning. Overall, rationale supervision's value depends on backbone capability and distribution shift: in this setting, its main benefits are Bangla adherence, auditable reasoning, and out-of-domain robustness rather than improved in-domain reasoning validity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究孟加拉语数学推理中教师生成的思维链（CoT）监督是否比普通监督微调更有益。研究构建了MathShikkha数据集，在匹配协议下微调四个4B-7B学生模型。结果表明：领域内CoT对三个较强模型无显著提升（但显著提升较弱4B模型18.56分），而在更大的BanglaMATH基准上CoT对所有模型显著优于纯答案监督（20.1-28.1分）。CoT的真正价值在于目标语言依从性、可审计推理和域外鲁棒性，而非提升领域内推理有效性。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语等低资源语言中的数学推理仍具挑战性，尚不清楚教师生成的CoT监督是否能带来超越普通监督微调的额外收益。已有研究多在高资源语言中进行，低资源场景下CoT的价值缺乏严格对照实验验证。作者希望通过匹配协议（仅在训练目标上不同）来隔离CoT监督的因果效应。
AI.method: 作者构建MathShikkha孟加拉语数学推理数据集（使用GPT-5.4生成理由），在匹配协议下微调四个4B-7B学生模型。匹配协议保证回答仅和CoT两种条件共享数据划分、响应级损失掩码、解码和评分，唯一区别是训练目标。使用配对bootstrap 95%置信区间和精确McNemar检验进行统计显著性验证；同时进行人工研究（两位合著者标注加外部专家仲裁，Cohen's κ=0.76-1.00）。
AI.result: 领域内：CoT对三个较强骨干模型无显著改进（95% CI含零；McNemar p≥0.17），尽管生成15-52倍更多token；但对较弱4B模型显著提升18.56分（p<0.0001）。在更大的BanglaMATH基准上模式反转：CoT对所有四个模型显著优于答案监督（20.1-28.1分，均p<0.0001）。纯答案微调使三个模型的域外准确率低于基础模型，而CoT对所有模型保持或提升域外性能。人工研究未发现CoT在推理内容标准上对基础模型的显著提升，其可测效果是目标语言依从性和可检验推理。
AI.conclusion: CoT监督的价值取决于骨干模型能力和分布偏移。在本研究设定下，CoT的主要收益在于孟加拉语依从性、可审计推理和域外鲁棒性，而非提升领域内推理有效性。这表明在低资源语言下，CoT的价值不应仅以领域内准确性衡量，还应考虑语言适配和推理可解释性。

title: SoftMCC: An MCC-Brier Calibration Bridge for Threshold-Free Model Selection under Class Imbalance
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
summary: Model selection for imbalanced binary classification often uses the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), but thresholding makes validation rankings threshold-dependent. SoftMCC is a post-training MCC validation framework on established probability-valued confusion counts, coupling an MCC-specific calibrated identity with a tie-aware, shared-pool selection protocol. Its core score is a covariance-normalized probability-label association, reduces exactly to MCC for hard predictions, and is Pearson-bounded. Under perfect population calibration it equals the Brier skill score with identical candidate ordering; outside that regime the gap does not identify calibration error. Across 18 settings with 12 duplicate-safe grouped repeats, SoftMCC attains the best stability mean rank (2.31) and highest mean tie-corrected Kendall's W (0.659), with a significant Friedman test (p=0.007); Nemenyi analysis separates it from AUPRC and MCC@0.5, while 14-source-family sensitivity retains only the latter. Selected-model utility shows no advantage. Three of six prespecified comparisons have negative mean test-MCC differences, only F1@best survives Holm correction (p=0.014), and the dataset-level test is not significant (p=0.117). Label permutation lowers mean W to 0.092; temperature scaling shifts SoftMCC rankings (mean Spearman 0.851) whereas rank-based and threshold-optimized metrics remain invariant. SoftMCC is a calibration-sensitive MCC-family selector with bounded stability and utility evidence.

AI.tldr: SoftMCC是一个后训练阶段的MCC验证框架，将概率值混淆计数与MCC校准恒等式耦合，通过协方差归一化的概率-标签关联得分在硬预测时精确退化为MCC，并具有Pearson界。实验显示其在稳定性上优于AUPRC和MCC@0.5，但对标定敏感且选模效用无优势。
AI.motivation: 类别不平衡二元分类中的模型选择常使用MCC指标，但基于硬阈值将MCC应用于概率输出时，验证排名会依赖阈值选择，导致不稳定性。作者旨在提出一个替代MCC的框架，使其能够利用概率信息而不受阈值影响。
AI.method: 提出SoftMCC框架：1）在已建立的概率值混淆计数上进行后训练验证；2）耦合MCC特定的校准恒等式与平局感知（tie-aware）、共享池（shared-pool）选择协议；3）核心得分是协方差归一化的概率-标签关联，对硬预测精确退化为MCC，且受Pearson界约束。在18个设置、12次去重安全分组重复下进行实验评估，并采用多种统计检验（Friedman测试、Nemenyi分析）和敏感性分析。
AI.result: SoftMCC取得最佳稳定性平均秩(2.31)和最高的平局校正Kendall's W(0.659)；Friedman检验显著(p=0.007)。但选模效用无优势：六个预设比较中三个测试MCC差异为负，仅F1@best通过Holm校正(p=0.014)，数据集级检验不显著(p=0.117)。标签置换将平均W降至0.092；温度缩放改变SoftMCC排名(平均Spearman 0.851)，而基于秩和阈值优化的指标保持不变。
AI.conclusion: SoftMCC是一个对标定敏感的MCC族选择器，在验证排名稳定性上表现优越，但其选择模型的实用性证据受限。在完美总体标定下它与Brier技巧得分等价并产生相同排序，但非标定状态下其差距不能用于识别标定误差，限制了其适用范围。

title: Understanding Calibration and Truncation Error Propagation in Training-Free Low-Rank Compression for LLMs
summary: Training-free low-rank compression frameworks have been gaining prominence for LLM compression given their effectiveness in reducing model parameter count while maintaining task-level accuracy. However, existing SOTA frameworks share two key limitations: (1) residual errors in calibration data activations accumulate across layers during compression, causing misalignment between representations simulated at compression time and those experienced at inference; (2) the assumption that layer importance distribution is preserved post-compression does not hold. Together, these two effects introduce misalignment in the compression process in relation to the deployed model. We study these effects and propose a simple, training-free methodology compatible with existing frameworks to mitigate them, comprising: (1) Layer-by-Layer Compression with Calibration Correction; (2) Iterative Compression with Rank Allocation Correction. Implemented atop an existing SOTA decomposition framework, and evaluated on Llama and Qwen3 models across various benchmarks and compression rates, our approach demonstrates up to ~1-2.5 accuracy point improvements over per-weight and joint decomposition baselines on zero-shot tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的低秩压缩改进方法，针对现有SOTA框架的两个关键局限（校准数据激活残差误差逐层累积导致的表示错位、压缩后层重要性分布假设不成立），通过逐层压缩校准校正和迭代压缩秩分配校正两种策略，在Llama和Qwen3模型上实现零样本任务约1-2.5个准确率点的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有训练-free低秩压缩框架虽能有效减少参数并保持任务准确率，但存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 压缩时校准数据的激活残差误差会跨层累积，导致压缩时模拟的表示与实际推理时不一致；(2) 假设压缩后层重要性分布保持不变，但该假设不成立。这两种效应共同导致压缩过程与部署模型之间产生错位，亟需解决。
AI.method: 提出一个简单且无需训练的方法论，兼容现有压缩框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 逐层压缩与校准校正——在每一层压缩时对校准数据的激活误差进行校正，防止误差跨层累积；(2) 迭代压缩与秩分配校正——通过迭代方式重新评估并纠正压缩后的层重要性分布，据此调整秩分配策略。
AI.result: 在现有SOTA分解框架基础上实现该方法，并在Llama和Qwen3模型上、多种基准和压缩率下进行评估。结果表明，相比逐权重和联合分解基线，该方法在零样本任务上可实现约1-2.5个准确率点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对压缩过程中的表示错位和层重要性偏差这两个核心问题进行校正，训练-free低秩压缩框架的性能可以得到显著改善，且该方法简单、与现有框架兼容，具有良好的实用性和扩展性。

title: Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Tracking in Vision-Language Representation Learning
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) aims to measure the reliability of model predictions, serving as a critical safeguard for deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in safety-critical scenarios. Post-hoc approaches are widely adopted due to their lightweight nature, mapping the outputs of VLMs to uncertainty measures through learnable modules or inductive summarization. However, Post-hoc approaches remain inherently confined to fitting the failure patterns of the source domain, ignoring the dynamic nature of test distributions. To address this challenge, we propose a Dynamic Distribution-Aware Uncertainty Quantification framework (DDA-UQ) that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic distribution-aware process. During training, we leverage a Gaussian Mixture Model to model the VVLMs'embedding space and extract distributional evidence, thereby dynamically deriving uncertainty estimates. During inference, the design dynamically responds to changes in the data distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DDA-UQ框架，通过高斯混合模型对VLM嵌入空间进行建模，将后验不确定性量化的静态映射范式转变为动态分布感知过程，以应对测试分布变化带来的不确定性估计失效问题。
AI.motivation: 后验不确定性量化方法虽然轻量高效，但本质上仅拟合源域的失败模式，忽略了测试分布动态变化的特性，导致在分布漂移场景下可靠性下降。
AI.method: 训练阶段使用高斯混合模型（GMM）对VLM的嵌入空间进行建模，提取分布证据并动态推导不确定性估计；推理阶段动态响应数据分布的变化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在不确定性量化任务上显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将不确定性量化从静态映射范式转向动态分布感知范式，为VLM在安全关键场景中的可靠性保障提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Time Present and Time Past: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Temporally Evolving Document Understanding
summary: Evolving documents, such as laws, tax codes, and software documentation, are amended, replaced, and sometimes reverted over time, so a question has different correct answers at different dates. In contrast to encyclopedic knowledge, where an old fact is simply overwritten, an amendment is itself an official text that states what it replaces and when it takes effect, and the earlier version stays correct for its validity period. The central challenge is therefore version resolution, that is, identifying the version in force on the queried date. Existing temporal QA datasets treat time only as an annotation, so version resolution stays untested. We present TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over 644 official customs instruments issued between 1969 and 2025 by the Government of Bangladesh, covering eight task types over deeply code-mixed documents that are heterogeneous in layout and dated in two calendars. In addition, we evaluate nine recent LLMs under a single protocol across parametric, gold-context, and retrieval access, scored by a three-judge LLM council with a hard date gate separating correct meaning from correct time. The best macro-averaged accuracy is only 68.5%. Resolving a version from an implicit date reaches 59.7%, and detecting that the supplied version does not govern the query reaches only 26.7%. Models are more likely to find correct versions than to reject incorrect ones, and they tend to follow a confident parametric answer over the supplied authoritative text. All code and data are available at https://github.com/icsetepa44/TIDE

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了TIDE基准数据集，包含3,050个关于孟加拉国政府1969-2025年间644份官方海关文书的问答对，用于测试时间敏感型文档的版本解析能力。评估了九个最新LLM，最好的宏平均准确率仅68.5%，且模型在版本识别和错误版本拒绝方面的表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 法律、税法、软件文档等不断演进的文档在不同日期有不同的正确答案。现有时间敏感问答数据集仅将时间视为注释，未测试版本解析（即识别查询日期对应的有效版本）这一核心挑战。
AI.method: 构建专家验证的TIDE基准，包含3,050个QA对、644份官方海关文书、八种任务类型，覆盖深度代码混合、异构布局、双历法日期的文档。在统一协议下评估九个最新LLM，涵盖参数化、金上下文和检索访问三种模式，使用三法官LLM评审团和硬性日期门控进行评分。
AI.result: 最佳宏平均准确率仅68.5%。从隐含日期解析版本准确率为59.7%，检测所提供版本不适用查询的准确率仅26.7%。模型更可能找到正确版本而非拒绝错误版本，且倾向于遵循自信的参数化答案而非提供的权威文本。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在时间敏感文档的版本解析任务上表现不足，尤其在识别错误版本方面有显著短板。模型倾向于信任参数化记忆而非权威上下文，凸显了时间感知问答仍需实质性改进。

title: HOPPER: Learnable Hop Extraction for Linearized Graph Sequence Models
summary: Graph neural networks typically propagate information through repeated message-passing layers, coupling the distance over which information travels with the number of nonlinear transformations applied. This coupling can make deep architectures difficult to optimize and can lead to over-smoothing, over-squashing, and the loss of long-range information. Linearized Graph Sequence Models (LGSMs) address this issue by separating information depth from processing depth and treating the successive propagation states of each node as a sequence. However, existing LGSMs construct these sequences using fixed graph operators, limiting their ability to adapt propagation to the input graph, node features, and downstream task. We introduce HOPPER, an end-to-end learnable extension of LGSM that learns how hop sequences should be extracted before they are processed by a modern state-space model. Our framework supports feature-conditioned, structure-aware, graph- and hop-adaptive propagation mechanisms while preserving permutation equivariance. Standard adjacency-based and non-backtracking LGSM sequences arise as special cases of our proposed extractor family. We show that HOPPER is state-of-the-art or competitive across the ECHO-Synth benchmark, and that varying the maximum neighborhood size of message backtracking cancellation (i.e. structural memory window) can optimize accuracy on the LRIM physics-based long-range dependency benchmark. These results demonstrate that learnable sequence extraction provides a flexible and effective approach to long-range graph representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOPPER，一种端到端可学习的线性化图序列模型（LGSM）扩展框架，通过可学习的跳序（hop sequence）提取机制替代固定图算子，实现传播适应于输入图、节点特征和下游任务，在长程图表示学习基准上达到SOTA或竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络通过重复消息传递耦合了信息传播距离与非线性变换层数，导致深层架构优化困难、过平滑、过挤压（over-squashing）及长程信息丢失。线性化图序列模型（LGSM）通过分离信息深度与处理深度来解决此问题，但现有LGSM使用固定图算子构建跳序序列，无法根据输入图、节点特征和下游任务自适应传播，限制了其表达能力。
AI.method: HOPPER的核心贡献是可学习的跳序提取器（learnable hop extractor family），它在现代状态空间模型（SSM）处理之前学习如何提取跳序序列。该框架支持以下传播机制：1）特征条件化（feature-conditioned）；2）结构感知（structure-aware）；3）图自适应与跳自适应（graph- and hop-adaptive）。同时保持置换等变性（permutation equivariance）。标准的基于邻接矩阵和非回溯（non-backtracking）的LGSM序列是该提取器族的特例。
AI.result: HOPPER在ECHO-Synth基准上达到SOTA或具有竞争力；在LRIM物理长程依赖基准上，通过调整消息回溯取消的最大邻域尺寸（即结构记忆窗口），可以优化精度。结果表明可学习的序列提取为长程图表示学习提供了灵活有效的途径。
AI.conclusion: 可学习的跳序提取能够实现传播的输入自适应，为长程图表示学习提供了比固定算子LGSM更灵活和有效的方案。通过控制结构记忆窗口的大小，可以在不同长程依赖任务上取得最优精度，验证了该方法在真实物理基准上的实用性。

title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code, data, and experiment logs: https://github.com/rabqatab/llm-reasoning-reliability-reproduction
summary: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. RPC reproduces the original grid exactly on the authors' released reasoning paths; on four new domains its edge over self-consistency is never significant (ties or small mixed differences, paired p >= 0.28), and on BIRD, the one domain where we vary the budget, the edge grows with K as predicted but its largest gap (+2.5 accuracy at K=32, p=0.16) reverses to -0.25 when we enlarge the sample to n=200. LCF's logic-validity direction is real but weak (0.82 separability at the single best sub-layer versus 0.95 for a semantic-attribute control); its one positive effect (Qwen3 $Δ$Prob) is not significant (p=0.56), while it significantly reduces $Δ$Prob on two of the other three models.

AI.tldr: 本文独立复现了两种提升大语言模型推理可靠性的方法（RPC和LCF），并在多个新领域和模型上进行压力测试。结果显示：RPC在作者发布的推理路径上能精确复现原始结果，但在四个新领域上相比self-consistency没有显著优势；LCF的"逻辑有效性"方向虽然存在但较弱，其正面效果不显著，且在部分模型上反而降低了推理质量。
AI.motivation: RPC和LCF两种方法的原始评估均由方法作者自行完成，从未被独立复现或在跨模型、跨领域场景下进行压力测试；LCF甚至没有公开代码。验证这些可靠性声称对于评估其真实有效性至关重要。
AI.method: 作者重新运行了RPC的已发布路径聚合方法，重新实现了LCF的投影器、对比学习和干预流程；将两种方法扩展到四个新任务领域（text-to-SQL、法律抽取、谬误识别、先例分级）；并直接探测了LCF的表示层。RPC使用Qwen3-8B在四个新领域评估，LCF在四个7-8B模型上评估。
AI.result: RPC在作者发布的推理路径上精确复现了原始网格结果，但在四个新领域上对self-consistency的优势从未达到统计显著（配对p>=0.28）；在BIRD数据集上，K增大时优势如预期增长，但样本扩至n=200后最大差距从+2.5（p=0.16）反转为-0.25。LCF的逻辑有效性方向真实但较弱（最佳子层可分离性0.82，低于语义属性对照的0.95）；在Qwen3上唯一的正面效果（ΔProb）不显著（p=0.56），而在其他三个模型中的两个上显著降低了ΔProb。
AI.conclusion: 两种方法的可靠性声称在独立复现和跨领域压力测试下均未得到强力支持：RPC的边际优势在小样本下不稳健，LCF的有效性方向存在但效果微弱且不一致。这凸显了方法作者自评结果的局限性以及独立复现的重要性。

title: F2STNet: Fair and Federated Spectral-Temporal Modeling for Graph Forecasting
summary: Spatiotemporal prediction on graph-structured data is central to traffic forecasting and environmental monitoring, yet decentralized and heterogeneous data complicate both sequence modeling and collaborative training. We propose F$^2$STNet, a federated forecasting framework that combines truncated graph-Fourier features, a lightweight diagonal state-space temporal encoder, graph convolution, and Fairness-aware Federated Aggregation (FFA). The spectral branch exposes graph-frequency structure, while the state-space layer models long temporal dependencies with linear complexity in the sequence length. FFA adjusts the FedAvg prior using client validation losses and an increasing fairness schedule. Experiments on PeMS04, HZMetro, and KnowAir show favorable forecasting accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines; federated experiments on PeMS04 additionally improve worst-client and client-dispersion metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出F$^2$STNet，一个联邦时空预测框架，结合截断图傅里叶特征、轻量对角状态空间时间编码器、图卷积和公平感知联邦聚合（FFA），解决去中心化异构图数据的时空预测与协作训练问题。
AI.motivation: 图结构数据的时空预测对交通流量预测和环境监测至关重要，但去中心化且异构的数据使得序列建模和协作训练都变得复杂，需要一种既能处理异质性数据又能在联邦场景下保持公平性的预测框架。
AI.method: F$^2$STNet包含四个核心组件：(1) 截断图傅里叶特征提取频谱分支，暴露图频率结构；(2) 轻量对角状态空间时间编码器，以序列长度线性复杂度建模长时时间依赖；(3) 图卷积处理空间关联；(4) 公平感知联邦聚合（FFA）基于客户端验证损失和递增公平调度调整FedAvg先验。
AI.result: 在PeMS04、HZMetro和KnowAir数据集上取得优于对比基线的预测精度；在PeMS04上的联邦实验中进一步改善了最差客户端的性能以及客户端间性能离散度指标。
AI.conclusion: F$^2$STNet在预测精度和联邦公平性两方面均表现出色，验证了频谱-状态空间-图卷积混合架构与公平感知联邦聚合在分布式时空预测任务中的有效性。

title: Discovering Diverse Planning Policies for Multimodal Embodied Agents with Quality-Diversity Optimization
summary: Multimodal embodied agents are increasingly required to solve long-horizon tasks by integrating visual observations, textual goals, and interaction history into closed-loop decision making. However, state-of-the-art large-model-based planners often rely on a single dominant planning style during execution. Once this execution mode becomes ineffective, the agent may remain stalled for many steps, repeatedly interacting with the environment without making meaningful progress. We address this limitation by proposing a Quality-Diversity (QD) framework for discovering diverse planning policies for multimodal embodied agents. The proposed method treats planning-policy templates as evolvable individuals and organizes them into a behavior-indexed archive rather than collapsing search to a single prompt style. In the offline stage, rollout trajectories are summarized into structured success and failure experiences, which guide policy variation through recombination and experience-guided mutation. The resulting policies are mapped into a behavior space defined by interaction intensity and goal-directedness, and the highest-quality policy in each niche is retained in the archive. In the online stage, the agent executes one policy at a time while monitoring task progress. When persistent stall is detected, the system rolls back to the latest checkpoint and switches to a behaviorally distinct archive policy to resume execution. Experiments on the ThreeDWorld transport benchmark show that the proposed framework improves both task success and interaction efficiency over representative baseline planners. These results suggest that discovering diverse policy repertoires is an effective way to support adaptive multimodal planning and online failure recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于质量-多样性(QD)框架的方法，用于为多模态具身智能体发现多样化的规划策略。该方法通过离线阶段将策略模板进化为行为索引的档案库，在线阶段在检测到停滞时回滚并切换到行为上不同的策略，从而提升长时程任务的成功率和交互效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态具身智能体在执行长时程任务时，基于大模型的规划器通常依赖单一的主导规划风格。当这种执行模式失效时，智能体会反复与环境交互却无法取得进展，导致任务停滞。需要一个能发现多样化规划策略的框架来支持自适应切换和失败恢复。
AI.method: 提出Quality-Diversity（QD）框架：将规划策略模板视为可进化的个体，组织成行为索引的档案库（archive）。离线阶段，将轨迹数据总结为结构化成功/失败经验，通过重组和经验引导变异生成策略；策略映射到由交互强度和目标导向性定义的行为空间，在每个生态位保留最高质量的策略。在线阶段，智能体逐策略执行并监控任务进展，检测到持续停滞时回滚到最新检查点并切换到行为上不同的存档策略。
AI.result: 在ThreeDWorld运输基准上的实验表明，该框架相比代表性基线规划器，在任务成功率和交互效率两方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 发现多样化的策略库是支持自适应多模态规划和在线失败恢复的有效途径。质量-多样性框架能够避免单一规划风格的局限性，通过行为空间的策略多样化实现更鲁棒的长期任务执行。

title: RAVEN: Frozen Random Graph Reservoirs with Physics-Informed Interaction Fingerprints for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
summary: Quantitative estimation of protein-ligand binding affinity from three-dimensional complex structures is a fundamental task in structure-based computational chemistry and molecular modeling. Reliable prediction remains challenging because available structure-affinity data are limited, experimentally heterogeneous, conformation-dependent, and sensitive to dataset partitioning. RAVEN (Randomized Atomistic Views with Ensemble Neural Reservoirs) utilizes a multihead reservoir of independently initialized and fully frozen atomistic graph encoders to generate diverse structural projections without end-to-end optimization of the graph representation. These projections are integrated with a deterministic physicochemical interaction fingerprint and processed by heterogeneous supervised readers, including neural and tree-based regressors, whose outputs are combined through validation-based nonnegative fusion. The random reservoir expands structural feature coverage across independent encoder realizations, whereas the explicit physicochemical descriptors and heterogeneous readers contribute complementary information and distinct inductive biases. Evaluation on a similarity-isolated PDBbind 2020R1 split reconstructed using GEMS similarity resources, together with the protected CASF-2016 subset, demonstrated strong predictive performance. The results indicate that frozen multi-view graph representations, explicit physicochemical statistics, and heterogeneous model fusion provide a robust and flexible framework for protein-ligand binding-affinity prediction.

AI.tldr: RAVEN提出了一种无需端到端优化图表示的蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测框架，通过多视角冻结原子图编码器随机库生成结构投影，并结合确定性物理化学相互作用指纹与异构监督回归器（神经网络和树模型）进行验证性非负融合，在GEMS重建的相似性隔离PDBbind 2020R1分割和CASF-2016子集上展现出强预测性能。
AI.motivation: 蛋白-配体结合亲和力的定量预测是结构生物学计算化学中的基础任务，但由于结构-亲和力数据有限、实验异质性高、构象依赖性强且对数据集划分敏感，可靠的预测仍具挑战性。
AI.method: RAVEN采用多head的随机储备池（reservoir），由多个独立初始化且完全冻结的原子级图编码器构成，生成多样化的结构投影；将其与确定性物理化学相互作用指纹整合，馈入异构监督读取器（包括神经网络和基于树的回归器），最后通过基于验证集的非负融合组合各模型输出。
AI.result: 在基于GEMS相似性资源重建的相似性隔离PDBbind 2020R1分割以及受保护的CASF-2016子集上进行评估，展现出强预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 冻结多视角图表示、显式物理化学统计量和异构模型融合为蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测提供了稳健且灵活的框架。

title: Deep probabilistic logic programming for diagnostic reasoning from incomplete information: A case study in stroke detection
comment: Accepted for presentation at IJCLR 2026. This is the accepted version, _not_ the camera-ready version for the post-proceedings of the conference
summary: In medical applications, raw data is frequently associated with significant privacy concerns, lending particular importance to the encoding of summary statistics from the literature. On the other hand, deep learning has become an invaluable tool for assessing symptoms based on visual or auditory sensor data. DeepProbLog allows for an extensible neuro-symbolic approach that accommodates connectionist components to analyse patient images within a transparent and rigorous probabilistic framework, namely probabilistic logic programming under the distribution semantics. Framed as a case study in stroke detection from multimodal data, this contribution explores the pathway from summary statistics available in the literature to a DeepProbLog-based diagnostic system. It suggests a workflow using established maximum entropy techniques to complete available probabilistic information and the probabilistic logic programming system ProbLog 2 to move from the entropy-maximising causal model to a discriminative neuro-symbolic model expressible within DeepProbLog. The relative performance of models derived from less complete data is analysed alongside the potential of the probabilistic inductive logic programming system ProbFOIL 2 for compressing large discriminative models, and the perspectives and implications of using DeepProbLog for diagnostic reasoning are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于DeepProbLog的神经符号诊断系统工作流，从文献中的汇总统计出发，利用最大熵技术补全概率信息，并通过ProbLog 2将熵最大化的因果模型转换为可判别的神经符号模型，以中风检测为案例验证其可行性与性能。
AI.motivation: 医学应用中原始数据常涉及隐私问题，因此从文献中已有的汇总统计编码信息具有重要意义；同时深度学习虽擅长基于视觉或听觉传感器数据评估症状，但缺乏透明性和可解释性，需要一种兼顾深度学习和概率逻辑推理的框架。
AI.method: 提出一条完整工作流：(1) 利用最大熵技术从文献汇总统计中补全缺失的概率信息；(2) 使用ProbLog 2将熵最大化的因果模型转化为可判别的神经符号模型；(3) 将模型表达在DeepProbLog框架内，融合连接主义组件分析患者图像；(4) 使用ProbFOIL 2对大规模判别模型进行压缩，并分析数据不完整情况下模型的相对性能。
AI.result: 以中风检测多模态数据为案例，构建了从汇总统计到DeepProbLog诊断系统的完整路径；分析了基于不完整数据推导出的模型相对性能，并展示了ProbFOIL 2在压缩大型判别模型方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: DeepProbLog为医学诊断推理提供了一种透明且严谨的概率框架，能够将文献汇总统计转化为可用的神经符号诊断系统，其可解释性在医学应用中具有重要前景。

title: Real Data Closes Synthetic-to-Real Gap in Optical Chemical Structure Recognition
summary: Millions of chemical structures appear in patents and papers only as drawings, and using that information at scale requires reading the drawings. OCSR appears nearly solved on synthetic images yet remains difficult on real documents: the starting recognizer, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, exceeds 91% accuracy on synthetic renders but falls below 16% on three real-world benchmarks (ACS, CLEF-IP, USPTO). To identify the main source of improvement, 21 recognizers were fine-tuned on mixtures of synthetically rendered structures and labeled real depictions from patents, journal figures, and hand-drawn collections, varying the vision language model (VLM) base, the fraction of real training data, and the vision-tower adaptation strategy. Labeled real training images make the largest difference. For Qwen2.5-VL, ACS exact match rises from 0.15 with no real data to 0.37 at 9.5% and 0.46 at 50.2%; a controlled experiment across three base models reproduces the trend. A vision-tower LoRA, in contrast, does nothing for Qwen (+0.00, paired p=1.00), substantially helps InternVL3-8B (+22.8 to +34.6 pt), and modestly helps GLM-4.1V-9B (+1.0 to +9.6 pt), so its value depends on the base model. The best configuration reaches 0.96 exact match on clean renders and 0.49, 0.65, 0.84, and 0.76 on ACS, CLEF-IP, UOB, and USPTO, respectively. Gaps between base models are largest without real data (0.21), shrink to 0.06 at 70% real data, and reorder the ranking; base model and real-data mixture must therefore be selected together. Small-scale experiments on handwritten image-to-LaTeX recognition and chart-to-table conversion show that base-model rankings also vary beyond chemistry. More generally, model and adaptation choices for visual structure recognition should be evaluated on the target task.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了化学结构识别（OCSR）在真实文档上的表现问题。通过微调21个识别器，发现标注真实训练图像是提升性能的最大因素（Qwen2.5-VL在ACS上的精确匹配率从0.15提升到0.46），而视觉塔LoRA的效果依基础模型而异（对Qwen无效，对InternVL3-8B显著有效）。最佳配置在干净渲染上达到0.96精确匹配，在ACS、CLEF-IP、UOB、USPTO分别达到0.49、0.65、0.84、0.76。研究还发现基础模型与真实数据混合比例必须联合选择，且该结论可推广到其他视觉结构识别任务。
AI.motivation: 化学结构在专利和论文中多以图片形式存在，大规模利用需要自动识别（OCSR）。虽然OCSR在合成图像上看似已解决（Qwen2.5-VL-7B在合成渲染上准确率超过91%），但在真实文档基准（ACS、CLEF-IP、USPTO）上准确率低于16%，存在巨大的领域差距。论文旨在识别性能提升的主要来源，并系统研究不同因素（基础模型、真实训练数据比例、视觉塔适配策略）的影响。
AI.method: 论文微调了21个化学结构识别器，在合成渲染结构、专利和期刊图中的标注真实描绘、手绘集合的混合数据上进行训练。实验设计系统地变化三个维度：视觉语言模型（VLM）基础（Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B、GLM-4.1V-9B）、真实训练数据的比例、视觉塔适配策略（视觉塔LoRA等）。此外还进行了小规模的消融实验验证结论的可推广性，并扩展到手写图像到LaTeX识别和图表到表格转换任务。
AI.result: 标注真实训练图像是最大的性能提升因素：Qwen2.5-VL在ACS上的精确匹配从无真实数据的0.15提升到9.5%真实数据时的0.37、50.2%时的0.46。视觉塔LoRA的效果具有基础模型依赖性：对Qwen无效（+0.00，配对p=1.00），对InternVL3-8B显著有效（+22.8至+34.6个百分点），对GLM-4.1V-9B中等效果（+1.0至+9.6个百分点）。最佳配置在干净渲染上精确匹配达0.96，在ACS、CLEF-IP、UOB、USPTO上分别达0.49、0.65、0.84、0.76。基础模型间差距从无真实数据时的0.21缩小至70%真实数据时的0.06，且排序发生重排。
AI.conclusion: 真实标注训练数据是提升OCSR在现实文档中性能的关键，VLM基础模型与真实数据混合比例必须联合选择而非独立优化。视觉塔适配策略（如LoRA）的有效性依赖基础模型，不能一概而论。研究结论不仅限于化学领域，在手写图像识别和图表转换任务中也观察到类似的基础模型排序变化，说明模型与适配选择应在目标任务上评估。

title: VoxZip: Semantic-Anchored Temporal KV Cache Compression for Long-Context Audio Inference
summary: Recent advancements in Speech Large Language Models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding complex audio tasks. Despite this progress, their long-context inference remains severely bottlenecked by prohibitive KV cache memory demands. Existing text-centric compression methods struggle here, often disrupting speech continuity or discarding crucial semantic cues. To address this, we propose VoxZip, a train-free, two-stage semantic-anchored KV cache compression framework. The first stage uses automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcriptions as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, significantly reducing the initial KV cache while elevating token information density. To further improve the compression ratio, the second stage employs a dynamic filtering strategy based on temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict non-essential tokens while mitigating early-token bias. Comprehensive evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six diverse audio benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. VoxZip excels in long-audio reasoning and consistently maintains high-fidelity perception on short-form tasks. Notably, it sustains over 90\% of the uncompressed baseline performance even under an aggressive 20x KV cache compression in long-context scenarios. Furthermore, at a 4x compression ratio, VoxZip yields a 1.9x increase in inference throughput alongside a 3.3x reduction in peak memory overhead. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxZip.

AI.tldr: VoxZip 是一种免训练的、两阶段语义锚定的 KV 缓存压缩框架，用于解决语音大语言模型在长上下文推理中的内存瓶颈问题。它利用 ASR 转录作为语义锚点进行音频 token 的对齐与压缩，再通过基于时间衰减累积注意力的动态过滤策略进一步剔除非关键 token，在 20x 压缩比下仍保持超过 90% 的基线性能，并显著提升推理吞吐量、降低峰值内存开销。
AI.motivation: 语音大语言模型在长上下文推理中受限于 KV 缓存带来的巨大内存需求，而现有面向文本的压缩方法并不适用于语音场景——它们往往破坏语音连续性或丢失关键语义信息，亟需针对语音特性设计的 KV 缓存压缩方案。
AI.method: 提出 VoxZip，一种免训练的两阶段语义锚定压缩框架：第一阶段利用 ASR 转录作为显式语义锚点，对音频 token 进行时间对齐、压缩与融合，在初始阶段大幅缩减 KV 缓存并提升 token 信息密度；第二阶段采用基于时间衰减累积注意力的动态过滤策略，逐出非必要 token 并缓解早期 token 偏置问题，从而进一步提升压缩比。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-Omni 上对六个音频基准进行全面评估：VoxZip 在长音频推理任务上表现优异，同时保持短时任务的感知保真度；在 20x 激进压缩比下仍能保持超过 90% 的未压缩基线性能；在 4x 压缩比下实现 1.9x 推理吞吐量提升和 3.3x 峰值内存开销降低。
AI.conclusion: VoxZip 通过语义锚定与动态滤波相结合的双阶段策略，有效解决了语音大语言模型长上下文推理中的 KV 缓存压缩难题，在保持高保真性能的同时大幅提升推理效率，为语音场景下的 KV 缓存压缩提供了可行且高效的解决方案。

title: A Probabilistic Circuit-Induced Pseudo-Metric for Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are tractable generative models whose internal nodes encode a hierarchy of probabilistic sum- maries over different variable scopes. Existing PC-based out- of-distribution (OOD) detection methods ignore this hierar- chy, reducing the entire circuit to the scalar likelihood (or its uncertainty) computed at the root. We introduce Hierar- chical Likelihood Vector (HLV), a representation whose en- tries are the likelihoods associated with selected PC nodes and define the Hierarchical Likelihood Distance (HLD), a PC-induced pseudo-metric that compares the probability dis- tributions through the expectations of their HLVs. We show that HLD is an integral probability metric over a function class naturally induced by the PC and develop a principled goodness-of-fit hypothesis test for unsupervised OOD detec- tion. Unlike existing approaches, the trained PC alone serves as the representation of the in-distribution: no held-out in- distribution data are required at deployment. We further show that the quantities required by the hypothesis test can be com- puted exactly, directly from the trained circuit, yielding an ap- proximate analytic decision threshold. Experiments on tabular and MNIST datasets demonstrate that exploiting the hierarchi- cal probabilistic summaries encoded through the PC improve OOD detection over root-likelihood, uncertainty-, typicality- and kernel-based baselines, while naturally localizing distri- bution shifts to the PC nodes responsible for the shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层次似然向量（HLV）和层次似然距离（HLD），利用概率电路（PCs）内部的层次结构进行无监督分布外（OOD）检测，通过精确计算的假设检验实现无需留出数据的检测，并在表格和MNIST数据集上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概率电路的OOD检测方法将整个电路简化为根节点的标量似然或不确定性，忽略了PC内部节点编码的层次化概率摘要信息，导致信息利用率不足。
AI.method: 提出HLV表示（选取PC节点关联的似然值组成向量）和HLD伪度量（通过HLV的期望比较概率分布）。证明HLD是PC自然诱导函数类上的积分概率度量（IPM），并基于此构建原则性的拟合优度假设检验用于无监督OOD检测。所有检验所需量均可从训练好的电路中精确计算，得到近似解析的决策阈值。
AI.result: 在表格数据集和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，利用PC编码的层次概率摘要进行OOD检测优于基于根似然、不确定性、典型性和核方法的基线，并能自然地将分布偏移定位到导致偏移的PC节点上。
AI.conclusion: 利用PC内部层次结构而非仅根节点标量，能显著提升OOD检测性能，同时无需部署时留出分布内数据，并具备节点级定位能力。

title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents
summary: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stronger base models may reduce the number of failures, but the remaining hard cases still define the frontier for further improvement. We propose FailForge, an agentic framework that converts failed rollouts into training signal. For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise and actionable skill, and injects the skill into the agent context for a guided second attempt. Trajectories that succeed under skill guidance are folded back into the RFT corpus. Crucially, the skill is removed at training time, so the model internalizes the recovered behavior rather than relying on external hints at inference.
