title: Recurrent Neural Networks Beyond Time: Learning from Multiple Ordered Projections
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are widely used for sequence learning, yet their application is commonly associated with temporal data, although recurrent computation fundamentally operates on ordered sequences rather than on time itself. Building on this observation, we introduce the Ordered Structural Dependency Hypothesis (OSDH), which proposes that multiple admissible orderings of the same observations may reveal complementary structural dependencies inaccessible through a single sequential organization. To operationalize this hypothesis, we propose the Independent Structural Expert Principle (ISEP), whereby projection-specific sequence models are trained independently before their learned representations are integrated through a dedicated fusion model. As a concrete realization, we present Structural Evolution RNNs (SE-RNNs), which employ conventional RNNs as projection-specific structural experts while preserving the underlying recurrent computation unchanged. Proof-of-concept experiments on three synthetic datasets with substantially different levels of structural complexity demonstrate that the proposed architecture consistently benefits from multiple ordered projections when hidden structural dependencies are present, while remaining competitive on simpler datasets. Since OSDH is independent of the underlying sequence-processing model, the proposed framework naturally extends beyond recurrent networks and may be instantiated using alternative architectures. The results suggest a general computational perspective for exploiting complementary ordered representations across diverse structured learning problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出有序结构依赖假说（OSDH），认为对同一观测采用多种合法排序可以揭示单一顺序组织无法获得的互补结构依赖，并通过独立结构专家原理（ISEP）和结构化演化RNN（SE-RNNs）实现，实验验证了多投影排序在隐含结构依赖数据集上的优势。
AI.motivation: RNN虽广泛用于序列学习，但通常局限于时序数据。作者注意到循环计算本质作用于有序序列而非时间本身，因此提出探索多种合法排序组合以挖掘更丰富的结构依赖，突破单一顺序组织的表征瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出OSDH假说与ISEP原理；具体实现为SE-RNNs：采用多个常规RNN作为投影特定的结构专家，各自独立训练后，通过专门的融合模型整合所学表示，底层循环计算保持不变。该框架与底层序列模型无关，可扩展到其他架构。
AI.result: 在三个结构复杂度差异显著的综合数据集上进行概念验证实验，结果表明当存在隐含结构依赖时，SE-RNNs持续受益于多种有序投影；在较简单数据集上性能仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 多种有序投影能提供互补的结构依赖，OSDH为利用互补有序表示提供了通用的计算视角，且框架天然可推广至RNN之外的序列处理架构，适用于多种结构化学习问题。

title: ChronoState: Hidden Elapsed-Time Conditioning for Temporal-State Action Selection in Frozen-Backbone Language Models
comment: Submitted to SPIE Defense and Commercial Sensing 2027
summary: Temporal decisions in language-model systems often depend on both symbolic task state and elapsed wall-clock time, such as cache expiration, job completion, quota resets, deadlines, or stale sessions. We study whether elapsed time can be supplied as a non-token, system-side scalar and composed with visible symbolic state by a frozen-backbone language model. We introduce ChronoState, a compositional temporal-state benchmark in which symbolic state appears in the prompt, elapsed seconds tau are supplied through a hidden chronometric-injection channel, and the model selects a forced-choice temporal action. Here, "hidden" means hidden from the user-visible token sequence, not from model computation. Using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a frozen bf16 backbone with a 31-dimensional sinusoidal-plus-log time encoding, gated FiLM residual modulation, and a rank-8 LoRA action surface, hidden-time CI reaches 0.9305 +/- 0.0134 accuracy and 0.9410 +/- 0.0103 balanced accuracy. No-time and shuffled-time controls fall to 0.5511 +/- 0.0042 and 0.3323 +/- 0.0097, respectively, with high shuffled-time wrong-state consistency supporting causal dependence on the injected scalar within the trained distribution. Generalization remains strong for held-out templates, durations, and multi-constraint compositions, but held-out quota-family transfer is weak at 0.5065 +/- 0.0559, while a fair prompt+LoRA timestamp baseline reaches 0.9893 +/- 0.0052. Thus, ChronoState supports a narrow conclusion: hidden elapsed time can be composed with symbolic task state under direct supervision, but does not establish autonomous time tracking, broad unseen-family abstraction, or superiority over prompt-injected timestamps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoState基准，研究在冻结骨干语言模型中通过隐藏的chronometric注入通道提供非token化的系统侧标量时间，并与可见符号状态组合来完成时序决策任务。结果显示隐藏时间注入(CI)达到0.93+准确率，远优于无时间(0.55)和打乱时间(0.33)对照，但对未见quota族泛化较弱(0.51)，且不如prompt+LoRA时间戳基线(0.99)。结论是隐藏时间可与符号状态在直接监督下组合，但不具备自主时间追踪或广泛跨族抽象能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统中的时序决策常依赖符号任务状态和真实墙钟时间的结合（如缓存过期、任务完成、配额重置、截止时间等），但现有方法主要依赖token内的时间信息。作者希望探索能否将经过的时间作为非token的系统侧标量，通过隐藏通道注入冻结骨干语言模型，并与可见符号状态进行组合推理。
AI.method: 构建ChronoState组合时序状态基准：符号状态出现在prompt中，经过的秒数τ通过隐藏的计时注入通道提供（对用户token序列隐藏，但不隐藏于模型计算）。使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct冻结bf16骨干，配合31维正弦加对数时间编码、门控FiLM残差调制和rank-8 LoRA动作面。设置无时间对照和打乱时间对照，并比较prompt+LoRA时间戳基线。
AI.result: 隐藏时间CI达到0.9305±0.0134准确率和0.9410±0.0103平衡准确率；无时间对照降至0.5511±0.0042，打乱时间对照降至0.3323±0.0097（高打乱状态一致性支持对注入标量的因果依赖）。对未见模板、时长和多约束组合泛化良好，但未见quota族迁移弱(0.5065±0.0559)；prompt+LoRA时间戳基线达0.9893±0.0052。
AI.conclusion: ChronoState支持一个窄结论：隐藏经过时间可在直接监督下与符号任务状态组合，但不支持自主时间追踪、广泛未见族抽象或优于prompt注入时间戳的结论。该工作为探索非token系统侧时间信号与语言模型组合提供了可控的测试框架。

title: Evaluating Generative Time-Series Models on Data with Point Masses
summary: Many of the series that generative time-series models are benchmarked on place a large probability mass on a single value --- it does not rain, no ride is requested, no part is ordered. We report what happens when such data is evaluated carefully. First, the standard rolling-origin protocol can score a model on a window whose atom structure bears no resemblance to the dataset: on one benchmark the dataset is $42\%$ zeros and the evaluation windows are $13\%$, on another $47\%$ against $5\%$. This is not a cosmetic problem --- it reversed one of our own conclusions, turning the strongest occurrence model in our study into what looked like a cautionary tale. Second, we give a control in which CRPS is invariant \emph{by construction} while the temporal coupling is destroyed, which measures exactly how much that coupling contributes to a chosen statistic. Third, benchmarking seven models on a matched protocol over five seeds, an autoregressive hurdle beats a conditional flow on five of six datasets, by up to a factor of $153$, while the flow's own occurrence statistics vary by up to $62\%$ across training seeds and every baseline is deterministic. Finally, the model ordering is not the same under five different occurrence statistics, and the two that do not share a construction agree with each other least.

AI.tldr: 本文指出生成式时间序列模型基准数据中普遍存在大量单值（如零）的概率质量，而标准的rolling-origin评估协议可能在评估窗口中出现与整体数据集结构严重不符的情况（如42%零值的数据集在评估窗口中仅13%零值），这可能导致结论颠倒。作者提出了控制实验证明CRPS在破坏时间耦合时仍保持不变，并通过对7个模型、5个数据集、5个种子的系统比较发现：自回归hurdle模型在5/6数据集上优于conditional flow最多153倍，且不同发生统计量下的模型排序不一致。
AI.motivation: 生成式时间序列模型基准中的许多数据集在单一值（如零）上集中了大量概率质量（如不下雨、无订单等），但现有的评估协议可能忽略或扭曲了这种原子结构，导致模型评估结果失真甚至结论颠倒。
AI.method: 1) 检查并报告标准rolling-origin协议下评估窗口与完整数据集的原子结构差异；2) 设计一个控制实验，通过构造性方法使CRPS保持不变但破坏时间耦合，以量化耦合对所选统计量的贡献；3) 在匹配协议下对7个模型、5个足证、5个种子进行系统基准测试（包括自回归hurdle和conditional flow）；4) 使用五种不同的发生统计量比较模型排序的一致性。
AI.result: 1) 滚动评估窗口的零值比例与数据集整体差异巨大（如42%对13%，47%对5%）；2) 这种不匹配足以颠倒研究结论，使最强发生模型看起来像是反面案例；3) 自回归hurdle在5/6数据集上优于conditional flow，优势最高达153倍；4) conditional flow的发生统计量在不同训练种子间波动高达62%；5) 五种发生统计量下模型排序不一致，其中共享构造的两个统计量之间排序差异最小。
AI.conclusion: 当前时间序列生成模型的评估协议在含大量单值（发生/零）数据的场景下存在严重缺陷，可能导致误导性结论。研究呼吁在评估此类数据时需要对评估窗口结构与数据集保持一致，并在比较模型时使用多种发生统计量并报告种子间的变异性。

title: TRACE: TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering
summary:
Production AI agents fail when their context sources -- system prompts, knowledge bases, tool descriptions, and procedural skills -- contain errors or gaps. Current maintenance relies on manual log review and ad-hoc debugging, creating a scalability bottleneck as interaction volume grows.
  We present TRACE (TRajectory Attribution for Automated Context Engineering), an automated feedback loop that mines historical agent trajectories to diagnose and remediate context failures. Our key insight is that trajectories are rich with implicit dissatisfaction signals -- user corrections, rephrasing, abandonment cues -- that reveal precisely where context sources failed, without explicit feedback collection. Unlike model fine-tuning, TRACE operates on the context layer, enabling rapid iteration without retraining.
  We make four contributions: (1) a trajectory mining framework that systematically extracts diagnostic information from historical agent executions; (2) multi-component causal attribution that extends textual gradients from monolithic prompt optimization to heterogeneous context sources (skills, knowledge bases, tools, prompts); (3) exploratory verification, where agents actively read context sources to distinguish content gaps requiring CREATE from stale content requiring UPDATE, achieving 96% operation accuracy; and (4) a reusable simulation methodology and verifiable benchmark addressing the absence of open datasets for context debugging, with a six-category fault taxonomy, ground truth annotations, and a cross-layer verification protocol.
  On 60 dissatisfaction traces spanning three complexity tiers (up to 16 execution nodes), TRACE achieves 72.7% root cause attribution and 82% end-to-end fix effectiveness, showing that over 80% of context-layer failures can be automatically diagnosed and remediated by mining historical trajectories, an overlooked resource in production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，通过挖掘历史智能体轨迹中的隐式不满信号（用户修正、重述、放弃线索）来自动化诊断和修复生产环境AI智能体的上下文（Context）故障，实现无需显式反馈收集和模型重训的自动反馈闭环。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的AI智能体常因上下文来源（系统提示、知识库、工具描述、程序技能）存在错误或缺口而失败。目前的维护依赖人工日志审查和临时调试，随着交互量增长形成可扩展性瓶颈，亟需自动化的上下文故障诊断与修复机制。
AI.method: TRACE包含四个核心贡献：(1) 轨迹挖掘框架，系统性地从历史智能体执行中提取诊断信息；(2) 多组件因果归因，将文本梯度从单块提示词优化扩展到异构上下文来源（技能、知识库、工具、提示词）；(3) 探索性验证机制，智能体主动阅读上下文来源以区分内容缺口（需要CREATE）与过时内容（需要UPDATE），达到96%操作准确率；(4) 可复用的模拟方法和可验证基准，包含六类故障分类法、ground truth标注和跨层验证协议。
AI.result: 在跨越三个复杂度层级（最多16个执行节点）的60条不满轨迹上，TRACE实现72.7%的根因归因准确率和82%的端到端修复有效性，证明超过80%的上下文层故障可通过挖掘历史轨迹自动诊断和修复。
AI.conclusion: TRACE证明了历史轨迹作为生产系统中被忽视的资源，蕴含丰富的隐式反馈信号，可用于自动化上下文工程。该方法在上下文层操作而非模型微调，支持快速迭代无需重训，为生产AI智能体的上下文维护提供了可扩展的自动化解决方案。

title: PET/CT Radiogenomic Mutation Prediction in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Using Multi-Label Learning
summary: Lung cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer- related mortality worldwide. Although targeted therapies have improved outcomes for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), they rely on mutation profiling through tissue biopsy, an invasive procedure with several limitations. This study investigates PET/CT-based radio- genomic prediction of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), tumour protein 53 (TP53), and Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene (KRAS) mutations using deep learning. We further evaluate whether pairwise multi-label learning improves mutation prediction compared with conventional single-gene classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is among the first studies to systematically investigate multi-label learning for PET/CT radiogenomic mutation prediction in NSCLC. Experiments were conducted on a novel UK-based radiogenomics cohort. Joint pre- diction of KRAS and TP53 improved AUC from 0.58 to 0.64 for KRAS and from 0.69 to 0.71 for TP53. For the EGFR/KRAS pair, only EGFR benefited from joint learning, while no improvement was observed for the EGFR/TP53 pair. These findings demonstrate that the effectiveness of multi-label learning depends on the specific combination of gene mutations being modelled, suggesting that mutation-specific modelling strategies may be preferable for PET/CT radiogenomic prediction.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统性地探索了基于PET/CT影像基因组学的深度学习多标签学习方法，用于预测非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）中EGFR、TP53和KRAS三种基因突变。实验在新型英国影像基因组学队列上进行，发现多标签联合学习对KRAS和TP53的预测效果有提升（AUC分别从0.58升至0.64、0.69升至0.71），但对EGFR/KRAS和EGFR/TP53组合效果不一致，表明多标签学习的有效性取决于具体基因突变组合，突变特异性建模策略可能更为可取。
AI.motivation: 肺癌是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，靶向治疗虽已改善非小细胞肺癌患者的预后，但依赖组织活检进行突变检测，而活检为侵入性操作且存在诸多局限。因此需要探索非侵入性的影像组学方法预测基因突变状态，以弥补组织活检的不足。
AI.method: 采用基于PET/CT影像的深度学习放射基因组学方法，分别对EGFR、TP53和KRAS三种基因突变进行预测，并系统比较了传统单基因分类与成对多标签联合学习的性能差异。实验基于一个新型英国放射基因组学队列。
AI.result: KRAS和TP53的联合预测提升了二者的AUC（KRAS从0.58提升至0.64，TP53从0.69提升至0.71）；EGFR/KRAS组合中仅EGFR获益于联合学习；EGFR/TP53组合则未见任何改善。
AI.conclusion: 多标签学习在PET/CT放射基因组学突变预测中的有效性依赖于所建模的具体基因突变组合，并非普遍适用。研究建议针对突变特异性的建模策略可能更适合PET/CT放射基因组学预测任务。

title: CIDER: A Dataset of Contextual Disclosure Boundaries for Privacy Preference Alignment
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human privacy preferences requires capturing individuals' disclosure boundaries beyond general privacy norms. However, a gap remains in eliciting such nuanced preferences to evaluate alignment in realistic settings. We introduce CIDER, a dataset of 14,850 human annotations from 169 users, forming 1,650 contextual disclosure boundary sets across 60 interpersonal communication scenarios involving information sharing that violates privacy norms. Each boundary represents a real user's disclosure decisions over 9 sharing variants in a scenario, for a given communication role and AI-mediated condition. We formulate a task in which models predict a user's disclosure decision from historical boundaries, with varying levels of contextual information. Across 12 open and proprietary models, in-context personalization improves prediction accuracy by up to 11.41 percentage points using only 6 historical examples. Larger models such as GPT-5.4 (with medium reasoning effort) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 are better at leveraging semantic context to understand user-specific, context-dependent disclosure preferences for more accurate predictions, while smaller models tend to rely on structured heuristics based on disclosure granularity and identifiability. Personalization generally improves prediction accuracy, but the improvement is often accompanied by imbalanced shifts in false-positive and false-negative rates across models, with only Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieving balanced improvements in both. Our findings reveal both the promise and limitations of inference-time personalization for privacy preference modeling and position CIDER as a resource for advancing personalized privacy alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIDER数据集，包含14,850条来自169位用户的人工标注，构成60个社交场景中1,650个上下文披露边界集。通过实验发现，上下文个性化能最多提升11.41个百分点的预测准确率（仅需6个历史示例），但不同模型在隐私偏好预测中呈现不同的策略权衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型与人类隐私偏好对齐需要捕捉个体化的信息披露边界，而不仅是一般隐私规范。然而，当前缺乏在真实场景中引发这种细粒度偏好并评估对齐效果的数据资源，这是研究空白所在。
AI.method: 构建CIDER数据集：在60个涉及违反隐私规范的信息共享人际沟通场景中，收集169位用户在9种共享变体上的披露决策，形成边界集。在此基础上设计任务：模型根据用户的历史披露边界预测其新的披露决策，并在12种开源和专有模型上评估不同上下文信息水平下的预测表现。
AI.result: 上下文个性化在仅使用6个历史示例的情况下，最多提升预测准确率11.41个百分点。大型模型（如GPT-5.4中等推理努力、Claude Sonnet 4.6）更擅长利用语义上下文理解用户特定且依赖上下文的披露偏好；小型模型则倾向依赖基于披露粒度和可识别性的结构化启发式。个性化普遍提升准确率，但常伴随假阳性和假阴性率的不均衡偏移，仅Claude Sonnet 4.6实现了二者平衡的改进。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现揭示了推理时个性化在隐私偏好建模中的潜力与局限，并将CIDER定位为推进个性化隐私对齐研究的资源。

title: Rethinking Factor Sharing in Federated LoRA: A Rank-Aware Adaptive Approach
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) represents large language model (LLM) updates with two compact matrix factors, i.e., $A$ and $B$, providing an efficient way to fine-tune large models in federated learning paradigm. Inspired by the asymmetric roles of the LoRA factors, we study whether $A$ should be shared across clients while $B$ remains client-specific (Share-A/Local-B), or whether $B$ should instead be shared while $A$ remains client-specific (Share-B/Local-A). With a least-squares surrogate, we reveal that Share-A/Local-B requires the client-specific LoRA update matrices to use a common rank-$r$ input-side space, whereas Share-B/Local-A requires a common rank-$r$ output-side space. The two strategies therefore incur different projection residuals, indicating that the preferred strategy is the one with the smaller aggregate residual across clients. With this insight, we propose Federated Adaptive Factor Sharing Low-Rank Adaptation (FedAS-LoRA), which selects the sharing side before training to enhance fine-tuning performance. To enable adaptive factor selection before training, we design a Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency (RSS) metric, which effectively assesses whether a shared rank-$r$ input subspace is sufficient for the local data distributions using representations extracted from a frozen LLM backbone. Experiments across different tasks, data distributions, LoRA ranks, and participation settings confirm the effectiveness of RSS and the superior performance of FedAS-LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FedAS-LoRA方法，在联邦学习中使用LoRA微调大语言模型时，根据共享子空间是否充分的自适应选择共享哪个LoRA因子（A或B），通过提出的RSS指标在训练前评估共享输入侧子空间的充分性，从而提升联邦微调性能。
AI.motivation: LoRA因子A和B在联邦学习中扮演不对称的角色，共享A保留客户端特定B（Share-A/Local-B）或共享B保留客户端特定A（Share-B/Local-A）会带来不同的投影残差。现有方法未考虑这种不对称性对各客户端数据分布适应性的影响，缺少系统性地分析哪种共享策略更优以及如何预先选择的框架。
AI.method: 1) 利用最小二乘替代模型从理论上分析两种共享策略（Share-A/Local-B与Share-B/Local-A）的投影残差差异；2) 提出FedAS-LoRA框架，在训练前根据较小聚合残差选择共享侧；3) 设计了RSS（Rank-Aware Shared-Subspace Sufficiency）指标，利用冻结的LLM骨干网络提取的表示来评估共享秩r输入子空间对本地数据分布的充分性，从而指导自适应因子选择。
AI.result: 在多种任务、数据分布、LoRA秩和参与率设置下，实验验证了RSS指标的有效性，并证明FedAS-LoRA相较于固定共享策略具有更优的微调性能。
AI.conclusion: LoRA因子的共享策略应根据客户端数据分布自适应选择，而非固定不变；RSS指标能够在训练前有效地指导共享侧的选择，FedAS-LoRA为联邦学习中的LoRA微调提供了一种更高效的个性化方案。

title: From Relevance to Execution Utility: Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gating for Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills are increasingly used to equip large language model (LLM) agents with reusable procedural knowledge. Although recent work has substantially improved skill retrieval due to the increasing skill libraries, retrieving a plausible skill bundle does not guarantee that executing it is worthwhile. Since every skill-conditioned rollout is computationally expensive, deciding whether a retrieved bundle should be executed has become an increasingly important challenge. To this end, we introduce the Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate (RADEG), a lightweight, retriever-agnostic decision layer between skill retrieval and agent execution. RADEG learns a low-cost surrogate model that predicts the execution utility of a query--bundle pair before the expensive rollout is launched. To obtain informative supervision while controlling for task difficulty, we locally perturb each retrieved bundle by deleting, adding, or replacing one skill, producing matched same-query rollouts that isolate the effect of bundle composition on verifier reward. During deployment, RADEG updates only a warm-started logistic head as new verifier feedback becomes available, enabling inexpensive adaptation of the execute/skip boundary without retraining either the retriever or the agent. Under a query-level held-out evaluation on 288 collected rollouts, RADEG substantially reduces unnecessary agent executions while preserving a large fraction of the downstream verifier reward. It consistently outperforms relevance-based and random gating across different execution budgets, demonstrating that execution-aware surrogate modeling provides a practical and cost-effective complement to skill retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RADEG（Reward-Aware Dynamic Execution Gate），一种轻量级、与检索器无关的决策层，介于技能检索与智能体执行之间，通过学习低成本代理模型预测查询-技能束对的执行效用，从而在不启动昂贵rollout的情况下决定是否执行检索到的技能束，显著减少不必要的智能体执行并保留大部分下游验证奖励。
AI.motivation: 随着技能库不断增大，检索到合理的技能束并不保证执行是值得的。每次技能条件化rollout计算代价高昂，因此决定是否执行检索到的技能束成为日益重要的挑战。现有工作主要集中于改进技能检索本身，而忽视了"检索结果是否值得执行"这一环节。
AI.method: RADEG包含三个核心组件：（1）学习一个低成本的代理模型，预测查询-技能束对的执行效用；（2）通过局部扰动（删除、添加或替换一个技能）生成同查询的匹配rollouts，隔离技能组成对验证奖励的影响，从而获得信息丰富的监督信号并控制任务难度；（3）部署阶段仅更新暖启动的logistic头以适应新验证反馈，无需重训练检索器或智能体。
AI.result: 在288个采集rollouts的查询级留出评估中，RADEG显著减少了不必要的智能体执行，同时保留了大部分下游验证器奖励。在不同执行预算下均一致优于基于相关性的门控和随机门控方法。
AI.conclusion: 执行感知的代理建模是技能检索的实用且经济高效的补充，RADEG为技能检索与智能体执行之间提供了一个轻量级的执行决策层，证明了在昂贵的rollout之前进行低成本执行效用预测的可行性。

title: SR-OPSD: Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) converts feedback into dense token-level supervision on trajectories generated by the policy to be optimized, providing a useful complement to reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards. However, the self-teacher policy used in OPSD is typically a stop-gradient or exponential-moving-average copy of the policy conditioned on additional context information, and thus co-evolves with both the student policy and its on-policy context distribution. Directly matching such a moving target with a fixed projection objective can lead to unstable optimization or excessive distributional concentration. This nature of OPSD motivates the proposed \emph{Self-Referenced On-Policy Self-Distillation (SR-OPSD)}. At fixed student-generated contexts, a token-level variational characterization identifies the effective distillation target as a geometric interpolation between the self-teacher policy and a reference policy. Meanwhile, we use the Rényi divergence family to generalize the projection geometry. This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SR-OPSD（自参考在线策略自蒸馏），通过在固定学生生成上下文中引入参考策略和Rényi散度族，稳定了在线策略自蒸馏中移动目标导致的优化不稳定问题，在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成任务上达到SOTA或竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过将反馈转化为密集的token级监督来补充稀疏结果奖励的强化学习，但其自教师策略与学生策略及其on-policy上下文分布共同演化，是一个移动目标。直接用固定的投影目标匹配这样的移动目标会导致优化不稳定或过度的分布集中。
AI.method: SR-OPSD通过token级别的变分特征化，在固定学生生成上下文中将有效蒸馏目标识别为自教师策略与参考策略之间的几何插值；同时使用Rényi散度族推广投影几何。该方法将自适应目标的位置（由插值系数控制）与学生向目标投影的方式（由Rényi阶数控制，决定对token级密度比的敏感性）解耦。
AI.result: 在科学评估、数学推理和代码生成等多个任务上，使用多种大语言模型的广泛实验表明，SR-OPSD在各种设置下均达到最先进或具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将目标的位置（where）与投影几何（how）分离，SR-OPSD有效地解决了OPSD中移动目标带来的不稳定问题，为在线自蒸馏提供了一种更稳健且通用的优化框架。

title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于执行反馈的双路径后果感知智能体框架，用于SONiC命令行网络操作，通过生成多个完整动作、预测执行后果并进行效用与风险感知的重排序来选择最终动作，同时通过可检索的运维经验和会话级LoRA更新两条路径分别提升候选覆盖率和选择质量。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在命令行网络操作中虽然能生成看似合理的命令，但执行后可能失败或引入运维风险。现有方法仅关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，未利用执行接地（execution-grounded）的经验来联合改善候选覆盖率和动作选择质量。
AI.method: 提出执行接地的双路径后果感知智能体（execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent）：1）提案侧（proposal-side）路径将可复用的运维经验抽象为可检索的指导信息，在不修改提案LLM的前提下提高可行动作覆盖率；2）选择侧（selection-side）路径通过会话级LoRA更新，利用真实SSH反馈自适应调整后果预测器，提升条件选择质量。整体流程为：生成多个完整动作→预测各自执行后果→通过效用与风险感知的重排序选择最终动作。
AI.result: 在基于不同Qwen3提案模型的多轮SONiC操作会话实验中，该框架显著提高了可行动作覆盖率和top-1执行成功率，且两条适应路径在交互过程中提供了互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 执行接地的双路径自适应框架能够有效结合候选生成与后果预测两条路径的互补优势，在不修改下游LLM的前提下同时提升动作覆盖率和选择质量，为命令行网络操作场景中的LLM智能体提供了一种实用的增强方案。

title: MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries
summary: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

AI.tldr: 提出了MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），通过CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）方法构建稳定的多尺度潜空间，解决现有可学习投影机制中潜token分配不平衡和深层token塌缩问题，在一般几何上高效求解PDE，性能与计算效率均优于现有最先进神经算子。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在求解PDE时，可学习的投影机制无法保证观测点到潜token的稳定均衡分配，导致部分token过载而其他token未被充分利用；这种不均衡在多尺度层级结构中会被继承并放大，最终引发深层空间的token塌缩，限制了层级架构的设计。
AI.method: 提出MoNo，一种渐进式多尺度神经算子。核心是CoTAP方法，将相邻潜空间之间的跨空间分配问题建模为熵正则化最优传输问题，从而构建均衡的双向投影和稳定的潜空间；CoTAP保证多潜空间间的稳定信息传递，支持在一般几何上的多尺度架构，有效学习长程物理交互。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均优于现有最先进的神经算子。
AI.conclusion: 通过最优传输理论解决了潜空间分配不平衡与token塌缩问题，为一般几何上的多尺度PDE求解提供了一种高效且鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Structure-Preserving Uncertainty Propagation in First-Order Proof Search
comment: 79 pages, 6 figures. Executable binaries, documentation, examples, and public samplers: https://github.com/tammet/gkreasoner
summary:
GK is a query-directed first-order prover that extends ordinary resolution-based proof search with explicit positive and negative claims, numerical confidence values, and prioritized default rules with exceptions. It works directly with non-ground clauses, including equality and function terms. Candidate proofs are found by bounded first-order proof search; exception conditions of defaults are checked by further bounded searches, recursively when exceptions themselves depend on defaults. This avoids requiring a finite global grounding, while allowing incomplete searches to be reported as such.
  This paper adds structure-preserving quantitative reporting to that framework. Retained proof histories are used in two calculations. The first reconstructs the uncertain ground premises used by each proof and computes the probability that at least one retained proof is available, without counting shared premises independently. The second resolves positive and negative support at intermediate atoms before that support is propagated through later rules; the same calculation evaluates uncertain exception conditions for individual rule applications. Reports separate positive support, negative support, conflict, and ignorance and identify detected incomplete calculations or fallbacks. The implementation performs bounded reconstruction and dependency traversal after proof search and still requires no global grounding. Analytic examples and independent simulators reproduce the reference calculations on their stated fragments. Comparisons with probabilistic logic, probabilistic ASP, default logic, and goal-directed ASP identify cases of agreement, semantic difference, unsupported translation, and incomplete computation.

AI.tldr: 本文为GK一阶定理证明框架增加了结构保持的定量报告机制，利用保留的证明历史进行两种计算：一是重构每项证明所依赖的不确定接地前提，并计算至少保留一个证明可用的概率（不重复计算共享前提）；二是在中间原子处解析正负支持后再将其传播到后续规则，同时评估每条规则应用的不确定例外条件。报告区分正支持、负支持、冲突和无知，并识别检测到的不完整计算或回退。实现无需全局接地，通过有界搜索和依赖遍历完成。
AI.motivation: GK框架此前虽能进行有界一阶证明搜索并处理默认规则，但缺乏结构化的定量报告能力，无法向用户清晰呈现正负支持、概率置信度及计算不完整性等信息。
AI.method: 利用保留的证明历史进行两种核心计算：(1) 重构每个证明使用的不确定接地前提，计算至少保留一个证明可用的概率（避免对共享前提重复计数）；(2) 在中间原子处解析正负支持后传播，同时评估个别规则应用的例外条件。实现通过有界重构和依赖遍历在证明搜索之后运行，仍无需全局接地。使用解析示例和独立模拟器验证。
AI.result: 解析示例和独立模拟器在所述片段上重现了参考计算结果；与概率逻辑、概率ASP、默认逻辑和目标导向ASP的比较识别出一致、语义差异、不支持的翻译和不完整计算等各类情况。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为GK框架增添了结构保持的定量报告能力，在保持无需全局接地的同时提供正/负支持、冲突和无知的区分，并通过与多种逻辑框架的比较明确了语义边界和局限性。

title: ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning
summary: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReliableNet，一种在训练阶段直接约束"高置信且错误"（JCW）联合概率的风险控制分类方法，通过机会约束的经验风险最小化和保守平滑内逼近，确保模型预测在给定风险预算内的可靠性，实验证明其在分布内和多种分布漂移场景下均优于ERM、校准、共形风险控制和选择性预测等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 高置信但错误的预测是关键的可靠性失效，因为它恰好能在模型出错时绕过弃权和人工审查。现有的ERM仅控制平均损失，而校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制和选择性预测等方法针对相关可靠性属性，但未在训练期间直接约束这一联合失效事件。需要一个能直接在训练中约束"自信且错误"联合概率的方法。
AI.method: ReliableNet将置信-错误联合概率约束形式化为机会约束的ERM问题（chance-constrained ERM），将JCW概率约束在用户指定的风险预算α之下。为解决机会约束的不可解性，使用一个保守平滑内逼近（conservative smooth inner approximation），该逼近的总体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束的成立。
AI.result: 在四个表格数据集和两个图像数据集上，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和随机种子下均在分布内被认证满足JCW预算的方法。在人口统计、模糊性、伪相关、新类别和协变量偏移下，它取得最低的经验JCW，同时在准确率、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测方面保持竞争力。风险覆盖结果表明其在多数数据集上选择性排序优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了一种有原则的方法，首次实现在训练阶段直接对高置信错误的联合概率进行约束，在各种分布偏移场景下均展现出优越的可靠性。

title: Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy for Dense Expert Merging
summary: Dense expert merging combines domain-specialized language models into one single checkpoint, typically by admitting task-vector support in weight space. However, this admission is governed by three decisions that existing methods answer only partially: where to open layer capacity from cross-expert conflict, who should occupy that capacity based on domain demand, and how to admit the resulting support without relying on costly recipe search. To tackle these issues, we propose SigMerge (Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy), a structured capacity assignment framework for dense expert merging. Starting from a dense base merge, conflict signatures set each layer's capacity from cross-expert conflict, positive base-merge deficits set each domain's share of that capacity, and a sequential occupancy rule admits each expert delta up to the resulting layer-domain budget. Across 21 paired settings spanning seven dense base merges and three model pools, SigMerge improves every one (by 15.0% on average) and achieves the best average rank (1.67) among six merging methods, outperforming three categories of merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SigMerge框架，通过冲突签名确定层容量、正基合并赤字确定领域份额、顺序占用规则分配专家增量，在21个配对设置上平均提升15.0%，平均排名1.67，超越六种合并方法。
AI.motivation: 稠密专家合并中存在三个关键决策未被现有方法充分解决：在何处开放层容量以消除跨专家冲突、谁应占用该容量（基于领域需求）、以及如何在不依赖昂贵配方搜索的情况下实现支持性分配。
AI.method: SigMerge包含三个核心组件：1) 冲突签名从稠密基础合并中设定每层容量；2) 正基础合并赤字设定每个领域在该容量中的份额；3) 顺序占用规则按层-域预算依次接纳每个专家增量。
AI.result: 在横跨7个稠密基础合并和3个模型池的21个配对设置中，SigMerge在所有设置上均取得改进（平均提升15.0%），平均排名1.67，优于三个类别的六个合并基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SigMerge通过结构化的容量分配框架有效解决了稠密专家合并中的容量开启、容量占用和分配支持三个问题，证明了基于冲突签名和领域需求的结构化分配方法显著优于现有合并策略。

title: Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning
summary: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数空间探索方法族——扰动参数策略优化（3PO），通过在rollout生成时从后验中采样不同策略来探索，作为动作空间温度缩放的补充控制杠杆，在数学推理和代码生成任务上一致优于标准GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM强化学习探索方法主要作用于动作空间（如温度缩放），这些方法无法重新排序token，只能影响输出分布的方差，限制了探索能力，可能导致训练发散或停滞。因此需要探索参数空间的探索机制作为补充。
AI.method: 提出3PO（Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization）方法族，包含两种设计维度：（1）不同的参数采样策略（从后验中采样不同多样性的策略）；（2）不同的rollout分组策略用于奖励估计。通过采样多样性不同的策略来生成rollout，实现参数空间的探索。
AI.result: 在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上的数学推理与代码生成实验中，3PO方法在近似相同的FLOPs成本下一致优于标准GRPO的平均下游性能。多个参数采样显著减少了训练中的零优势组、格式错误和错误rollout的数量。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了参数空间探索能改善LLM强化学习的证据，表明其可作为动作空间探索的有效补充，尤其在减少无效rollout和提升训练稳定性方面具有优势。

title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出CRUISE框架，利用视觉语言模型引导的细粒度像素级不确定性量化，结合动态自适应机制进行跨模态传感器融合，提升自动驾驶在恶劣条件下的感知鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶多传感器（摄像头、LiDAR、雷达）在不同环境条件下可靠性差异大，现有的不确定性感知融合方法仅依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，难以在复杂的分布外场景中有效泛化。
AI.method: CRUISE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) VLM引导的不确定性量化模块，生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计，利用VLM的丰富先验知识和上下文推理能力；(2) 动态自适应机制，显式建模跨模态依赖关系，充分利用多传感器输入的互补特性。
AI.result: 该工作为所提出的CRUISE框架提供了方法论描述，原文摘要中未提供具体实验结果数据，但框架设计旨在提升复杂、分布外场景下的跨模态融合性能。
AI.conclusion: CRUISE通过VLM引导的像素级不确定性估计和动态跨模态依赖建模，为自动驾驶中的鲁棒传感器融合提供了一种新颖的解决方案，有望克服传统不确定性感知融合方法在复杂场景下的泛化瓶颈。

title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
summary: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.

AI.tldr: Macaron-V1是一个面向"体验智能"（experiential intelligence）的开源智能体模型家族，核心目标是在真实环境中学习并部署后持续学习。系统通过两个关键机制实现：自适应的递归改进版模型-测试工具对（Model-Harness Co-design），以及协作式的Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构。旗舰版Venti基于744B GLM-5.2基础模型搭配四个LoRA专家（chat、agent、coding、GenUI），轻量版Tall（50B）基于Qwen3.6用于本地部署。系统集成了架构、算法和基础设施的协同设计，在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准上进行了全面评估。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体模型大多在静态数据集上单次训练后即部署，缺乏从真实环境经验中学习和持续进化的能力。作者希望构建一个能"体验驱动"的智能体系统，既能通过递归自改进实现自适应，又能通过模块化LoRA专家实现多方协作，从而突破传统模型训练-部署割裂的范式。
AI.method: 系统采用两种核心设计：(1) 自适应机制——通过Model-Harness Co-design和递归自我改进循环，将经验从旧版本的模型-测试工具组合中提取，在外部合约（HCP，版本化）约束下评估并构建下一代模型；(2) 协作机制——MoL架构冻结基础模型，组合多个专门的LoRA适配器，每个用户轮次动态选择一个最适合的LoRA。配套基础设施包括：UI4A组件级GenUI测试工具、有状态动作基座、MindForge智能体强化学习框架、MinT后训练平台、LongStraw长上下文RL方法，以及针对稀疏MoE和DSA基础模型的稳定性技术。
AI.result: Macaron-V1在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准上与前沿基线进行了对比评估，结果验证了当前系统设计的有效性。但持续学习和集体智能带来的复合收益是否成立，仍作为开放问题留待后续研究验证。
AI.conclusion: Macaron-V1展示了通过架构-算法-基础设施协同设计实现体验智能的可行性。MoL架构提供了可持续学习的可扩展机制，递归自改进循环支持部署后的持续进化。当前系统设计已获得初步验证，而持续学习与集体智能的长期复合收益是未来工作的核心开放方向。

title: Omni2LoRA: Coherence-Preserving Parametric Memory for Efficient Omni Language Models
summary: Omnimodal language models (OLMs) enable unified audio-visual understanding, but processing long joint token sequences makes inference computationally prohibitive. While recent token compression methods attempt to alleviate this burden, compressing modalities in isolation often destroys the temporal cross-modal anchors necessary for coherent reasoning. We introduce Omni2LoRA, a two-stage framework for efficient parametric memory compression via coherence-preserving context distillation that bypasses the token bottleneck entirely. First, a Perceiver hypernetwork processes intermediate representations from a frozen OLM to encode the multimodal context into a full-rank Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. To prevent the resulting parameter footprint from scaling linearly with recording length, we optimize a discrete rank allocation policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that uses a modality-ablated counterfactual reward to explicitly penalize the loss of audio-visual coherence, forcing the model to allocate its fixed sub-linear rank budget to synergistic cross-modal anchors rather than isolated visual features. Across three omnimodal backbones, Omni2LoRA operating at a 30% rank budget outperforms direct full-context inference and strong token-compression baselines (OmniZip, OMAC, O-MARC) on four audio-visual question answering benchmarks, improving average accuracy by 8-12% over the strongest baseline and remaining stable under compression ratios as tight as 75%, where token-pruning methods degrade sharply. By converting multimodal memory into a fixed-budget, reusable parameter state, our method drives answer-time multimodal-token load to zero, cutting per-query Time to First Token (TTFT) by up to 12x relative to full-context inference and amortizing to under 0.5s after a handful of queries.

AI.tldr: Omni2LoRA是一种两阶段框架，通过相干性保持的上下文蒸馏将多模态上下文编码为全秩LoRA适配器，绕过token瓶颈实现高效的omnimodal语言模型推理。它使用GRPO优化的离散秩分配策略，以模态消融反事实奖励惩罚音视频相干性损失，在30%秩预算下超越全上下文推理和现有token压缩基线，将TTFT降低至12倍。
AI.motivation: 现有omnimodal语言模型虽然支持统一的音视频理解，但长联合token序列使得推理计算代价过高。现有的token压缩方法在孤立压缩各模态时会破坏时间上的跨模态锚点，损害连贯推理所需的跨模态关联信息。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) Perceiver超网络在单次前向传播中将冻结OLM的中间表示编码为全秩LoRA适配器，实现参数化内存压缩；(2) 通过GRPO优化离散秩分配策略，使用模态消融反事实奖励显式惩罚音视频相干性损失，在固定的亚线性秩预算下将资源分配给协同的跨模态锚点。
AI.result: 在三个omnimodal骨干网络和四个音视频问答基准上，Omni2LoRA在30%秩预算下优于直接全上下文推理和强token压缩基线（OmniZip、OMAC、O-MARC），平均准确率比最强基线提高8-12%，在75%压缩比下保持稳定，将每查询TTFT降低至12倍，摊销后低于0.5秒。
AI.conclusion: Omni2LoRA通过将多模态内存转换为固定预算、可复用的参数状态，将回答时的多模态token负载降至零，有效解决了omnimodal推理的计算瓶颈，同时通过相干性感知的秩分配保持跨模态推理质量。

title: Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SKALD（Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation），一种基于技能锚定的潜在蒸馏框架，用于解决可验证奖励强化学习中rollout组均匀正确或均匀错误时（占实验分组63-68%）缺乏组间相对信号的问题。SKALD通过对Qwen3-Base模型的教师-学生双视图蒸馏，将抽象技能优势迁移到共享参数中，在五个数学基准上相对GRPO平均提升avg@8达+2.46到+12.01（0.6B-4B规模）。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励的强化学习中，当rollout组内所有样本全部正确或全部错误时（占63-68%），组间相对比较信号完全消失，导致学习信号退化为纯正确性监督而丧失相对偏好信息。这显著限制了策略优化的signal密度和效率。
AI.method: SKALD采用同策略自蒸馏框架，包含两个视角：仅基于问题的学生模型和以抽象显式答案过滤技能卡片为条件的教师模型。学生利用自身前缀训练，将技能引导的优势迁移到共享参数中，推理时无需特权输入。关键机制包括：(1) 退火指数倾斜目标函数，降低教师偏好但学生似然极低的token权重，倾斜消失时收敛到教师交叉熵并恢复前向KL学生梯度；(2) 经验门控机制，仅在验证rollout估计教师模型优势为正时激活蒸馏。
AI.result: 在五个数学基准上，SKALD相对GRPO在avg@8指标上提升：0.6B为+2.46，1.7B为+4.85，4B为+12.01。1.7B规模下，仅零方差蒸馏可恢复完整增益的84.7%，SKALD相对FLOP匹配的GRPO高出+4.06，并超过上下文技能暴露方法+3.77。
AI.conclusion: 抽象技能为可验证奖励RL中组相对信号失效的场景提供了密集监督信号。SKALD通过技能锚定的潜在蒸馏，在不引入推理期特权输入的前提下，将技能条件优势有效编码进模型共享参数，实现了对GRPO的一致且显著的性能提升。

title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge
summary: Industrial-safety understanding requires more than detecting workers, equipment, and personal protective equipment. Models must also assess compliance, identify hazardous interactions, explain potential accident mechanisms, and recommend preventive actions. Existing safety datasets primarily focus on visual perception or isolated violation recognition and provide limited supervision for evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce SafeSceneReason, a multimodal industrial-safety reasoning benchmark and companion training corpus that connects workplace scenes with knowledge from occupational accident investigations. SafeSceneReason combines two complementary data-construction pipelines. The scene-centric pipeline converts annotated workplace images into executable safety scene graphs and generates deterministic answers through program execution over objects, relations, and safety rules. The report-centric pipeline extracts figures and contextual evidence from accident reports and constructs multimodal questions using evidence graphs, explicit information boundaries, multi-step reasoning paths, and iterative verification. The resulting resource contains 110,581 verified scene-centric question--answer pairs and 13,114 refined report-centric question--answer pairs, covering perception, spatial and quantitative reasoning, compliance assessment, evidence synthesis, causal analysis, and mitigation-oriented decision making. Evaluation of representative proprietary and open-source vision--language models reveals substantial performance differences and persistent weaknesses in comparative, technical, and multi-evidence reasoning, demonstrating that strong general visual understanding does not yet guarantee reliable industrial-safety reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeSceneReason，一个多模态工业安全推理基准与配套训练语料库，通过场景中心流程（安全场景图+程序执行生成确定性答案）和报告中心流程（从事故报告中提取证据构建多模态问题）两条互补的数据构建管道，生成约12万条问答对，覆盖感知、空间与定量推理、合规评估、证据综合、因果分析及缓解决策，并揭示现有视觉语言模型在工业安全推理上的显著不足。
AI.motivation: 工业安全理解不仅需要检测人员、设备和个人防护装备，还必须评估合规性、识别危险交互、解释潜在事故机制并提出预防措施。然而现有安全数据集主要聚焦于视觉感知或孤立的违规识别，缺乏面向证据推理（evidence-grounded reasoning）的监督信号，制约了模型在真实工业场景中的可靠推理能力。
AI.method: SafeSceneReason包含两条互补的数据构建管道：（1）场景中心管道：将标注的工作场所图像转化为可执行的安全场景图，通过针对对象、关系和安全规则的程序执行生成确定性答案；（2）报告中心管道：从职业事故调查报告中提取图形和上下文证据，利用证据图、显式信息边界、多步推理路径和迭代验证构建多模态问题。最终生成110,581条场景中心QA对和13,114条报告中心QA对。
AI.result: 评测了代表性的专有与开源视觉语言模型，发现它们在比较推理、技术推理和多证据推理等维度上存在持续性弱点，且不同模型之间性能差异显著，表明强大的通用视觉理解能力尚不能保证可靠的工业安全推理。
AI.conclusion: SafeSceneReason填补了工业安全推理数据资源的空白，为评估和训练模型在工业安全场景中的证据推理能力提供了标准化基准。评测结果说明，通用VLM在工业安全这一高风险垂直领域的推理能力仍需专门的数据与训练方法加以强化。

title: Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproducibility artifacts available in the public POLIS repository
summary: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.

AI.tldr: 本文是POLIS研究计划的首篇论文，通过一个预先冻结的5,280集结构化工作流研究套件，系统性地考察AI机构中哪些组成部分（规则表述、权威状态、合规路径等）影响安全性。结果显示宪法式提示词和可溯源执行守卫均实现0/384违规，而仅依赖局部状态的守卫在高冲突场景中失败（22/96违规）；同一违规率下可能存在完全不同的安全机制。
AI.motivation: AI代理越来越多地在多代理系统中运行，其委派任务、传递信息、执行行动和共享资源的方式受到系统规则的约束。已有研究表明部署规则可以改变集体行为，但尚不清楚AI机构的哪个具体部分产生安全性以及如何产生。作者希望通过系统性的实验分离规则本身与权威状态、执行路径等制度组件的独立贡献。
AI.method: 研究采用预注册/预先指定的实验设计，构建了5,280集的冻结研究套件。主要委派实验覆盖四个模型家族，另有三个额外的模型端点用于高冲突诊断场景。实验操纵包括：不同规则表述、守卫咨询不同权威状态（局部状态vs可溯源到原始权威）、合规的内部/自我回退路径的吸引力、以及阻塞后允许继续执行的选项。此外还有一个单独的资源分配实验检验揭示数值上限的影响。
AI.result: 1) 详细的宪法式提示词实现0/384实际违规；2) 可溯源执行守卫也实现0/384违规，但在51/384集中阻止了被禁止的尝试，其中44/51后来安全完成；3) 局部状态守卫在可见策略被普通变换改变而原始权威不变的场景中失效，在匹配的洗钱场景中22/96集出现违规，而可溯源执法实现0/96（p = 4.77 x 10^-7）；4) 单独的实验中，揭示数字上限的值改变了代理的资源请求行为。
AI.conclusion: 相同最终的违规率可能掩盖截然不同的底层机制——规则本身只是机构的一部分。系统所信赖的权威状态至关重要，阻塞后可供继续执行的路径同样重要。这一发现为设计多层级的、具有可溯源权威安全机制的多代理系统提供了实证基础。

title: An Explainable GNN Framework for Component-Level Anomaly Diagnosis
summary: Industrial processes are complex systems composed of multiple interacting sensors that generate multivariate time series (MTS). Detecting anomalies in such systems is critical for reliability and safety, yet understanding their origin is equally important. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)based methods for anomaly detection primarily focus on sensor-level deviations and either attribute anomalies directly to the deviating sensors. When diagnosis is attempted, generally, the most deviated sensor is identified as a root cause of a system fault. However, in many industrial systems, anomalies do not arise from faulty sensors but from disruptions in the influences governing the system dynamics. We propose an explainable GNN-based anomaly detection framework that shifts the perspective from sensor-level anomalies to component-level diagnosis, hypothesizing that anomalous measurements are symptoms of altered inter-sensor influences. Experiments show that the method effectively identifies and prioritizes the true faulty components, providing interpretable insights into system failures.

title: Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors
summary: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态深度学习框架，利用腕戴式传感器（IMU、热释电、飞行时间传感器）对躯体重复行为（如拔毛、抓皮）进行早期客观检测与分类，在二分类任务上达到F1=0.985、AUC=0.997，九分类任务上达到宏F1=0.700、AUC=0.963，为可穿戴式心理健康诊断与个性化干预奠定了基础。
AI.motivation: 躯体重复行为（如拔毛、抓皮）是强迫症和焦虑障碍中常见的强迫性运动行为，其早期客观检测十分困难，因为这些运动细微且与正常非病态手势高度重叠。传统依赖主观观察或事后报告的方式无法实现客观、连续、早期的行为监测，亟需一种自动化的检测手段。
AI.method: 研究使用Child Mind Institute通过Helios腕戴设备采集的多模态数据，包含惯性测量单元（IMU）、热释电传感器和飞行时间传感器，分别捕获运动学、热学和接近度信息。框架将卷积神经网络（CNN）与门控循环单元（GRU）相结合，并引入模态专用的自编码器及晚期融合分类器，以充分利用时空动力学特征。
AI.result: 二分类检测中F1分数达0.985、ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.997；九分类方案（区分每种具体行为与单一归组的非目标类）中宏平均F1为0.700、AUC为0.963，优于单模态基线。基于Shapley加性解释（SHAP）的后验可解释性分析表明，飞行时间与惯性模态通过捕获空间接近度和动态运动主导判别力；层次聚类显示误分类主要由手势的解剖区域驱动。
AI.conclusion: 多模态传感器融合能够实现对这些行为准确、客观、连续的监测，为实时可穿戴辅助心理健康诊断和个性化干预奠定了坚实基础，在生物医学研究和临床护理中具有广阔应用前景。

title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
summary: Skill-based LLM agents select reusable procedures from an external library to solve complex tasks, yet their routing decisions rely entirely on text-level signals such as task descriptions, verbal reflections, and experience-derived rules, while the model's own internal representational state remains unobserved. Recent interpretability work has shown that LLMs maintain linear emotion representations that causally influence behavior; however, these representations have been exploited only for post-hoc analysis or direct output steering, and have not been used to inform agent-level decision-making. We propose Emotion2Skill, a framework that extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and incorporates them into both skill selection and skill evolution. At each decision step, a 27-dimensional emotion state is extracted from the residual stream and mapped to a confidence-gated summary injected into the routing prompt. Beyond online selection, emotion trajectories are analyzed for abrupt internal-state shifts to pinpoint problematic skill invocations, guiding targeted SOP rewriting that replaces the coarse binary outcome signal of prior methods. On WebShop and ALFWorld, Emotion2Skill with Qwen3-8B improves over the Zero-Shot baseline by +26.9% success rate and +25.5% average success respectively, outperforming all baselines on both benchmarks with consistent gains on Qwen3-14B. Co-activation analysis further reveals semantically coherent emotion--skill pairings, confirming that the routing improvements reflect meaningful internal-state signals rather than opaque statistical correlations. These results establish LLM-internal emotion representations as an effective decision-level signal for orchestrating agent skill systems, extending their utility beyond interpretability and output steering. The code is available at https://github.com/BoHan-LIN04/Emotion2Skill.

AI.tldr: 提出Emotion2Skill框架，从LLM残差流中提取27维情绪向量，整合到技能选择与技能演化流程中，在WebShop和ALFWorld上显著提升智能体成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于技能的LLM智能体在路由决策时仅依赖文本级信号（如任务描述、反思、经验规则），忽略了模型内部的表征状态；此前可解释性工作虽然发现LLM存在线性情绪表征且对行为有因果影响，但这类表征仅用于事后分析或直接输出操纵，未被用于智能体层级的决策。
AI.method: 从残差流中提取27维情绪状态，映射为置信度门控的摘要注入到路由提示中；同时分析情绪轨迹中的内部状态突变来定位有问题的技能调用，指导针对性的SOP重写，替代先前方法的粗粒度二元结果信号。
AI.result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上，基于Qwen3-8B的Emotion2Skill相比Zero-Shot基线分别提升+26.9%成功率与+25.5%平均成功率，在所有基线上均取得最优，且在Qwen3-14B上保持一致增益；共激活分析揭示语义一致的情绪-技能配对。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部情绪表征可作为有效的决策级信号用于编排智能体技能系统，将其效用从可解释性和输出操纵扩展到智能体决策层面。

title: Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture
summary: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于数据驱动nowcasting（临近预报）方法论的框架，用于实时气候风险评估，以增强哥伦比亚农业供应链韧性。该框架将短期气候预测与供应链风险建模结合，构建概念性早期预警系统架构，并通过受控计算环境中的原型实现验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 哥伦比亚气候变异性大，降雨不规则、温度波动及极端事件频发，对农业生产和物流（尤其对时间敏感作物）造成直接影响。现有方法缺乏将短期气候预测与供应链决策有效整合的手段，亟需一种实时气候风险评估框架来支持前瞻性决策。
AI.method: 该方法整合基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报（nowcasting）与供应链风险建模，建立概念性早期预警系统架构。核心流程包括：明确的风险映射、基于阈值的分类、面向利益相关者的风险信号输出。原型实现使用官方统计和再分析产品生成的历史气象与农业时间序列，在受控计算环境中开发，不依赖卫星影像或计算机视觉组件。
AI.result: 合成数据与历史数据实验表明，短期降水临近预报可被转化为可操作的农业供应链风险指标，有效支持与库存管理、采购和运输相关的前瞻性决策。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了气候nowcasting与供应链决策整合的可行性，为哥伦比亚农业供应链在气候变异性背景下提供了一种实用的早期预警方法论支撑。

title: SkillSentry: Reliable Skill Execution for LLM Agents via Runtime Assurance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly equipped with skills to perform complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Although skills provide reusable procedural knowledge, agents may still execute them unreliably. Even when an agent has demonstrated the capability to complete tasks under the guidance of a skill, it may fail to do so consistently across similar tasks or repeated runs due to deviations from the skill procedure or incorrect execution of individual steps. Such instability limits the practical reliability of LLM agents. To address this problem, we propose SkillSentry, a skill-oriented runtime assurance framework built upon a new domain-specific language (DSL) for representing runtime guidance for skill execution. SkillSentry initializes the runtime guidance by combining a skill specification extracted from the corresponding skill document with execution experience mined from historical successful and failed traces. It then wraps around the agent execution loop to monitor and guide skill execution under the current guidance, while iteratively refining the guidance using newly collected traces. We evaluate SkillSentry on 15 skills across two LLM agents, each paired with two backbone models, i.e., Claude Code with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and Claude-Opus-4.6, and Codex with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4. Our results show that SkillSentry improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 24.1% across skills, on average, while exhibiting lower variability across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: SkillSentry是一个面向LLM智能体的技能导向运行时保障框架，通过基于新DSL的运行时指南来监控和引导技能执行，并结合技能规范与历史执行经验，显著提升任务成功率并降低重复运行的可变性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体即使具备技能指导，在执行多步骤推理和工具使用任务时仍可能不可靠，存在偏离技能流程或单步执行错误的问题，这种不稳定性限制了LLM智能体在实际应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: SkillSentry基于一种新的领域特定语言（DSL）表示技能执行的运行时指南。初始化阶段融合从技能文档提取的技能规范与从历史成功/失败轨迹挖掘的执行经验；然后在智能体执行循环外包裹监测与引导机制，并利用新收集的轨迹迭代精化运行时指南。
AI.result: 在15个技能、两个LLM智能体（Claude Code和Codex）各搭配两个骨干模型（Claude-Haiku-4.5、Claude-Opus-4.6、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.4）上评估，SkillSentry将任务成功率平均提升24.1%，且重复运行的可变性更低。
AI.conclusion: SkillSentry通过结合规范驱动与经验驱动的运行时保障，有效提升了LLM智能体的执行可靠性和一致性，为技能导向的智能体系统提供了实用的运行时保障方案。

title: Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (05/2026)
summary: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

AI.tldr: 本研究复现了Mattos等人(2025)关于公平排序链接预测中的论点，证明Δ_DP（人口统计奇偶性）无法检测暴露偏差，而排序感知的NDKL指标可以；同时验证了MORAL后处理方法在改善暴露公平性和保持效用的有效性，并扩展测试了同质性设置、分类敏感属性及其他公平性指标。
AI.motivation: 公平排序链接预测中广泛使用的Δ_DP公平指标未考虑链接在排序中的位置，可能掩盖系统性的排序偏差。作者旨在复现这一关键论点并通过更广泛的实验验证其稳健性，以推动更可靠的公平性评估方法。
AI.method: 复现研究基于三个层面：(1) 展示Δ_DP在子组对链接被系统性排名较低时仍可指示总体均等； (2) 验证排序感知的NDKL指标能检测此类差异；(3) 评估MORAL后处理方法的公平性改善效果。研究还扩展了综合同质性设置、分类敏感属性、额外公平性指标（如子组对适配的Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness）及效用指标的鲁棒性分析，并发布了可复现的实现代码。
AI.result: 结果表明Δ_DP确实无法捕捉隐藏的暴露偏差，而基于暴露的指标（如NDKL）能揭示Δ_DP掩盖的偏见。MORAL能显著减少这些偏见，且在多种设置和数据集下仅造成极小的效用损失。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持Mattos等人的论点，即公平排序链接预测应采用暴露感知的公平性指标，并验证了MORAL作为通用后处理方法的有效性，同时提供了经过修正的可复现实现供社区使用。

title: Business Truth, not SQL Accuracy: A Rule-Gated 7B Analytics Agent Outperforms a Direct-Prompted 32B Baseline
comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Benchmark, code, run records, pre-registration and one-command reproduction: https://github.com/k-w-lee/query_proof
summary: LLM analytics agents are evaluated on SQL syntax accuracy, but production failures look different: questions with two valid business definitions, questions the warehouse cannot answer, deprecated columns after a schema change, and queries that execute successfully while returning the wrong business number. No execution-match metric can score them. This paper introduces WarehouseReliabilityBench, 400 frozen tasks over two synthetic warehouses in which roughly half the correct responses are a clarification, an abstention or a refusal, with pinned denominators and a pre-registered paired bootstrap fixing each claim verb before the numbers existed. QueryProof, a 7B agent, uses rules derived from a semantic layer and physical catalog to determine its behaviour, and gates every answer on deterministic post-execution checks. On an 80-task synthetic test split evaluated once, QueryProof outperforms a direct-prompted 32B baseline by +0.237 [+0.112, +0.375] Business Truth Rate at 71.0% lower cost per correct answer; against a cost-matched few-shot baseline the accuracy gain holds but the cost difference does not resolve. This compares systems rather than model sizes: the 32B baseline receives none of the scaffolding. False success falls from 0.754 to 0.351 of returned answers, and no wrong number was returned on an answerable task (0 of 24), though 13 answers went to questions requiring clarification or abstention. Removing the routing layer changes little (0.562 against 0.537), so the result does not depend on escalation. Routing tuned on validation over-abstains on test, and the fitted confidence model loses to the heuristic it replaced. Resampling template families rather than tasks widens both accuracy intervals to include zero, so the effect's direction is better supported than its magnitude. The gain tracks the deterministic layer, though no component ablation was run.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WarehouseReliabilityBench基准，包含400个冻结任务，其中约一半的正确回答是澄清、弃权或拒绝，而非SQL执行本身。基于此基准，作者开发了7B参数的QueryProof智能体，通过语义层和物理目录规则确定行为，并使用确定性执行后检查门控回答。在80任务合成测试集上，QueryProof相较于直接提示的32B基线，在业务真值率上提升了+0.237（置信区间[+0.112,+0.375]），成本降低71.0%；但其在需要澄清或弃权的问题上仍返回了13个错误答案。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM分析智能体评估仅关注SQL语法正确性，但生产环境中的失败往往表现为业务定义歧义、仓库无法回答、模式变更后列废弃、以及执行成功但业务数字错误等问题，这些无法通过执行匹配指标打分。作者旨在建立能评估这类真实业务可靠性的基准，并证明通过较小模型配合系统工程手段可以超越单纯依赖大模型规模的做法。
AI.method: 构建WarehouseReliabilityBench：400个冻结任务，覆盖两个合成仓库，约半数正确回答为澄清（clarification）、弃权（abstention）或拒绝（refusal）；采用钉住分母和预注册配对bootstrap进行统计检验。开发QueryProof：一个7B参数智能体，利用语义层和物理目录推导的规则确定行为，并通过确定性执行后检查来门控每个回答。与直接提示的32B基线及成本匹配的少样本基线对比，同时通过消融式分析（移除路由层、调整置信模型、重采样模板族）检验结论稳健性。
AI.result: 在80任务合成测试集上，QueryProof的业务真值率（Business Truth Rate）为0.237（置信区间[0.112,0.375]），均高于直接提示32B基线，且每个正确答案的成本低71.0%。与成本匹配的少样本基线相比，准确率优势保持但成本差异不显著。错误成功率（false success）从0.754降至0.351；在可回答任务上未返回任何错误数字（0/24），但13个答案被错误地用于需要澄清或弃权的问题。移除路由层效果变化不大（0.562对比0.537），说明结果不依赖升级机制。验证集上调优的路由在测试集上过度弃权，拟合的置信模型不如被替换的启发式方法。按模板族重采样后置信区间扩大至包含零，说明效果的显著性成立但幅度支持较弱。
AI.conclusion: 基于系统工程（语义层规则+确定性后执行检查）的小模型智能体能够在业务可靠性任务上超越缺乏脚手架的大模型基线，且效果主要归因于确定性层而非路由升级。但作者同时指出结论的稳健性边界：效果方向有较好支持但幅度不确定，路由和置信模型调优存在过拟合问题，且未执行组件级消融实验。

title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions formally. When a rollout is scored using hindsight feedback written about that same rollout, its content determines both the tokens and the scoring context, creating direct self-dependence. Using feedback from another rollout of the same problem removes this dependence but does not guarantee a useful score. In matched experiments with a 20B model on AIME 2025, the implemented additive score is near chance (AUC=0.505) and slightly favors incorrect traces after length adjustment. In the paired comparison, the outcome-only control records 64.2\%, versus 24.2\%--33.9\% for five token-score variants. The results motivate validating score meaning, feedback construction, and training behavior separately before calling a likelihood signal credit.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了"结果验证器评分"、"特权自蒸馏反馈构造"和"训练损失行为"三个不同层次的问题，指出token似然变化并不自动等同于结果归因。实验表明，用同一条轨迹的 hindsight 反馈评分会引入直接自依赖；不同轨迹反馈虽消除依赖但评分近乎随机（AUC=0.505）。配对比较中，纯结果控制组达64.2%，而五种token评分变体仅24.2%-33.9%，远低于随机。
AI.motivation: 结果验证器只能对完整推理链打分，无法对中间token赋予信用。特权自蒸馏通过训练时信息对模型自身rollout重新评分来弥补这一缺口，但token似然的变化是否真的反映"结果归因"尚不清楚。作者希望厘清评分是否追踪更优动作、反馈构造改变比较对象、以及训练损失强化何种行为这三个内在混淆的问题，并予以正式刻画。
AI.method: 作者形式上区分三个问题：(1) 评分是否更好地追踪动作质量；(2) 反馈构造方式如何改变被比较的内容；(3) 训练损失实际强化何种行为。当用关于某条rollout的hindsight反馈对该rollout评分时，反馈内容同时决定token和评分语境，产生直接自依赖；改用同一问题的另一条rollout反馈则消除此依赖但无法保证评分有用。在AIME 2025上以20B模型进行匹配实验，比较加性评分与多种token评分变体。
AI.result: 实现中的加性评分接近随机（AUC=0.505），经长度校正后甚至略微偏向错误轨迹。配对比较中，纯结果控制达到64.2%正确率，而五种token评分变体仅为24.2%-33.9%，显著低于随机水平，表明这些评分信号并未正确分配信用。
AI.conclusion: 将似然信号称为"信用"之前，必须分别验证评分含义、反馈构造和训练行为三个维度。当前token级评分变体在实证上未达到结果归因的有效性，说明privileged self-distillation的token信用信号需要更严格的验证框架。

title: P$^{3}$: Joint Program-and-Proof Planning for Verified Code Generation
summary: Verified code generation asks a large language model (LLM) to generate both an executable program and a machine-checkable proof that the program meets a formal specification, promising software that is correct by construction. The de facto workflow decouples the two halves of the problem: first synthesize a program, then attempt to prove it correct. We observe that this sequential pipeline can be both ineffective and inefficient in practice. A program generated without anticipating its proof can be subtly incorrect or structurally difficult to verify, forcing the LLM into brittle repair loops that alternate between patching the code and patching the proof. Inspired by Dijkstra's view that a program and its correctness argument should be developed hand in hand, we propose $P^3$, an LLM-based agentic workflow that first derives a unified program-and-proof plan from the specification, then elaborates the implementation and proof scaffold under this shared plan. To evaluate verified code generation in realistic settings, we further introduce Lean4Commit0, a repository-derived, library-level benchmark built by extracting core APIs from real-world software repositories and translating their requirements, including relational specifications across APIs, into Lean tasks. Using four frontier LLM backends, we evaluate $P^3$ on Verina, AlgoVeri, and our Lean4Commit0 benchmark, where it achieves the highest solve rate in every benchmark--model setting. Compared with the stronger baseline, it improves solve rates by 4.6--11.2 percentage points and reduces per-task API cost by up to roughly 40\% and wall-clock time by up to roughly 37\% on the difficult subset of each benchmark. A targeted ablation further shows gains of 3.3--8.3 points over implementation-only planning, isolating the benefit of planning the program and proof jointly.

AI.tldr: 提出P³，一种将程序与证明联合规划的LLM智能体工作流，用于验证代码生成，并引入基准Lean4Commit0，在多个基准上显著提升求解率并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有验证代码生成的去事实工作流是"先合成程序、再证明正确"的串行管线，这在实践中可能既无效又低效——程序若未预先考虑证明可产生结构上难以验证的代码，导致模型陷入修补代码与修补证明的脆弱循环。
AI.method: 受Dijkstra启发，提出P³：首先从规范导出统一的程序-证明联合计划，然后在共享计划指导下细化实现和证明骨架。同时构建Lean4Commit0基准，从真实软件仓库提取核心API并将其需求（包括跨API的关系规范）翻译为Lean任务。
AI.result: 在Verina、AlgoVeri和Lean4Commit0上使用四种前沿LLM后端评估，P³在每个基准-模型组合中均取得最高求解率。相比强基线，求解率提升4.6-11.2个百分点，在困难子集上API成本降低约40%，墙钟时间降低约37%。消融实验显示相比仅规划实现的方案，联合规划带来3.3-8.3个百分点的额外提升。
AI.conclusion: 程序与正确性论证应同步发展，联合规划程序与证明比单独规划实现或事后修补证明更有效且更高效。

title: MMArch: Benchmarking Multimodal Reasoning Grounded in Architectural Evidence
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform strongly on engineering imagery, yet existing benchmarks mostly test drawing recognition, information extraction, or compliance checking, leaving open whether models can combine distributed visual evidence with engineering principles to reach a conclusion. We introduce MMArch, a benchmark for architecture and civil engineering spanning ten subdomains and built entirely from figures in peer-reviewed papers. Its $1{,}212$ short-answer items are produced by a decoupled planner--writer pipeline and validated through automated screening, a blind adversarial audit, and expert review, so that answering requires perceiving the relevant evidence, identifying the governing principle, and applying it, not exploiting textual or single-figure shortcuts. Evaluating $18$ open-weight and proprietary MLLMs against a domain-expert panel, we find a wide gap: the strongest open-source model attains about $30\%$ and the best proprietary system $52\%$, while human experts reach $95\%$, more than forty points ahead. Our error analysis shows that failures concentrate in applying principles and combining evidence across figures rather than in locating it, pointing to substantial headroom for future research. Code and data are available at https://dcx-swjtu.github.io/MMArch/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMArch基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在建筑与土木工程领域结合分布式视觉证据与工程原理进行推理的能力。该基准包含来自同行评审论文插图的1212道简答题，通过解耦的规划器-写手流程生成，并经过多重验证。评估显示，最强开源模型准确率约30%，最强商业系统52%，而人类专家达95%，凸显当前MLLMs在该领域的显著差距，错误主要集中在原理应用与跨图证据整合环节。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在工程图像上表现良好，但已有基准大多只测试绘图识别、信息提取或合规检查，未评估模型能否结合分布式视觉证据与工程原理得出推理结论，因此需要一个专门衡量该类高阶推理能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建MMArch基准，覆盖10个建筑与土木工程子领域，数据全部来自同行评审论文中的插图。采用解耦的规划器-写手（planner-writer）流水线生成1212道简答题，并通过自动化筛选、盲对抗审计和专家评审三重验证，确保答题必须依靠感知相关证据、识别主导原理并应用之，无法通过文本或单图捷径作答。评估时将18个开源及专有MLLM与领域专家小组对比。
AI.result: 最强开源模型准确率仅约30%，最佳专有系统为52%，而人类专家达到95%，差距超过40个百分点。错误分析表明，失败主要集中于原理应用和跨图证据整合环节，而非证据定位环节。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs在建筑与土木工程领域的分布式证据-原理联合推理能力仍远落后于人类专家，尤其在原理应用与跨图推理方面存在巨大提升空间，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: ComboShoppingBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Budget-Constrained Basket Shopping with Coupons
summary: Real-world shopping often requires constructing a basket of complementary items rather than retrieving a single product. Such combo-shopping tasks arise in device setup, meal preparation, event planning, and group takeout ordering, requiring joint reasoning about item compatibility, availability, store-level requirements, delivery fees, coupons, and budgets. Evaluation is challenging because multiple baskets may satisfy the same request, making exact-match metrics unsuitable, whereas semantic evaluation alone cannot detect infeasible orders, invalid coupon combinations, or incorrect payments. We introduce ComboShoppingBench, an agentic shopping benchmark for open-ended yet verifiable basket construction in a simulated commerce and takeout environment. During task synthesis, an exploration agent constructs a feasible and semantically coherent basket of purchasable products; this witness guides the generation of coupons, budget constraints, user queries, and aligned evaluation rubrics. During evaluation, LLM judges assess semantic satisfaction, response quality, and claim faithfulness, while deterministic validation checks product-ID validity, budget compliance, and coupon optimality. Experiments with diverse LLM agents demonstrate that even strong agents struggle on ComboShoppingBench, highlighting substantial room for improvement in reliable, constraint-aware combo shopping.

AI.tldr: 提出了ComboShoppingBench，一个用于开放但可验证的组合购物（basket construction）任务的智能体购物基准。该基准通过探索代理生成可行的购物篮作为"见证"，并据此生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询和评估准则。评估结合LLM语义判断与确定性验证（产品ID、预算、优惠券最优性），实验表明当前强LLM代理在该基准上表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 现实购物往往是构建互补商品的组合购物篮而非检索单个商品，涉及兼容性、可用性、门店要求、配送费、优惠券和预算等多维约束。然而现有评估存在两难：精确匹配指标不适用（多个篮子都可满足同一请求），而纯语义评估无法检测不可行订单、无效优惠券组合或错误支付。因此需要一个开放但可验证的组合购物基准。
AI.method: 提出ComboShoppingBench。（1）任务合成阶段：探索代理构建可行且语义一致的购物篮作为witness，指导生成优惠券、预算约束、用户查询及对齐的评估准则；（2）评估阶段：LLM judges评估语义满意度、响应质量和声明忠实性，同时确定性验证检查产品ID有效性、预算合规性和优惠券最优性。实验在模拟商业与外卖环境中进行，测试多种LLM代理。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使是强LLM代理在ComboShoppingBench上也表现困难，存在显著的改进空间，特别是在可靠的、约束感知的组合购物方面。
AI.conclusion: 现有的强LLM代理在组合购物任务上仍不成熟，ComboShoppingBench提供了一个兼具开放性与可验证性的评测平台，揭示了可靠、约束感知的购物代理这一重要研究方向。

title: CADEngBench: It Looks Like CAD, but Does It Work? Evaluating Parametric Design, Assembly Reasoning, and Physics Simulation
summary: A CAD model is not engineering-grade merely because it looks correct. It must satisfy design requirements, respond predictably to parameter changes, support controlled edits, match a reference structural response under a declared analysis, and connect to other parts through valid joints. We present CADEngBench, a two-track benchmark for these capabilities. CADEngBench-P evaluates 300 parametric parts, each used for one zero-to-CAD task and one functional-editing task (600 tasks in total), through boundary-representation (B-Rep) validity, engineering and DFM checks, parameter-family perturbations, functional editing, and matched linear-static FEA in CalculiX. CADEngBench-A evaluates 150 body pairs through ranked joint retrieval, exact face-and-edge grounding, joint-frame prediction, and kinematic verification. Across eight multimodal, code-capable models, editing supplied CAD is substantially easier than generating it, while complex edits and matched FEA remain difficult. Assembly predictions often locate the relevant region but fail to recover the recorded joint or mating entities. These results show that CAD evaluation must test engineering behavior rather than appearance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CADEngBench基准，包含两个轨道：CADEngBench-P评估300个参数化零件的零到CAD建模与功能编辑能力（共600个任务），CADEngBench-A评估150对身体对的装配预测能力。实验表明编辑已有CAD比从头生成更易，但复杂编辑与匹配FEA仍具挑战，装配预测常定位区域但无法恢复具体关节或配合实体。
AI.motivation: CAD模型仅外形正确远不足以达到工程级标准，还需满足设计要求、对参数变化可预测响应、支持受控编辑、在声明的分析下匹配参考结构响应，并通过有效关节与其他部件连接。现有CAD评估多关注外观而忽视工程行为，缺乏系统性的工程能力基准。
AI.method: CADEngBench包含两个评估轨道：1) CADEngBench-P，针对300个参数化零件，每个零件执行一个zero-to-CAD建模任务和一个功能编辑任务（共600任务），通过B-Rep有效性、工程与DFM检查、参数族扰动、功能编辑及CalculiX中的线性静力FEA匹配进行评估；2) CADEngBench-A，针对150对身体对，通过排序关节检索、精确面边接地、关节坐标系预测和运动学验证进行评估。在八个多模态、具备代码能力的模型上测试。
AI.result: 编辑提供的CAD比从零生成CAD要容易得多；复杂编辑和匹配FEA对现有模型仍然困难；装配预测往往能定位相关区域但无法恢复记录的关节或配合实体。
AI.conclusion: CAD评估必须测试工程行为而非仅测试外观，CADEngBench为这一目标提供了系统化的评估框架。

title: Linearized 2-Simplicial Attention
summary: We present a linearized form of 2-simplicial attention by rewriting the trilinear score as an inner product between a composite query and a key, so that the sum over one token axis takes the same form as ordinary softmax attention. We then approximate this sum with positive random features and store the entire past in a fixed-size state, while the second axis stays explicit over a short window of recent tokens. This enables us to achieve linear cost in sequence length combined with a global reach that windowed 2-simplicial attention lacks. We implement it with custom Triton kernels and combine it with Kimi Delta Attention to build a model with no softmax attention at all. Under matched compute, this model achieves the highest mean downstream accuracy among the compared architectures, and at 16k context it improves mean accuracy over a KDA hybrid while lowering LAMBADA perplexity from 715.6 to 602.6.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种线性化的2-单纯形注意力（2-simplicial attention），通过将三线性分数重写为复合查询与键的内积，使沿一个token轴的求和等价于普通softmax注意力的形式。使用正随机特征近似该求和，并将整个历史存储在固定大小的状态中，而第二个轴则显式地覆盖短窗口的近期token。这样既实现了序列长度的线性复杂度，又保持了全局访问范围。通过自定义Triton内核实现，并融合Kimi Delta Attention构建了完全无softmax注意力的模型。在匹配计算量下，该模型在下游平均准确率上达到最高，并在16k上下文下相比KDA混合模型提升了平均准确率，将LAMBADA困惑度从715.6降至602.6。
AI.motivation: 普通的窗口化2-单纯形注意力虽然具有高阶交互能力，但缺乏全局访问范围；而完全展开的2-单纯形注意力的三线性分数计算复杂度高，难以在长序列上应用。作者希望在线性成本下保留全局感受野和二阶/高阶token交互的表达能力。
AI.method: 1) 将三线性分数（tri-linear score）重写为复合查询（composite query）与键（key）的内积形式；2) 沿一个token轴的求和转换为与普通softmax注意力同构的形式；3) 使用正随机特征（positive random features）近似该求和，将全部历史压缩为固定大小的状态向量；4) 第二个token轴通过较短的近期token窗口显式计算；5) 使用自定义Triton内核高效实现；6) 与Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）结合，构建完全不含softmax注意力的模型。
AI.result: 在匹配计算资源条件下，该模型在平均下游任务准确率上超过了所对比的所有架构，达到最高；在16k上下文长度下，相比KDA混合模型平均准确率有所提升，同时将LAMBADA困惑度从715.6显著降低到602.6。
AI.conclusion: 线性化的2-单纯形注意力在保持线性序列长度复杂度的同时，成功恢复了窗口化高阶注意力所缺失的全局访问能力，并通过消除softmax注意力构建了更优的架构，在准确率和困惑度两个指标上均取得明显提升。

title: ASPaeroFlow: Decomposition Heuristics for Joint Air Traffic Flow & Capacity Management
comment: To cite this contribution, please cite the ATMOS 2026 paper not the arXiv version; the arXiv version includes the supplementary material. Experimental results are available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21869481
summary: While mathematical models act as vital decision support systems for operational Air Traffic Flow and Capacity Management (ATFCM), existing approaches isolate Air Traffic Flow Management (ATFM) from Dynamic Airspace Configuration (DAC). This separation introduces an unresolved circular dependency between fixed-demand and fixed-capacity assumptions.
