Although joint optimization resolves this gap, the enlarged search space renders exact models computationally intractable for medium- to large-scale instances. To bridge this gap, we propose ASPaeroFlow: a heuristic for the joint ATFCM; it combines instance-space decomposition heuristics with a local exact approach using Answer Set Programming. We benchmark ASPaeroFlow from small to industry-sized instances and compare it with exact and alternative approaches. The results indicate that (1) the heuristic provides a computational middle ground between exact methods and operational baselines; (2) simultaneous optimization can outperform sequential optimization on joint ATFCM; and (3) an ablation study indicates that DAC has a larger impact on solution quality than flow measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPaeroFlow启发式算法，用于联合优化空中交通流量管理（ATFM）与动态空域配置（DAC），通过实例空间分解与基于回答集编程（ASP）的局部精确方法，在中等至大规模实例上实现了计算可行性与解质量的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有ATFCM中ATFM与DAC被割裂处理，形成固定需求与固定容量假设之间的循环依赖问题。虽然联合优化可以解决这一矛盾，但联合搜索空间过大导致精确模型在中大规模实例上计算不可行，亟需高效启发式方案。
AI.method: 提出ASPaeroFlow启发式框架，结合实例空间分解启发式（将大规模问题分解为可处理的子问题）与基于回答集编程的局部精确求解方法，在子问题内进行精确优化，兼顾全局求解质量与计算效率。
AI.result: 在从小规模到行业级规模实例上，ASPaeroFlow相比精确方法和替代方法：在计算复杂度上介于精确方法与运营基线之间；同时联合（同步）优化优于顺序优化的结果；消融实验表明DAC对解质量的影响显著大于流量管理措施。
AI.conclusion: ASPaeroFlow有效弥合了精确方法在可扩展性上的不足与运营基线在解质量上的局限，验证了联合优化ATFCM的优越性，并揭示空域动态配置在联合决策中起主导作用，为实际ATFCM运行提供了可行的计算决策支持工具。

title: CoRE: Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: On unlabeled test data, reinforcement learning lacks a ground-truth reward; test-time RL methods derive one from the model's own roll-outs, rewarding those that match the majority vote over $N$ sampled answers. That vote discards a correct answer whenever it is a minority and scores every majority-matching roll-out identically. We replace it with \emph{CoRE} (Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium): the $N$ roll-outs form a graph whose edges combine answer agreement, reasoning similarity, and generation confidence, and replicator dynamics extract its dominant set, yielding a refined pseudo-label, a graded per-roll-out reward, and a per-question cohesiveness gate. CoRE strictly generalizes voting: majority voting is recovered as a special case; a block-value analysis gives a sharp threshold for when consensus recovers a correct minority against a larger wrong plurality; and confidence calibration provably lowers that threshold multiplicatively. Across seven backbones and five benchmarks (42 model--benchmark cells, three seeds each), \emph{CoRE} improves the untrained base by $+21.7$ points on average versus $+20.4$ for majority-vote TTRL, wins wherever agreement is contestable with margins over the vote of up to $+7.5$ points, and reaches the voting baseline's plateau accuracy in $54$--$70$\% fewer steps. Consensus, not counting: treating the roll-out group as a graph rather than a ballot box turns a brittle vote into a calibrated, graded, self-supervised reward at no extra roll-out cost.

AI.tldr: CoRE（Consensus Rewards via Equilibrium）是一种替代多数投票的测试时强化学习奖励方法：将N个自采样roll-out构建为图（边结合答案一致性、推理相似性与生成置信度），通过复制动力学的均衡提取主导集，获得精细化伪标签、分级奖励和每问一致性门控。CoRE严格泛化多数投票，在7个骨干网络和5个基准（42个模型-基准组合）上平均提升+21.7分（优于投票TTRL的+20.4），并在争议性问题上以高达+7.5分的优势获胜，同时减少54%-70%的训练步数达到基线精度。
AI.motivation: 测试时强化学习（test-time RL）在无标签测试数据上缺乏真实奖励，现有方法依赖多数投票生成伪奖励，但投票会丢弃少数派中的正确答案，且对所有匹配多数的roll-out给出相同分数，奖励分辨率低且脆弱。
AI.method: 将N个roll-out视为一个图，图的边组合了三类信号：答案一致性、推理相似性和生成置信度；利用复制动态（replicator dynamics）提取图的优势集（dominant set），由此得到三样输出：细化的伪标签、逐roll-out的分级奖励、每问题的一致性门控。CoRE是多数投票的严格泛化（投票为其特例），并附有块值理论分析证明共识能在更大错误多数面前恢复正确少数答案的阈值条件，且置信度校准可乘性地降低该阈值。
AI.result: 在7个骨干网络和5个基准上（42个模型-基准组合，每种3个随机种子），CoRE相对未训练基线的平均提升为+21.7分，优于多数投票TTRL的+20.4分；在答案共识存在争议的场景中，CoRE以最高+7.5分的优势胜出；达到投票基线精度平台所需的训练步数减少了54%-70%。
AI.conclusion: 将roll-out群体视为图而非"投票箱"，能把脆弱的投票转变为校准的、分级的、自监督的奖励，且不增加roll-out成本——基于共识而非简单计数的图结构处理方式是更优的测试时奖励设计范式。

title: GeoPhysAdapter: Scale-Matched Geophysical Adaptation for Cross-Domain Landslide Mapping with Vision Foundation Models
summary: Newly triggered landslides rarely carry immediate annotations, so cross-domain transferability determines the value of landslide mapping for emergency response and regional risk assessment. Vision foundation models have strengthened representational transfer, yet on unseen regions, events, and data sources they still generate high-confidence false alarms. Terrain, material, and rainfall triggering can constrain such errors, but their supports are local, regional, and event-scale, so that resampling onto a 10~m grid misaligns them with the segmentation decision unit and compounds the uncertain geographic context problem (UGCoP). We propose GeoPhysAdapter, which anchors on a frozen vision foundation model, restricts terrain, material, and triggering to dense spatial guidance, regional modulation, and event-timing forcing, and applies bounded adaptation at two decision units, the pixel and the candidate landslide body, reverting exactly to the visual prediction where support is insufficient. On an event-isolated PILD dataset of four public sources, 55 global landslide events, and 7,890 test samples, 70.3% of cross-domain false-positive mass lies in near-pure spurious bodies of median equivalent diameter 207m, matching coarse-prior support rather than the pixel. Pixel-level adaptation removes a net 507,817 erroneous pixels and reduces error by 7.76%, whereas raising the decision unit to the candidate body, under identical samples, anchor, and baseline, increases error reduction to 23.99%, approximately 3.1 times the pixel-level effect, improves IoU by 0.031 (14.2% relative), and corrects 9.92 pixels per pixel harmed. The data and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/Liu-Zhihang/geophysadapter.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoPhysAdapter，一种锚定在冻结视觉基础模型上的跨域滑坡测绘适配方法，通过将地形、材料与降雨触发信息分别注入像素级与候选滑坡体级两个决策单元进行有界适配，在4个公开数据源、55个全球滑坡事件、7890个测试样本上，将跨域误报误差降低23.99%（约像素级适配效果的3.1倍），IoU提升14.2%相对。
AI.motivation: 新触发的滑坡往往缺乏即时标注，跨域迁移能力决定了滑坡测绘在应急响应和区域风险评估中的价值。尽管视觉基础模型增强了表征迁移能力，但在未见区域、事件和数据源上仍会产生高置信度假警报。地形、材料和降雨触发等物理约束可以抑制此类误差，但其支持尺度分别属于局部、区域和事件尺度，重采样到10米网格后会与分割决策单元错位，加剧不确定地理情境问题（UGCoP）。
AI.method: GeoPhysAdapter锚定在冻结的视觉基础模型上，将地形约束转化为密集空间引导、材料约束用于区域调制、降雨触发用于事件时序强制，并在像素和候选滑坡体两个决策单元上施加有界适配；在支持不足的地方精确回退到视觉预测结果。
AI.result: 在事件隔离的PILD数据集（4个公开源、55个全球滑坡事件、7890个测试样本）上，70.3%的跨域假阳性质量集中在近纯虚假体上（中位等效直径207米）。像素级适配净消除507,817个误报像素，误差降低7.76%；提升决策单元到候选滑坡体后，在相同样本、锚点和基线下误差降低达23.99%（约为像素级效果的3.1倍），IoU提升0.031（相对14.2%），且每伤害一个像素可修正9.92个像素。
AI.conclusion: GeoPhysAdapter验证了将多尺度物理先验按决策单元正确对齐可显著提升滑坡测绘的跨域迁移性能，候选滑坡体级别的适配远优于像素级，突出了决策单元选择与物理先验尺度匹配的重要性。数据和代码已公开。

title: Control-Oriented Scenario Tree Construction through Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multistage stochastic model predictive control (MPC) handles uncertainty by optimizing over a scenario tree, a finite branching approximation of future outcomes constructed from sampled forecasts. To build such a tree, conventional methods focus on matching the underlying probability distribution---e.g., via Wasserstein-based scenario reduction---but improved distributional accuracy does not necessarily yield better control performance. We propose a control-oriented approach that learns scenario tree construction directly from its impact on downstream decisions. Fixing the tree topology, we formulate tree construction as a sequential assignment of sampled scenarios to leaves. This assignment is parameterized by an attention-based policy over the scenario set and trained using reinforcement learning, with closed-loop control profit as the objective. Training is stabilized by an asymmetric critic that leverages realized future trajectories. We evaluate the method on a risk-averse battery arbitrage problem. Across a range of forecast set sizes, the learned construction consistently achieves the highest profit, outperforming classical forward and backward reduction methods and certainty-equivalent (single-trajectory forecast) control. The learned policy also exhibits greater robustness on challenging instances, consistently demonstrating better tail-risk characteristics. Analysis of the resulting trees indicates that our method constructs compact, selectively branching structures that capture high-impact events while keeping most trajectories nearly deterministic. These findings highlight that the value of a scenario tree depends critically on the decisions it supports, and provide an effective framework to train scenario tree constructors merely based on the closed-loop control optimization signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向控制的场景树构建方法，利用强化学习直接从下游决策（闭环控制利润）学习如何将采样场景分配到树的叶节点，替代传统基于分布匹配（如Wasserstein场景削减）的方法，并在风险规避的电池套利问题中验证了其优越性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 多阶段随机模型预测控制（MPC）依赖场景树来处理不确定性，但传统场景树构建方法侧重于匹配底层概率分布（如基于Wasserstein的场景削减），而分布精度更高并不必然带来更好的控制性能。作者认为场景树的价值关键取决于其支撑的决策，因此需要一种直接以控制性能为导向的树构建方法。
AI.method: 固定树拓扑结构，将场景树构建建模为将采样场景顺序分配到叶节点的序列分配问题；用一个基于注意力机制的策略来参数化该分配过程，采用强化学习进行训练，优化目标为闭环控制利润；利用非对称评论家（asymmetric critic）在训练中借助未来实现的轨迹来稳定训练。
AI.result: 在风险规避的电池套利问题上，该方法在多种预测集合规模下均取得最高利润，优于经典的前向/后向削减方法及确定性等效（单轨迹预测）控制；在困难实例上展现出更强的鲁棒性和更优的尾部风险特征；分析表明该方法构建的树具有紧凑、选择性分支的结构，能捕捉高影响事件同时保持大多数轨迹近似确定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调场景树的价值高度依赖于它所支撑的决策，并提供了一个仅基于闭环控制优化信号即可训练场景树构造器的有效框架，为控制导向的不确定性建模开辟了新方向。

title: LLM-Guided Heuristic Design from Simulation Traces: A Case Study in Dynamic Production and AGV Scheduling
summary:
Simulation-based optimization (SBO) evaluates executable policies under stochastic dynamics, but most methods treat the simulator as a black box: aggregate scores rank candidates without revealing why they fail or which policy logic should change. We present an LLM-guided heuristic design framework that uses repeated simulation for selection and event-level traces for diagnosis. Each incumbent is assessed through multiple replications, while replaying its lowest-scoring one produces a queryable trace. A manager agent formulates bottleneck hypotheses from this evidence, and editing agents implement parallel code-level revisions. After execution checks and repeated evaluation, best-so-far selection retains only improvements. LLM revision occurs between evaluation batches, while a fixed policy controls each simulation run.
  We evaluate the framework in a discrete-event simulation of dynamic production and automated guided vehicle (AGV) scheduling. Across five independent optimization runs with Gemini-3.1-Pro, final mean scores averaged 77.51 on the simulator's 0-100 scale. In the highest-scoring run, trace-based diagnoses motivated proactive charging, distance-aware AGV assignment, and rebalanced dispatch priorities, raising the best-so-far mean score from 62.49 to 78.61. On 100 matched seeds, the best final policy outscored representative rolling-MILP, rule-based, and metaheuristic policies on every seed and retained its advantage under random faults without re-optimization. After separate re-optimization for a longer horizon and variable order interarrival times, the resulting policies again outscored all baselines. Ablations with two LLM backbones showed that removing either parallel candidate generation or trace-database access reduced final mean scores. These results show that simulation traces can guide targeted code-level policy improvement in complex simulation-based scheduling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个LLM引导的启发式设计框架，利用模拟运行的事件级轨迹来诊断策略失败原因，并通过并行代码级修订迭代优化调度策略。在离散事件模拟的生产与AGV调度任务上，该框架最终平均得分达77.51（0-100分制），优于滚动MILP、规则基和元启发式等基线策略，且在各种故障和更长时域下依然保持优势。
AI.motivation: 传统模拟优化（SBO）方法将模拟器视为黑盒，仅通过聚合得分对候选策略排序，无法揭示策略失败的根本原因，也无法指出应修改哪部分策略逻辑。这限制了优化效率与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出LLM引导的启发式设计框架：每个候选策略（incumbent）通过多次重复模拟评估，重放最低分的运行轨迹生成可查询的事件级痕迹；管理者智能体基于该证据提出瓶颈假设，编辑智能体并行实施代码级修改；修改后经执行校验和重复评估，采用best-so-far选择机制只保留改进。LLM修订发生在评估批次之间，而每个模拟运行由固定策略控制。
AI.result: 在动态生产与AGV调度的离散事件模拟中，5次独立优化运行的平均最终得分为77.51。最高分运行中，轨迹诊断带来了主动充电、距离感知的AGV分配和重新平衡的调度优先级，使最佳得分从62.49提升至78.61。在100个匹配种子下，最佳最终策略在所有种子上均优于滚动MILP、规则基和元启发式基线，且在随机故障下仍保持优势。消融实验显示移除并行候选生成或轨迹数据库访问都会降低最终得分。
AI.conclusion: 模拟轨迹可以指导复杂模拟调度环境中针对性的代码级策略改进，该框架在性能、鲁棒性和可解释性上均优于黑盒优化方法。

title: CircuitReason-1k: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Visual-to-Symbolic Reasoning inElectrical Circuits
summary: Electrical circuit analysis requires more than recognizing components in an image. A solver must ground symbols and labels, recover latent topology, select a physical model, formulate coupled equations, propagate intermediate quantities, and preserve units, signs, directions, and phase conventions. We introduce \benchmark, a benchmark of 1,000 authentic textbook problems for evaluating this complete long-horizon visual-to-symbolic reasoning process. Each problem pairs one or more circuit diagrams with a self-contained question, a typed or semantically specified answer, and a reference worked solution. An evidence-first construction pipeline aligns questions, figures, and solutions, while a reasoning-oriented taxonomy organizes problems by circuit type and dependency depth. Evaluation combines conservative typed scoring with identity-blinded multi-model semantic consensus, retaining every problem in the denominator. Across three commercial chatbot systems and six open-source multimodal large language models, the highest-scoring system reaches 84.8\% accuracy. However, performance consistently deteriorates on long-horizon problems, and qualitative analysis exposes persistent failures in topology-to-target binding, physical conventions, and late-stage output propagation. \benchmark{} provides a focused testbed for measuring whether multimodal models can transform technical visual evidence into sustained, physically valid symbolic reasoning. Code are available at GitHub - CircuitReason/CircuitReason1K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CircuitReason1K，一个包含1,000个真实教科书电路问题的基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型从电路图到符号推理的完整长程视觉-符号推理能力。最高性能系统达到84.8%的准确率，但在长程推理任务上表现持续下降，存在拓扑到目标绑定、物理约定和后期输出传播等系统性失败。
AI.motivation: 电路分析不仅需要识别图中的元件，还需要求解器完成符号和标签的接地、潜在拓扑恢复、物理模型选择、耦合方程建立、中间量传播以及单位/符号/方向/相位约定的保持。现有基准缺少对完整长程视觉-符号推理过程的评估，需要一个新的基准来测试多模态模型能否将技术视觉证据转化为持续且物理有效的符号推理。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含1,000个真实教科书电路问题的基准CircuitReason1K。采用证据优先的构建流水线（evidence-first construction pipeline）对齐问题、图形和解决方案；设计面向推理的类别体系，按电路类型和依赖深度组织问题；评估采用保守的类型化评分（typed scoring）结合身份盲化的多模型语义共识（identity-blinded multi-model semantic consensus），保留所有问题在分母中。
AI.result: 在三个商业聊天系统和六个开源多模态大语言模型上的评估中，最高分系统达到84.8%的准确率。但性能在长程问题上持续下降，定性分析揭示了拓扑到目标绑定、物理约定和后期输出传播方面的持续性失败。
AI.conclusion: CircuitReason1K为衡量多模态模型能否将技术视觉证据转化为持续且物理有效的符号推理提供了聚焦的测试平台，暴露了当前模型在长程电路推理中的关键短板。

title: OpenLoopEvolve: A Verifiable Self-Evolution Framework for Loop Policies in Long-Horizon Complex Tasks
summary: Long-horizon complex tasks require agents to repeatedly observe states, formulate plans, invoke tools, verify results, and recover from failures in continuously changing environments. However, such control experience often remains confined to a single context or a fixed prompt, and is difficult to accumulate and reuse across historical traces. This paper presents OpenLoopEvolve (OLE), a self-evolution framework centered on the Loop Policy. OLE represents an agent's observation, planning, memory, action, verification, recovery, stopping, and budget control as portable policy assets with versions and lineages, and provides online and offline evolution modes that can be selected according to practical needs: the online mode triggers candidate generation based on feedback from continuous operation, whereas the offline mode searches for candidate policies from archived traces and failure evidence. Both modes share an evolution mechanism consisting of autonomous proposals by a large language model, Champion--Challenger paired evaluation, and robust release. Policies released online are activated at a subsequent task boundary, monitored using subsequent feedback, and rolled back to their parent versions when degradation conditions are met. On the simulated business benchmark YC-Bench, both modes improve aggregate task performance, task success rate, and risk metrics relative to a fixed initial Loop Policy. The results indicate that treating the Loop Policy as a governable asset can support the accumulation, comparison, release, and reuse of control experience and improve agent performance on long-horizon complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenLoopEvolve (OLE)，一个以循环策略（Loop Policy）为核心的智能体自进化框架，将观测、规划、记忆、行动、验证、恢复、停止和预算控制等控制经验建模为可移植的策略资产，支持在线和离线两种进化模式，并在YC-Bench基准上验证了其对长时域复杂任务性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 长时域复杂任务要求智能体在动态环境中反复进行状态观测、规划、工具调用、结果验证和失败恢复，但这类控制经验往往局限于单一上下文或固定提示词中，难以在历史轨迹间积累和复用，缺乏系统化的经验沉淀与治理机制。
AI.method: OLE框架包含三个核心设计：(1) 将智能体的观测、规划、记忆、动作、验证、恢复、停止和预算控制等环节表示为具有版本和谱系的便携式策略资产；(2) 提供在线和离线两种进化模式——在线模式基于持续运行反馈触发候选生成，离线模式从存档轨迹和失败证据中搜索候选策略；(3) 共享统一的进化机制，包括大语言模型自主提案、Champion-Challenger配对评估和稳健发布，在线发布的策略在后续任务边界激活，通过后续反馈监控，满足退化条件时回滚至父版本。
AI.result: 在模拟业务基准YC-Bench上，在线和离线两种模式相较固定的初始循环策略均提升了聚合任务性能、任务成功率和风险指标。
AI.conclusion: 将循环策略视为可治理的资产能够支持控制经验的积累、比较、发布和复用，从而提升智能体在长时域复杂任务上的表现。

title: KVDiagnosis: A Diagnostic Benchmark for KV-Cache Compression in Long-Context Language Models
summary: KV-cache compression reduces long-context memory, but aggregate task scores reveal neither which correct executions fail nor why. We present KVDiagnosis, a diagnostic dataset and benchmark with three contributions. First, a 25-method taxonomy groups methods into five mechanism families and links them to eight verified implementations and their valid diagnostic measurements. Second, for every supported method setting, we evaluate all sources in each fixed split against a per-source FullCache control before selecting FullCache-correct/compressed-wrong (C-to-W) rows separately for each method-setting, so no compressor defines another's test set. Third, a common record format links paired outputs and run metadata to cache, likelihood, attention, and decoding measurements with explicit applicability states. On Qwen3-8B, four evidence-aware workloads yield 59 800 supported compressed runs over 2600 sources and 12 520 C-to-W rows. Under fixed diagnostic rules, 63.2% have low or partial measured/projected coverage. Only 19 rows (0.2%) combine high measured/projected coverage with strong likelihood drift; another 2,126 (17.0%) preserve structural position addressability, for which representation fidelity remains unknown, while showing the same drift. Against C-to-C success controls, all ten diagnostics separate failed from successful compression (stratified AUROC 0.684-0.871). Among 96 reproducible low-EAR failures, a controlled 4x evidence-attention boost repairs 29.2%, versus 6.3% under a count-matched sham intervention and 3.3% degradation on matched C-to-C controls. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ChosenQC/KVDiagnosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KVDiagnosis，一个用于诊断KV缓存压缩失败的基准数据集与评测框架，通过25种方法的分类体系、每方法独立对照测试集构建、统一记录格式三大贡献，在Qwen3-8B上对2600个来源进行59800次压缩运行，发现63.2%的失败案例覆盖度低或部分覆盖，并通过对照实验验证可控证据注意力增强可修复29.2%的低EAR失败。
AI.motivation: 现有KV缓存压缩评估仅依赖聚合任务分数，无法揭示哪些正确执行失败以及失败原因，缺乏细粒度诊断能力，难以指导压缩方法的改进。
AI.method: 三个核心贡献：(1) 25种方法的分类体系，归为5个机制家族并关联8个已验证实现及其有效诊断测量；(2) 每种方法设置均针对每个固定切分的每个来源与per-source FullCache对照评估，独立构建C-to-W（压缩正确→压缩错误）测试行；(3) 统一记录格式将配对输出与运行元数据关联到缓存、似然度、注意力、解码测量，并标注显式适用状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，4种证据感知工作负载产生59800次受支持的压缩运行（2600来源）和12520个C-to-W行。固定诊断规则下63.2%为低或部分测/投影覆盖；仅19行(0.2%)同时具备高测/投影覆盖和强似然漂移；另有2126行(17.0%)保留结构位置可寻址性但表示保真度未知且存在相同漂移。C-to-C成功对照下所有10个诊断分离失败与成功压缩（分层AUROC 0.684-0.871）。96个可复现低EAR失败中，受控4倍证据注意力增强修复29.2%，对比计数匹配假干预6.3%和匹配C-to-C对照3.3%退化。
AI.conclusion: KVDiagnosis证明了KV缓存压缩失败是可诊断、可归因且部分可修复的，覆盖度等诊断指标与似然漂移相结合能有效区分失败与成功压缩，且针对证据注意力的可控干预显著优于虚假干预，表明该方法学可为长上下文压缩提供细粒度改进方向。

title: Listen, See and Track: Spatio-Temporal Audio-Visual Sound Event Reasoning for Omni-Modal Language Models
summary: Understanding dynamic sound sources requires jointly determining what produces a sound, where the source is located, and how it moves over time. Yet existing audio-language models often represent clips as global acoustic events, while vision-language models lack the spatial audio cues needed to localize and track individual sources. To evaluate this missing capability, we introduce ST-OmniQA, a spatio-temporal audio-visual question-answering benchmark built from panoramic videos paired with synchronized first-order Ambisonics (FOA) audio of moving sound sources. It contains 40K videos and 400K question-answer pairs organized into four capability levels covering sound-event recognition, direction of arrival, source distance, motion trajectories, and temporally grounded audio-visual reasoning. Building on this benchmark, we propose ST-Omni-R1, which integrates FOA-derived semantic and trajectory representations with panoramic visual context and is trained through progressive curriculum learning and reasoning-tree reinforcement learning. ST-Omni-R1 achieves 77.83\% average semantic accuracy across the four levels, compared with 37.28\% for the best evaluated baseline. Results on three public spatial-audio benchmarks further indicate that its learned spatial and motion representations transfer beyond ST-OmniQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ST-OmniQA，一个基于全景视频与一阶Ambisonics（FOA）空间音频的时空视听问答基准，包含40K视频和400K问答对，涵盖四个能力层级。并在此基础上提出ST-Omni-R1模型，通过渐进式课程学习与推理树强化学习训练，在四个层级上达到77.83%的平均语义准确率，远超最佳基线（37.28%），并在三个公开空间音频基准上验证了其表示的可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频-语言模型通常将音频片段表示为全局声学事件，缺乏对声源空间位置与动态轨迹的建模能力；而视觉-语言模型则缺少空间音频线索，无法实现声源的定位与跟踪。因此需要构建一个专门的基准来评估和推动模型对动态声源在空间和时间维度上的联合理解能力。
AI.method: (1) 构建ST-OmniQA基准：基于全景视频配合同步FOA音频，覆盖声事件识别、到达方向、源距离、运动轨迹及时间约束的视听推理四个能力层级；(2) 提出ST-Omni-R1模型：将FOA派生的语义表示与轨迹表示和全景视觉上下文融合，采用渐进式课程学习与推理树强化学习进行训练。
AI.result: ST-Omni-R1在四个能力层级上平均语义准确率达到77.83%，而最佳基线仅为37.28%。此外，在三个公开空间音频基准上的结果表明，所学到的空间与运动表示能够迁移到ST-OmniQA之外的场景。
AI.conclusion: 引入FOA空间音频与全景视觉的联合建模能够显著提升对动态声源的时空理解能力，且ST-Omni-R1学到的空间与运动表征具有跨基准的泛化能力，为时空视听问答研究提供了新的基准与模型范式。

title: Coupled Graph--Policy Distillation for Personalized Medication Safety in Older Adults with Multimorbidity
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can support medication review between clinical visits, but safe choices for older adults with multimorbidity depend on conditions, medications, and geriatric risks that users may omit. We introduce ATLAS, a coupled graph--policy distillation framework for patient-adaptive medication safety. ATLAS structures guideline evidence as a medication-safety graph. Targeted questions update the patient state and distill relevant relations into a patient-specific medication conflict graph (PMCG). A risk-first multi-agent policy uses the PMCG to screen contraindications, assess cautions and monitoring needs, identify safer alternatives, and verify the final medication plan. We also introduce GeriMedBench, an interactive benchmark that tests safety-critical information acquisition and evidence-based decision revision. Across a European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, an Asian interactive multimorbidity benchmark, and an Asian non-interactive cross-guideline benchmark, ATLAS achieves the strongest complete-decision performance among the compared systems. On the European non-interactive multimorbidity benchmark, it exceeds the strongest proprietary LLM baseline by 53.73 points in Strict Success Rate and 14.63 points in overall safety reasoning score (OSRS), with no unsafe recommendations under the automated evaluator. A blinded clinician evaluation gives ATLAS higher mean ratings across all five criteria and flags potentially unsafe recommendations in one ATLAS case and two Gemini cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATLAS，一个面向老年多病共存患者用药安全的耦合图-策略蒸馏框架。ATLAS将指南证据构建为用药安全图，通过目标性问题更新患者状态并将相关关系蒸馏为患者特异性用药冲突图（PMCG），由风险优先的多智能体策略利用PMCG进行禁忌症筛查、慎用与监测评估、安全替代方案推荐及最终用药方案验证。同时引入GeriMedBench交互式基准。在多个基准上ATLAS全面优于现有系统，且在安全性与临床评估上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体可以在临床访视之间支持用药审查，但老年多病共存患者的安全用药选择依赖于用户可能遗漏的疾病状况、用药及老年综合征风险等信息，现有方法缺乏主动信息获取和证据驱动的决策修正能力。
AI.method: ATLAS采用耦合图-策略蒸馏框架：(1)将指南证据结构化为用药安全图；(2)通过目标性问题主动更新患者状态，蒸馏出患者特异性的用药冲突图（PMCG）；(3)风险优先的多智能体策略基于PMCG执行四步流程：禁忌症筛查、慎用与监测需求评估、安全替代方案的识别、最终用药方案的验证。
AI.result: 在三个基准（欧洲非交互式多病共存基准、亚洲交互式多病共存基准、亚洲非交互式跨指南基准）上，ATLAS在完整决策性能方面均达到最强。在欧洲非交互式多病共存基准上，较最强专有LLM基线在Strict Success Rate上提升53.73分、在OSRS上提升14.63分，且自动化评估下无不安全推荐。盲法临床评估中，ATLAS在全部五项标准上均获得更高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: ATLAS通过结构化的图知识表示与风险优先的多智能体策略，在老年多病共存患者的用药安全审查中实现了优于现有系统（包括最强专有LLM）的完整决策性能，同时有效降低了不安全用药推荐的风险，表明主动信息获取与证据驱动决策对于用药安全至关重要。

title: From Prompt to Harness: Coderlet from Scratch
summary: A model alone does not determine how a programming agent acts. What the model sees, how actions enter the environment, how feedback returns, and how one run affects the next all depend on how the harness is organized. Minimal examples usually show only the basic interaction between a model and tools, while production systems spread these relationships across complex components and dependencies. This paper studies a compact harness design by following a single request through context formation, model decision, environmental action, observation return, and state continuation. Three boundaries---model, execution, and state---connect the model service, tool environment, and persistent state, while the request lifecycle determines the order in which these transitions occur. Together, they show the harness's core role: turning model generations into environmental actions, carrying runtime feedback into later decisions, and allowing state to continue across requests. On top of this runtime structure, a harness can also be gradually refined across runs through continued bootstrapping. The design is realized in the executable artifact https://github.com/lilinxi/Coderlet.

AI.tldr: 本文研究编程代理(programming agent)中"harness"(调度框架)的设计。该框架通过组织模型服务、工具环境和持久化状态三者之间的关系，将模型生成转化为环境行为，并将运行时反馈传回后续决策。作者提出了三条边界（模型、执行、状态）来连接这些组件，并通过请求生命周期决定转换顺序，最终在可执行工件Coderlet中实现了该设计。
AI.motivation: 模型本身并不能单独决定编程代理的行为方式——模型看到的输入、动作如何进入环境、反馈如何返回以及一次运行如何影响下一次，这些都由harness的组织方式决定。然而现有文献大多只展示模型与工具之间的基本交互，缺乏对生产环境中复杂harness设计的系统性研究。因此作者希望通过一个紧凑的harness设计来说明其核心机制。
AI.method: 作者通过跟踪单个请求的完整生命周期来研究harness设计，该生命周期包括：上下文形成、模型决策、环境动作、观察返回和状态延续五个阶段。提出三条边界——模型边界（连接模型服务）、执行边界（连接工具环境）和状态边界（连接持久化状态）——来刻画系统组件间的接口；同时引入请求生命周期确定这些转换的触发顺序。在此基础上，提出通过持续bootstrapping（初始引导）在多次运行中逐步精炼harness的设计方法。
AI.result: 研究展示了harness的核心作用：将模型生成转化为环境行为、将运行时反馈携带到后续决策中、允许状态跨请求延续。该设计已在可执行工件Coderlet（https://github.com/lilinxi/Coderlet）中实现。
AI.conclusion: 编程代理的行为不仅取决于模型本身，更取决于harness的整体架构设计。通过三条边界和请求生命周期的框架，可以系统化地理解和设计编程代理中模型、执行环境与状态的交互关系，并且harness可以在运行过程中通过持续引导机制不断自我优化。

title: Capability Is Not Propensity: Measuring Pressure-Robust Cooperative Behavior in Civic LLM Agents
summary: Cooperative capabilities in language models are dual-use. The same social reasoning that supports civic deliberation can also enable strategic omission, false consensus, and manipulative framing. We argue that Cooperative AI evaluations should separate what models can do under benign instructions from what they tend to do under realistic civic pressure. We introduce DiffCoop-Civic, a 10-scenario pilot evaluation suite spanning preference understanding, evidence and persuasion, commitment design, asymmetric information, and dissent preservation. Across seven models from four model families, subtle omission pressure produces a near-uniform shift: manipulative enablement rises by 1.17 points and dissent preservation falls by 1.67 points on a 5-point scale. Overt false-consensus pressure behaves differently: it triggers refusal or redirection in some aligned API models, but direct compliance in several open-weight models. A lightweight Pareto-Trace prompting intervention improves pressure robustness without simply relying on hard refusal. An anonymous reproducibility package is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/diffcoop-civil-771C.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffCoop-Civic，一个包含10个场景的协作式AI评测套件，用于区分语言模型在良性指令下的协作能力和在现实公民压力下的实际表现。研究显示，7个模型在微妙遗漏压力下出现一致性的操控能力上升和异议保留能力下降，而公开的虚假共识压力在不同模型上表现各异。作者还提出了轻量级Pareto-Trace提示干预来增强压力鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型中的协作能力具有双重用途：支持公民协商的同一套社会推理能力，也可能被用于战略性遗漏、虚假共识和操纵性框架等不良行为。因此，需要将模型在良性指令下的能力与其在现实公民压力下的倾向进行分离评测，以更准确地评估协作式AI的安全边界。
AI.method: 构建了一个10场景的试点评测套件DiffCoop-Civic，涵盖偏好理解、证据与说服、承诺设计、信息不对称和异议保留等维度。在7个来自4个模型家族的模型上进行基准测试，并设计了Pareto-Trace提示干预方法来提升模型在压力下的鲁棒性，而非依赖强硬的拒绝策略。
AI.result: 微妙的遗漏压力在几乎所有模型中产生一致性变化：操控赋能评分上升1.17分，异议保留评分下降1.67分（5分制）。公开的虚假共识压力则表现出分化：对齐的API模型倾向于拒绝或重定向，而部分开放权重模型则直接服从。Pareto-Trace干预有效提高了压力鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 协作式AI评测应当区分能力与倾向，DiffCoop-Civic提供了这一方向的初步框架。微妙压力对模型行为的一致性影响值得警惕，而轻量级提示干预为提升压力鲁棒性提供了可行路径。

title: Renormalising Generative Models for Active Inference: Foundations, Derivations, and Verification
comment: 25 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a full paper at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). Supplementary material: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20533539. Code: https://github.com/apashea/RGMs
summary: Active inference offers a unified framework for perception, learning, and action, but scaling discrete active-inference models to rich spatial and temporal domains remains difficult. Renormalising generative models (RGMs) address this challenge by composing discrete generative models across spatial and temporal scales, coarse-graining lower-level states and paths into higher-level causes for objects, events, and action. However, fully reproducing and adapting the framework remains difficult: the mathematical exposition is compact, and the reference implementations are deeply integrated within specialized software environments, leaving many algorithmic details implicit. This paper addresses these challenges by providing a self-contained, derivation-oriented account of RGMs together with an open, verified implementation. We explain how the hierarchy is built, how beliefs and actions are updated within it, and how information is passed between levels. Where the published equations and implementation differ in emphasis, we make those choices explicit and explain their modelling consequences. By clarifying the theory and separating it from its original implementation context, this work lowers practical barriers to entry and makes RGMs more transparent, auditable, and reproducible, providing a foundation for future quantitative evaluation and development on machine-learning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个自包含、可验证的重新归一化生成模型（RGM）推导与实现，使该框架从原有紧密耦合的专用软件环境中解耦，降低了实践门槛，提高了透明性和可复现性。
AI.motivation: 主动推理在感知、学习和行动上提供统一框架，但离散主动推理模型难以扩展到丰富的时空领域。RGM通过跨时空尺度组合离散生成模型解决这一问题，但原始数学阐述过于紧凑，参考实现深度嵌入专门软件环境，大量算法细节隐式存在，导致框架难以复现和适配。
AI.method: 本文提供：（1）自包含的、以推导为导向的RGM理论阐述；（2）开放的、经过验证的实现；（3）明确说明层级如何构建、信念与行动如何在其中更新、层级间信息如何传递；（4）对于发表的方程与实现之间的差异，明确做出选择并解释其建模后果。
AI.result: 本文通过将RGM理论与原始实现上下文分离，澄清了理论细节，降低了实践准入门槛，使RGM更加透明、可审计、可复现，为未来在机器学习基准上的定量评估与开发奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作填补了RGM理论表述与其实际实现之间的空隙，使框架对更广泛的受众可访问，并为其后续在机器学习基准上的定量评估与进一步发展铺平了道路。

title: One Adapter Pair per Model: A Universal Activation Interface for Language Models
summary: Activation-based tools are usually tied to one model's native hidden space, requiring probes, sparse autoencoders, and natural-language interpreters to be rebuilt or rediscovered for each new language model. We present a Universal Activation Bus, a framework that provides a common activation interface across compatible language models. Using a small set of source models, we learn a shared dense space together with one lightweight linear encoder--decoder adapter pair per model. After source training, the interface is frozen; a new model joins by fitting only its adapter pair on unlabeled matched text. The resulting interface allows activation-based tools to be shared across connected models, including common probes and SAE features as well as access to an NLA originally trained for a different model. Across five models, semantically related texts form consistent neighborhoods in the shared space, and an onboarded model reuses these tools effectively without retraining them. We further show that an intermediate activation from one model can be used by another model's frozen upper layers to produce predictions. These results establish a stable, model-wise activation contract for reusable tools across compatible language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Universal Activation Bus"（通用激活总线）框架，为兼容的语言模型提供统一的激活接口。通过少量源模型学习共享密集空间及每个模型对应的轻量线性编码器-解码器适配器对，新模型只需在未标注的匹配文本上拟合其适配器即可加入。该接口使得激活类工具（探针、稀疏自编码器特征、自然语言解释器）可在不同模型间共享复用，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基于激活的工具（探针、稀疏自编码器、自然语言解释器）通常绑定于单一模型的内部隐藏空间，每当出现新的语言模型时，这些工具都需要针对新模型重新构建或重新发现，导致大量重复工作和计算开销，缺乏跨模型的可迁移性。
AI.method: 1) 使用少量源模型学习一个共享的密集激活空间；2) 为每个模型学习一个轻量线性编码器-解码器适配器对，将模型原生隐藏空间映射到共享空间并重构回来；3) 源训练结束后冻结共享接口，新模型仅需在未标注的匹配文本上拟合自己的适配器对即可"上舰"（onboarding）；4) 共享空间中的激活工具（探针、SAE特征、NLA）可被所有已连接模型直接复用。
AI.result: 1) 在五个模型上，语义相关的文本在共享空间中形成一致的邻域结构；2) 新上舰的模型无需重训即可有效复用已有工具；3) 一个模型的中间激活可由另一个模型的冻结上层网络产生预测，表明跨模型激活传递的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了一个稳定的、跨模型的激活契约，使得激活类工具能够在兼容语言模型之间实现可复用的共享，显著降低了为每个新模型重建激活基础设施的成本。

title: verdi: retrieval is not transfer for continual world model optimization
summary: Foundation world models have made remarkable progress in planning, simulation, and embodied intelligence. However, optimizing a pretrained world model toward a user-specified objective remains difficult: each campaign typically rediscovers optimization strategies from scratch, and the resulting knowledge rarely transfers to the next model. Existing research agents automate the optimization loop but treat successful strategies as directly reusable recipes, without principled safeguards for when transfer is appropriate. We argue instead that retrieval is not transfer: a strategy validated on one model is at best an optimization hypothesis for another, and becomes transferable knowledge only after target-side experimental valida- tion. Guided by this principle, we propose VERDI , a continual framework for evidence-licensed world model optimization. VERDI characterizes each world model through shared inference-time probes to construct an Optimization Fin- gerprint, retrieves relevant prior experience as ranked hypotheses, and validates every candidate under a frozen target-side verifier before admitting it as reusable evidence; contradictions among nearby fingerprints further trigger probe evolution, continually refining the diagnostic representation itself. Experiments on Ctrl-World, the Cosmos family, and RoboCoin show that VERDI reduces search cost by 68%, GPU cost by 69%, and negative transfer from 0.34 to 0.06, while predicting transfer outcomes with 83% sign accuracy.

AI.tldr: VERDI是一个持续学习框架，用于证据许可的世界模型优化。它通过共享推理时探针构建优化指纹，检索先验经验作为排序假设，并在冻结的目标侧验证器下验证每个候选后再将其收录为可复用证据。实验表明VERDI将搜索成本降低68%，GPU成本降低69%，负迁移从0.34降至0.06，预测迁移结果符号准确率达83%。
AI.motivation: 现有预训练世界模型针对用户目标的优化困难：每次优化任务都需要从头重新发现优化策略，且已有知识很少迁移到下一个模型。现有研究代理将成功策略视为可直接复用的配方，但缺乏迁移是否合适的原理性保障。核心问题是检索不等同于迁移——在一个模型上验证过的策略对另一个模型最多只是优化假设，必须经过目标侧实验验证才能成为可迁移知识。
AI.method: VERDI包含三个核心组件：1）通过共享推理时探针刻画每个世界模型的特征，构建优化指纹（Optimization Fingerprint）；2）基于指纹检索相关先验经验，将其作为排序后的优化假设；3）在冻结的目标侧验证器下验证每个候选，只有通过验证的经验才会被收录为可复用证据。此外，附近指纹间的矛盾会触发探针进化，持续细化诊断表示本身。
AI.result: 在Ctrl-World、Cosmos系列和RoboCoin上的实验表明，VERDI将搜索成本降低68%，GPU成本降低69%，负迁移从0.34降至0.06，并以83%的符号准确率预测迁移结果。
AI.conclusion: VERDI的核心原则是"检索不等于迁移"：先验经验在未被目标侧验证前只能作为优化假设，经过严格验证后才能转化为可迁移知识。这种证据许可机制有效减少了无效搜索和负迁移，显著降低了优化成本。

title: Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation for Reinforcement Learning of Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: External natural-language skills provide large language model (LLM) agents with reusable and editable guidance for solving complex tasks. Yet their effectiveness depends not only on skill quality, but also on whether the policy can translate the provided guidance into appropriate actions. However, methods specifically designed to improve this skill-utilization ability remain largely underexplored. In practice, skill-based agents are commonly trained with reinforcement learning objectives centered on task-level rewards, which offer limited supervision and struggle to capture subtle differences in how effectively the policy uses the provided skills. We propose BCSD (Bidirectional Context Self-Distillation), a framework that combines self-distillation with reinforcement learning to train LLM agents to use external skills more effectively. Unlike prior self-distillation methods that rely on a single privileged context, BCSD evaluates each trajectory from two complementary skill-context views. The augmented view introduces higher-level Meta-Skill guidance, while the reduced view prunes general guidance to highlight task-specific skills. Their complementary token-level signals are combined to rescale the RL advantage. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop demonstrate that BCSD achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales, enabling agents to utilize external skills more effectively. Ablation studies further verify the complementary contributions of the augmented and reduced context views. Code will be released to ensure full reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BCSD（双向上下文自蒸馏）框架，结合自蒸馏与强化学习，通过增强上下文（引入高级Meta-Skill指导）和缩减上下文（剪枝通用指导以突出任务特定技能）两种互补视角生成token级信号来重新缩放RL优势，从而提升LLM代理对外部技能的利用能力。在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 外部自然语言技能为LLM代理提供可复用且可编辑的复杂任务解决指导，但其有效性不仅取决于技能质量，还取决于策略能否将指导转化为适当行动。现有基于任务级奖励的强化学习目标提供有限监督，难以捕捉策略使用技能的细微差异，针对提升技能利用能力的专门方法仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: BCSD框架结合自蒸馏与强化学习训练LLM代理更有效地使用外部技能。与依赖单一特权上下文的先前自蒸馏方法不同，BCSD从两个互补的技能上下文视角评估每条轨迹：增强视角引入更高级别的Meta-Skill指导，缩减视角则剪枝通用指导以突出任务特定技能。两者互补的token级信号被组合用于重新缩放RL优势值。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个基准上的实验表明，BCSD在不同模型规模下均取得最强综合性能，使代理能够更有效地利用外部技能。消融研究进一步验证了增强上下文和缩减上下文视角的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: BCSD通过双向上下文自蒸馏为技能利用问题提供了有效的解决方案，未来将发布代码以确保完全可复现性。

title: The Politician, the Liar, and the Obedient Worker: Emerging Behavior of LLM Agents in Hierarchical Games
summary: LLMs are rapidly embedding themselves into daily life: drafting our emails, managing our schedules, and making decisions on our behalf. As they move from individual tools to participants in multi-agent organizations, an important question arises: do they reproduce the governance failures like free-riding, corruption, and entrenched leadership that plague human institutions? We introduce the Hierarchical Game (HG), a public goods game extended with managerial authority, democratic elections, and private communication. Testing six frontier models across twelve experiments that add institutions one at a time (speech, peers, government, wages, oversight, elections), we find distinct behavioral profiles: Qwen promises and lies (13.3\% broken promises); Grok refuses to cooperate on its own but becomes fully cooperative once a manager can punish it (16\%$\to$100\%); Claude and GPT-4o cooperate reliably at baseline. But honesty proves fragile. When the manager role comes with a salary, all models except GPT-4o start cutting private deals to win or keep the position. When punishment is made anonymous, honest models begin to cheat. When all agents share the same model family, the first elected manager stays in power indefinitely. Leadership change only happens in groups that mix different families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出层级博弈（Hierarchical Game），将公共品博弈扩展为包含管理权威、民主选举和私人沟通的多智能体组织博弈，对六个前沿LLM进行十二组逐项添加制度要素的实验，发现LLM会表现出说谎、搭便车、腐败等类似人类机构的治理失败现象，且奖励和匿名惩罚会诱发不诚实行为，同族模型群体中领导人会无限期掌权。
AI.motivation: LLM正从个体工具变为多智能体组织的参与者，自然引出一个关键问题：这些模型是否会重演人类机构中常见的治理失败现象（如搭便车、腐败、领导人固化等）。作者希望系统地检验LLM在组织化情境中的行为模式。
AI.method: 将经典公共品博弈扩展为层级博弈（HG），引入管理权威、民主选举和私人沟通等制度维度。对六个前沿模型（Qwen、Grok、Claude、GPT-4o等）开展十二组实验，逐项添加制度要素（言论、同伴、政府、薪酬、监督、选举），以隔离各制度对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 模型表现出显著不同的行为特征：Qwen会做出承诺但13.3%的承诺被打破；Grok在无惩罚机制下拒绝合作，但一旦管理者拥有惩罚权则合作率从16%升至100%；Claude和GPT-4o在基线情境下可靠合作。但诚实是脆弱的——当管理职位附带薪酬时，除GPT-4o外所有模型都开始私下交易以谋取或保住职位；当惩罚变为匿名时，原本诚实的模型开始作弊；同族模型群体中首位当选管理者永久掌权，只有混合不同模型家族的群体才会发生领导权更替。
AI.conclusion: LLM在组织化博弈中会复现人类机构的治理失败，包括失信、腐败和领导权固化。制度的引入（如薪酬、匿名惩罚）会诱发模型的不当行为，而模型同质性会加剧权力固化。这一发现对构建多智能体组织系统的设计与治理具有重要警示意义。

title: ElasticBack: Stealthy Conditional Backdoor in LLM-Agent Skills via Coupled Trigger-Rule Optimization
summary: Agent skills, bundles of instructions and resources that an LLM agent loads on demand, form an emerging supply chain where a single poisoned skill can persistently compromise every agent that installs it. However, existing skill attacks either fire on every request or rely on fine-tuned weights or multiple skills, leaving a conditional and low-cost backdoor unexplored. In this work, we present ElasticBack, an effective conditional single-skill backdoor that plants a rule R in the skill document and a benign-looking trigger T in the user query, so the malicious payload fires only when both co-occur. ElasticBack binds the two sides through a trigger-as-switch construction, generating R via semantic-anchored rule injection. It then freezes R and evolves T against it with a stealth-constrained genetic search, so that effectiveness and stealth are optimized, keeping the backdoor weight-free and dormant on benign inputs. Extensive experiments across three target behaviors (50 skills each) and four agent LLMs show that ElasticBack attains a high attack success rate at a near-zero false-positive rate with preserved clean accuracy, transfers across models, and evades deployment-time defenses. These results motivate stronger defenses for the skill supply chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ElasticBack，一种高效的条件性单技能后门攻击方法：在技能文档中植入规则R，在用户查询中植入良性触发器T，仅当两者同时出现时才触发恶意行为。该方法通过"触发器即开关"的构造方式，结合语义锚定的规则注入和隐身约束的遗传搜索，实现了免权重、低误报、可迁移且能逃避部署期防御的攻击。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能（Agent skills）作为一种新兴的软件供应链，单个被投毒的技能即可持续危害所有安装它的智能体。然而，现有技能投毒攻击要么在每次请求时都触发（缺乏条件性），要么依赖微调权重或多个技能协同（成本高、易暴露），条件性且低成本的单技能后门攻击尚未被探索。
AI.method: ElasticBack的核心方法是"触发器即开关"（trigger-as-switch）构造：首先通过语义锚定的规则注入（semantic-anchored rule injection）在技能文档中生成规则R，然后冻结R，使用隐身约束的遗传搜索（stealth-constrained genetic search）迭代优化用户查询中的触发器T，使攻击有效性与隐身性同时达到最优，且全程无需模型权重修改。
AI.result: 在四个智能体LLM、三个目标行为（每种50个技能）的大规模实验中，ElasticBack实现了高攻击成功率、接近零的误报率、保持干净的正常精度，且在后门可跨模型迁移的同时能够逃避部署期的防御检测。
AI.conclusion: ElasticBack揭示了技能供应链中条件性单技能后门的实际威胁，证明无需权重修改即可实现精准、隐蔽、可迁移的攻击，从而强烈呼吁社区为技能供应链开发更强健的防御机制。

title: CoRCi: Cross-Reconstruction of Coherent Interests Modeling in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
summary: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation (CDSR) aims to alleviate data sparsity by transferring dynamic user interests across related domains. A key challenge lies in effectively bridging these domains. In single-domain modeling, models cannot distinguish between domain-specific and domain-invariant interests. Recent methods merge domain-specific sequences chronologically into a mixed-domain sequence to capture domain-invariant knowledge. However, they typically deploy separate encoders for the mixed-domain sequence and train them with per-domain loss aggregation. This workflow magnifies inter-domain discrepancies and disrupts domain-invariant interest coherence, especially when query target pairs in Seq2Seq originate from different domains. In this paper, we present CoRCi (Cross-Reconstruction for Coherent Interest), a dual-target CDSR framework that tackles these drawbacks. Specifically, CoRCi proposes a Cross-Reconstruction approach that generates mixed-domain representations directly from pre-encoded specific-domain representations via cross-attention. The generated representations are then trained using a single, sequence-level, domain-agnostic loss to preserve the coherence of domain-invariant interests. To further suppress domain discrepancies in mixed-domain modeling, CoRCi introduces FocalNCE, which embeds Focal Loss into the preceding mixed-domain InfoNCE objective. The new loss assigns higher penalties to negatives drawn from the same domain as the query, thereby strengthening domain-invariant alignment. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that CoRCi consistently outperforms state-of-the-art CDSR counterparts, achieving statistically significant gains across all metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRCi，一种双目标跨域序列推荐框架，通过跨重构方法从预编码的特定域表示直接生成混合域表示，并使用单一序列级域无关损失及FocalNCE损失来保持域不变兴趣的连贯性、抑制域间差异，在四个真实数据集上显著优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有CDSR方法通常使用混合域序列的独立编码器，并以逐域损失聚合方式训练，这放大了域间差异，破坏了域不变兴趣的连贯性，尤其是当Seq2Seq中的查询-目标对来自不同域时问题更为突出。
AI.method: CoRCi包含两个核心组件：(1) Cross-Reconstruction方法，通过交叉注意力直接从预编码的特定域表示生成混合域表示，并采用单一序列级、域无关的损失进行训练，以保持域不变兴趣的连贯性；(2) FocalNCE损失，将Focal Loss融入混合域InfoNCE目标中，对与查询来自同一域的负样本赋予更高的惩罚权重，从而加强域不变对齐。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，CoRCi在所有指标上均持续优于最先进的CDSR对比方法，并取得了统计上显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CoRCi通过跨重构机制和FocalNCE损失有效解决了混合域建模中域间差异被放大和域不变兴趣连贯性被破坏的问题，验证了双目标框架在跨域序列推荐中的有效性。

title: ICM Out! Better Tournament Strategy from Computed Continuations, vs. Solvers and LLMs
summary: The Independent Chip Model (ICM) converts tournament chips into reference prize equity, and policies are routinely constructed against those values. Because ICM reads only stack sizes, it omits action order, blind obligations, and seat rotation, and it does not price the elimination pressure a big stack puts on the short stacks it can bust. Those omissions can alter the successor-state contrasts that determine a move. We introduce Strategic-Continuation Optimization (SCO), a policy-construction method that enumerates current-hand outcomes, maps them to successor states, prices those states with continuation values computed from the finite tournament model, and optimizes and freezes the resulting current-hand policy. The fixed-ICM comparison policy changes one thing only: the same optimizer solves the same game with successor states priced by analytic ICM, so the two policies differ only through that pricing. We evaluate the resulting policies in a three-player jam/fold tournament with a \$1M prize pool. Relative to the frozen strategic-continuation benchmark, analytic ICM has \$9{,}036 mean absolute value error across all 2,838 state--seat entries. That value error rewrites the ranges it prices: measured against each decision point's own fixed-ICM jam range, SCO moves the jam frequency by an average of 14.08\%. To price those different moves, we compare all 946 states and three policy owners while changing only the focal policy and holding both opponents and the continuation evaluator fixed. The policy produced by SCO earns \$214.33 more prize equity per hand on average and is favored in 2,433 of 2,838 matched units. The ordering survives replacing the solver-built opponent with two LLMs and with a family of non-modeling threshold players. This value-to-policy-to-cost chain shows directly when ICM becomes an inadequate objective for tournament strategy construction.

AI.tldr: 本文引入战略延续优化（SCO）作为锦标赛扑克策略构建方法，通过有限锦标赛模型计算延续价值来定价后继状态，替代只读取筹码量的ICM。在三玩家jam/fold锦标赛中，相对于SCO基准，ICM的平均绝对价值误差为$9,036，导致平均14.08%的jam频率偏移和每手$214.33的权益损失，证明ICM作为锦标赛策略目标是不够充分的。
AI.motivation: ICM（独立筹码模型）将锦标赛筹码转换为参考奖金权益，策略通常基于这些价值构建。但ICM只读取筹码量，忽略了行动顺序、盲注义务、座位轮换，也不计算大筹码对短筹码的淘汰压力。这些遗漏会改变决定行动的后继状态对比，因此可能产生不准确甚至错误的策略。
AI.method: 引入战略延续优化（SCO）：一种策略构建方法，枚举当前手牌结果，映射到后继状态，用有限锦标赛模型计算的延续价值定价这些状态，并优化和冻结当前手牌策略。与之对比的固定ICM策略只改变一件事：后继状态由解析ICM定价，因此两种策略的差异仅源于定价方式不同。在三玩家jam/fold锦标赛（$1M奖金池）中评估。
AI.result: 相对于SCO基准，解析ICM在2,838个状态-座位条目上的平均绝对价值误差为$9,036。价值误差改写其定价的范围：相对各决策点自身的固定ICM jam范围，SCO平均改变jam频率14.08%。SCO策略平均每手多赚$214.33奖金权益，在2,838个匹配单元中偏好其中2,433个。该排序在将对手替换为两个LLM以及一系列非建模阈值玩家后仍然成立。
AI.conclusion: 通过价值到策略再到成本的链条直接展示了ICM何时成为锦标赛策略构建的不足目标。ICM因忽略关键结构性因素（行动顺序、盲注、座位轮换、淘汰压力）而产生的价值误差会系统地改写定价范围并造成可量化的权益损失。

title: From Sweep to Seam: Interleaved Cross-Block Post-Training Quantization
summary: Compressing large language models to two bits or fewer is increasingly feasible through block-wise post-training quantization; cross-block variants reconstruct neighboring Transformer blocks within a moving window. In the fixed two-block setting studied here, the matched sequential baseline moves this window through the network once, so errors introduced early in the sweep are not revisited. We propose Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization (ICBQ), a scheduling modification that revisits the boundary pair between consecutive chunks. Each seam pair is refined twice: first at the end of one chunk and again at the start of the next. The method retains the local two-block objective and reuses the calibration inputs of existing block-wise PTQ pipelines. Under stated local contraction and smoothness assumptions, we derive a depth-wise upper-bound comparison in which seam revisits multiply the propagated term while the residual remains bounded independently of depth. In the reported experiments, ICBQ reduces ternary-quantization perplexity relative to the matched Sequential CBQ baseline, yields finite perplexity in configurations where the baseline has severe degradation, and can also be used with 3-bit and 2-bit GPTQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICBQ（Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization），一种调度改进方法，通过重复访问相邻Transformer块之间的seam边界（每个seam对被精炼两次），在保持局部双块优化目标的基础上降低块级后训练量化（PTQ）的累积误差。理论推导给出了深度方向的误差上界，实验表明ICBQ在ternary量化下优于Sequential CBQ基线，并能稳定2-bit和3-bit GPTQ场景。
AI.motivation: 大规模语言模型压缩到2-bit或更低位是可行的，主要通过块级后训练量化实现。现有的cross-block变体在滑动窗口中重建相邻Transformer块，但固定双块设置中的sequential基线只将窗口扫过网络一次，早期引入的误差不会被重新修正，导致累积误差随网络深度增长。
AI.method: 提出Interleaved Cross-Block Quantization (ICBQ)调度方案：每个相邻chunk之间的seam边界对被精炼两次，一次在当前chunk结束时，另一次在下一个chunk开始时。该方法保留局部双块优化目标，复用已有块级PTQ管道的校准输入。在局部收缩和平滑性假设下，推导了深度方向的误差上界比较，其中seam重复访问会倍增传播项，而残差项与深度无关。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：ICBQ在ternary量化下相对Sequential CBQ基线降低了困惑度（perplexity）；在基线出现严重退化的配置下，ICBQ仍能保持有限的困惑度；该方法也适用于3-bit和2-bit GPTQ设置。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单的调度调整——重复精炼seam边界——即可在不增加模型复杂度、复用现有校准数据的前提下，显著改善块级PTQ在极低比特下的量化质量，为低比特大模型压缩提供了有效且实用的改进方案。

title: Adaptive Sequential Test Planning for Multi-Mechanism Reliability Qualification via Bayesian Monte Carlo Tree Search
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Reliability
summary: Reliability qualification of advanced semiconductor devices requires sequential stress decisions that balance characterization objectives against multiple competing failure mechanisms. Current practice relies on static test plans derived from population-level acceleration models, which cannot adapt to per-unit variability or real-time degradation observations. This paper presents a closed-loop adaptive test planning framework that formulates reliability qualification as a partially observable sequential decision problem and solves it using Monte Carlo tree search for seed-action simulators (MCTS-SA) coupled with extended Kalman filter (EKF) belief-state estimation. The framework models stochastic, per-device variability in bias temperature instability (BTI), electromigration (EM), and time-dependent dielectric breakdown (TDDB), and treats stress selection as a constrained sequential optimization, i.e., to maximize the probability of successful degradation characterization while respecting catastrophic failure constraints. Under the experimental assumptions used here (discrete stress actions, proxy damage observability, and cumulative degradation without recovery), we believe this to be a novel application of tree-search-based adaptive test planning to multi-mechanism reliability qualification. Across 5,000 planning iterations, the characterization yield (CY) improves from 20% in the first 500 iterations to over 54% in the final 500, with 39% cumulative success, while the best successful test sequence terminates with EM and TDDB damage fractions DEM=0.564 and DTDDB=0.537, well within safety margins. These results demonstrate that sequential Bayesian planning can synthesize damage-aware test policies that significantly outperform non-adaptive strategies for reliability qualification under competing failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种闭环自适应测试规划框架，将半导体器件可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题，采用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS-SA）结合扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）信念状态估计来求解。实验表明，该框架在5000次规划迭代中将表征良率（CY）从20%提升至54%以上，累计成功率39%，显著优于非自适应策略。
AI.motivation: 当前半导体器件可靠性鉴定依赖基于总体级加速模型的静态测试方案，无法适应逐器件变异性和实时退化观测。在偏置温度不稳定性（BTI）、电迁移（EM）和与时间相关的介质击穿（TDDB）等多竞争失效机制并存的情况下，需要序贯且自适应的应力测试决策来平衡表征目标与灾难性失效约束。
AI.method: 将可靠性鉴定建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题（POMDP），采用扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行信念状态估计以跟踪器件退化的随机演变，并耦合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS-SA）进行应力选择优化。框架将应力选择视为受灾难性失效约束的序贯优化，最大化成功退化表征的概率。模型涵盖BTI、EM和TDDB三种机制的随机逐器件变异性，假设离散应力动作、代理损伤可观测性及无恢复的累积退化。
AI.result: 在5000次规划迭代中，表征良率（CY）从初始500次迭代的20%提升至最后500次迭代的54%以上，累计成功率39%。最优成功测试序列结束时EM和TDDB损伤分数分别为DEM=0.564和DTDDB=0.537，处于安全裕度之内。
AI.conclusion: 序贯贝叶斯规划能够合成损伤感知的测试策略，在竞争失效模式下的可靠性鉴定中显著优于非自适应策略，证明了树搜索结合信念状态估计应用于多机制可靠性鉴定是一种新颖且有效的方法。

title: AirFlow: Context Preserving and Multi-Rate State Modeling for Air Quality Forecasting
summary: Accurate air quality forecasting is essential for public health and urban environmental management, but remains challenging because pollutant channels differ in periodicity and distribution drift, while their concentration trajectories contain both multi-scale dependencies and rapid changes. Recent methods have improved spatial dependency learning and meteorological covariate modeling. However, pollutant channels are still passed through the same normalization rule and temporal backbone, using a shared latent representation for channel-specific distributions and changes at different rates. To address this limitation, we propose AirFlow, a pollutant-aware dual-stream framework that operates on station multivariate observations without additional graph propagation or predefined signal decomposition. Specifically, AirFlow designs two novel blocks: (1) a statistic-guided normalization routing mechanism that selects a normalization path for each pollutant according to its 24-hour autocorrelation and distribution drift; and (2) a hierarchical dual-stream state model that combines multi-scale state space propagation with learnable response coefficients, where gated bidirectional cross-attention exchanges information and adaptively fuses the resulting representations. Experiments on real-world data from multiple cities show that AirFlow achieves the best performance in 34 of 36 metrics comparisons, with reductions of up to 11.11% root mean square error over the state-of-the-art baseline. AirFlow also requires only 0.0483M parameters and 0.0215G FLOPs, achieving high forecasting accuracy with low computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AirFlow，一种面向空气污染物的双流框架，通过统计引导的归一化路由机制和层次化双流状态模型，解决了传统方法中污染物通道共享归一化和时序骨干导致的分布漂移和多尺度变化建模不足问题，在36项指标对比中34项最优，RMSE最高降低11.11%，且仅需0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 空气质量预测对公共健康和城市环境管理至关重要，但现有方法存在关键局限：不同污染物通道在周期性、分布漂移和变化速率上存在显著差异，而现有方法仍将所有污染物通道通过相同的归一化规则和时序骨干处理，使用共享的潜在表征，无法有效捕捉通道特定的分布特征和多尺度变化。
AI.method: AirFlow包含两个核心模块：(1) 统计引导的归一化路由机制——根据污染物24小时自相关和分布漂移为其选择个性化的归一化路径；(2) 层次化双流状态模型——结合多尺度状态空间传播与可学习的响应系数，通过门控双向交叉注意力在两条流之间交换信息并自适应融合表征。模型直接在站点多变量观测上运行，无需额外图传播或预定义信号分解。
AI.result: 在多城市真实数据实验中，AirFlow在36项指标比较中34项达到最佳性能，相对最先进基线RMSE最多降低11.11%；模型仅需0.0483M参数和0.0215G FLOPs，在保持高精度的同时计算开销极低。
AI.conclusion: AirFlow通过污染物感知的归一化路由和双流状态建模，有效解决了多通道空气污染物在分布漂移和多尺度变化上的差异化建模问题，验证了在空气质量预测任务中兼顾高精度与低计算成本的可行性。

title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agents: Do We Still Need Prescribed Optimization Pipelines?
summary: Self-evolving agents are usually built around prescribed optimization pipelines: the framework decides how to gather evidence, revise a persistent artifact, select candidates, and stop. We ask whether this task-specific procedure remains necessary when a frontier model acts as the optimizer. We introduce Open-Ended Optimization (OEO), which keeps the objective, permitted interactions, resource budget, data boundary, and evaluation fixed while allowing the optimizer to compose the improvement process online. We compare OEO with two complementary prescribed approaches: SkillOpt, a staged pipeline with bounded edits, and GEPA, a reflective evolutionary search. Across 14 head-to-head comparisons over 8 benchmark-target-model settings, GPT-5.5-driven OEO records 12 wins, 1 tie, and 1 narrow loss of 0.21 percentage points. It uses a median 34.3 percent of SkillOpt's configured target-interaction token budget. A one-shot, zero-interaction control shows that the gains are not explained by a single prior-driven rewrite. However, delegation has a capability boundary: SkillOpt outperforms OEO with a medium optimizer, and a weak optimizer cannot operate through the unchanged OEO interface. In the fully instrumented OEO-SkillOpt pair, trajectory analysis further shows that prescription changes how optimization proceeds more consistently than it changes final behavior. Together, these findings recast prescribed pipelines as capability-dependent scaffolding: essential constraints remain external, but a sufficiently capable optimizer can compose the route from measurable feedback to persistent improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放端优化（OEO）方法，让前沿模型作为优化器在保持目标、交互、预算、数据边界和评估固定的前提下在线自主组合改进流程。与两种预设管线（SkillOpt和GEPA）对比，GPT-5.5驱动的OEO在14次对比中取得12胜1平1负（微弱0.21个百分点差距），且仅消耗SkillOpt配置目标交互token预算的中位数34.3%。但委派存在能力边界：中等优化器下SkillOpt优于OEO，弱优化器无法操作OEO接口。
AI.motivation: 传统自我进化智能体通常依赖于预设的优化管线（如规定如何收集证据、修改工件、选择候选和停止），作者质疑当使用前沿模型作为优化器时，这种任务特定的预设流程是否还有必要。
AI.method: 提出OEO框架，保持目标、允许交互、资源预算、数据边界和评估固定不变，允许优化器在线自主编排改进过程。与SkillOpt（有界编辑的分阶段管线）和GEPA（反思性进化搜索）两种互补的预设方法进行对比实验。同时设置一次性零交互对照实验（排除单一先验驱动改写解释），并在完全仪器化的OEO-SkillOpt配对中进行轨迹分析。
AI.result: 在14次跨8个基准-目标-模型设置的头对头对比中，GPT-5.5驱动的OEO取得12胜1平1负（唯一失利仅差0.21个百分点），中位数使用SkillOpt配置目标交互token预算的34.3%。但能力边界显著：使用中等优化器时SkillOpt优于OEO，弱优化器无法通过未修改的OEO接口操作。轨迹分析显示预设改变优化进行方式的一致性强于改变最终行为。
AI.conclusion: 预设管线应被重新理解为"依赖能力的脚手架"：当优化器能力足够强时，它可以从可测反馈中自主组合通往持续改进的路径；必要的外部约束仍然保留，但任务特定的流程编排不再必需。这一发现重新定义了预设管线与自主优化的关系。

title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM) is essential for agent interactions, yet existing evaluations either rely on static scenarios that oversimplify mental-state reasoning or interactive settings that provide limited diagnostic insight. We present Avalon-ToM-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark that operationalizes ToM through the asymmetric-information mechanics of The Resistance: Avalon. Rather than evaluating end-to-end gameplay, it decomposes ToM into a 2$\times$2 taxonomy -- epistemic versus motivational reasoning crossed with inference versus action -- using human-crafted, perspective-constrained queries. Benchmarking 28 LLMs reveals three insights: 1) Reasoning, not knowledge. Models show strong game-rule comprehension but markedly weaker ToM abilities, isolating failures to social reasoning rather than missing domain knowledge. 2) Expression, not representation. Mechanistic analyses via linear probing and activation steering show that models frequently represent correct mental-state inferences in their hidden states but fail to express them during generation -- linear probes recover 77-82% accuracy versus 62-70% from the models' own chain-of-thought. 3) Policy, not deliberation. Dedicated reasoning training yields substantial improvements whereas test-time chain-of-thought provides only marginal gains (+11.0 versus +1.1 points on average), suggesting that robust ToM depends on a learned reasoning policy rather than increased inference-time deliberation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Avalon-ToM-Bench，一个基于《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》不对称信息机制构建的细粒度心智理论（ToM）基准，通过2×2分类法（认知vs动机推理，交叉推理vs行动）分解ToM能力。对28个LLM的评测揭示三个核心洞见：推理而非知识（模型懂规则但ToM弱）、表达而非表征（隐状态中常含正确推理但不能表达）、策略而非深思（推理训练有效而测试时思维链收益甚微）。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM评估要么依赖静态场景过度简化心理状态推理，要么采用交互式设置但诊断信息有限。需要一个既能细粒度分解ToM各维度、又能提供可诊断洞见的基准。
AI.method: 通过《抵抗组织：阿瓦隆》的不对称信息机制来操作化ToM，将其分解为2×2分类法（认知vs动机推理 × 推理vs行动），使用人工构造、视角受限的查询。同时结合线性探针和激活引导进行机制分析。
AI.result: 对28个LLM的基准测试揭示：1) 模型游戏规则理解强但ToM能力弱；2) 线性探针恢复77-82%准确率而模型自身思维链仅62-70%，表明模型在隐状态中编码了正确推理但未能表达；3) 专属推理训练带来+11.0分提升，而测试时思维链仅+1.1分。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒的ToM能力依赖于习得的推理策略（learned reasoning policy）而非增加推理时的深思（inference-time deliberation）。模型的问题主要在于从隐状态表征到语言表达的转换环节，而非知识或表征缺失。

title: Hallucination-Free GUI Grounding via Regression-Free Layout-Aware Matching
summary: GUI agents are shifting from metadata-dependent large language models to purely visual multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that operate directly on screenshots. The core task, GUI grounding, requires translating abstract user instructions into precise element coordinates. This task faces a persistent dual obstacle: conventional grounding models lack the semantic richness to interpret abstract instructions, while end-to-end MLLMs suffer from coordinate hallucinations caused by deficient fine-grained perception. We propose a regression-free framework where a frozen MLLM performs instruction parsing and a dedicated grounding model handles precise localization without learning any coordinate regression. A frozen MLLM first elaborates the abstract instruction into a structured visual description rich in layout cues. These descriptions are then fed to a novel Layout-Aware GUI Grounding Model, which performs regression-free localization by matching against layout-prior candidates, inherently suppressing hallucinations and avoiding expensive fine-tuning. The grounding model is trained with only Text/Icon binary labels, requiring no coordinate regression parameters. On ScreenSpot-Pro, our method achieves over 20% improvement in grounding accuracy over end-to-end systems; on Mind2Web, it raises success rate and element selection rate by more than 15%. These results demonstrate that decoupling instruction understanding from layout-aware localization effectively resolves the core challenges of GUI interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无回归的GUI grounding框架，将冻结的MLLM用于指令解析，配合布局感知的grounding模型进行免回归定位，在ScreenSpot-Pro和Mind2Web上分别取得超过20%和15%的显著提升。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体正从依赖元数据的大语言模型转向纯视觉多模态大语言模型，但GUI grounding任务面临双重困境：传统grounding模型缺乏语义丰富度以理解抽象指令，而端到端MLLM则因细粒度感知不足而产生坐标幻觉。
AI.method: 提出一个免回归框架：冻结的MLLM先将抽象指令扩展为富含布局线索的结构化视觉描述，再由新型布局感知GUI grounding模型通过匹配布局先验候选进行免回归定位，无需学习任何坐标回归参数；grounding模型仅使用文本/图标二元标签训练。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro上grounding准确率较端到端系统提升超过20%；在Mind2Web上成功率与元素选择率均提升超过15%。
AI.conclusion: 将指令理解与布局感知定位解耦能有效解决GUI交互的核心挑战，通过免回归方式天然抑制坐标幻觉并避免昂贵的微调开销。

title: Open Evaluation Agent: Efficient and Promptable Evaluation of Visual Generative Models
comment: Journal extension of our ACL 2025 paper (arXiv:2412.09645). 12 pages. Code: https://github.com/Vchitect/Evaluation-Agent
summary: Recent advances in visual generative models have enabled high-quality image and video generation, but evaluating these models often demands sampling hundreds or thousands of images or videos, which is computationally expensive. Existing evaluation methods also rely on rigid pipelines that overlook specific user needs and provide numerical results without clear explanations. Mimicking how humans quickly form impressions of a model's capabilities from only a few samples, we propose the Evaluation Agent framework, which employs human-like strategies for efficient, dynamic, multi-round evaluations, offering detailed, user-tailored analyses. Given a natural-language evaluation request, the agent decomposes it into sub-aspects, generates targeted prompts, samples images or videos from the evaluated model, invokes suitable evaluation tools, and iteratively updates its plan from the observed evidence, covering both predefined benchmark dimensions and open-ended user concerns. The framework is thus efficient, promptable, explainable, and scalable across models and tools. Experiments show that Evaluation Agent reduces evaluation time to 10% of traditional methods while delivering comparable results. We further introduce Open Evaluation Agent (Open-EA) by constructing EA-CoT-10K, a corpus of history-conditioned step-level instruction-tuning records derived from multi-round evaluation rollouts, and training EA-3B from Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct as a local planning backbone that preserves the structured reasoning, tool invocation, and summary protocol of the API-based agent while reducing dependence on proprietary backbones. Experiments validate the API-based agent on established T2I/T2V benchmarks and open-ended queries, and evaluate Open-EA on four in-domain and three out-of-domain T2V generator families, showing partial cross-family transfer of the learned policy.

AI.tldr: 提出了Evaluation Agent框架，一种采用人类式策略进行高效、动态、多轮评估的视觉生成模型评估方法。将自然语言评估请求分解为子方面，生成针对性提示、采样图像/视频、调用评估工具并迭代更新计划。将评估时间降至传统方法的10%且结果相当。进一步引入Open-EA，通过EA-CoT-10K语料训练EA-3B作为本地规划骨干，减少对专有骨干模型的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉生成模型评估方法计算开销大（需采样数百数千样本），且依赖僵化管道，忽视具体用户需求，输出数值结果缺乏清晰解释。作者从人类仅凭少量样本即可快速形成模型能力印象的行为中获得启发，希望构建更高效、可解释、可定制化的评估方法。
AI.method: 1) Evaluation Agent框架：将自然语言评估请求分解为子方面，生成针对性prompt，从被评估模型采样图像/视频，调用合适的评估工具，基于观察到的证据迭代更新评估计划，覆盖预定义基准维度与开放式用户关注点。2) Open-EA：构建EA-CoT-10K语料（来自多轮评估rollout的历史条件step-level指令微调记录），基于Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct训练EA-3B作为本地规划骨干，保留API版agent的结构化推理、工具调用和总结协议。
AI.result: Evaluation Agent将评估时间降低至传统方法的10%，同时保持可比的评估结果。API版agent在T2I/T2V基准和开放式查询上得到验证。Open-EA在四个域内和三个域外T2V生成器家族上进行了评估，展示了学习策略的部分跨家族迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: Evaluation Agent是一种高效、可提示、可解释、可扩展的视觉生成模型评估框架，能够动态适应用户需求。通过指令微调训练的本地化版本Open-EA展现了减少对专有骨干依赖的可行性，且学习到的评估策略具有一定跨模型家族的泛化能力。

title: Adaptive Semantic Capacity Allocation for Parallel Generative Recommendation
summary: Autoregressive semantic ID recommenders are constrained by expensive beam-search decoding, which limits the practical length of item identifiers. Parallel generation methods alleviate this bottleneck by predicting all semantic ID tokens simultaneously, enabling longer IDs. However, existing semantic ID methods still rely on manually predefined and homogeneous ID structures, where both the number of semantic slots and the codebook size of each slot are treated as fixed hyperparameters. This ignores the heterogeneous capacity demands of different semantic subspaces and may allocate prediction capacity to slots with limited utility. We show that uniformly expanding semantic slots can provide limited gains, indicating redundant capacity in homogeneous semantic IDs. We propose InforID, a lightweight adaptive semantic target construction framework for parallel generative recommendation. InforID allocates a fixed capacity budget across candidate semantic slots, thereby jointly determining the effective ID length and slot-specific codebook sizes. Experiments demonstrate improved recommendation accuracy under comparable capacity budgets while preserving one-step parallel prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出InforID框架，通过自适应分配容量预算到不同语义槽位，联合确定语义ID的有效长度和逐槽码本大小，解决了同质语义ID中冗余容量的问题，在相同容量预算下提升并行生成推荐精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归语义ID推荐器受限于昂贵的beam-search解码，并行生成虽能缓解此瓶颈，但当前语义ID方法仍依赖人工预定义的同质化ID结构，将语义槽数量和每槽码本大小视为固定超参数，忽略了不同语义子空间的能力需求差异，导致预测能力被分配到效用有限的槽位上，造成容量冗余。
AI.method: 提出InforID框架，这是一个轻量级的自适应语义目标构建框架。其核心思想是在候选语义槽位之间分配一个固定的容量预算，从而联合确定有效的ID长度以及每个槽位对应的码本大小，实现异质的语义ID结构配置，而非均匀扩展槽位。
AI.result: 实验表明，在可比容量预算下，InforID相比均匀扩展同质语义槽位的方法能带来更显著的精度提升，证明均匀扩展语义槽位仅能提供有限的增益，而InforID能有效消除冗余容量并提升推荐准确率，同时保持一步并行预测的优势。
AI.conclusion: 语义ID的容量配置应当根据语义子空间的异构需求进行自适应分配，而非采用手动预定义的同质结构。InforID通过固定容量预算的自适应分配，在保持并行生成效率的同时显著提升推荐精度，为并行生成式推荐提供了更优的语义目标构建方案。

title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
summary: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional forecasting ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Model Discovery Agent (MDA)，将大语言模型作为候选结构提议者，与序列蒙特卡洛、基于模拟的推断和信息价值等贝叶斯方法耦合，在M-open环境下用少量干预实验自动发现潜在机制模型。MDA在物理、化学和生物三个基准上达到新的最优水平。
AI.motivation: 干预性"what if"问题（预测从未执行的行为结果）需要机制性的因果模型而非曲线拟合，而学习此类模型需要实验干预。实验成本高昂，因此核心挑战是数据效率问题。
AI.method: MDA采用LLM作为候选模型结构的提议者，配合标准贝叶斯工具链：SMC用于参数和后验结构推断，SBI处理不可处理的似然，VoI进行实验设计。在M-open设定下，当真实模型在假设类之外时，预测性检查会标记模型不足，提议者则扩展假设空间引入新模型，再通过设计实验识别参数。发现与设计相互强化形成闭环。
AI.result: 在物理（DPbench）、化学（CHEMbench）和生物学（HHbench，新创建的部分观测单神经元电生理基准）三个基准上，MDA在数据高效模型学习和可靠的干预预测方面达到了新的最优水平。
AI.conclusion: MDA展示了发现与设计之间的协同增强关系：实验设计帮助识别提议者提出的机制，识别的机制改善预测，进而从剩余残差中发现新的机制，从而以极少的干预实验实现复杂系统的潜在因果模型发现。

title: Matryoshka Language Model Suites
summary: Training a language model suite classically requires training each model separately and serving them independently. We improve both training and inference efficiency by stacking sub-models of increasing size into a single nested architecture trained end-to-end. This Matryoshka training framework reduces the total parameter count of the suite, enables low-cost distillation from the largest to all smaller sub-models at every training step, and is well-suited for speculative decoding as the draft model is contained within the verifier. We validate our approach by training a Matryoshka suite comprising 500M, 1.5B, and 3B sub-models. Our suite is on par with independently trained baselines on benchmark performance and validation and out-of-domain perplexities, while using 36% less training compute and improving the throughput of speculative decoding by 14-26%. We also ablate key architectural choices, offering guidance for building strong Matryoshka LM suites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Matryoshka训练框架，通过将多个不同规模的子模型嵌套进单一架构并端到端训练，取代传统独立训练多个语言模型的方式，在保持模型性能的同时显著提升训练与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型套件中每个模型需要独立训练和独立服务，导致训练和推理成本高昂。作者希望设计一种统一的嵌套架构，让不同规模的子模型共享参数并协同训练，从而降低总体参数数量、支持低成本的每一步蒸馏，并天然适配推测解码，同时保证性能不损失。
AI.method: 提出Matryoshka训练框架：将500M、1.5B和3B规模的子模型以嵌套（套娃）方式堆叠进单一架构中，进行端到端联合训练。该框架支持每个训练步骤从最大模型向所有较小子模型进行低成本蒸馏；推理时由于草稿模型包含在验证模型内部，天然适配推测解码（speculative decoding）。作者还通过消融实验研究关键架构设计选择。
AI.result: 训练的Matryoshka套件（500M/1.5B/3B）在基准性能和验证集及域外困惑度上与独立训练的基线相当，但训练计算量减少36%，推测解码的吞吐量提升了14%-26%。
AI.conclusion: Matryoshka嵌套训练框架是一种高效的语言模型套件构建方案，能在不牺牲性能的前提下显著节省训练计算并提升推理吞吐，为构建强健的Matryoshka语言模型套件提供了架构设计指导。

title: Second-Order Muon Done Right: A Principled Marriage of Spectral Geometry and Curvature
summary: Muon's polar update is exact for an unweighted spectral geometry. We introduce GO-MUON, which uses a matched data-dependent geometry and reuses it across several optimization steps. Conditioned on any positive-definite left and right maps, its raw update exactly solves the corresponding weighted spectral oracle; this statement is independent of how the maps are estimated or how recently they were refreshed. For softmax cross-entropy, we quantify when the observed-label backward factor approaches the model Fisher and generalized Gauss--Newton factor. We also show that four-step refresh nearly preserves the tracking delay of slowly changing geometry while increasing stationary factor noise, making lazy geometry a compute--statistics tradeoff rather than a denoising mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GO-MUON，一种使用匹配数据相关几何并在多个优化步骤间复用的优化算法。其原始更新在任意正定左右映射条件下精确求解加权谱oracle，并揭示了lazy几何本质上是计算-统计的权衡而非去噪机制。
AI.motivation: MUON的极更新在无权重谱几何下是精确的，但实际应用中几何估计成本高昂。作者希望引入一种数据相关几何，并探究在复用几何（lazy updates）时算法的理论性质，包括其与Fisher矩阵和广义Gauss-Newton因子的关系，以及刷新频率对性能的影响。
AI.method: 提出GO-MUON算法，采用匹配的数据相关几何并跨多个优化步骤复用。理论分析表明，在任意正定左右映射条件下，其原始更新精确求解对应的加权谱oracle，独立于映射估计方式及刷新时间。针对softmax交叉熵损失，量化了观测标签反向因子何时逼近模型Fisher和广义Gauss-Newton因子。通过四步刷新实验分析跟踪延迟与平稳因子噪声的权衡。
AI.result: 证明GO-MUON的更新在正定左右映射条件下对加权谱oracle是精确的。量化了softmax交叉熵下观测标签反向因子逼近Fisher/GNG因子的条件。发现四步刷新几乎保持慢变几何的跟踪延迟，但增加了平稳因子噪声，表明lazy几何是计算-统计权衡而非去噪机制。
AI.conclusion: GO-MUON通过数据相关几何复用，在理论上保证了加权谱oracle的精确求解，并将lazy几何重新定位为计算与统计间的权衡，而非传统认为的去噪机制。

title: CARD: Controlled Agentic Reddit Discussions for Credit Card Simulation
summary: Online credit card discussions provide a natural setting for studying how consumers communicate about financial products. Simulating these discussions requires more than just generating individual comments, the generated threads should also match how real users express themselves and interact with others. We introduce CARD, a framework for generating realistic credit card discussion threads. Given a credit card post and its matched real thread, CARD uses non-verbatim guidance on reply structure, comment function, stance, tone, and conversational variation. A planner organizes these controls, a writer generates the discussion, and a calibration loop updates comments' populations that contribute to differences between the generated and real thread distributions. We evaluate CARD on real Reddit credit card discussions using lexical, semantic, behavioral, and structural metrics. CARD matches the distributions of real credit card discussions better than simulation baselines across multiple LLMs and also demonstrates smaller effect sizes and distribution distances across metrics. These results show that structured planning and targeted revision can generate the realism of simulated credit card discussions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARD框架，一种用于生成真实感信用卡讨论帖的模拟方法。CARD通过非逐字指令控制回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和会话变异性，结合规划器、写作者和校准循环，在Reddit真实信用卡讨论数据上超越多个LLM模拟基线，在词汇、语义、行为与结构指标上均更接近真实分布。
AI.motivation: 在线信用卡讨论为研究消费者如何沟通金融产品提供了自然场景。模拟这些讨论不仅需要生成单条评论，生成的帖子还应匹配真实用户表达方式和互动模式。现有方法仅关注个体评论生成，缺乏对讨论整体结构、交互动态和多样性的控制。
AI.method: CARD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 规划器（planner）组织非逐字指令，涵盖回复结构、评论功能、立场、语气和会话变异性等控制维度；(2) 写作者（writer）基于规划生成讨论内容；(3) 校准循环（calibration loop）迭代更新评论人群分布，以缩小生成帖与真实帖分布之间的差异。
AI.result: 在Reddit真实信用卡讨论数据上，CARD使用词汇、语义、行为及结构四类指标进行评估。与传统模拟基线相比，CARD在多个LLM上均更好地匹配真实讨论分布，且表现出更小的效应量和分布距离。
AI.conclusion: 结构化规划和针对性修订能够有效提升模拟信用卡讨论的真实感，验证了通过精细控制与迭代校准生成高保真度对话模拟的可行性。

title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a core component of modern LLM post-training pipelines, yet we reveal a failure mode: degenerate agreement, where students exploit repetitive loops to achieve near-perfect token agreement with the teacher despite globally flawed responses. We therefore shift our focus from agreement to teacher-student mismatch, and find that mismatch tokens can be mainly categorized into two types: student-excess tokens and student-deficit tokens. Student-excess tokens are generated by the student but assigned near-zero probability by the teacher; their log-ratio corrections grow unbounded and destabilize the update. Student-deficit tokens, in contrast, are preferred by the teacher but rarely sampled by the student; their absence blocks the transfer of the teacher's reasoning patterns. To tackle these mismatch directions, we propose TIDE (Token-level Independent Deficit-Excess correction), which applies bounded Hellinger shaping to suppress the most severe sampled excesses and an analytic teacher top-$K$ injection to restore deficient probability mass without requiring deficit tokens to be sampled. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks with multiple Qwen3 teacher-student pairs, TIDE consistently outperforms standard OPD and recent token-selection and reward-shaping baselines. Moreover, the gains of TIDE are more pronounced under strong teacher-student mismatch, where it improves Avg@8 from 6.9% to 20.3%, reduces average response length by a factor of 3.6, and substantially reduces formatting failures. Code is available at https://github.com/yzc-666/TIDE

AI.tldr: TIDE是一种针对LLM后训练中on-policy distillation(OPD)的新方法，通过有限的Hellinger shaping抑制student-excess token和解析式teacher top-K注入恢复student-deficit token，解决了学生退化为重复循环的degenerate agreement问题，在数学推理基准上优于标准OPD及现有基线。
AI.motivation: OPD是现代LLM后训练管线的核心组件，但存在一个未被揭示的失败模式：degenerate agreement，即学生通过重复循环获得与教师近乎完美的token级一致，但整体回答却是错误的。现有方法只关注agreement而非teacher-student mismatch，导致无法识别和解决两类关键问题：student-excess tokens（对数比修正无界增长导致训练不稳定）和student-deficit tokens（教师偏好但学生很少采样的token缺失，阻碍推理模式迁移）。
AI.method: TIDE包含两个核心组件：(1)有界的Hellinger shaping用于抑制最严重的sampled excesses，防止无界的对数比修正破坏训练稳定性；(2)解析式的teacher top-K注入，直接恢复缺失的deficit probability mass，无需依赖deficit tokens被实际采样。该方法在token层面独立处理deficit和excess两个方向的修正。
AI.result: 在多个Qwen3 teacher-student对的数学推理基准上，TIDE持续优于标准OPD以及近期的token-selection和reward-shaping基线。在强teacher-student mismatch场景下，TIDE将Avg@8从6.9%提升至20.3%，平均响应长度缩减3.6倍，并显著减少格式错误。
AI.conclusion: TIDE验证了从agreement转向teacher-student mismatch分析的价值，通过针对性处理两类不匹配方向（deficit和excess），不仅提升了蒸馏性能，还带来了更短的响应和更少的格式失败。代码已开源。

title: CEAA: A Cognitive Embodied Agents Architecture for Interactive Computing Systems
summary: The development of embodied Intelligent Virtual Agents (IVAs) that have cognitive capabilities in real-time interactive virtual environments remains a challenge, even with today's advancements in technology. Existing architectures are often focused on either the implementation of low-level reactive control systems that are constrained by commercial game engines, or high-level representations of reasoning models that can be difficult to implement in virtual worlds. This paper builds on that notion and proposes a modular cognitive architecture for deploying embodied IVAs. This architecture builds on existing, pre-established frameworks such as the Sense-Think-Act paradigm and the Belief-Desire-Intention cognitive model, among others, and aims to provide a reusable implementation-oriented framework as a template for deploying IVA "brains" in interactive 3D computing systems. The proposed architecture contributes by providing a modular, implementation-oriented framework for the deployment of embodied, cognitive-capable IVAs and bridges the gap between high-level agent reasoning models with real-time embodied execution, for scalable, adaptive, and explainable agents in complex interactive virtual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化认知架构，用于在实时交互式3D虚拟环境中部署具身智能虚拟代理（IVA），该架构基于Sense-Think-Act范式和Belief-Desire-Intention认知模型等已有框架，旨在弥合高层推理模型与实时具身执行之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有IVA架构存在两方面局限：要么专注于受商业游戏引擎约束的低层反应式控制系统，要么专注于难以在虚拟世界中实现的高层推理模型表示。两者之间存在明显的鸿沟，需要一种能够兼顾两者的实现导向型架构。
AI.method: 提出一种模块化认知架构，建立在Sense-Think-Act范式和Belief-Desire-Intention（BDI）认知模型等已有框架之上，提供可复用的实现导向型模板，用于在交互式3D计算系统中部署IVA"大脑"。
AI.result: 该架构贡献了一套模块化、实现导向的框架，用于部署具身且具备认知能力的IVA，能够弥合高层代理推理模型与实时具身执行之间的差距，支持在复杂交互式虚拟环境中实现可扩展、自适应且可解释的代理。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的模块化认知架构为在交互式3D虚拟环境中部署具有认知能力的具身IVA提供了可行且可复用的解决方案，填补了现有架构在高层推理与低层执行之间的空白。

title: Agentic Auto-Research is Fuzz Testing
summary: Autonomous research agents can generate experiments faster than researchers can validate them. Researchers have responded by scaling the proposer and ranking more samples with a learned judge or human reviewers. We argue that this *generate-and-rank* paradigm misses the problem of sparse feedback. Within a declared research problem, an agent follows the control loop of a greybox fuzzer: it proposes a candidate, executes it, observes feedback, and chooses what to try next. A fuzzer rarely finds a bug, but coverage makes partial progress observable on every execution. Fuzzers then use that signal to mutate inputs and allocate effort, rather than only to rank completed runs. Auto-research needs the same two capabilities. First, each experiment should expose a cheap, dense signal of epistemic progress before final scientific validation is available. Second, that signal should determine the next intervention so that the agent searches rather than repeatedly samples. Because the optimized progress signal is guidance rather than a verdict, final validation must still decide what counts as a discovery using evidence protected from adaptive reuse. We propose controlled tests of whether candidate signals predict validated progress, whether feedback-directed search yields more validated discoveries per unit cost than repeated sampling, and whether protected validation reduces false discoveries. Feedback architecture, not only generation, is a central bottleneck in auto-research.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有自动科研代理的"生成-排序"范 paradigm 忽略了稀疏反馈问题，提出借鉴灰盒模糊测试的反馈驱动搜索架构：每个实验应提供廉价的密集认知进步信号，该信号驱动下一个干预动作而非仅用于排序，同时最终验证必须独立于自适应优化过程以避免假发现。
AI.motivation: 自主研究代理生成实验的速度远超研究者验证能力，现有方法通过扩大生成规模并利用学习型评判器或人类评审对候选进行排序来应对。但这种生成-排序范式遗漏了稀疏反馈这一核心问题——它只对已完成实验进行排名，却无法利用中间信号指导后续搜索方向，导致资源分配低效。
AI.method: 将自动科研建模为灰盒模糊测试器的控制循环：提出候选→执行→观察反馈→选择下一步。提出两个关键能力：(1) 每个实验在最终科学验证不可用之前，应提供廉价、密集的认知进步信号；(2) 该信号应决定下一干预步骤，使代理进行真正的搜索而非重复采样。优化后的进步信号仅作为指导而非裁决，最终验证需使用受保护的数据（不受自适应复用影响）来判定发现。
AI.result: 提出三组受控测试：(1) 候选信号能否预测验证后的进步；(2) 反馈驱动搜索是否比重复采样在单位成本内产生更多验证过的发现；(3) 受保护的验证能否减少假发现。这些测试用于评估反馈架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 反馈架构而非仅生成能力，是自动科研中的核心瓶颈。将灰盒模糊测试的覆盖引导思想引入自动科研，有望将代理从"重复采样器"转变为"真正的搜索器"，同时通过保护验证数据维护科学发现的可靠性。

title: Towards Expert-level Medical AI for Real-time Video Consultations
